title: Customer Engineer, Korea
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: Seoul</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As the architectural complexity of enterprise solutions scales, we are evolving how we partner with our customers. The Customer Engineer (CE) represents the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted advisor who owns the technical relationship from the initial discovery phase through to long-term adoption and ongoing account expansion.</p> <p>Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to the Regional Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, utilizing AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation:</strong> Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, build bespoke architectures, and deliver compelling product demonstrations and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) across Cloudflare’s portfolio (Security, Networking, Zero Trust and Developer Platforms).</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory:</strong> Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Alignment:</strong> Own the long-term technical relationship across the entire customer lifecycle, ensuring continuous alignment between the customer’s evolving business goals and our product roadmap.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion:</strong> Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. You will be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation:</strong> Act as an "AI-Augmented" engineer. Leverage AI agents and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, and basic telemetry monitoring, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Sales Engineering, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer.</li> <li><strong>Technical Acumen:</strong> Broad technical expertise spanning web security, networking (routing, DNS, DDoS mitigation), cloud infrastructure, and enterprise architecture.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Mindset:</strong> Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Cloudflare Developer Stack Experience:</strong> Hands-on experience building, deploying, or architecting solutions using Cloudflare's developer platform and AI ecosystem, specifically Workers AI and AI Gateway.</li> <li><strong>Applied AI Knowledge:</strong> Experience with prompt engineering, Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.</li> <li><strong>Coding/Scripting:</strong> Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Now is an amazing time to join Nozomi Networks as we build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.</p> <p>We defend some of the world’s largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we’re just getting started. Improvement by tracking enablement adoption, proficiency, readiness, and business impact through leading indicators, sales performance metrics, and actionable insights that refine programs and resources.<br>• Leverage Technology, AI, and Enablement Platforms to optimize the use of AI-powered coaching, conversation intelligence, LMS, CRM, content management platforms, and a scalable source of truth for the revenue organization.<br>• Champion Change Management and Cross-Functional Alignment by driving adoption of new methodologies, processes, tools, messaging, and co-selling practices through stakeholder influence and organizational alignment.<br>• Support Product and Go-to-Market Enablement by partnering with Product, Marketing, and Revenue leadership to prepare the field for launches, competitive differentiation, and evolving market opportunities.</div> <h2>To be successful in this opportunity, you will have:</h2> <div>• 8–10 years of demonstrated experience enabling quota-carrying Enterprise and/or Commercial sales teams in a complex B2B technology environment.<br>• Demonstrated ability to measure program adoption, readiness, behavior change, and relevant title: Principal AI Engineer - AI Tutor
description: <p><strong>About DataCamp</strong></p> <p>DataCamp's mission is to empower everyone with the data and AI skills essential for 21st-century success. By providing practical, engaging learning experiences, DataCamp equips learners and organizations of all sizes to harness the power of data and AI. As a trusted partner to over<strong> 17 million learners</strong> and<strong> 6,000+ companies</strong>, including 80% of the Fortune 1000, DataCamp is leading the charge in addressing the critical data and AI skills shortage.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Research has consistently shown that one-on-one tutoring dramatically outperforms traditional classroom instruction—a finding known as Bloom's 2 Sigma Problem. Despite decades of awareness, no solution has successfully delivered personalized tutoring at scale. Until now.</p> <p>We are building an AI tutoring system designed to emulate and eventually surpass the best human tutors. You will work on the core AI system that delivers real-time, adaptive learning experiences to learners. <strong>If you're excited about building the future of human learning, this role is for you.<span style="text-decoration: underline;"> This role can be done remotely from anyone of the following; United States, United Kingdom, Belgium, Portugal OR UAE</span></strong></p> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <p>At DataCamp, we seek individuals who embody our core values of data-driven decision-making, action, transparency, ownership, and customer focus. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing environment and are driven by a passion for making a meaningful impact. You're adaptable, embracing change and ambiguity with enthusiasm. Your initiative and entrepreneurial spirit push you beyond just meeting targets—you aim to understand the "why" behind our goals and take ownership to drive the business forward. You’re a collaborative team player who values transparency and always seeks to improve and innovate. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build and evolve the core AI tutoring system</strong>, including prompt architectures, agentic workflows, and real-time adaptive behaviors.</li> <li><strong>Run rigorous experimentation and evaluation</strong>, developing custom metrics and frameworks to measure learning effectiveness and improve model reliability.</li> <li><strong>Design and implement scalable, maintainable software</strong>, integrating AI capabilities with platform systems, content pipelines, and user experience components.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate cross-functionally</strong> with educators, content creators, and product teams to translate pedagogical goals into technical solutions.</li> <li><strong>Prototype and productionize novel model interactions</strong>, leveraging emerging research and capabilities to advance the tutor’s intelligence.</li> <li><strong>Ensure quality, safety, and observability</strong> through monitoring, testing, guardrails, and iterative refinement of model behavior.</li> <li><strong>Share knowledge and elevate teammates</strong>, contributing to a culture of clarity, simplicity, and continuous learning.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <h3><strong>Technical</strong></h3> <ul> <li>1+ years building complex LLM-based systems, with strong prompt engineering intuition and experience designing agentic workflows.</li> <li>Ability to design meaningful evaluation methods, including custom metrics and frameworks when off-the-shelf options fall short.</li> <li>Strong software engineering fundamentals, architectural thinking, and fluency in Python; comfortable working with production infrastructure, cloud environments, and CI/CD.</li> <li>Actively follows AI research and emerging capabilities, applying new ideas creatively to real problems.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Product & Pedagogy</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Strong empathy for learners and content creators; able to translate pedagogical goals into system behavior and product decisions.</li> <li>Ability to reason holistically across AI behavior, content structure, platform features, and user experience.</li> <li>Familiarity with learning science or a desire to develop expertise.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Character & Collaboration</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Drawn to difficult, ambiguous problems with no clear blueprint; persistent in exploring and refining solutions.</li> <li>Preference for elegance and simplicity in system design.</li> <li>Communicates clearly across mediums and enjoys mentoring and collaborating in small, high-ownership teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Datacamp? </strong></p> <p>Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you’ll love being on our team:</p> <ul> <li>Exciting challenges: Face new technical challenges daily, keeping your work engaging and rewarding.</li> <li>Competitive compensation: We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits.</li> <li>Flexibility: Benefit from flexible working hours because the future is flexible! </li> <li>Continuous learning: Access a yearly learning budget for conferences & training to support your professional growth.</li> <li>Global retreats: Participate in international company retreats, fostering a global team spirit.</li> <li>Equipment: Yearly refreshment of your IT Equipment budget for your home working setup.</li> <li>Amazing team: Collaborate with a truly exceptional team—seriously, we’re awesome!</li> </ul> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: BITTE KEINE PERSONALVERMITTLER Erobere mit uns gemeinsam Zukunftsmärkte, entdecke neue Technologien und wachse in eine echte Schlüsselrolle mit zukünftiger Führungsverantwortung hinein! title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager
description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. Who we’re looking for Someone who can shape how travellers discover Interrail, whether they’re typing into a search engine or asking an AI assistant to plan their trip. Exploring Europe by rail is one of the most transformative ways to travel, and there’s a big, untapped opportunity to make it even easier. With SEO and GEO, you’ll help travellers get inspired, plan and book their next rail adventure with an Interrail Pass in fewer steps. Also, it’s good to know that the team has agreed to meet in the office every Tuesday and Thursday, so you’ll be expected to be in the office on these days to work side by side with your colleagues. What you’ll be doing You’ll be joining the Growth team (in a nutshell: the people who turn traveller curiosity into journeys booked), reporting to our E-Commerce Lead. You’ll own the end-to-end SEO and GEO strategy, so that Interrail is found, cited and recommended wherever travellers research rail travel in Europe. Working across content, product, engineering and PR/brand, you’ll turn search and AI visibility insight into meaningful, measurable growth. Strategy and leadership Own and scale a unified SEO and GEO strategy and roadmap, aligned to commercial goals across our priority markets. Prioritise investment across markets and languages based on search demand, commercial opportunity and local traveller needs. Be our internal expert on how AI is changing travel discovery, embedding SEO and GEO thinking across marketing, content, PR/brand and product. Partner with engineering, content and product to get the right work prioritised and shipped. Technical SEO and architecture Own technical SEO for our large, complex site and set the technical roadmap with product and content. Lead our SEO architecture: hreflang at scale, domain and subfolder strategy, and localisation quality across languages. Make sure search engines and AI systems can access and understand the site, with the right structured data and clear, consistent information on passes, pricing and eligibility. Own our crawler access policy for AI bots together with legal and engineering, balancing visibility against content protection. GEO Own our GEO strategy and roadmap: how we earn mentions, citations and recommendations across markets and languages. Build our GEO measurement framework, tracking brand presence, citation share, share of voice against competitors and sentiment. Spot recurring inaccuracies in AI-generated answers, fix them at the source with the relevant teams and track whether accuracy improves. Partner with PR, partnerships and social to strengthen the off-site signals AI models rely on, from trusted travel publications to community presence and review platforms. Measure and attribute AI-referred traffic and conversions, and run structured tests to build repeatable GEO playbooks. Assess emerging opportunities, such as AI agents that plan and book travel, and advise on what Interrail needs to be ready. Content and topical authority Shape content strategy and topical authority across destinations, routes, guides and inspiration, balancing discovery with pass and booking intent. Make sure our content performs in both search results and AI answers, with clear factual structure and original rail expertise worth citing. Be the SEO and GEO advisor to the content team, building a shared roadmap that connects visibility opportunity to editorial output. Set and govern content quality standards (briefs, structure, internal linking, E-E-A-T) and upskill the team in SEO and GEO best practice. Identify gaps, cannibalisation and refresh opportunities, and advise on what to create, update, consolidate or retire. Measurement and reporting Forecast organic and AI-driven performance, set KPIs across both, and report clearly to senior stakeholders. What success looks like Non-brand searches make up a growing share of organic traffic and revenue across our priority markets. Who we’re looking for Every Interrail trip starts with a question: "Where should I go in October?", "Can I see the Alps by train?", "How does the Pass actually work?". We're looking for someone who will make sure Interrail is the best answer, wherever it's asked: Google, AI assistants or a paid search ad. You'll write the guides, itineraries and how-tos that bring travellers to us, and the search ads and landing pages that turn their curiosity into a Pass. You'll sit in our Creatives & Content team and work day-to-day with our SEO Specialist, Paid Media, CRO, CRM and UX colleagues. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage. Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. Ceci peut inclure : Concevoir une interface pour ajouter, modifier et réordonner les demandes d'un dossier, chacune avec son montant, son unité de calcul et son ordre Modéliser les dépendances entre demandes (une demande qui ne s'applique que si une autre est refusée par exemple) Calculer et afficher les montants (du coût pour l’employeur au net empoché par le salarié), pour aider l'utilisateur à évaluer les risques Générer automatiquement un document de synthèse clair et structuré, prêt à être intégré dans les conclusions écrites de l'avocat Et d'autres fonctionnalités ! Le ou la stagiaire participera à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit et les juristes) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Jobexit et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise). Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides. Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien. Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc. Nos valeurs 🤝 Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses. Challenge the status quo : n ous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur. Liberty and responsibility : n ous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership. Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume. (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles) Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater ! description: Your Role Als Senior/ Principal Group Accounting Manager (m/w/x) gestaltest Du aktiv Weiterentwicklung unseres IFRS Financial Reportings (Reporting word derzeit von von HGB auf IFRS umgestellt) und bist federführend bei der Erstellung der Konzernabschlüsse nach IFRS. Du arbeitest an der Konsolidierung unserer Konzerngesellschaften, optimierst universelle Finanzprozesse und agierst als Ansprechpartner für externe Wirtschaftsprüfer und Berater. Konsolidierung: Du übernimmst die Konsolidierung aller Konzerngesellschaften (in LucaNet) und treibst die Automatisierung und Verbesserung unserer Prozesse voran. Fundierte Berufserfahrung in einer namhaften Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft (Big4 ist ein Plus) oder im Group Accounting / Konzernrechnungswesen eines internationalen Konzern / Scale-ups. Umfassende Exzellenz und nachgewiesene Expertise in der bilanztechnischen Abbildung von IFRS. Ob Sommer-Events am See oder einfach ein entspannter After-Work-Drink. Wir feiern unsere Meilensteine bei regelmäßigen Teamevents gemeinsam. title: Software Engineer - Dynamics
description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft Orbital is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Dynamics team within Ground Platform. Dynamics computes the timeline of what every spacecraft in our fleet can do and when (contacts with ground stations, links, accesses, unavailability windows) and turns it into schedules: which satellite talks to which ground station, when, and in which order of priority. As our fleet grows, these services need to handle more data, more queries, and harder allocation problems. You’ll bring strong backend engineering to that challenge: making our APIs fast, our databases scale, and our contact allocation and scheduling smarter. No astrodynamics background is needed; you’ll work alongside flight dynamics engineers who bring that expertise. If you enjoy hard performance problems and optimization with real-world constraints, we’d love to hear from you. About this role: Build and optimize our scheduling capabilities: model constraints and objectives, design algorithms and solver-based approaches that produce feasible, high-quality schedules across a growing fleet, and replan quickly when things change Evolve contact allocation (Contact Allocation Framework) to share ground station capacity across satellites and missions Improve the performance of our backend services and APIs: profile, find bottlenecks and cut latency for the timeline and scheduling services that operators and other teams rely on Design and evolve our data layer for large, fast-growing time-based datasets: data modeling, partitioning, indexing, query optimization and retention Shape the architecture of Dynamics services for low latency and scale, in step with the rest of Ground Platform Collaborate with flight dynamics engineers, Mission Platform (Execution & Insights) and satellite operators to turn their needs into reliable, performant software Have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations through SatDevOps rotations, occasionally helping investigate anomalies Must Haves: Solid backend software development experience, in Python Strong algorithmic foundations for scheduling and optimization problems: modeling constraints and objectives, heuristics, and knowing when to reach for a solver Proven track record improving the performance of APIs or backend services (profiling, caching, concurrency, load testing) Strong relational database skills, ideally PostgreSQL: data modeling, indexing, partitioning, reading query plans Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal Nice to Haves: Experience with constraint programming or operations research (e.g. OR-Tools / CP-SAT , MILP solvers), or with scheduling and allocation problems Django and GraphQL (Graphene) Time-series or geospatial data at scale (e.g. TimescaleDB, PostGIS) Kubernetes and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) Interest in space At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes. Who We Are Loft: Space Made Simple. Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit. We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, FeedForward 3D/4D Reconstruction
description: At Parallel Domain, we believe that autonomous systems – from self-driving cars to contactless delivery drones – have the opportunity to drastically improve the quality of life for billions of people. That is why we love what we do: enabling our customers to develop their technology safely using the Parallel Domain data generation platform. Our platform revolutionizes the way our customers generate sensor data for AI development. We're looking for people like you to join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence and synthetic data. About the role Before any physical AI system is trusted in the real world, it has to prove itself in ours. Parallel Domain turns real captured drives into faithful digital replicas — geometry, appearance and motion that perception stacks are trained and validated against. We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to push our feed-forward reconstruction stack forward — from static 3D toward full 4D scenes over time. You will join a small, deep team where your technical judgment carries real weight from day one, and your work will ship in a pipeline customers depend on. What You'll Do Advance our feed-forward reconstruction models . Improve how we predict geometry, camera pose and appearance from real capture with transformer-based models, and extend it from static scenes to dynamic 4D. Train at scale . Run multi-node GPU training on large multi-view and video datasets, and decide what to scale, what to ablate and when a result is real. Define what "good" means . Build evaluation the team trusts for reconstruction quality, temporal consistency and geometric accuracy. Explore stronger priors . Investigate where generative models, such as pre-trained video diffusion, can help fill gaps the capture did not see. Land research in the product . Work with the pipeline engineers to get results into production, and care whether they hold up there. Track the field . This area moves monthly; form a view on where it is heading and argue for it. What we're looking for Hands-on feed-forward reconstruction experience . You have built or trained feedforward 3D reconstruction models (for example in the lineage of DUSt3R, VGGT, π³ or D4RT), and you know where they work and where they break. A track record of models others relied on . We weight demonstrated depth over years served : a recent PhD with the right focus and an experienced research engineer are both credible here. Large-scale trainin g. Practical experience with multi-node, multi-GPU training and telling a promising run from a stalled one early. Strong PyTorch skills in a large shared codebase with real build and CI. Research judgment . title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React
description: ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community. We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research. Objective of the role We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end. Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany. The team You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors. Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment. Responsibilites Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features. Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP. Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure. Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products. Requirements 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable. Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking. Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective. You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output. Knowledge of GraphQL. It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres). What we're looking for You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them. You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment. You focus on building a great product. You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information. The interview process We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry. There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague. We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion. You'll have a conversation with our VP of Product, Mark, and our VP of Engineering, Frank, to learn more about our product and engineering organization and discuss how your experience aligns with our goals. title: Executive & Personal Assistant, Founders’ Office
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Executive & Personal Assistant, Founders’ Office</strong></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> San Francisco, CA or New York, NY (In-office / Hybrid)</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare is seeking an exceptional, highly organized, and discreet <strong>Executive & Personal Assistant</strong> to join our Founders’ Office support team. Based in either <strong>San Francisco</strong> or <strong>New York City</strong>, this role works in close alignment with two Senior Executive Business Partners who manage direct daily support for Cloudflare’s Co-Founders.</p> <p>This is a versatile, high-touch role combining executive administrative support, event coordination, personal projects, and lifestyle logistics. You will provide critical execution capacity behind the scenes—anticipating needs effortlessly, moving between business and personal requests seamlessly, and ensuring every detail is handled with precision, follow-through, and strict confidentiality.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Executive & Founder Support:</strong> Manage executive calendar coordination, meeting logistics, priority tracking, expense reports, and backup support alongside the Senior Executive Business Partners.</li> <li><strong>Travel & Itinerary Planning:</strong> Coordinate domestic and international executive and personal travel, including private aviation charters, luxury lodging, ground transportation, dining arrangements, and detailed door-to-door itineraries.</li> <li><strong>Events & Entertaining:</strong> Plan and execute private dinners, VIP hospitality, and personal events, managing venue sourcing, guest lists, menus, invitations, and on-site vendor logistics.</li> <li><strong>Personal & Lifestyle Support:</strong> Coordinate day-to-day personal logistics, appointments, dining reservations, executive gifting, wellness schedules, and ad-hoc errands.</li> <li><strong>Special Projects:</strong> Assist with special research, bespoke purchasing, prospective property coordination, and vendor oversight for home/office maintenance and seasonal projects.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years of experience supporting C-suite executives, Founders, or UHNW individuals in a combined executive and personal assistant capacity.</li> <li><strong>Core Skills:</strong> Exceptional organization, eagle-eyed attention to detail, and proactive follow-through</li> <li><strong>Travel & Hospitality Expertise:</strong> Deep experience booking, managing, and troubleshooting travel, including private aviation charters and luxury accommodations. You offer a high-touch concierge service.</li> <li><strong>Professional Demeanor:</strong> Personable, polished, and collaborative, adept at partnering seamlessly with internal teams and external vendors, holding firm boundaries, and maintaining complete confidentiality</li> <li><strong>Technical Savvy:</strong> Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace (G-Suite) alongside practical adoption of AI and modern productivity workflows.</li> </ul> <h2><strong style="font-size: 14px;">Compensation</strong></h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites. It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small team with research experience from ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley and MIT, and we are looking for an engineer who wants to bring this technology onto real construction sites and make it work for our customers. Tasks Work directly with our customers – contractors, utilities and surveyors in Switzerland, Germany and Austria – from first site visit to daily use Get field crews up and running with our capture app, on site and remotely Adapt our outputs to each customer's CAD, GIS and documentation standards Write the scripts, integrations and tooling that connect sizeless to customer systems Bring what you learn on site back into the product, together with the engineering team Requirements Solid engineering fundamentals in TypeScript, Python or a comparable language You enjoy working with customers and are comfortable on a construction site Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through Fluent German and English – most of our customers work in German Willingness to travel regularly within Switzerland, Germany and Austria Experience with 3D data, mobile apps or geospatial systems is welcome. We care more that you learn quickly and take details seriously. Benefits Early team member with real ownership – your work ships to paying customers, not a demo Employee stock options: you own part of what you build New office in Zürich Kreis 5 Modern, AI-first toolchain – we invest in whatever makes you faster Work directly with the founders Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Application Engineer Laserscanning & Photogrammetrie – SLAM, Drohnen, BIM, CAD & Vermessung (m/w/x)
description: BITTE KEINE PERSONALVERMITTLER Mach Zukunftstechnologien zu Deinem Projekt und Deiner Expertise! Die Epotronic GmbH ist spezialisiert auf den Vertrieb von Industriedrohnen wie DJI , Roboterhunden von Astrall Dynamics oder Pudu Robotics, sowie hochmodernen Vermessungs - und SLAM -Scannern von EMLID , Matterport, GreenValley oder XGRIDS . Außerdem sind wir Vertragspartner von Bentley Systems , BricsCAD, HESAI und vielen weiteren renommierten Herstellern und Weltmarktführern – ZUKUNFTSSICHERHEIT garantiert! Da viele unserer Kunden aus der Bauwirtschaft unsere Hardware nutzen, um daraus CAD - und BIM-Modelle zu erstellen, fehlt uns genau hier dein Know-how: Wir suchen unser fehlendes Puzzleteil – einen vertriebsstarken Technikexperten, der die Sprache der Bauzeichner und Vermessungsingenieure spricht. Zu unseren Kunden zählen internationale Großkonzerne, die Bundesrepublik, Behörden, Universitäten, aber auch SMEs, KMUs und selbstständige gewerbetreibende. Der Erfolg gehört dir: Lege den Grundstein für ein überdurchschnittliches Einkommen in deinem Wissens- oder Erfahrungsbereich. Unser Umsatz stieg von 2 Mio. € im Jahr 2021 auf 9 Mio. € im Jahr 2023. Wir führen derzeit über 30 Hersteller in unserem Sortiment mit stark steigender Tendenz. Du hast dein Studium in Geodäsie, Geoinformatik oder Geographie abgeschlossen und willst Messtechnik nicht nur aus der Vorlesung kennen? Bei uns hast du jede Woche neue Hardware in der Hand, löst echte Probleme beim Kunden und arbeitest parallel in einem Forschungsprojekt mit. Wir sind ein kleines, eigenfinanziertes Team ohne Investoren im Hintergrund – kurze Wege, viel Verantwortung und ein Arbeitstag, der garantiert nicht langweilig wird. Wenn es dir wichtig ist, deine Tage frei gestalten zu können und mit Menschen zusammenzuarbeiten, auf die du dich täglich freust, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Starke interne Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten Regelmäßige Produktschulungen durch unsere Hersteller Einblicke in einen Geschäftsbereich, der als Datenlieferant für die KI-Industrie gilt Einstieg in den Zukunftsmarkt Robotik Teilnahme an einem stark wachsenden Marktumfeld mit professionellem Wettbewerb Aufgaben - Was erwartet dich? Laserscanning & Photogrammetrie: Du begleitest Kundenprojekte von der Datenerfassung mit Drohnen-LiDAR, mobilen SLAM-Scannern bis zur Auswertung von Punktwolken, Orthofotos und 3D-Modellen. Troubleshooting beim Kunden: Du analysierst technische Probleme remote oder vor Ort und bringst Systeme, Workflows und Daten wieder zum Laufen. Kommunikation mit den Herstellern: Du bist technischer Ansprechpartner für unsere Hersteller, eröffnest und verfolgst Support-Fälle und gibst Feedback aus der Praxis weiter – meist auf Englisch. RMA-Abwicklung: Du kümmerst dich um Reparatur- und Garantiefälle, von der Fehlerdiagnose über die Abstimmung mit dem Hersteller bis zur Rückmeldung an den Kunden. Demos & Schulungen: Du führst Testmessungen und Produktvorführungen durch und unterstützt bei Kundenschulungen, z. B. zu DJI Terra oder LiDAR-Workflows. Vertriebliche Unterstützung: Du berätst Interessenten technisch, bereitest Demodaten auf und begleitest den Vertrieb bei Terminen und auf Messen. Forschungsprojekt: Du arbeitest in einem geförderten Forschungsprojekt mit Hochschulpartnern mit – von der Planung von Messkampagnen bis zu Genauigkeitsanalysen und Dokumentation. Qualifikation - Was solltest du mitbringen? Abgeschlossenes Studium M.Sc. oder Diplom der Geodäsie, Vermessung, Geodäsie, Geoinformatik oder Geomatik, Geospatial Technologies oder Applied Geoinformatics, Geographie mit Schwerpunkt Fernerkundung, GIS oder Photogrammetrie, Vergleichbare Studiengänge, z. B. Bauingenieurwesen mit Vermessungsschwerpunkt Praxishintergrund: Erste praktische Erfahrung mit Laserscanning und/oder Photogrammetrie, z. B. aus Studienprojekten, deiner Abschlussarbeit oder einem Werkstudentenjob Praxishintergrund: Erfahrung mit Laserscanning und/oder Photogrammetrie, z. B. aus Studienprojekten, deiner Abschlussarbeit oder einem Werkstudentenjob Dein Know-how: Sicheres Verständnis von Koordinatensystemen, Georeferenzierung, GNSS/RTK und Genauigkeitsbetrachtungen Routine mit Punktwolken- und GIS-Software (z. B. CloudCompare, QGIS); Skripting-Kenntnisse, etwa in Python, sind ein Plus (Hobby) Drohnenerfahrungen o.ä. sind von Vorteil – alles Weitere bringen wir dir bei. Arbeitsweise: Eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Ruhe beim Troubleshooting und Freude am Kontakt mit Kunden und Herstellern. Offenheit für vertriebliche Themen. Reisebereitschaft für Kundeneinsätze und Führerschein Klasse B Sprachen: Deutsch C2-Niveau und Englisch mindestens C1-Niveau Benefits - Was bieten wir dir? Praxis und Forschung in einem Job: Du arbeitest an echten Kundenprojekten und gleichzeitig wissenschaftlich mit Hochschulpartnern. Zukunftstechnologien: Du arbeitest mit Drohnen, LiDAR-Sensoren und 3D-Scannern der weltweiten Marktführer bevor sie auf dem Markt sind. Du bist die europäische Speerspitze dieser Technologien. Weiterbildung: Interne Einarbeitung und regelmäßige Produktschulungen direkt bei den Herstellern. Verantwortung von Anfang an: Ein kleines Team, kurze Wege und viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Solange Arbeit und Ergebnis stimmen, ist bei uns fast alles möglich. Freiheit & Flexibilität: Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, flexible Gestaltung deiner Arbeitstage (mobiles Arbeiten 1-2 mal wöchentlich) und Kernarbeitszeiten rund um die Mittagspause. Extras: Zusätzliche Urlaubstage, ein leistungsabhängiger Gehaltsbestandteil mit Bonussystem, Fahrzeugpool und Mitarbeiterrabatte. Netzwerk: Du lernst Hersteller, Hochschulen und Kunden aus Bau, Industrie und Behörden kennen und baust dir ein starkes Netzwerk in einer schnell wachsenden Branche auf. Unbegrenztes Potenzial: Ein stark wachsendes Marktumfeld (Umsatzsteigerung von 2 Mio. € auf 9 Mio. € in zwei Jahren) und ein ungedeckeltes, erfolgsorientiertes Gehaltsmodell. Klingt nach deinem nächsten Schritt? Wir brauchen kein Standard-Anschreiben. Schick uns dein CV und eine moderne, schlagfertige Bewerbung (E-Mail / Nachricht) mit mindestens einem starken Argument für deine Kompetenzen oder (d)einer kurzen Vision, wie du (d)ein erstes Projekt bei uns angehen würdest. Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse / Zertifikate hier hochladen oder auf unserer Website Kurze(s) Argument(e) für dich – kein langes Anschreiben Rückfragen telefonisch an Dr. Christoph Hütt unter +49 (0) 211 59892936 oder Tobias Wentzler unter +49 (0) 211 59892931 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Advanced Support Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>NICE Public Safety – Senior Advanced Support Engineer</strong></p> <p>Location: Hedge End, Hampshire – Office Based(5 days in Southampton office)</p> <p><strong>Context and Purpose</strong></p> <p>Here at NICE <a href="https://www.nicepublicsafety.com/">Public Safety</a>, we develop state of the art solutions for the Public Safety market, bringing together voice, video and screen recording, playback and analysis for Security customers worldwide.</p> <p>We are currently expanding our Cloud Platform Engineering team to ensure we continue to offer exemplary service to our customers. As our products and support workloads scale, we are building an AI-first support model, and this role will help shape it.</p> <p><strong>Scope</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Advanced Support Engineer to work with an innovative product launching in an area new to cloud services.</p> <p>The primary focus will be providing expert insight and analysis of complex support and integration issues, escalated by our regional T2/3 support teams. The role is hands-on and requires you to resolve the support cases and tasks raised by our customers from production on our production applications. This role will be required to deliver scripts, tooling, automation, documentation, knowledge articles and guidance to the regional teams to reduce the ongoing effort required to support our products.</p> <p>This is an engineering-minded support role with an AI-first mindset. You will use AI tools and platforms, alongside your own technical judgement, to automate the triage, investigation and resolution of problems raised from the application, and you will help the wider support organisation adopt these ways of working as they evolve.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop subject matter expertise in our core technologies and services.</li> <li>Use tools to pull and effectively analyse logs, traces, and other telemetry to determine the root cause of issues.</li> <li>Provide root cause correction, not just symptom relief. Ensure that all facets of the problem are evaluated to eliminate recurrence of the issue.</li> <li>Design, build and maintain AI-first workflows (using approved AI tools and platforms) that automate the triage, classification, investigation and resolution of issues raised from the application.</li> <li>Apply AI to accelerate log, trace and telemetry analysis, and to draft root cause analyses, knowledge articles and customer updates, always validating AI output before it is acted on. Ensure that any data used is safe, secured and sanitised (removing personal, customer-identifiable and other sensitive information) before it is shared for AI analysis.</li> <li>Automate repetitive support activity through scripts, tooling and process automation, turning recurring issues into self-service or auto-remediating solutions.</li> <li>Identify, document, and report issues with software, design, reliability, and maintenance issues to the relevant teams, ensuring that they are aware of and are addressing customer expectations.</li> <li>Collaborate and help build utilities and tools for internal use that enable you and your fellow Engineers to operate safely at high speed / wide scale.</li> <li>Coach and enable regional T2/3 teams to adopt AI tooling and automation, sharing prompts, patterns and good practice.</li> <li>Measure the impact of automation and AI on time to detection, time to resolution and case volumes, and use the results to keep improving.</li> <li>Work effectively with staff in all areas of the business, escalating when appropriate to management and/or R&D and Cloud Operations.</li> <li>Take ownership of, and resolve, the support cases and tasks raised by our customers from production on our production applications, through to a confirmed resolution. Proactively pull cases from the queue based upon your skills and abilities, and work cases that are increasingly challenging to develop and sharpen your skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Knowledge and experience we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in cloud support, ideally with a software engineering or developer background (for example, previously a software developer, DevOps or SRE engineer, a production or application support engineer who writes production-quality code, or similar experience supporting live production systems).</li> <li>Excellent technical and analytical skills.</li> <li>Experience and in-depth knowledge of data handling and MS SQL.</li> <li>Strong experience of programming or advanced scripting (C#, PowerShell, Python, etc.), including version control, code review and testing practices.</li> <li>Proven experience of automation, either through scripts and tooling or by automating and streamlining support processes (for example, CI/CD pipelines, scheduled jobs, runbook or workflow automation).</li> <li>Hands-on exposure to AI tools and platforms, ideally applied to automating triage, investigation and resolution of application problems (for example, prompt design, agents, tool or API integration, or retrieval over knowledge bases and logs).</li> <li>A strong AI mindset: you embrace AI-driven change, experiment with new tooling, and can critically assess AI output for accuracy, security and data-handling risk, with a clear understanding that data must be safe, secured and sanitised before it is shared for AI analysis.</li> <li>Experience querying API’s (REST, SOAP) and processing the output.</li> <li>Experience working on Production and Test customer systems.</li> <li>Exposure to SOA applications and services.</li> <li>Exposure to commercial cloud providers (Ideally Azure, others considered).</li> <li>Familiarity with observability and telemetry tooling for logs, traces and metrics (desirable).</li> <li>Efficient, effective and respectful communication skills both with customers and within internal departments. Including, <ul> <li>Good listener, able to identify and validate assumptions.</li> <li>Able to use effective questioning to confirm understanding of a customer problem and then provide help to solve it.</li> <li>Methodical troubleshooting, technical skill and attention to detail used in diagnosing problems and reproducing issues in a local environment.</li> <li>Multi-tasking and time-management to prioritise and switch between varied tasks.</li> <li>Curiosity and adaptability: willing to learn quickly, share knowledge, and change how the team works as AI capabilities evolve.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>You must:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be flexible with working hours when needed to address critical or urgent matters.</li> <li>Will require to currently hold, or be eligible for, security clearance (NPVV3 and SC).</li> <li>Be willing to embrace AI and automation as a core part of how Advanced Support works, and to use approved AI tools responsibly in line with NICE security, privacy and customer data-handling requirements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who We Are</strong></p> <p>NICE Public Safety is a software solutions provider specialising in helping public safety agencies round the globe. Our NICE Investigate solution has recently become a significant player in the modernisation of the UK and US justice systems by facilitating digital evidence management and sharing in a cloud service.</p> <p><strong>What The Team Does</strong></p> <p>NICE Investigate is being adopted by an increasing number of public-safety organisations around the globe. As a result, we are expanding our Cloud Platform Engineering team to ensure we continue to offer exemplary service to our customers.</p> <p>Our Cloud Platform Engineering team is responsible for speeding up the time to detection and resolution of issues using tooling, telemetry, data and, increasingly, AI and automation.</p> <p><em>This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive, and you will also perform other reasonable related business duties as assigned by your immediate supervisor and other management as required. We may revise or change job duties as the need arises. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment.</em></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Requisition ID: 12041</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Role Type: </strong>Individual Contributor</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. </em></p> <p><em>Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. </em></p> <p><em>NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Research Scientist 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.</span></p></div><h2>Role</h2> <p>As a Senior 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI Engineer, you will own the development of the geometric and semantic perception stacks that power our physical AI framework. You will design real-time systems that enable our robots to translate unstructured, dynamic 3D environments into structured, queryable world models - seamlessly linking high-level task planners (such as VLM/VLA models) directly to robust, low-level manipulation and grasp policies in Flowstate. </p> <h2>How your work moves the mission forward</h2> <ul> <li>Design and deploy real-time spatial perception and state estimation pipelines using both in-house models like Gemini/Gemma and open source models</li> <li>Build multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating RGB-D, stereo cameras, and IMU data into dense spatial representations (ex: point clouds, neural occupancy grids, or implicit signed distance function fields)</li> <li>Ground high-level semantic concepts into 3D geometric structures. This means building queryable, object-centric 3D scene graphs that map not just where an object is, but what it is, and its relationship to the other objects, and its functional properties</li> <li>Integrate open-vocabulary vision language models (ex: CLiP based visual descriptors, DINOv2) into 3D metric space to allow the robot to reason about natural language instructions (ex: ‘pick up the half-eaten apple and put it in the trash bin’)</li> <li>Develop learning-based spatial models (such as 3D Diffusion Policies) that utilize 3D point clouds to predict continuous grasp poses and trajectories</li> <li>Translate abstract semantic logic into functional affordances (ex: identifying the ‘graspable’ part of a mug versus the ‘containment’ part)</li> <li>Collaborate with eng teams to ensure that stochastic, learned semantic models cleanly map to deterministic safe boundaries on physical hardware</li> <li>Drive data strategies for collecting, labeling, and generating 3D synthetic data </li> </ul> <h2>Skills you will need to be successful</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> PhD (preferred) or Master’s in Robotics, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field—with a focus on Spatial AI, SLAM, or Embodied AI .</li> <li><strong>3D Vision:</strong> Deep mathematical foundations in multi-view geometry, camera calibration, visual-inertial odometry (VIO), and probabilistic state estimation .</li> <li><strong>Modern Deep Learning:</strong> Proven experience training and deploying multimodal architectures (VLMs/VLAs), contrastive learning frameworks, or 3D neural scene representations (NeRFs, Gaussian Splatting)</li> <li><strong>Programming & Systems</strong>: Expert level command of Python (PyTorch)</li> </ul> <h2>Skills that will differentiate your candidacy</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with robotics middleware (ROS2) and real time execution constraints would be a plus</li> <li>Hands-on "battle scars" from deploying onto physical robotic manipulators or mobile platforms</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Intrinsic, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Employment at Intrinsic is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Intrinsic does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. It is Intrinsic’s policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.</p> <p>If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at: ----- Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Test Technician
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing. Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects. WHAT YOU WILL DO Run acceptance and characterization tests across incoming High Temperature Superconducting (HTS) tape, cables, intermediate assemblies, complete plate assemblies, and completed coils, supporting both development and production. Prepare and identify test articles by cutting, soldering, terminating, mounting, and fixturing in accordance with the test plan. Install sensors, voltage taps, feedthroughs and measurement wiring with careful grounding and shielding. Set up and operate dimensional inspection equipment, electrical instruments, high-current supplies, liquid-nitrogen baths, cryostats, cryocooler-based rigs and vacuum systems after training and authorization. Carry out critical-current and n-value measurements, joint-resistance, insulation-resistance and high-voltage insulation tests, plus visual and dimensional checks, using approved methods. Configure data acquisition and check connections, signal quality and instrument settings before each run. Follow test sequences precisely, monitor sample behavior and pause or stop at defined limits or unexpected conditions. Maintain full traceability of sample identity, test configuration, instrument settings, raw data, observations and deviations so that results and setups can be reproduced. Check data for completeness and plausibility, reduce and present results clearly, and compare them with defined acceptance criteria. Record all deviations, escalate suspect results or failures, and obtain approval before changing acceptance criteria. Troubleshoot test setups, wiring, instrumentation, and data acquisition. Distinguish test-article behavior from measurement faults, involving equipment technicians for machinery or rig repairs beyond approved routine care. Keep rigs ready for testing through pre-use checks, calibration-status verification, approved routine care and consumables management. Coordinate servicing and calibration, and recheck the test configuration after maintenance. Commission new fixtures with design and test engineering, and help turn development setups into documented, repeatable operations. Support failure investigations through post-test inspection and, when authorized in an agreed investigation plan, sectioning and other destructive examination. WHO YOU ARE A technical apprenticeship or qualification in electronics, mechatronics, laboratory work or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Hands-on testing, laboratory or measurement experience in an industrial, research or engineering environment. Practical electrical measurement skills. The ability to read engineering drawings and wiring diagrams and work precisely to a formal test procedure. Experience using data-acquisition systems and basic data reduction, with accurate record-keeping and the judgment to question implausible results. A disciplined approach to safety, configuration control and traceability. The ability to work across teams, communicate observations clearly and adapt as hardware and test methods develop. Working English for following procedures, recording results and discussing technical findings. Ln2 Experience Nice to have Experience with superconductoring, high or low temperature, cables or magnets, including critical-current measurements. High-current DC testing or quench detection. Experience with cryogenic testing, liquid nitrogen or helium, cryocoolers or vacuum systems. Specialist low-level instrumentation experience, including voltage taps, feedthroughs, sensor mounting, grounding and shielding. CAD literacy for reviewing or developing test fixtures. Python or LabVIEW for test automation, data handling, and plotting. German language skills. INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) CEO call (30 min) This job would require frequent travels to our office in Villigen ( Zurich, CH) *This role sits at "L3" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.
