title: AI & Data Platform Engineer (GCP) (all levels)
description: Über KnowWay KnowWay entwickelt KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur: Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Wir automatisieren Geschäftsprozesse mit autonomen Agenten, und zwar für Kunden, bei denen Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität Pflicht sind. Wir begleiten unsere Kunden über den gesamten Daten- und KI-Lebenszyklus. Wir sammeln und speichern die Daten, verarbeiten sie mit und für KI, sichern ihre Qualität und integrieren die Ergebnisse in produktive Systeme. Das Projekt Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Wir kennen die gesamte Prozess- und Systemlandschaft des Kunden, arbeiten darin und bauen mehrere Plattformen, auf denen die Fachbereiche ihre Anwendungsfälle betreiben. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel und stehen an unterschiedlichen Punkten zwischen Discovery und Live-Betrieb. Unser Delivery-Team deckt dabei ungewöhnlich viel ab: Business-Analyse und die Definition der eigentlichen Anforderungen, Solution Design, schnelle PoCs und die Produktivsetzung. Wo es passt, verwenden wir vorhandene Plattform-Capabilities wieder, und wo etwas fehlt, entwickeln wir es neu. Der Stack läuft bereits produktiv. Dazu gehören LLM-Extraktionspipelines über einen gemanagten AI-Service mit vorgeschaltetem Compliance-Proxy, agentische Systeme mit Vector Search, Batch-Verarbeitung und Orchestrierung, ein zentrales Data Warehouse und containerisierte Services. Die Infrastruktur ist komplett als Code beschrieben und läuft in einer streng abgeschotteten Umgebung mit mehreren Freigabestufen. Auf der Roadmap stehen unter anderem der Umbau des Query-Layers, die Anbindung von On-Premise-Systemen an Cloud-Worker und die Integration weiterer Quellsysteme. Die Rolle Du arbeitest mit uns dort, wo Datenpipelines, KI-Modelle und Cloud-Infrastruktur zusammenkommen. Gemeinsam mit dem Team sorgst Du dafür, dass das Ergebnis im Produktivbetrieb zuverlässig läuft, und übernimmst dabei nach und nach mehr Verantwortung. Jeder Schritt soll nachvollziehbar, überwacht und wartbar bleiben, auch wenn sich Datenmengen, Dokumentqualität oder Anforderungen ändern. Zwei Wege in diese Rolle Der Stack reicht von der Infrastruktur über Datenpipelines bis zu LLM- und Agentensystemen. Niemand bringt das alles auf Expertenniveau mit, deshalb beschreiben wir zwei Profile mit jeweils anderen Entwicklungsperspektiven. Wenn Du einen Schwerpunkt und die Bereitschaft hast, auch in die andere Richtung mitzudenken, dann ist die Rolle die Richtige für Dich. Profil A - Platform-Schwerpunkt : Deine Erfahrung liegt vor allem in GCP/Cloud-Infrastruktur, Infrastructure as Code und Deployment. Daten- und AI-Pipelines willst Du so weit verstehen, dass Du sie betreiben und debuggen kannst. Profil B - AI & Data-Schwerpunkt : Deine Erfahrung liegt vor allem in AI Engineering, LLM- und Datenpipelines und in Datenmodellierung. Die Infrastruktur darunter willst Du so weit verstehen, dass Du selbst deployen und Probleme bis in die Plattform verfolgen kannst. In der Rolle entwickelst Du Dich jeweils in die andere Richtung: Mit Profil A arbeitest Du Dich zunehmend in AI- und Datenthemen ein, mit Profil B in Infrastruktur und Plattform. Wir planen das bewusst ein, und Du übernimmst auf der anderen Seite nach und nach mehr Aufgaben. Die Rolle passt auch für Junior- und Mid-Level-Engineers. Wichtiger als viele Jahre Erfahrung ist uns, dass Du in einem der beiden Bereiche schon praktisch gearbeitet hast und Lust hast, Dich in den anderen einzuarbeiten. Die Anforderungen unten "für beide Profile“ + das A oder B-Profil sind das Minimum, mit dem Du einsteigen kannst. Wer mehr mitbringt, steigt entsprechend höher ein. Deine Aufgaben Die Listen beschreiben das Spektrum des Teams. Wie viel davon Du am Anfang übernimmst, hängt von Deiner Erfahrung ab. Gemeinsamer Kern: Entwicklung und Betrieb von Datenpipelines auf GCP: Batch-Verarbeitung, Orchestrierung, Beladung der Datenplattform Anbindung neuer Datenquellen. Jede Quelle hat ihre eigenen Eigenheiten, deshalb lässt sich eine Anbindung selten einfach auf die nächste übertragen. Fehlersuche über die gesamte Kette, von der Quelldatei über Pipeline und Modell bis in die Anwendung Zusammenarbeit mit den Plattform-Teams des Kunden und Begleitung der technischen Freigabeprozesse Enge Abstimmung mit unserem Solution Architect zu Datenmodell und Architektur Schwerpunkt Platform: Aufbau und Pflege der Infrastruktur mit Terraform, über mehrere Umgebungen und Freigabestufen CI/CD-Pipelines, Deployment-Automatisierung, Container-Builds und Vulnerability-Gates Netzwerk, IAM, Secret-Management, Verschlüsselung und Zugriffskonzepte Logging, Monitoring und Alerting für Pipelines und Anwendungen Kostenkontrolle und Ressourcendimensionierung Schwerpunkt AI & Data: Entwicklung von LLM-Extraktionspipelines: Segmentierung und Klassifikation von Dokumenten, prompt-basierte Extraktion, Schema-Validierung, Upsert in die Datenplattform Extraktionsgenauigkeit bewerten und verbessern, auf Basis belastbarer Messungen Agentische Systeme und RAG: Multi-Agent-Architekturen, Embeddings, Vector Search, Evaluierung von Tool-Auswahl und Antwortqualität Datenmodellierung und Migration: Schema-Design, Historisierung, Umbau des Query-Layers von BigQuery nach Postgres Datenqualität als eigenes Arbeitsfeld Was Du mitbringst Für beide Profile: Mindestens etwa ein Jahr Berufserfahrung mit Datenpipelines, Cloud-Infrastruktur oder KI-Systemen. Eine längere Werkstudententätigkeit in einem Engineering-Team zählt auch. Idealerweise lief davon schon etwas in Produktion und nicht nur in Notebooks oder Proof-of-Concepts. Gute Python-Kenntnisse und solides SQL. Erfahrung mit GCP oder einer anderen Cloud wie AWS oder Azure. Kommst Du nicht von GCP, traust Du Dir zu, Dein Wissen schnell zu übertragen. Du arbeitest mit Git und Code Review und hast CI/CD schon in der Praxis genutzt. Du bleibst an einem Problem dran, bis Du verstehst, was passiert, auch wenn die Ursache drei Systemgrenzen weiter liegt. Deutsch und Englisch mindestens fließend. Unser Team arbeitet in beiden Sprachen, die Dokumentation der Fachbereiche ist auf Deutsch. Profil A (Platform): In mehreren dieser Punkte hast Du schon Erfahrung: Terraform oder ein vergleichbares IaC-Werkzeug GCP-Kernservices oder ihre Pendants bei anderen Clouds: Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, IAM, Networking, Secret Management CI/CD-Pipelines und Container-Builds Logging, Monitoring und Alerting in der Cloud Interesse an Daten- und AI-Pipelines: Du willst lernen, sie zu betreiben, zu debuggen und zu erweitern Profil B (AI & Data): In mehreren dieser Punkte hast Du schon Erfahrung: LLM-Anwendungen gebaut, etwa für Extraktion aus unstrukturierten Dokumenten, mit strukturierten Ausgaben, Schema-Validierung und Prompt-Design Du kennst die Grenzen von LLMs, etwa Nicht-Determinismus, Halluzination und Datenqualität als limitierenden Faktor, und Du misst die Genauigkeit Deiner Ergebnisse. Datenpipelines und Datenmodellierung: BigQuery oder ein vergleichbares Warehouse, Orchestrierung, Schema-Design Interesse an der Infrastruktur darunter: Du willst lernen, selbst zu deployen und Probleme bis in die Plattform zu verfolgen Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit Gemini/Vertex AI, Document AI oder vergleichbaren Cloud-AI-Diensten Erfahrung mit Agenten-Frameworks (Google ADK, LangChain o. Ä.), Vector Search und RAG-Evaluierung Erfahrung mit Dataflow/Apache Beam, Composer/Airflow oder Kubeflow/KFP Erfahrung mit Data-Warehouse-Migrationen und Historisierungsmustern (SCD-2) Erfahrung mit Django/DRF Erfahrung mit OCR-Verarbeitung und schwankender Dokumentenqualität Erfahrung in regulierten oder governance-lastigen Enterprise-Umgebungen, etwa mit Security-Assessments, Datenschutz-Prüfungen und Verschlüsselungskonzepten Du setzt AI-Coding-Tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot o. Ä.) aktiv ein und hast einen eigenen Workflow, mit dem Du ihre Ergebnisse prüfst Branchenkenntnisse in Telekommunikation, Infrastruktur oder Rechnungsprüfung Wie wir Dich einarbeiten Du bekommst eine feste Ansprechperson im Team und startest mit einem abgegrenzten Teil, zum Beispiel einer Pipeline oder einem Modul. Code Reviews und Pairing mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen sind dabei Dein wichtigster Lernweg. So arbeiten wir mit KI Wir versuchen, KI in jedes Asset einzubauen, an dem wir arbeiten. Dabei prüfen wir jedes Mal, wo sie hilft, ob sie überhaupt hilft, ob ihr Einsatz compliant ist und wie man sie richtig einsetzt. Das gehört bei uns zur täglichen Routine und sollte auch zu Deiner werden. Was wir bieten Gehalt zwischen 60.000 und 80.000 Euro brutto im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung Erfolgsbeteiligung Betriebliche Weiterbildung Firmenevents und Company Offsites Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice Ein Stack, der in Produktion läuft und den Du substanziell weiterentwickeln kannst, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten Standort Du arbeitest überwiegend im Homeoffice. Einmal pro Woche treffen wir uns als Team im Ruhrgebiet, im Wechsel in Duisburg und Dortmund, und einmal im Monat beim Kunden in Düsseldorf. Damit das gut machbar bleibt, sollte Dein Wohnort höchstens etwa 1,5 Stunden Fahrzeit von Dortmund oder Duisburg entfernt sein. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Engineering Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Mexico City, Mexico</strong></h3> <h3><strong>What you’ll do as a Customer Engineering Manager</strong></h3> <p>As a SE Manager for Cloudflare for the LATAM Markets  you will be responsible for managing a cross functional, full sales life cycle and technical activities for Cloudflare customers. When hiring we look for diversity of experience combined with genuine curiosity for our technology.</p> <p>Ultimately, you are passionate about technology and people, and have the ability to explain complex technical concepts in easy-to-understand terms, and you like coaching and teaching. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Robot Learning Engineer, Human Motion Data (m/f/d)
description: About EASE EASE builds active, AI-powered exoskeletons for logistics and manufacturing. As a TUM spin-off, we have just started series production, and paid pilots with well-known logistics companies have led to first purchase orders. Our goal: move every parcel better, manually with an exoskeleton or autonomously with a robot. The role Our exoskeletons are deployed in real warehouses and production plants and capture what video-only datasets miss: body pose, joint kinematics, interaction torques, vision, and hand forces from real human work. Your job is to turn that data into skills our humanoid can actually perform, so that human workers and robots can work side by side on the same tasks. What you'll do Map human motion onto humanoid kinematics and close the embodiment gap Train manipulation and whole-body policies with imitation and reinforcement learning Evaluate in Isaac Lab or MuJoCo and on our in-house humanoid, and measure the value of our data Define what data training needs and help build our training setup, including GPU compute Turn new research on robot foundation models and VLAs into prototypes What you bring Master's or PhD in robotics, CS, ML or similar, with hands-on experience from industry or research Imitation or reinforcement learning on real robots (e.g. Diffusion Policy, ACT, PPO) Strong Python and PyTorch; C++ is a plus Physics simulation and sim-to-real transfer Solid kinematics, dynamics and control Nice to have Learning from human data (egocentric video, motion capture, retargeting) Humanoids, legged robots or exoskeletons; publications at CoRL, RSS, ICRA or NeurIPS Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. What you have built matters more than a perfect match. What we offer Data almost nobody else has, from a product in series deployment Our own humanoid and the chance to build Physical AI at EASE from the ground up Competitive salary plus virtual stock options (VSOP) Flexible hours, hybrid in Munich, mobility benefit Budget for conferences and further training How to apply Send your CV with links to GitHub, papers or robot videos. Martin Fleischer, CEO & Co-Founder EASE is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants need a valid work permit for the EU. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Site Reliability Engineer  - AI Assisted Platform (OPCP) (m/f/d)
description: At our company, it's all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH. As a leading tech company, we've been working for over two decades to reduce our environmental footprint - with innovative solutions and an open cloud designed to be sustainable from the ground up: #SustainableByDesign. Within our #OneTeam, you'll shape the automation-first framework that lets every product team ship securely and at speed on top of OPCP, our On-Prem Cloud Platform. Our Tech Stack 🚀 · Kubernetes · GitOps · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Ansible · Terraform · OpenStack · Linux · CI/CD · Python · Bash · Go · Observability (Metrics, Logs, Traces) · LLMs · Agentic Coding Tooling Your Role💻 As a Site Reliability Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of platform engineering, AI-driven tooling and security by design. Together with your team, you'll build the framework to package and deploy software solutions on top of OPCP - turning vague product ideas into repeatable, observable and self-healing services. We are investing in this direction as a structural part of our engineering practice and are looking for teammates who already work this way – not because it is trendy, but because they have seen it compound their own output. Your Tasks Design, build and maintain the Cloud Store packaging framework that standardizes how software is delivered on OPCP. Extend and evolve the AI substrate - LLM-driven code assistants, knowledge-base retrieval and agentic coding hooks - that amplifies our engineering output. Create and curate agentic coding environments : custom agents and sub-agents, slash commands, hooks and prompt engineering pipelines that become everyday developer tools. Own the knowledge-base layer that powers AI-driven incident response, design assistance and runbook generation. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. The team moves quickly and works closely with teams across Cloudflare.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>You will be Chief of Staff to the head of ETI, working alongside the product managers and engineering leaders on each bet. Drive decisions and plans to closure, follow through on what is owed, and prep and close out the big moments such as planning cycles, onsites, and key forums. The teams will trust you to help set priorities across the group and to own new projects or dependencies. You will partner with the executive assistant, who handles booking, expenses, and logistics, while you help prioritize the calendar.</p> <p><strong>Research and Analysis: </strong>Get into the details with the teams: research and analysis, solving problems, and producing the docs and materials the head of ETI needs while keeping them human. You will be a real sounding board, with useful commentary and feedback.</p> <p><strong>Communications: </strong>Help ETI tell its story, internally and, with the Communications team, externally. Own the presentations and materials ETI shares, including retrospectives and celebrations, and help the product, engineering, and marketing teams get the inputs they need to tell specific stories.</p> <h2>Who you are</h2> <p>A suitable candidate gets into the details and understands them while keeping the high-level view, figures out ways to make things work, and communicates with grace and empathy inside and outside of Cloudflare. You work independently and ask for help when you need it. You solve thorny problems by getting to first principles and then aligning the team on the goal; executing, learning, and adapting.</p> <ul> <li>Gets into the weeds and really understands the details, while keeping the high-level perspective</li> <li>Systems minded: thinks through dependencies and how the pieces fit together</li> <li>High agency: figures out ways to make things work</li> <li>Deeply curious: wants to know how and why the world works and is always learning</li> <li>Learns enough about how the Internet, crypto, and business work to give useful insight and make decisions on their own</li> <li>Builds well with LLMs, even if not a developer, shown by clear communication, structured thinking, and ownership of tasks</li> <li>Works comfortably with senior leaders and handles confidential information with discretion</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>A high degree of attention to detail</li> <li>The ability to work in a fast-moving and ever-changing environment</li> <li>A desire to receive feedback and grow</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_ee1e331a02991da7" class="markdown markdown-main-panel md-content enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color tutor-markdown-rendering"> <div class="first-token"><strong class="" data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Application Deadline:</strong> February 21, 2027</div> <h3 data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p id="p-rc_fd65bd246204b359-19" data-path-to-node="2,1,0"><span data-path-to-node="2,1,0,0">For SF, SJ, and Bay Area Metro based hires: Estimated annual salary of $216,000 - Your mission will be to empower customers by making their telemetry discoverable and actionable in one place. </p> <p>The team is international and distributed, they move fast and are deeply attuned to customer feedback. They bring a deep range of observability experience from major companies and fast-moving startups. This is a deeply cross-functional role that will need to understand the nuances of monitoring some of our most complex and high volume primitives such as Workers, Workers for Platforms, Agents, and Durable Objects. This is a high-visibility role that will be directly interfacing with some of our biggest customers.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li> <p>Deliver excellent customer outcomes above all else. Build the right thing at the right time.</li> <li> <p>Building an observability platform for the current AI driven ecosystem. Agents empower new types of platforms capabilities even as they require new types of observability.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own the operational aspects of your platform such as SLOs, incident response, customer escalations, and technical debt. Reliability is its own feature.</p> </li> <li> <p>Recruit, mentor, and grow engineers. Preferably in observability, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, edge/proxy systems, or high-scale APIs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Significant technical depth, with the ability to guide architectural discussions, make credible technical decisions, review designs, and unblock your team.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong developer tools taste. You have used and built enough observability products to know what makes them delightful or painful.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, and develop senior engineers, and to build high-performing, inclusive teams that ship. You care about teams and team culture.</p> </li> <li> <p>A hands-on approach to leadership: you consider yourself a builder, stay close to the code, know the numbers, know the customer, and know what to build next.</p> </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points </strong></h4> <ul> <li> <p>Working on hosted customer-facing observability products</p> </li> <li> <p>Instrumenting observability in global-scale, production environments </p> </li> <li> <p>Implementing observability (OTLP, OLAP databases such as Clickhouse, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Kibana, etc)</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building with Cloudflare’s Developer Platform and have opinions on where we could improve, especially with respect to observability.</p> </li> </ul> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For NY-based hires: Estimated annual salary of $220,000 - $303,000</li> <li>For Portugal-based hires: Estimated annual salary of €89,000 - €122,000</li> </ul> <h4>Equity</h4> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h4>Benefits</h4> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. title: Client Success Manager - Netherlands
description: We are the platform turning browsing into shopping . We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands. We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases. In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia. Ready to spark your growth with us? WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄 We’re expanding into the Netherlands – and you could be one of our very first team members! We are looking for a Client Success Manager who combines hands-on campaign expertise , outstanding client communication , and an AI-first mindset . This is a highly client-facing role : you will work closely with our Performance and Paid Marketing teams, who handle most of the set-up and monitoring, and be ready to set up campaigns end-to-end and optimize them where needed and, above all, be the trusted point of contact for our clients throughout the whole campaign journey. You will own the operational execution and performance success of digital campaigns for our clients in the Netherlands, from the internal and client kickoff through optimization to periodic performance evaluations. The role goes well beyond campaign set-up: you will keep clients informed proactively , turn performance data into clear and convincing stories, and use AI , to work smarter, faster and with better insights. Your work directly impacts campaign performance, client satisfaction, and long-term customer partnerships. WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄 Client Communication & Relationship Management Be the main point of contact for your clients: communicate consistently and proactively about progress, results and next steps Run periodic evaluations with the client, translating performance into clear insights and recommendations Build trusted, long-term relationships and translate client objectives into effective, measurable campaign strategies Campaign Set-up & Coordination Lead the internal and client kickoffs, coordinate content with all stakeholders and supervise the respective Performance and Paid Marketing teams in setting up campaigns, stepping in to do the full set-up yourself when necessary Collaborate closely with Sales, Client teams and internal stakeholders to ensure campaign success and delivery on time Optimization & Performance Optimize campaigns where needed, turning data into concrete actions to achieve the best possible results for the client Monitor and analyze performance, and manage campaign tracking, reporting and performance dashboards across formats, in coordination with the Performance and Paid Marketing teams Reports, Presentations & Sales Support Create reports and presentations for your clients, from regular performance updates to periodic evaluations Support the Sales team in creating decks for their proposals AI-Powered Ways of Working Use AI tools, in particular Claude, to generate reports and presentations, analyze performance and streamline your daily workflow Identify opportunities to improve and scale campaign processes through AI and automation Collaboration & Administration Work closely with international colleagues, with English as the language of collaboration Handle client invoicing WHAT YOU WILL NEED 🪄 Experience: 2–5 years in digital marketing, campaign management, or account management, ideally in an agency or international environment. Client Communication: Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach. You feel at ease being the main point of contact, translating data into clear insights and building trusted relationships. AI Proficiency: Confident in using AI in your daily work, in particular Claude for generating reports and insights, and curious to keep exploring new ways to work smarter. Coordination & Organization: Strong coordination skills, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines and stakeholders at once. Optimization & Data Mindset: Curious about data, with a drive to achieve the best results for the client and the ability to make data-driven decisions. Digital Expertise: Strong knowledge of digital channels, trends, and tools (CRM systems like HubSpot, analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, Looker; display advertising platforms; Meta Business Suite). Excel or similar skills (Pivot tables) are a must. Campaign Knowledge: Proven experience managing multi-channel campaigns, understanding KPIs, and optimizing performance. Languages: Native-level Dutch and fluent spoken English. WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY 🤗 🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company 🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment 🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work 📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions 🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups 🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks 💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are 🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices WHO WE ARE 💜 We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. title: Research Scientist Intern (PhD) - Cohort '27
description: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level. We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years. About the role You’ll join our research team for a 4 to 6 month internship, in the cohort that starts in May 2027. The work is hands-on, with tabular foundation models, a new class of AI model, and how they’re applied. We have more open research problems than people to work on them, and you’ll get a project matched to your interests and expertise, with the chance to publish the results. Some of the problems we’re working on: Scaling model architectures and training Models that read text and tables together Architectures for time series, forecasting and anomaly detection Faster training and inference Causal reasoning in foundation models Learning across multiple related tables Benchmarks that show where tabular foundation models work and where they break, in science and in industry What we’re looking for You’re doing a PhD in computer science, applied maths, statistics, electrical engineering or a related field. You have at least one first-author or shared-first-author paper at a top venue such as NeurIPS, ICML or ICLR. You've turned your own research ideas into working experiments, for example in PyTorch, and you can tell when code is quietly wrong, whether you or a coding agent wrote it. You can join us in Freiburg or Berlin from May 2027 for 4 to 6 months. Experience with data science for tabular data or time series data is a plus Mentorship at Prior Labs Your mentor will be one of the researchers building TabPFN, who’ll help you with the technical side of your project and with your development as a researcher. Before you accept, we agree on a project area and a mentor with you, so you know what you’re working on and who you’re working with from day one. During the internship you’ll also work alongside the rest of our research and data science teams. Onshape is a plus) You've applied design for manufacturing and design for cost, and cut cost through design: fewer parts, standard parts At least two years of mentoring or technically guiding other engineers; title: Produktionsmitarbeiter  (m/w/d)
description: Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen. Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen. Die Rolle In unserer Eigenproduktion bauen wir die Komponenten vor, die unsere Installationsteams beim Kunden direkt einsetzen: hydraulische Cubes und elektrische Unterverteilungen für die Wärmepumpe. Je besser sie vorgefertigt sind, desto schneller und sauberer läuft die Installation vor Ort. Cubes sind unsere vormontierten Hydraulikmodule, die alle wesentlichen Komponenten für den Heizkreis kompakt in einem Gehäuse bündeln. Wir fertigen sie in mehreren Varianten für unterschiedliche Wärmepumpen und Einbausituationen. Unterverteilungen sind die elektrischen Verteiler, über die die Wärmepumpe abgesichert und angeschlossen wird. Sie werden nach Plan in Standardvarianten je Geräteserie und Leistungsklasse aufgebaut. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Produktionsteam innerhalb von Supply Chain, eng verzahnt mit Lager, Kommissionierung und Einkauf. Die Produktion wächst mit unseren Installationszahlen und zieht 2027 in unser neues Hauptlager in Ludwigsfelde. Deine Aufgaben Montage von Cubes: Rahmen aus Aluprofilen aufbauen, Komponenten einsetzen, Verrohrung in Edelstahl-Pressfitting und Gewinde herstellen, Verkleidung montieren. Aufbau und Verdrahtung von Unterverteilungen nach Bestückungsplan, Stückliste und Stromlaufplan, inklusive Beschriftung der Betriebsmittel. Qualitätsprüfung vor Auslieferung: Dichtheitsprüfung der Cubes, Sicht- und Funktionsprüfung der Unterverteilungen, Dokumentation der Prüfergebnisse. Vorbereitung von Material für die Produktion, z. B. Kabel ablängen, Anschlusssets zusammenstellen, Rohre zuschneiden. Übergabe fertiger Cubes und Unterverteilungen in die Projektkommissionierung, termingerecht zur geplanten Installation. Pflege der Materialbestände am Arbeitsplatz und frühzeitige Meldung von Fehlmengen an Lager und Einkauf. Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Varianten und Arbeitsabläufe: Rückmeldung aus der Montage zu Stücklisten, Bauteilen und Prozessen. Ordnung, Sauberkeit und Arbeitssicherheit in deinem Produktionsbereich. Dein Profil Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker:in für Energie- und Gebäudetechnik, Anlagenmechaniker:in SHK, Mechatroniker:in oder vergleichbare Qualifikation. Erfahrung in Montage, Verdrahtung oder Rohrinstallation, idealerweise im Schaltschrank-/Verteilerbau oder in der Heizungstechnik. Du liest Stromlaufpläne, Bestückungspläne und Stücklisten sicher und setzt sie genau um. Handwerkliches Geschick und sauberer Umgang mit Werkzeug, z. B. Pressmaschine, Crimpzange, Abisolierwerkzeug. Von Vorteil: Qualifikation als Elektrofachkraft, Erfahrung mit Prüfungen nach DIN VDE 0100-600 bzw. DIN EN 61439 oder Grundkenntnisse zu Wärmepumpen-Hydraulik. Gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. B2), um Arbeitsanweisungen und Pläne sicher zu verstehen. Benefits Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden und profitablen Climate-Tech-Startups. Attraktive und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung. Feste Arbeitszeiten ohne Montage- und Reisetätigkeit. Strukturierte Einarbeitung in unsere Cube- und Unterverteilungsvarianten. Individuelle Benefits, abgestimmt auf deine Bedürfnisse, z. B. Sportmitgliedschaften, ÖPNV-Ticket oder Learning Budget. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Named Account Executive, New Business
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Available Locations</span></h2> <hr> <p>Munich, Frankfurt or Berlin</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">About the Role</span></h2> <hr> <p>We are seeking an exceptional new-logo builder to join our <strong>Named Sales Team</strong> as a <strong>Senior Named Account Executive</strong>. Your primary mission is new logo acquisition within an assigned portfolio of high-potential Named accounts: identifying, pursuing, and closing net-new business with leading enterprises across Germany. You will create opportunities where no existing relationship or active buying process exists, open doors at executive level, and establish Cloudflare as a long-term platform partner. Developing and expanding a limited number of existing Named accounts will be secondary to winning new business. The ideal candidate combines a relentless prospecting mindset with sophisticated enterprise sales execution, executive presence, and genuine technical fluency, enabling credible engagement from the boardroom to CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Infrastructure.</p> <p>As a Senior Named Account Executive, you will own your territory and assigned Named-account portfolio end-to-end. You will prioritise accounts based on their potential, build multi-year account plans, generate high-quality pipeline through direct outreach and the wider partner ecosystem, and orchestrate virtual deal teams across Customer Engineering, Product, Deal Desk, Legal, and Partners. You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, challenge customers’ thinking with a strong point of view, and consistently exceed new logo and new business targets. In line with Cloudflare’s AI-native culture, you will actively leverage AI tools across prospect research, account prioritisation, executive outreach, account planning, meeting preparation, and pipeline management—using them as a genuine force multiplier in how you hunt and sell.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Responsibilities</span></h2> <hr> <p><strong>New Logo Acquisition within Named Accounts:</strong> Own the identification, pursuit, and closure of net-new business across your assigned Named-account portfolio as the primary focus of the role. Build pipeline proactively through personalised executive outreach, disciplined prospecting, ecosystem engagement, partner channels, industry networks, and referrals. Create demand rather than relying on inbound opportunities, and consistently bring significant new logos onto the Cloudflare platform.</p> <p><strong>Named Account Planning:</strong> Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year account plans for priority net-new targets and selected existing Named accounts. Identify whitespace, business initiatives, power structures, buying processes, competitive dynamics, and potential entry points. Continuously assess account potential and concentrate time and resources on the accounts and opportunities with the greatest potential for platform-wide adoption.</p> <p><strong>Executive Relationship Management:</strong> Build trusted relationships at CISO, CIO, CTO, and board level, often starting without an existing Cloudflare presence. Develop broad, multi-threaded executive networks within target Named accounts and act as a trusted advisor by bringing relevant market insight, a compelling point of view, and clear business value—not simply responding to RFPs.</p> <p><strong>Complex Sales Cycle Leadership:</strong> Lead sophisticated enterprise sales processes from initial engagement through contract signature. Navigate technical, security, legal, procurement, financial, and executive buying centres simultaneously. Establish clear mutual action plans, maintain control of deal momentum, qualification, and next steps, and advance opportunities with precision and appropriate urgency.</p> <p><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a thorough understanding of each prospect’s technology environment, including cloud strategy, network architecture, security posture, application landscape, data sovereignty, regulatory requirements, and AI infrastructure. Map Cloudflare’s platform capabilities to these environments through relevant Reference Architectures, positioning comprehensive platform adoption rather than isolated point solutions.</p> <p><strong>Virtual Deal Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of Customer Engineers, Product Managers, Deal Desk, Legal, Partners, and other specialists to win complex, high-value opportunities. Align resources around a differentiated strategy, proactively remove blockers, and deliver a consistently excellent prospect experience throughout the sales cycle.</p> <p><strong>AI-Powered Sales Execution:</strong> Use AI tools deliberately and consistently to improve the quality and velocity of your sales execution. Apply them to account research and prioritisation, hypothesis development, stakeholder mapping, personalised executive outreach, meeting preparation, competitive analysis, pipeline inspection, and follow-up. Continuously experiment with new ways to make your Named-account management and customer engagement sharper and more effective.</p> <p><strong>Digital Transformation & AI Positioning:</strong> Serve as a credible partner to enterprises navigating digital, cloud, security, and AI-driven transformation. Understand how AI adoption is reshaping infrastructure, compliance, security, and competitive dynamics. Position Cloudflare capabilities—including AI Gateway, Workers AI, and Zero Trust for AI workloads—as strategic enablers of customers’ long-term transformation agendas.</p> <p><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Build and maintain sufficient high-quality pipeline across your Named-account portfolio to consistently achieve ambitious new business targets. Deliver accurate, evidence-based account and opportunity forecasts to sales leadership, with clear visibility into qualification, deal status, risks, stakeholder alignment, and required actions. Apply rigorous inspection and honest judgement across long and complex enterprise sales cycles.</p> <p><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Lead complex commercial and contractual negotiations with confidence and discipline. Construct compelling, outcome-linked value propositions tied directly to each customer’s business objectives. Secure commercially strong, sustainable agreements while protecting long-term customer value and Cloudflare’s position as a strategic platform partner.</p> <p><strong>Trusted Advisor & Organisational Contribution:</strong> Share field intelligence, competitive insight, and winning practices openly across the German and wider international teams. Contribute to Cloudflare’s understanding of the German Named-account market, partner with colleagues to improve execution, and elevate the performance of those around you through coaching, collaboration, and example.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li><strong>8+ years of within assigned account portfolios, including disciplined prospecting, executive outreach, account-based selling, and effective use of partners and industry networks to access senior decision-makers.</li> <li>Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security (Zero Trust, SASE, SSE), Connectivity, Developer Platforms, and Edge Computing, with the ability to engage credibly with CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and senior infrastructure leaders.</li> <li>Proven ability to understand complex enterprise IT architectures and map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures, connecting title: Payment Operations Manager (w/m/x)
description: Über Patronus Patronus entwickelt intelligente Notruf-Technologie, die Senior*innen mehr Sicherheit und Unabhängigkeit im Alltag gibt. Was uns als Team ausmacht: Echte Ownership statt Abarbeiten, schnelle Umsetzung und offene Kommunikation. Wir sind ein bisschen nerdy, wenn es um saubere Prozesse und gute Daten geht – und mindestens genauso begeistert, wenn ein Problem endlich an der Wurzel gelöst ist. Wenn es dir genauso geht, bist du bei uns richtig! Deine Mission Du verantwortest die Abrechnung mit Pflegekassen End-to-End – vom Antrag auf Kostenübernahme bis zum Zahlungseingang – und packst dabei selbst operativ mit an. Du steuerst unseren Abrechnungsdienstleister sowie weitere externe Partner und treibst offene Themen mit ihnen und den Kassen konsequent bis zum Ergebnis. Du prüfst Abrechnungs- und Zahlungsdaten, erkennst Auffälligkeiten und finanzielle Risiken früh und machst Zahlen und Prozesse mit einem aussagekräftigen Reporting transparent. Du löst nicht nur Einzelfälle, sondern erkennst Muster, behebst Ursachen und baust Abläufe so auf, dass sie dokumentiert, skalierbar und wo sinnvoll automatisiert sind. Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie sich unsere Abrechnung in Zukunft aufstellt – nicht nur auf dem Papier, sondern auch in der Umsetzung. Dein Talent Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Operations, Prozessmanagement, FinOps, Partnermanagement oder Abrechnungsmanagement mit, idealerweise im Healthcare- oder Tech-Umfeld. Du hast nachweislich Prozesse von Grund auf aufgebaut und externe Dienstleister gesteuert. Du bist proaktiv, übernimmst Ownership, erkennst Verbesserungspotenzial und packst operativ mit an. Dabei kommunizierst du klar und verbindlich – intern wie extern. Du arbeitest analytisch und sehr genau, bist sicher in Google Sheets/Excel und nutzt AI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT selbstverständlich im Arbeitsalltag. Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau. Plus: Erfahrung in der Abrechnung mit Pflege-/Krankenkassen Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und No-Code-Tools (z. B. Zapier, n8n) oder SQL-Grundkenntnisse Unser Angebot ⚖️ Fair von Anfang an: Du bekommst von uns direkt unser bestmögliches Angebot – wir gehen von Anfang an mit der Zahl rein, die woanders erst am Ende einer Verhandlung steht. 🏢 Arbeitsort: 2 Tage pro Woche mobil arbeiten sowie klimatisiertes Büro mit Spree-Blick mitten in Friedrichshain 📚 Wachstum: 500€ jährliches Learning & Development-Budget, klarer Career Framework und 360°-Feedback für deine Weiterentwicklung 🤝 Miteinander: Wir feiern Erfolge gemeinsam bei regelmäßigen Company Events und bei vierteljährlichen Teamevents mit 50€ Budget pro Person für besondere Erlebnisse (z.B. Escape Rooms, Cooking Classes oder Game Shows) 🏖️ Urlaub: Bis zu 30 Tage Urlaub (nach Start mit 26 im 1. & 28 im 2. Jahr) 🧘 Fitness & Freizeit: Bis zu 50% Rabatt auf Urban Sports Club, Corporate Benefits, Restaurant-Deals sowie Family & Friends Coupon auf die Patronus Uhr 🚲 Mobilität: 30% Rabatt aufs Job Ticket sowie vergünstigtes Fahrrad-Leasing 🥤 Verpflegung: Kostenfreie Softdrinks & Kaffeevollautomat, Müslibar, vierteljährliche Company Brunches sowie wöchentliche Healthy Snacks 💻 Hardware: Freie Wahl zwischen MacBook und Lenovo 🌍 Impact: Ein Produkt mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Mehrwert plus ein Volunteering-Tag im Jahr Einfach. Sicher. Leben. Mit Patronus. Wir sind mehr als ein Anbieter für intelligente Notruf-Uhren – wir entwickeln Technologien, die Menschen ein selbstbestimmtes Leben ermöglichen: We create a world where aging is delightful. Möglich macht das unsere revolutionäre Patronus-Uhr: Auf den ersten Blick nicht als Notruf erkennbar, ermöglicht sie es Nutzer*innen, jederzeit und überall unkompliziert Hilfe zu rufen. Damit sorgen wir für Sicherheit und retten im wahrsten Sinne des Wortes Leben. Sie ist dabei unser Türöffner, um das Leben älterer Menschen, ihrer Angehörigen und Pflegepersonen zu verbessern und das Gesundheitssystem effektiver zu machen. Damit in Zukunft alle Menschen ihr Leben so leben können, wie sie es möchten. Klingt nach einer perfekten Stelle für dich? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Auch wenn du unserem Anforderungsprofil nicht zu 100 % entsprichst, ermutigen wir dich trotzdem, dich bei uns zu bewerben. Patronus ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt fördert. Wir bemühen uns, ein freundliches, sicheres und einladendes Umfeld für alle unsere Mitarbeiter*innen zu schaffen, unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität und -ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, Einschränkungen und Begabungen jeglicher Art, körperlicher Erscheinung, sozialem Hintergrund, Familienstand, Alter oder Religion (oder deren Fehlen). title: Recruiter, R&D (APJ)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong></p> <p>As a Technical Recruiter, you'll help GitLab build the engineering and product teams behind our DevSecOps platform. In this individual contributor role, you'll partner with leaders across Engineering, Product, Security, and UX and own searches from intake through close. You'll build inclusive pipelines and use data and market insight to guide hiring decisions, while growing into a trusted talent advisor.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage full-cycle searches for roles such as Backend and Frontend Engineers, Site Reliability Engineers, Security Engineers, Data Engineers, Engineering Managers, and Product Managers, delivering against agreed recruiting goals and key metrics with accurate, timely documentation in Greenhouse.</li> <li>Lead intake and kickoff conversations to align hiring teams on role scope, technical requirements, team context, interview plans, and timelines, with senior team guidance as needed.</li> <li>Partner with hiring teams on structured, equitable technical interviews with clear competencies and actionable feedback; challenge assumptions and escalate risks or blockers early.</li> <li>Use talent-market research, compensation benchmarks, funnel metrics, and candidate feedback to shape search strategy and address hiring issues.</li> <li>Assess technical candidates on depth of experience, scope and impact of past work, problem-solving, and open source or community contributions, and how well their skills fit GitLab's teams and technology.</li> <li>Build research-based, diversity-focused sourcing plans that balance applicants, passive talent, referrals, internal talent, and targeted outreach across technical communities and specialized talent pools.</li> <li>Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience through disciplined pipeline management, proactive communication, timely feedback, and offer negotiations that clearly explain compensation, equity, and benefits.</li> <li>Improve recruiting practices by sharing learnings and reusable resources, using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly, and representing GitLab's mission, values, and culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Intermediate-level recruiting experience, with a track record of owning full-cycle searches independently.</li> <li>Technical recruiting experience, or a strong interest in learning engineering and product disciplines, tech stacks, team structures, and how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Developing advisor skills: building stakeholder trust, influencing without authority, and managing hiring team expectations.</li> <li>Experience building proactive, diversity-focused sourcing strategies and balanced pipelines for hard-to-fill or specialized roles.</li> <li>A data-informed approach that turns funnel insights into practical actions.</li> <li>Strong organization across multiple requisitions and clear written and verbal communication across time zones, with attention to detail and candidate care.</li> <li>Experience with an applicant tracking system and recruiting tools such as Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn Insights, SeekOut, or comparable platforms; ability to evaluate AI-generated work, protect confidential information, and share responsible workflows with team members.</li> <li>Experience recruiting for DevSecOps, developer tools, or open source software is helpful, not required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>We work in a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. Our team members share learnings and create reusable resources to improve the quality and consistency of hiring across Research & Development.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. title: Marketing Specialist (Benelux & Nordics)
description: Do you want to have an excellent experience as an employee in one of the most pioneering toy companies in the market? Are you passionate about games and driven to provide exceptional products and services to customers worldwide? This is the company you are looking for! At Jumbo Group, we are not just an international company; we are an international playground. Our world is filled with games, puzzles, and toys that spread joy and inspire creativity across the globe. We enjoy a robust presence throughout Europe and in all corners of the world. About the role Are you ready to make our brands shine – both online and offline? As Marketing Specialist, you’ll take full ownership of a selection of Jumbo’s brands across the Benelux and Nordics. From strategy to execution, from campaign concept to retail catalogue — you’ll manage your brands full journey. You translate global brand strategies into local plans that drive awareness, engagement and sales at retail. You’ll also make sure your brands perform at their best on all online platforms. In this dynamic role, you’ll work closely with the Marketing Manager, the local Sales teams, Product Development, the global Brand team, and the local eCommerce manager. Together, you’ll make sure Jumbo’s brands are top of mind for retailers and consumers– no two days are the same. What you’ll be working on: Brand & Campaign Management · Take ownership of your brand portfolio in Benelux & Nordics. · Translate global brand strategies into local brand plans and activation strategies. · Manage the local assortment: know your products inside out, select the right new launches together with commercial team, and ensure the best fit for your markets. · Be a sparring partner for local and global teams, bringing in fresh ideas and creativity and ensure alignment across markets. · Monitor brand performance, track results and adjust plans accordingly. Share insights with the sales teams and global team. · Create and manage impactful campaigns, events & retail activations (ATL and BTL) in close collaboration with sales and e-commerce. · Work closely with creative, media, influencer, social media and activation agencies. · Create presentations and sell-in decks for sales, retailers and partners. · Communicate plans, updates and best practices clearly across internal teams and external partners. E-Commerce & Digital Marketing · Ensure strong online visibility and conversion for your brands through optimised product content. · Execute retail media campaigns and product activations on Bol.com, Amazon and other key online partners, together with the local e-com manager. · Align your brand presence across Jumbo’s local social channels in collaboration with our SoMe agency and fellow Marketing Specialists. · Share and apply digital insights and best practices across markets. What you bring to the team · Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communication, Business Administration, Digital Commerce, or a related field. · Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in Marketing, Brand Management, Trade Marketing or Digital Marketing. · Hands-on with e-commerce platforms (Bol.com, Amazon or similar) and retail media campaigns. · Affinity with social media management and content creation. · Analytical and organisational skills; confident with Excel, PowerPoint and analytics tools. · Experience in the toy, entertainment, or FMCG sector is a plus, but not mandatory. What makes you a great fit · You’re a strong multitasker who loves variety – product launches, campaigns, activations, all in one week? Bring it on! · A creative storyteller with fresh ideas and an eye for detail. · A confident communicator in Dutch & English; French or a Nordic language is a plus. · A collaborative, hands-on team player who enjoys making things happen. · Passion for toys & games – you know how to turn play into impact. title: Accountmanager Bouw - Waterdichting
description: Nederland Een commerciële buitendienstfunctie waarin jij zelf een markt opbouwt, met de slagkracht van een internationale producent achter je. Bij IKO krijg je de vrijheid om jouw eigen commerciële koers te bepalen, hoogwaardige technische oplossingen te verkopen en zichtbaar bij te dragen aan groei. Een zelfstandige baan voor een ondernemende accountmanager die kansen ziet én benut! Maak het verschil als Accountmanager Bouw en Techniek in Nederland Dankzij jouw commerciële daadkracht groeit IKO's positie in de Nederlandse markt voor vloeibare waterdichting. Je ontwikkelt zelfstandig nieuwe klantrelaties en brengt hoogwaardige oplossingen onder de aandacht bij onder andere aannemers, voorschrijvers, woningcorporaties en vastgoedbeheerders. Denk aan waterdichtingstoepassingen voor balkons, galerijen, parkeerdaken en -dekken, dakdetails en brugdekken. Je onderzoekt de markt, signaleert bouw- en renovatieprojecten en weet op het juiste moment de juiste gesprekspartners te bereiken. Daarbij verkoop je op technische meerwaarde en bouw je aan langdurige samenwerkingen. Je start met een kleine bestaande klantenportefeuille en richt je aanvankelijk op new business om jouw portefeuille verder uit te breiden. Je bent regelmatig onderweg naar klanten en projecten, werkt verder regelmatig vanuit huis en bent uiteraard welkom op het kantoor in Klundert. Je schakelt met jouw Nederlandse en Belgische salescollega's en technische specialisten. Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het: zelfstandig ontwikkelen van de Nederlandse markt voor vloeibare waterdichting; actief benaderen van nieuwe klanten, waaronder aannemers, voorschrijvers en andere potentiële opdrachtgevers; signaleren en opvolgen van commerciële kansen binnen bouw-, renovatie- en infrastructurele projecten; adviseren over hoogwaardige technische oplossingen en opbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties; ontwikkelen van een sterke salespipeline en zorgvuldig vastleggen van commerciële activiteiten in Salesforce (CRM). Als gedreven Accountmanager Bouw en Techniek kun jij rekenen op: Een zelfstandige commerciële functie bij een internationaal familiebedrijf waar ondernemerschap en eigen initiatief worden gewaardeerd. IKO biedt je de ruimte om jouw markt te ontwikkelen, ondersteund door ervaren collega's en technische specialisten. Tijdens jouw inwerkperiode leer je bovendien van het Belgische salesteam. Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop: een salaris tot € 5.500,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring; een bonusregeling tot 10% van jouw jaarsalaris; 25 vakantiedagen + 12 ATV dagen; een auto, laptop en telefoon van de zaak; een pensioenregeling volgens Hibin; veel vrijheid om jouw eigen agenda en commerciële activiteiten te organiseren; de mogelijkheid om regelmatig vanuit huis te werken; toegang tot kennis en expertise binnen een internationale organisatie. Voor deze vacature neem jij mee: Jij krijgt energie van het openen van deuren en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe commerciële kansen. Je neemt initiatief, werkt gestructureerd en houdt koers tijdens langdurige verkooptrajecten. Met jouw nieuwsgierigheid en technische interesse achterhaal je de werkelijke klantbehoefte. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende gesprekspartners, van uitvoerende aannemers tot technisch adviseurs, en weet hen met inhoudelijke argumenten te overtuigen. Vink jij deze checklist ook af? mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau; minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar commerciële buitendienstervaring, bij voorkeur als accountmanager of technisch-commercieel adviseur; aantoonbare ervaring met directe verkoop aan aannemers en actieve acquisitie; technische affiniteit, bij voorkeur met bouwproducten, waterdichting, coatings of infrastructurele toepassingen; ervaring met CRM-systemen, bij voorkeur Salesforce, en goede kennis van Excel. Jouw werkgebied Jouw werkgebied beslaat heel Nederland, met een focusgebied in de driehoek Rotterdam, Utrecht en Amsterdam. title: Mainframe Data Engineer - 3 to 6 Months Contract
description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer with a strong background in designing, deploying, configuring, and managing enterprise-scale data engineering platforms within secure, on-premises and air-gapped environments. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience working with Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark clusters , including installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, performance optimisation, and workload management in environments with restricted or no internet connectivity. This role will support our Global Data Centre (GDC) environment, requiring a candidate who understands the operational and technical challenges of delivering robust, scalable, and secure data platforms within isolated infrastructure. The successful candidate will work closely with infrastructure, platform, DevOps, and data engineering teams to build and maintain reliable data processing capabilities. Key Responsibilities Design, deploy, configure, and maintain Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark clusters in on-premises and air-gapped environments. Manage the full lifecycle of Hadoop/Spark platforms, including installation, upgrades, patching, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting. Develop, implement, and maintain scalable data pipelines for batch and distributed data processing. Optimise Spark workloads and Hadoop cluster performance, including resource allocation, job scheduling, and capacity management. Work with PostgreSQL and other enterprise data systems to support data integration, storage, and processing requirements. Support the deployment and management of containerised applications using Kubernetes and Helm. Implement and manage service-to-service communication and traffic management using Istio Service Mesh. Ensure software dependencies, container images, packages, and platform components can be deployed and maintained without external internet connectivity. Implement secure configuration and operational practices aligned with enterprise security requirements. Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, cluster, application, and data pipeline issues. Collaborate with infrastructure, security, DevOps, and application teams to ensure platform stability and availability. Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, operational runbooks, and platform architecture documentation. Support integration with legacy enterprise data systems, including VSAM. Requirements Required Technical Skills & Experience 1. Apache Hadoop & Apache Spark Strong hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and administering Apache Hadoop clusters. Proven experience deploying and managing Apache Spark clusters and workloads. Experience with distributed data processing, batch processing, and large-scale data pipelines. Strong understanding of cluster architecture, resource management, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. Experience operating big data platforms in on-premises and air-gapped environments. 2. Air-Gapped & On-Premises Infrastructure Practical experience working in isolated, restricted-network, or air-gapped environments. Understanding of offline software installation, dependency management, package repositories, and container image management. Experience managing platform deployments without direct access to public internet repositories. Knowledge of secure infrastructure operations and enterprise deployment standards. 3. Containerisation & Platform Engineering Experience with Kubernetes-based platform deployments. Hands-on experience with Helm charts for application and platform deployments. Working knowledge of Istio Service Mesh, including traffic management, service discovery, and secure service-to-service communication. Understanding of container orchestration and microservices architecture. 4. Data Systems & Engineering Strong experience with PostgreSQL, including database integration and performance considerations. Experience designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines. Understanding of distributed data storage and processing architectures. Knowledge of VSAM and integration with legacy enterprise data environments. Preferred / Desirable Skills Experience supporting large-scale enterprise or government data centre environments. Familiarity with Linux system administration. Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management. Knowledge of data security, access controls, encryption, and secure data handling. Experience with monitoring, logging, and platform observability. Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD practices in restricted-network environments. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a hands-on technical engineer rather than purely an architectural or theoretical resource. They should be comfortable taking ownership of the deployment, administration, troubleshooting, and ongoing operational management of Hadoop and Spark platforms. Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical experience working within environments where internet connectivity is restricted or unavailable, with an understanding of the additional complexities involved in deploying and maintaining enterprise data platforms in such environments. Zwei Unternehmenswelten: Du lernst das Zusammenspiel von traditioneller Industriekultur und dynamischer Venture-Kultur kennen und prägst es aktiv mit. Unternehmertum von Anfang an: Gestalte die frühe Aufbauphase unseres Ventures mit – vom Teamaufbau über die Entwicklung von Prozessen bis zur Etablierung des Geschäftsmodells. 360-Grad-Einblick: Du arbeitest in nahezu allen Unternehmensfunktionen an der Schnittstelle von Industrie, Technologie und Unternehmertum und entwickelst ein ganzheitliches Verständnis unternehmerischer Zusammenhänge. Lernen von erfahrenen Unternehmern: Du arbeitest direkt und auf Augenhöhe mit Gründern und Geschäftsführern zusammen, die langjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau neuer Geschäftsfelder und Corporate Ventures in familiengeführten Weltmarktführern mitbringen. Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Hohe Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und Schwerpunkte, die zu deinen Interessen und Stärken passen. AI First in der Praxis: Du erlebst, wie ein Unternehmen von Beginn an konsequent auf künstliche Intelligenz, Automatisierung und schlanke Strukturen setzt. Dein Profil Wir suchen eine außergewöhnlich leistungsstarke, unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernehmen und Dinge bewegen möchte. Statt Probleme zu verwalten, suchst du nach Lösungen und setzt Ideen mit Eigeninitiative und Entschlossenheit in die Tat um. Neugier und Lernbereitschaft: Du möchtest verstehen, wie Unternehmen funktionieren, und arbeitest dich schnell und mit Begeisterung in neue Themen ein. Technologieaffinität: Du interessierst dich für digitale Geschäftsmodelle, künstliche Intelligenz und industrielle Innovationen. Klingt die Stelle interessant für dich?
