title: Enterprise Platform Engineer, EMEA
description: <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>As an Engineer, Enterprise Platforms, you will be a hands-on owner of the collaboration tools our employees use all day. You will administer, automate, and improve them, working alongside identity, endpoints, and the wider SaaS stack.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who sees a problem, figures out the fix, and ships it. Our team is small and the scope is broad. You will have real ownership early, a lot of autonomy, and few layers between you and the people you support. You will turn policies, runbooks, and employee needs into reliable configurations, scripts, and self-service experiences. We use AI tools where they make us faster or more accurate, and we expect good judgment about when to trust them.</p> <p>This role reflects Abnormal VOICE values. You move with velocity, design for long-term ownership and governance, use data with intellectual honesty, stay close to customer needs, and aim for excellence in reliability and simplicity.</p> <h2><strong>What You Will Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Administer Google Workspace: users, groups, org units, shared drives, Drive sharing and DLP, Gmail routing and policies, Calendar and room resources, Meet, and audit and security investigation tooling.</li> <li>Administer Slack (Enterprise Grid): workspaces, channels, user groups, permissions, app approvals, Slack Connect, retention, export and eDiscovery, workflows, and audit logs.</li> <li>Build and maintain automation for joiner, mover, and leaver flows, access requests, deprovisioning, and common employee needs, using SCIM, APIs, webhooks, Apps Script, and scripting.</li> <li>Work with identity (Okta SSO, MFA, group-based access) so Google and Slack access follows least privilege and birthright rules.</li> <li>Support endpoints and other SaaS platforms as needed, including macOS device management and long-tail SaaS administration.</li> <li>Create self-service experiences, runbooks, and enablement content so employees can resolve common needs without escalation.</li> <li>Participate in Tier 2/3 incidents, perform root cause analysis, and feed what you learn back into automation, runbooks, and standards.</li> <li>Add logging, dashboards, and reporting so changes are monitored and audit questions can be answered quickly.</li> <li>Use AI tools where they help (documentation, troubleshooting, request triage, analysis), with human review and appropriate access controls.</li> <li>Partner with Security, GRC, Legal, People, Finance, and IT Service Delivery to deliver changes safely.</li> <li>Triage incoming requests and incidents by impact and urgency, route them to the right owner or queue, and resolve or escalate within agreed response targets.</li> <li>Turn vague or incomplete requests into clear requirements: ask clarifying questions, identify stakeholders and constraints, and confirm the desired outcome before building.</li> <li>Set clear expectations with employees and stakeholders about scope, timelines, and tradeoffs. Give status updates proactively, and flag risks or delays early.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Governance and Compliance</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define and enforce standards for external sharing, Slack Connect, guest access, and third-party and OAuth app approval in Google Workspace and Slack.</li> <li>Run regular access and license reviews, using systems and audit logs to find unused, orphaned, or over-privileged access.</li> <li>Keep configuration baselines documented, changes tracked in ServiceNow, and evidence ready for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP audits.</li> <li>Review audit logs and investigate suspicious activity with Security.</li> <li>Document requirements, risks, and approvals for changes so they pass change review and can be audited later.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Scripting and Automation</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Automate first. If a task happens more than a couple of times, you script it, build a workflow, or turn it into self-service.</li> <li>Write scripts and tools (Python, Apps Script, and shell) against the Google Workspace, Slack, and Okta APIs.</li> <li>Build and maintain integrations and workflows in Workato, connecting identity, HR, collaboration, ticketing, and SaaS systems.</li> <li>Use Torii workflows to automate app discovery, onboarding and offboarding, and license reclamation.</li> <li>Build ServiceNow catalog items and flows so requests are routed, approved, and fulfilled with minimal manual touch.</li> <li>Keep scripts and configuration in version control, with logging, error handling, and clear documentation so others can run and maintain them.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our Tooling</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Collaboration:</strong> Google Workspace, Slack (Enterprise Grid)</li> <li><strong>Identity:</strong> Okta</li> <li><strong>Automation and integration:</strong> Workato, Torii, Python, Apps Script</li> <li><strong>Service management:</strong> ServiceNow</li> <li><strong>Endpoints and other:</strong> Jamf, Zoom, and a long tail of SaaS applications</li> </ul> <p>You don't need experience with every tool. Strong experience with comparable platforms, and a record of learning new ones quickly, is what matters.</p> <h2><strong>How We Work</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Automation-first:</strong> We remove repetitive work rather than absorbing it, and we measure success by manual touches eliminated.</li> <li><strong>Customer-first:</strong> Employees are our customers. We respond with urgency, communicate clearly, and fix root causes so the same problem doesn't come back. We do what we say we'll do, or we tell people early when that changes.</li> <li><strong>Fast-paced:</strong> Priorities shift quickly and requests arrive from every direction. We move fast, ship in small steps, and iterate.</li> <li><strong>Time management and triage:</strong> You juggle incidents, requests, and project work. You sort what comes in by impact and urgency, handle what's urgent first, and protect focused time for project work and for the root-cause fixes that prevent tomorrow's tickets.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You find the problem before someone assigns it, and you follow through to a documented, working fix.</li> <li>You are comfortable with ambiguity: unclear requirements, incomplete documentation, and shifting priorities don't stop you.</li> <li>You prioritize well when everything feels urgent. You set expectations early and honestly: you say no or "not yet" clearly and kindly, and you explain the reason.</li> <li>You learn new platforms quickly and teach what you learn.</li> <li>You ask the right questions up front: who needs this, what problem it solves, what 'done' looks like, and what could go wrong. You propose a recommended approach rather than waiting to be told.</li> <li>You communicate proactively: status updates, change notices, and honest post-incident write-ups.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Must Haves</strong></h2> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience in IT engineering, systems administration, or a similar role supporting business-critical technology.</li> <li>Hands-on administration of Google Workspace (Admin console, groups, Drive and sharing controls, Gmail, Calendar).</li> <li>Hands-on administration of Slack (workspace and channel management, user groups, app management, permissions). Enterprise Grid experience is a strong plus.</li> <li>Working knowledge of identity and access concepts: SSO, MFA, least privilege, directory and group management, and SCIM or standards-based provisioning.</li> <li>Ability to script and integrate systems using APIs, webhooks, Apps Script, Python, or similar tooling.</li> <li>Experience with incident and change management, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and documented follow-through.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including documenting technical processes and explaining complex systems to non-technical audiences.</li> <li>A track record of working independently and taking ownership without close direction.</li> <li>Experience writing scripts or building workflows that automate repetitive IT work, and a habit of automating before doing something manually a third time.</li> <li>A customer-first approach to supporting employees: responsive, clear, and focused on fixing root causes.</li> <li>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage your time across incidents, requests, and project work, prioritizing by impact.</li> <li>Ability to set and manage expectations with stakeholders, including saying no or negotiating scope and timelines while keeping trust.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience at a startup or high-growth company, where you wore multiple hats, built processes from scratch, or scaled IT through rapid headcount growth. </li> <li>Experience with acquisitions, tenant or domain migrations, or workspace consolidation. </li> <li>Experience with data governance in collaboration tools: retention, legal hold, eDiscovery, DLP, and audit log analysis. </li> <li>Google Workspace or Slack administration certifications, or involvement in their admin communities. </li> <li>Experience with Okta, Jamf, Zoom, or other enterprise SaaS administration.</li> <li>Experience in remote-first, SaaS-first, or zero-trust environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with version control, configuration-as-code, or CI/CD for platform automation.</li> <li>Experience building self-service workflows, or using AI tools to improve support, troubleshooting, and documentation.</li> <li>Awareness of security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP) as applied to collaboration and end-user platforms.</li> <li>Experience with Workato or a similar integration platform (Zapier, Tray.io, Boomi, or Okta Workflows).</li> <li>Experience with Torii or another SaaS management platform, such as Zluri or BetterCloud.</li> <li>Experience with ServiceNow (catalog items, flows, incident, request, and change) or a similar ITSM platform.</li> <li>Experience administering Microsoft 365 (Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, or the M365 admin center), especially in a mixed Google and Microsoft environment.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>#LI-AA1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>A title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Business Banking
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£80,000 - £105,000 +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> |</p> <p><strong>About Business Banking at Monzo</strong></p> <p>Since its launch five years ago, Monzo Business Banking has been dedicated to delivering the very best of Monzo to small businesses. Today, it's an award-winning service, empowering over 1 million businesses across the UK. </p> <p>As Monzo expands across Europe, Business Banking is entering its next phase: adapting our products and proposition for small businesses in new markets, while continuing our mission to make money work for businesses.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for <em>several</em><strong> Senior PMMs </strong>to own Product Marketing for entire products and experiences. </p> <p>A useful distinction - at Monzo, Product Marketing starts upstream in product-market fit. We're embedded in squads with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Designers, User Researchers, and Sales, bringing the voice of the customer and market into what we build, how we position it, and how we take it to market. We own customer and market understanding, positioning, proposition, launch strategy, and sales enablement. We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead campaign strategy, creative direction, channel execution, and growth. Together, we build the right products and help them succeed in market.</p> <p><strong>This is a senior individual contributor role.</strong> You'll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market.</p> <p><strong>Where you could join</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Business Banking EU. </strong>Business Banking is entering its next phase of growth as we expand beyond the UK. In this role, you'll define how Monzo Business Banking succeeds in new European markets - understanding local customer needs, building the proposition that translates our core product into local relevance, and working across Product, Growth, Marketing, and local teams to bring those products to market. This is a senior role for someone with high autonomy who loves turning dense customer and market insight into practical decisions about what should launch.</li> <li><strong>Business Banking</strong><strong>. </strong>Business Banking is growing quickly, serving more than one million businesses across the UK while expanding into increasingly sophisticated customer needs. In this role, you'll shape how our products are positioned, sold, and adopted—from defining compelling product narratives to enabling Sales and partnering with Growth and Marketing on launches. This is a role for someone who enjoys sitting at the intersection of Product and commercial teams, translating customer insight into positioning, propositions, and go-to-market strategies that help more businesses choose Monzo.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Set Product Marketing Strategy for a set of products. </strong>You'll define a one-year Product Marketing strategy for a major area of Business Banking, connecting customer insight, market opportunity, and commercial priorities into a clear direction for the product area, rather than one individual product, with measurable business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Develop differentiated positioning & messaging: </strong>You'll create compelling positioning, messaging, and value propositions that differentiate Monzo in the market and resonate with different customer segments. You'll build messaging frameworks that Product, Sales, Integrated Marketing, and broader marketing teams use consistently across launches and customer journeys.</li> <li><strong>Drive competitive intelligence and market insights</strong>: You’ll build and maintain the market view for your product area. You'll become the recognised authority on your customer segment and competitive landscape, building a coherent view of the market from customer research, commercial data, competitor intelligence, and Sales insight. Your recommendations will shape product strategy, positioning, go-to-market, and commercial priorities across the Business Banking collective.</li> <li><strong>Shape product strategy across markets.</strong> You'll partner closely with Product, Research, Design, and Data to identify customer problems, market opportunities, and competitive gaps that influence roadmap priorities. Your customer and market insight will shape what we build, not just how we bring it to market.</li> <li><strong>Set the go-to-market strategy for priority products and markets</strong>. You'll define what audiences we prioritise, why they would choose Monzo, what needs to be true for them to switch and stay, and what success looks like - giving Product, Sales, Marketing, and local market teams a shared strategic direction for how the product enters or scales in market.</li> <li><strong>Own product representation across the customer journey.</strong> You'll define the core proposition and value messages that should carry through key customer and sales touchpoints, so customers consistently understand why the product matters. You'll partner with teams across Product, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and local markets to make sure the customer experience reflects the agreed positioning.</li> <li><strong>Enable localisation:</strong> You'll work with local market teams to determine what should remain globally consistent and what should adapt locally, ensuring positioning, customer journeys, and launches resonate in each market while strengthening the overall Monzo Business Banking proposition.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This is for you if: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You're recognised for your Product Marketing expertise.</strong> You're comfortable owning Product Marketing across a product area or market, and people seek your perspective on customers, competitors, positioning, and product strategy.</li> <li><strong>You bring senior stakeholders with you & thrive in cross-functional environments. </strong>You work effectively across Product, Sales, Growth, Marketing, and Research, building alignment around difficult decisions and helping teams make confident product and commercial choices.</li> <li><strong>You raise the quality of the work around you.</strong> You enjoy mentoring less experienced PMMs, sharing your expertise, and improving how the team works through better frameworks, feedback, and knowledge sharing.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Initial Call (45mins) </li> <li>Case Study Presentation (1hour)</li> <li>x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to ----- You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>£80,000 - £105,000 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"><strong>here</strong><strong> </strong></a></li> </ul> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family

title: Software Engineer II: Autonomous Supply Chains
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h1>Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply Chains</h1> <h2>About Flexport</h2> <p>Look around you. Almost everything in the room crossed an ocean to get there. Moving one container from a factory to a warehouse takes 10 to 15 companies: truckers, customs brokers, port terminals, ocean carriers, insurers, lenders and warehouses, each with its own systems, paperwork and rules. A freight forwarder runs that whole journey, so the brand that makes the goods doesn't have to.</p> <p>Most forwarders still run it on email, spreadsheets and phone calls. We call it email freight forwarding. Flexport runs it on one platform, where AI agents do the routine work and experts step in where judgment matters. We've moved $175B of goods for more than 13,000 brands across 135 countries. Our agents handle 21 million tasks a year, and up to 80% of customs work is automated.</p> <p>Global logistics is a $13 trillion industry, and even the largest forwarder earns less than 3% of global logistics outsourcing revenue. People-powered operations don't scale: to grow, you hire. Software broke that ceiling for taxis with Uber, and for payments with Adyen and Stripe. Freight is next.</p> <p>Amsterdam is one of Flexport's six engineering hubs, alongside San Francisco, Seattle, Chicago, Shanghai and Shenzhen. We own four domains end to end: Customs Technology, Autonomous Supply Chains (Applied AI), Platform and Security. See what we build at <a href="https://amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com">amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com</a>.</p> <h2>The team: Autonomous Supply Chains</h2> <p>Logistics is famously hard to automate, because the happy path rarely happens. One customer won't take deliveries on a Tuesday. Another wants invoices only on Fridays, with some lines merged and others renamed. Until recently, people handled all of that by hand. Now operators use Forge, the agentic platform we build, to automate their own work: catching anomalies, routing exceptions, escalating stuck containers and adjusting invoices to each customer. Forge remembers every customer's rules and learns from every workflow run, so it gets smarter every day.</p> <p>Autonomous Supply Chains is our Applied AI team: small, senior and reporting to the VP of Engineering. Self-driving cars are rated from level 0 to level 5. Most of the freight industry still runs at level 0: people emailing spreadsheets. Our goal is level 5 for freight, with Forge as the best agentic platform there is, handling every complexity, every calamity and every odd preference without skipping a beat.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> TypeScript, Rust, Next.js, Temporal, Postgres and Snowflake, with models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google.</p> <h2>The role</h2> <p>As an Applied AI Engineer II on Autonomous Supply Chains, you'll build the agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations faster and increasingly autonomous. You'll find the most painful problems in our operations, design the solution and ship it to operators moving freight across 135 countries. This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li>Design and ship end-to-end AI agents that handle real logistics work, such as customs compliance, document processing, invoice validation and exception management.</li> <li>Build the evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop flows that make an agent trustworthy enough to run 24/7.</li> <li>Stay on top of what's happening in the world of AI, and channel those innovations straight into the product. When Jev came out this fall, we had three use cases live within two weeks.</li> <li>Work directly with operators, domain experts and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into shipped products, and measure whether they worked.</li> <li>Move fast from idea to production, and treat every deployment as a chance to learn.</li> <li>Cross organizational boundaries to understand problems deeply and get things done without waiting for permission.</li> </ul> <h2>You should have</h2> <ul> <li>3+ years of software engineering experience, and you've built seriously with LLMs, whether in production, in side projects or just because you couldn't stop yourself.</li> <li>LLM fluency: agent patterns, tool use, RAG, prompt design and evaluation. You know the difference between what works in production and what looks good in a demo.</li> <li>Full-stack capability in TypeScript and Next.js. You can own a feature end to end.</li> <li>Product instinct: you can tell what's worth building, not just how to build it.</li> <li>Clear written and spoken communication in English, including design docs that people actually read.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with workflow orchestration, such as Temporal.</li> <li>Experience building internal tools or operator-facing applications.</li> </ul> <h2>How we work</h2> <ul> <li><strong>We value builders.</strong> People who think end to end, do their own discovery and ship independently. Nobody hands you a spec.</li> <li><strong>Your users sit next to you.</strong> Operators, customs experts and account teams work in the same office. Watch them use your tool, and fix it before dessert.</li> <li><strong>Any model, any harness.</strong> Use any frontier model from Anthropic, OpenAI or Google, in all the popular coding harnesses. Our engineers manage swarms of coding agents from their first week.</li> <li><strong>We ship dozens of times a day,</strong> with continuous deployment and a platform team obsessed with making it safe and fast.</li> <li><strong>Hybrid, in English.</strong> We're together in our office on Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal, a few minutes from Dam Square, three days a week*. The other days are flexible. English is our working language, and we work daily with colleagues in the US and China.</li> <li><strong>No logistics background needed.</strong> Almost nobody joins knowing what an HTS code or a bill of lading is. The experts sit a few desks away.</li> <li><strong>Agile, but not dogmatic.</strong> Teams decide how they work best.</li> </ul> <h2>Why this role is special</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Your work is visible:</strong> a small, senior team that reports to the VP of Engineering. What you build gets noticed, and your ideas shape the direction.</li> <li><strong>Real stakes:</strong> your agents act on real shipments for 13,000+ brands in 135 countries, so the impact is immediate and measurable.</li> <li><strong>You're early:</strong> the playbook for applied AI in logistics hasn't been written yet. You'll help write it.</li> </ul> <h2>What's in it for you</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Equity for everyone:</strong> every team member becomes a shareholder in a pre-IPO company in a multi-trillion dollar industry.</li> <li><strong>25 vacation days,</strong> based on full-time employment, plus Dutch public holidays.</li> <li><strong>Health insurance, fully paid:</strong> a collective plan with basic and additional packages. Flexport pays the monthly premium.</li> <li><strong>Pension:</strong> a defined contribution scheme.</li> <li><strong>Breakfast and lunch:</strong> daily catered lunch with vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and drinks in the office.</li> <li><strong>Commute covered:</strong> Flexport covers home-to-office commuting costs if you live outside Amsterdam.</li> <li><strong>Parental leave:</strong> time off for both parents to bond with a new child.</li> <li><strong>Wellbeing support:</strong> an Employee Assistance Program through Aetna for you and your household, at no cost.</li> <li><strong>Visa sponsorship:</strong> we sponsor visas for the right candidates and help you move to Amsterdam. Eligible international hires may also benefit from the Dutch expat tax ruling.</li> </ul> <h2>Our hiring process</h2> <ol> <li><strong>Application review:</strong> our team reviews your application.</li> <li><strong>Recruiter screen:</strong> talk about your experience, the role and your questions about Flexport.</li> <li><strong>Remote coding:</strong> your first coding interview takes place over video.</li> <li><strong>Onsite coding and system design:</strong> a second coding interview and system design in our office.</li> <li><strong>Project deep dive:</strong> discuss a project from your experience with the hiring manager.</li> <li><strong>Team debrief:</strong> the interview team reviews feedback together. You don't attend this step.</li> <li><strong>Offer:</strong> if there's a match, your recruiter walks you through the offer.</li> </ol> <p>An additional remote coding round may be needed if the earlier coding interviews leave questions to resolve. Your recruiter will confirm the plan before interviews begin. We only contact candidates from ----- addresses, and we will never ask you for money or banking details.</p> <h2>Commitment to equal opportunity</h2> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <h2>Global data privacy notice for job candidates and applicants</h2> <p>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice at <a href="https://www.flexport.com/privacy">www.flexport.com/privacy</a> for more information.</p> <p>* Three days a week is what w

title: Senior Product Manager
description: <p><strong>Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN, Proton was built on the belief that <strong>privacy is a fundamental human right</strong>. What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide.</p> <p>We're profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. Our work helps protect digital freedom, from everyday privacy to supporting journalists and activists in challenging environments.</p> <p>Today, we're an international team of 700+ people, with offices across 9 countries. We have high standards for the people we hire and the work we do. You'll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right.</p> <p>Explore our <a href="https://proton.me/community/open-source">open-source projects</a>.</p> <h3 class="Lexical__h3">The Role</h3> <p class="Lexical__paragraph">We're building something new at Proton and we're hiring a Senior PM to lead it from the front.</p> <p class="Lexical__paragraph">This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, community dynamics, and Proton's mission to give people back control over their digital lives. You'll own the roadmap and execution for a product that brings privacy-first community experiences to millions of users. The team is small and senior; the scope is large. You’ll turn an ambitious product direction into clear strategy, crisp requirements, shipped experiences, and measurable outcomes.</p> <p class="Lexical__paragraph">We're looking for someone who has lived inside community products: who understands how engagement compounds, why moderation decisions shape culture, and how trust is built (and destroyed) at scale. If you've helped build or grow a platform where users interact, organize, and belong, and you want to do it in a way that doesn't exploit the people using it, this is the role.</p> <hr> <h3 class="Lexical__h3">What You'll Own</h3> <ul class="Lexical__ul Lexical__ul--depth-1"> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="1">Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap end-to-end — from first principles through to shipped features — without waiting for direction from above</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="2">Own the metrics that matter: activation, engagement, retention, and community health. Set the targets, instrument the product to track them, and course-correct fast when signals shift</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="3">Translate deep knowledge of how online communities work — growth loops, moderation, network effects, content dynamics — into a clear product point of view and a prioritized execution plan</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="4">Lead cross-functional execution across a team of 6–12 engineers plus design, data, and growth — maintain velocity, surface blockers early, and keep the team focused on outcomes over activity</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="5">Drive structured discovery: user research, competitive analysis, and direct feedback loops that keep product decisions grounded in real behaviour, not assumptions</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="6">Represent the product externally when needed — to users, partners, and internal leadership — with clarity and confidence</li> </ul> <hr> <h3 class="Lexical__h3">Who You Are</h3> <ul class="Lexical__ul Lexical__ul--depth-1"> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="1">10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on a social, messaging, or community platform</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="2">Deep understanding of community product mechanics — you can reason clearly about engagement loops, content moderation trade-offs, trust and safety, and network effects without needing it explained</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="3">Analytically sharp: you define success in numbers, run structured experiments, and make data-informed calls without losing sight of user intuition</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="4">Strong, direct communicator — you write and speak with precision, push back when something doesn't make sense, and keep stakeholders aligned without over-meeting</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="5">Proven ability to lead a product autonomously: you identify the right problem, build the case, and drive it to shipped — without a roadmap handed to you</li> </ul> <p class="Lexical__paragraph"><strong><strong class="Lexical__textBold">Nice to Have</strong></strong></p> <ul class="Lexical__ul Lexical__ul--depth-1"> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="1">Experience building privacy-respecting alternatives to mainstream social or community platforms</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="2">Familiarity with open-source community protocols (atproto, IETF MLS, Matrix, etc.)</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="3">Background scaling a community product from early traction to millions of active users<br><br>Mainstream community platforms often optimize for attention, ads, and control. Proton has a different opportunity: to build community communication around privacy, user agency, and trust. This role is for a PM who understands the mechanics of social and community products, but wants to apply them in a way that respects the people using them.</li> </ul> <hr> <h3 class="Lexical__h3">What We Offer</h3> <ul class="Lexical__ul Lexical__ul--depth-1"> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="1"><strong><strong class="Lexical__textBold">Work that Matters:</strong></strong> Millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments.</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="2"><strong><strong class="Lexical__textBold">A Great Team:</strong></strong> Diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit, with people from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, ETH, and more.</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="3"><strong><strong class="Lexical__textBold">Technology:</strong></strong> The right hardware and software to do your best work.</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="4"><strong><strong class="Lexical__textBold">Learning & Development:</strong></strong> We invest in your growth. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career — real challenges, real ownership, from day one.</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="5"><strong><strong class="Lexical__textBold">Employee Benefits:</strong></strong> Strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support.</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="6"><strong><strong class="Lexical__textBold">Stock Options:</strong></strong> From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="7"><strong><strong class="Lexical__textBold">In-Person Collaboration:</strong></strong> Offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London, and more. You'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face.</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="8"><strong><strong class="Lexical__textBold">Food:</strong></strong> Lunch and snacks on us every day in the office.</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="9"><strong><strong class="Lexical__textBold">Transport:</strong></strong> We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking — whichever works for you.</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="10"><strong><strong class="Lexical__textBold">Flexible Working:</strong></strong> You own your schedule. Outcomes matter more than clock-in times.</li> </ul> <hr> <h3 class="Lexical__h3">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</h3> <p class="Lexical__paragraph">At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. title: Oracle EPM Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p> </p> <p><strong>Available Location:</strong> Austin, TX</p> <p><strong>Job Title:</strong> <strong>Senior </strong><strong>Oracle EPM Specialist</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong> This critical role is responsible for ensuring smooth financial operations throughout the close cycles by maintaining the stability, security, and high performance of Oracle GL and Oracle EPM environments. The EPM Specialist will absorb knowledge transfer from implementation partners and serve as the primary operational lead for Financial Consolidation and Close - FCCS, Account Reconciliation - ARCS, and Enterprise Data Management - EDMCS. A core aspect of the job involves collaborating cross-functionally with IT and business teams to understand downstream system impacts, manage critical system handshakes, and oversee regular maintenance. Partnering closely with Financial Systems leadership, you will help translate the strategic roadmap into reality. </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Cross-Functional System Execution:</strong> Work closely with finance, IT, and cross-functional teams to implement roadmap initiatives and evaluate downstream impacts.</li> <li><strong>Troubleshooting & Resolution:</strong> Investigate and resolve data load, mapping, validation, and calculation issues. Track and resolve recurring or critical issues through Oracle Service Requests</li> <li><strong>Financial Module Ownership:</strong> Define and own the functional configuration roadmap for key financial modules, including General Ledger<strong>.</strong></li> <li><strong>Compliance and System Configuration:</strong> Directly design and configure Oracle Fusion to ensure enforcement of critical financial compliance standards (e.g., ASC 606/IFRS 15, SOX).</li> <li><strong>Data Integration Management:</strong> Administer Data Exchange pipelines, import/export definitions, and update EDM subscriptions to keep metadata aligned. Manage calculation rules, consolidations, and cash flow mappings.</li> <li><strong>Maintenance & Patching:</strong> Review release notes and perform patch regression testing on monthly EPM patches, promoting updates safely across DEV, TEST, and PROD pods.</li> <li><strong>System Support & Operations:</strong> Manage and monitor user access control, including assigning predefined and application roles. Provide functional support during close cycles, assisting users with application navigation, workflows, and Smart View queries.</li> <li><strong>Solution Architecture & Development:</strong> Partner with leadership to design, build, and optimize scalable EPM data models and solutions. Translate business requirements into technical architecture and execute complex development work across FCCS, ARCS, PCMCS and EDMCS.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Active Oracle Cloud EPM Certification(s)</strong> (e.g., Financial Consolidation and Close (FCCS), Account Reconciliation (ARCS), Enterprise Data Management (EDMCS), Profitability and Cost Management (PCMCS) or EPM Data Integration).</li> <li>Strong experience managing and supporting Oracle EPM applications, specifically FCCS, ARCS, PCMCS, and EDMCS.</li> <li>Proven ability to manage daily operations, including integrations, consolidations, and reconciliations.</li> <li>Exceptional troubleshooting skills, specifically regarding Smart View installations, connection settings, and resolving setup conflicts.</li> <li>Experience managing user security, access roles, and maintaining compliance governance.</li> <li>Ability to perform monthly/quarterly close operations and execute environment health checks.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with cross-functional IT and business teams to evaluate inbound and outbound data flows and build architectural solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).</li> <li>Familiarity or experience with Oracle Tax Reporting (TRCS), as future roadmap capabilities may expand into this area.</li> <li>Experience with Risk Control Matrix (RCM) functionality to monitor Segregation of Duties (SOD) controls between ERP and EPM systems.</li> <li>Prior experience with other Finance Planning tools (e.g., PBCS, Adaptive Planning, Planful, Pigment, SAP, IBM, OneStream, etc is a plus).</li> <li>Conceptual understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Agentic AI frameworks</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Head of Operation
description: About nu glass nu glass improves wireless connectivity in enclosed spaces by making glass permeable to radio frequencies using laser ablation technology. By engraving an ultra-thin pattern that remains invisible, the company preserves the insulating properties of glazing while shaping connected environments. Main mission The Head of Operations leads all operations of nu glass Group and ensures that every project is delivered on time, to the expected quality, with a solid organisation across all sites. They take over the operational responsibility currently held by management, structure and coordinate several teams, oversee the project managers and deal directly with clients in crisis situations. A hands-on leader, they combine a big-picture view with the willingness to roll up their sleeves, while embodying the company's culture and values. description: The role Haven’t found the right open role, but believe you have the drive to take QD to the next level? This is your application. Great companies are built by curious people, and we’re looking for those who are excited about quantum technology, love solving problems and want to grow with a deep-tech company. Whether your background is technical, operational, business-oriented or somewhere in between, we want to meet people who are motivated to contribute and shape the future with us. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. title: Tritium Process Engineers

description: About Tritium Fuel Cycle (TFC) GFG is designing a first-of-a-kind (FOAK) fusion power plant (FPP) to deliver 1 GW of electrical power in the 2040s. The “GIGA” plant will be based on a stellarator magnetic confinement fusion device, operating continuously on a deuterium-tritium (D-T) fuel cycle. Prior to this, the smaller “Gauss Industrial Demonstrator (GID-170)” will be deployed in the mid-2030s. While deuterium can be extracted from seawater, tritium is a tightly controlled radioactive isotope with an extremely limited global supply. Therefore, both GID-170 and GIGA must utilise closed tritium fuel cycle infrastructure, to ensure that unburnt tritium is fully recycled back to the stellarator and not released to the environment. Meanwhile, the tritium consumed by the fusion reaction must be replenished using tritium breeding blankets (TBB). A first-of-a-kind dedicated tritium fuel cycle (TFC) facility, suitable for continuously supporting a stellarator device, must be designed, built and commissioned. It will adopt a multi-loop process architecture, each loop comprising many deeply integrated subsystems. Developing such a facility presents unique engineering challenges: the supply chain is still emerging, commercial process simulation tools lack dedicated TFC libraries, suitable off-the-shelf equipment is not always available, and some technologies have relatively low technology readiness levels (TRLs). A conceptual design is currently under development, with the project then progressing into pre-front-end engineering design (pre-FEED) in 2028, followed by front-end engineering design (FEED) and design for manufacturing phases. Completion of the overall design phase (for GID-170) must be achieved by 2032. About the role GFG is looking for several Tritium Process Engineers to join the TFC department and develop the GID-170 and GIGA TFC facilities. The roles will contribute to the continued development and optimisation of the overall fuel cycle architecture and its subsystems. Activities will include managing design requirements; developing process flow diagrams (PFDs), piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), heat and mass balances (HMBs) and the Basis of Design (BoD); selecting technologies; sizing and arranging equipment; and contributing to safety-related design. The roles may also involve supporting equipment prototype development and testing with technology developers and research partners. We welcome candidates with complementary strengths in process design and process modelling and simulation, with systems engineering experience also desirable. These specialisations sit within the same engineering function, and candidates are not expected to have equal expertise across all areas. The number of appointments and balance of responsibilities will reflect the successful candidates’ experience and technical strengths. Drawing on their specialist expertise, successful candidates will work collaboratively on design development, modelling, analysis and optimisation to assess design alternatives and inform robust, well-documented design decisions. The TFC comprises a wide range of technologies and subsystems, requiring the department to manage multiple sub-projects and work packages in parallel. Each engineer will contribute across several activities and will be expected to take ownership of specific tasks or subsystems, or lead work packages, depending on their experience. The roles will involve close collaboration with engineers from the same and other disciplines at national and international partner organisations, research institutions and suppliers, as well as with colleagues across disciplines and departments within GFG. Given the specific challenges associated with tritium, close collaboration with Nuclear Safety and Export Control specialists will also be essential. During conceptual design, successful candidates will work closely with the Head of Tritium Fuel Cycle to address the strong interdependencies between subsystems and develop a coherent, integrated design. As the project moves into pre-FEED, they will be expected to take greater day-to-day ownership of their assigned areas and drive design development through pre-FEED and FEED, while maintaining close coordination across subsystem interfaces. As the project progresses, the roles will evolve to support design for manufacture, procurement and commissioning of the GID-170 TFC systems, followed by further development and refinement of the TFC design for GIGA. Main responsibilities Process definition and systems engineering Identify, define and manage system requirements and interfaces across TFC subsystems and the overall plant architecture. Develop and optimise the fuel cycle architecture, assessing alternative subsystem technologies, their respective advantages and disadvantages, technology readiness levels (TRLs), and potential system configurations. Develop process flow diagrams (PFDs) for individual TFC subsystem blocks and the overall plant architecture. Participate in the development of piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), identification and sizing of key components, and equipment layout. Develop and maintain representative heat and mass balances to support process definition, system integration and design decisions. Process modelling and simulation Develop, apply and improve process simulation models for individual TFC subsystem blocks and the overall plant architecture, using tools such as Aspen Plus, Aspen Custom Modeler, Python and dedicated proprietary software, as appropriate. title: Senior Delivery Consultant
description: Who we are Software Improvement Group (SIG) helpt organisaties grip te houden op de software waar hun business op draait. Ons platform Sigrid® bestaat uit twee delen. Sigrid Core geeft organisaties continu inzicht in de kwaliteit, security en risico’s van hun volledige softwareportfolio, en borgt kwaliteitsstandaarden tot in de ontwikkelstraat. Sigrid Axis, gelanceerd in oktober 2026, brengt diezelfde standaarden naar AI coding agents: het controleert elke wijziging die een agent maakt in real time en verbetert bestaande code, zodat organisaties agentic engineering kunnen opschalen zonder grip te verliezen op kwaliteit, kosten en risico. Beide zijn gebouwd op ’s werelds grootste benchmark voor softwarekwaliteit, met meer dan 40.000 systemen en ruim 600 miljard regels code, en op ruim 25 jaar ervaring in het enige ISO/IEC 17025-geaccrediteerde lab voor softwarekwaliteit ter wereld. Samen met onze consultants vertalen we die inzichten naar strategisch en praktisch advies, zodat technologie een aanjager van succes is in plaats van een bron van risico. Onze klanten zijn grote (internationale) ondernemingen, financiële instellingen en overheidsorganisaties. Zij vertrouwen op SIG om softwarekwaliteit structureel onderdeel te maken van de manier waarop ze hun IT-landschap besturen. Where you come in Als Senior Delivery Consultant zorg je ervoor dat onze grootste klanten Sigrid succesvol inbedden in hun organisatie. Sigrid is geen tool die je even installeert: het is complexe software voor kwaliteitsmanagement die raakt aan de ontwikkelstraat, de architectuur, de securityprocessen en de besluitvorming van een organisatie. Jij leidt die implementaties van begin tot eind: van kick-off en technische onboarding tot training, rapportage en de borging van softwarekwaliteit in de werkwijze van de klant. Of Sigrid nu als SaaS-oplossing wordt afgenomen of on-premise in de eigen infrastructuur van de klant draait, jij zorgt dat het project slaagt. Dat maakt het werk uitdagend en cutting edge. Je werkt met technologie die vooroploopt, op het snijvlak van softwarekwaliteit en AI, bij organisaties die nu de stap zetten naar softwareontwikkeling met AI coding agents. Wat je bij hen implementeert, bepaalt mede hoe zij die stap veilig en beheerst kunnen maken. Je werkt voor grote corporate organisaties en overheidsinstellingen, vaak met honderden ontwikkelteams en duizenden applicaties. Dat betekent complexe trajecten met veel belanghebbenden: van CIO en CISO tot architecten, IT-beheer, inkoop en ontwikkelteams. Je brengt structuur aan in die complexiteit, houdt planning en scope in de hand, en houdt de vaart erin zonder mensen kwijt te raken. Je vertaalt de inzichten uit Sigrid naar rapportages en adviezen die passen bij je publiek. Een bestuurder wil weten waar de risico’s zitten, een architect wil technische schuld gericht aanpakken en een ontwikkelteam wil het dagelijkse werk verbeteren. Dezelfde data vertelt voor ieder van hen een ander verhaal, en jij weet die vertaalslag te maken. Intern noemen we deze rol Senior Guidance Consultant. Je maakt deel uit van ons Guidance-team: een klein, hands-on team van consultants dat nauw samenwerkt met onze Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, technische consultants en het productteam. Na de implementatie draag je de klant over aan de Customer Success Manager, die de langetermijnrelatie voortzet. Wat ga je doen Je leidt complete implementatietrajecten waarin Sigrid wordt ingebed in grote organisaties, zowel SaaS als on-premise: van projectplan en kick-off tot technische onboarding, training en overdracht. Je bent de projectleider: je bewaakt planning, scope en budget, managet risico’s en afhankelijkheden, en sluit aan op de governance van de klant, zoals stuurgroepen, security- en compliance-eisen en beheerprocessen. Bij on-premise implementaties werk je samen met de infrastructuur- en securityteams van de klant en met onze technische consultants, zodat installatie, configuratie en integratie soepel verlopen. Je begeleidt ontwikkelaars, architecten, managers en bestuurders bij het adopteren van Sigrid en het verankeren ervan in hun processen. Je levert heldere rapportages en presentaties aan zowel management als technische doelgroepen, afgestemd op de doelen van de organisatie. Je helpt klanten bij de inzet van Sigrid Axis, zodat hun AI coding agents werken volgens dezelfde kwaliteitsstandaarden als hun ontwikkelteams. Je adviseert klanten over sturen op softwarekwaliteit, het beheersen van technische schuld en de verantwoorde inzet van AI in softwareontwikkeling. Je managet meerdere trajecten tegelijk, gestructureerd en pragmatisch, inclusief een nauwkeurige projectadministratie in ons CRM. Je ondersteunt salestrajecten met overtuigende productdemo’s en met je inbreng over implementatieaanpak en planning. Je draagt bij aan de doorontwikkeling van onze implementatiemethodiek, onze Academy-content en de ondersteuning van partners die zelf Sigrid-implementaties uitvoeren. What's in it for you? Een betekenisvolle rol op het snijvlak van technologie, consultancy en organisatieverandering Directe impact bij enkele van de grootste organisaties van Nederland, in het bedrijfsleven en bij de overheid Een platte organisatie met ruimte voor ondernemerschap, initiatief en creativiteit Een grondig inwerkprogramma in onze tooling en methodiek, en ruimte voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling Flexibele werkafspraken en een betrokken team van hoog niveau Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een mobiele telefoon, MacBook en verzekeringen Wij geloven dat software beter kan en moet bijdragen aan de organisaties waarin het draait. Deel jij die overtuiging en wil je helpen die waar te maken? Dan horen we graag van je. Job Requirements Je bent een senior professional die sterk projectmanagement combineert met plezier in klantcontact. Je hebt eerder complexe projecten geleid binnen grote organisaties en weet hoe je resultaat boekt in een omgeving met veel belanghebbenden, wisselende prioriteiten en formele besluitvorming. title: Art Director mit Schwerpunkt Digital – Websites und Social Media (all genders)
description: Aus guten Ideen machst du starke Kommunikation? Publik ist eine inhabergeführte Agentur in Mannheim mit einem klaren Fokus: Wir machen Kommunikation, die wirkt – strategisch fundiert, kreativ umgesetzt und messbar erfolgreich. Unsere Kundinnen und Kunden kommen aus Technologie, Industrie und Professional Services. Für sie entwickeln wir Strategien, steuern Kampagnen und sorgen dafür, dass aus Sichtbarkeit echte Ergebnisse werden. Aufgaben Du entwickelst kreative Leitideen und Kommunikationskonzepte, die über einzelne Maßnahmen hinausgehen. Du denkst nicht nur in Layouts und Kampagnen, sondern auch in Zielen, Zielgruppen und Ergebnissen. Du hinterfragst Briefings, erkennst Chancen und bringst eigene Ideen ein, die unsere Kundinnen und Kunden weiterbringen. Kennzahlen aus Webanalyse und Social Media nutzt du, um deine Gestaltung weiterzuentwickeln. Du konzipierst und gestaltest Websites und Landingpages, von der Seitenstruktur und Nutzerführung über Wireframes bis zum responsiven Design. Die Umsetzung begleitest du gemeinsam mit unseren Entwicklungspartnern. Für Social Media konzipierst du visuelle Systeme und plattformgerechte Formate für LinkedIn und Instagram. Dazu gehören Karussell-Beiträge, Postings und Stories mit Bewegtbild. Du entwickelst flexible Gestaltungselemente und Templates, die eine Marke über viele Beiträge hinweg einheitlich und wiedererkennbar halten. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte und kannst unseren Kundinnen und Kunden Ideen und Konzepte gut vermitteln. Dabei weißt du, wie wichtig Content ist, und hast ein hervorragendes Gespür dafür, wie du ihn mithilfe deiner ausgefeilten Designs noch besser transportieren kannst. Du arbeitest eng mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Kundenberatung und Projektmanagement zusammen – so sorgst du für spür- und messbare Wirkung auf allen Kommunikationskanälen, von Website und Social Media über das Kampagnenmotiv bis zu Magazin und Geschäftsbericht. Ob Print oder Digital – das ist für dich keine Frage. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt im Digitalen, und du kennst trotzdem die Stärken, Anforderungen und Möglichkeiten beider Welten. Qualifikation Du hast dein Designstudium abgeschlossen und Berufserfahrung bevorzugt in einer Agentur gesammelt. In Konzeption und Gestaltung bist du versiert, und das zeigt dein Portfolio mit Websites und Social-Media-Projekten als wichtigem Teil. Figma ist eines deiner zentralen Werkzeuge, auch für Komponenten und Prototypen. Mit der Adobe Creative Suite bringst du deine kreativen Ideen zum Leben, und mit Microsoft 365 kommst du gut zurecht. Du kennst die Grundlagen von UX und Content-Management-Systemen gut genug, um mit unseren Entwicklungspartnern auf Augenhöhe zu sprechen. Du beobachtest neue Technologien und Werkzeuge – von KI-gestützter Bild- und Content-Erstellung bis zu neuen Design-Workflows – und setzt sie sinnvoll ein. Den Feinschliff verleihst du mit deiner Persönlichkeit: Du bist kreativ, besitzt ein gutes Gespür für effektive Werbung, verstehst die Bedeutung von Usability und kannst Trends einschätzen sowie zwischen nachhaltigen Entwicklungen und kurzlebigen Hypes unterscheiden. Du bist kontaktfreudig, nimmst andere gerne mit in die „Design-Denke“ und scheust weder Kunden noch Pitches. Benefits Spannende und vielseitige Aufgaben in Teil- oder Vollzeit. Bei uns arbeitest du nicht in einer Kreativabteilung mit langen Abstimmungsschleifen. Du entwickelst Ideen direkt mit Kundinnen und Kunden und Kolleginnen und Kollegen, bringst deine Perspektive ein und kannst sichtbar Einfluss auf Projekte, Prozesse und die kreative Entwicklung der Agentur nehmen. Eine vertrauensvolle Agenturatmosphäre und sympathische Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten, zahlreiche Teamveranstaltungen, ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und weitere Benefits. Eine ansprechend gestaltete Agentur im Taylor Green Business Park Mannheim, die ein nachhaltiges Konzept verfolgt und viel Raum zur Erholung und sportlichen Betätigung bietet. Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns über deine Bewerbung mit Angabe deines möglichen Eintrittstermins und sehr gerne auch mit ein paar Arbeitsproben. title: Junior Consultant (Werkstudent:in, m/w/d)
description: Die Wirtschaft von morgen entsteht heute. Unter alles andere als einfachen Bedingungen. Viele Unternehmen stehen unter erheblichem Druck. Kosten müssen gesenkt, komplexe regulatorische Anforderungen bewältigt und bestehende Geschäftsmodelle hinterfragt werden. Gleichzeitig eröffnen neue Technologien, Innovationen und veränderte Märkte große Chancen. Wir sind überzeugt: Die Antwort liegt nicht allein darin, das Bestehende effizienter zu machen. Unternehmen müssen sich weiterentwickeln, neue Geschäftsmodelle gestalten, die langfristig wirtschaftlich erfolgreich sind – innerhalb planetarer Grenzen und mit Blick auf die Menschen. Hast Du bereits erste Erfahrungen in der Unternehmensberatung gesammelt? Möchtest Du verstehen, wie Unternehmen funktionieren und wie man Transformation gestaltet? Suchst Du ein Umfeld mit hohen Ansprüchen, persönlichem Vertrauen und viel Gelegenheit zum Lernen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen. Über uns Better Earth steht für Business Transformation für eine zukunftsfähige Wirtschaft. Wir unterstützen Menschen in Unternehmen und Unternehmer:innen, die wirtschaftlichen Erfolg und die Gestaltung einer positiven Zukunft miteinander verbinden wollen. Wir sind pragmatisch aber folgen einem klare Kompass. Unsere Arbeit reicht von der Entwicklung zukunftsfähiger Geschäftsmodelle über den Aufbau wirksamer ESG-Funktionen inkl. Berichtswesen bis zur Integration langfristiger ökologischer und gesellschaftlicher Anforderungen in unternehmerische und Investitionsentscheidungen. Dabei wissen wir, dass unsere Partnerunternehmen unter erheblichem wirtschaftlichem und organisatorischem Druck stehen. Wir helfen etablierten Unternehmen, Gründungs- und Investmentteams, handlungsfähig zu bleiben und die richtigen Weichen zu stellen. Wie wir zusammenarbeiten, ist uns genauso wichtig wie das, woran wir arbeiten. Better Earth hat ein kleines Kernteam und arbeitet bewusst mit einem Netzwerk langjährig vertrauter, erfahrener Berater:innen, Unternehmer:innen und Fachexpert:innen. Wir stellen Teams zusammen, die fachliche Tiefe, unternehmerische Erfahrung und Perspektiven verbinden. Für Dich bedeutet das: Du arbeitest unmittelbar mit erfahrenen Menschen, lernst ihre Herangehensweisen kennen und kannst früh Verantwortung übernehmen. Statt vieler Ebenen gibt es bei uns kurze Wege, persönliche Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiges Vertrauen. Unser Büro liegt in Berlin-Mitte. Dort teilen wir uns die Räume mit der Deep-Tech-Investmentplattform Marvelous. Unsere Partnerunternehmen sitzen in Berlin, im Ruhrgebiet, in Müchen und an der Küste. Was Du bei uns machst Du arbeitest eng mit einem Co-Founder von Better Earth zusammen und unterstützt ihn direkt in Kundenprojekten sowie bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt zunächst auf der Zusammenarbeit mit etablierten Unternehmen. Inhaltliche Arbeit Du recherchierst, analysierst und strukturierst Informationen und bereitest sie in Präsentationen und Berichten auf Du unterstützt die Entwicklung von Strategien, die Ausgestaltung von ESG-Funktionen und die Integration von Nachhaltigkeitsinformationen in Geschäftsprozesse. Du hilfst Unternehmen, ihre Berichtsfähigkeit wirkungvoll und bürokratiearm aufzubauen und regulatorische Anforderungen pragmatisch umzusetzen Organisation und Projektsteuerung Du unterstützt die Zusammenarbeit in Projektteams aus Better Earth, unseren Netzwerkpartner:innen und unseren Partnerunternehmen Du koordinierst Aufgaben, Termine und Informationen, verfolgst Ergebnisse nach und sorgst dafür, dass Vereinbarungen umgesetzt werden Du übernimmst zunehmend eigenständig Aufgaben und bist für unsere Projektpartner:innen eine verlässliche Ansprechperson Weiterentwicklung von Better Earth Du bringst Dich bei der Geschäftsentwicklung, beim Marketing und bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Organisation ein Du hilfst, unsere internen Prozesse und die sinnvolle kontrollierte Nutzung von KI-Werkzeugen weiterzuentwickeln Du unterstützt uns dabei, unser Wissen systematisch zu nutzen und strukturiert verfügbar zu halten. Was du mitbringst: Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrungen in einer Strategie-, Management- oder Unternehmensberatung gesammelt, beispielsweise im Rahmen eines Praktikums Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder ein vergleichbares Fach, idealerweise im fortgeschrittenen Bachelor- oder Masterstudium, Nachhaltigkeitsbezug ist hilfreich Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest strukturiert, präzise und gewissenhaft. Hohe Ansprüche und ein vertrauensvolles Umfeld. Wir arbeiten sorgfältig, geben einander Feedback und sprechen offen über Fehler und Unsicherheiten. title: Product Frontend Engineer
description: quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where this is going Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either. That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience. One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy. Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled. Why this role exists Today , quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with. What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards. That is the opening. How we work We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing. We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high. Tasks What you will own Everything on the screen: The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account. The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components. The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device. Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native. The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished. Where design ends, engineering begins. We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you. Requirements Who we are looking for You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed. You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building. You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels. You are fluent in English, no other language is required.
