Händlerkooperationen: Mit unseren Handelspartnern entwickelst du gemeinsame Social-Media- und Online-Aktionen. Du stellst ihnen passenden Content bereit und sorgst dafür, dass RAYMON auch auf den Kanälen unserer Händler stark auftritt. Online & Social weiterdenken: Du bringst unsere Online- und Social-Themen aktiv voran. Dazu gehören neue Formate, Plattformen, Tools und KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen. Events & Content vor Ort: Bei Messen, Händlerveranstaltungen und eigenen Events unterstützt du das Team. Dabei hältst du die besten Momente direkt für unsere Kanäle fest. Qualifikation Social-Media-Know-how: Du hast ein Studium in Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien oder einem ähnlichen Bereich abgeschlossen und/oder Berufserfahrung im Social Media Marketing gesammelt. Immer am Social-Media-Ball: Du verfolgst Trends, Formate und Plattform-Updates. Du kannst einschätzen, was davon zu RAYMON passt und was nicht. Kreativität & Ideen: Du hast eigene Ideen und bringst sie aktiv ein. Bestehendes stellst du gern infrage und probierst Neues aus. Kamerapräsenz: Du stehst auch mal selbst vor der Kamera, ob für Reels, Stories oder Produktvideos. Digital Mindset: Du bist offen für neue Tools und KI-gestützte Workflows. Du siehst, wo sich Content-Produktion und Prozesse smarter gestalten lassen. Hands-on-Mentalität: Du bist dir für keine Aufgabe zu schade, egal ob Content-Planung, Dreh am Trail oder Unterstützung beim Eventaufbau. Organisationstalent: Du arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch bei vielen Kanälen und Projekten gleichzeitig den Überblick. Bike Passion & Produktverständnis: Du interessierst dich für Fahrräder und unsere Branche. Du willst unsere Bikes, Technologien und Zielgruppen genau kennenlernen und dieses Wissen in deinen Content einfließen lassen. Kommunikationsstärke: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, mit unserer Community genauso wie mit internationalen Partnern. Flexibilität: Du bist bereit, gelegentlich zu reisen, um das Team bei Events und Messen zu unterstützen. Benefits Familiäres Team, starke Marke: Bei R Raymon Bicycles erwartet dich ein herzliches, motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echter Hands-on-Kultur. Bike-Benefit: Dein Bike, dein Ride: Leihe dir für bis zu ein Jahr ein Fahrrad oder E-Bike aus unserem aktuellen Sortiment – nahezu kostenfrei und mit flexiblen Optionen im Anschluss. Zeit für dich: Genieße 30 Tage Jahresurlaub für Erholung, Abenteuer und neue Energie. Zukunft sichern: Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge inklusive 25 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss – für eine finanziell abgesicherte Zukunft. Gesundheit zählt: Wir unterstützen dich mit einer privaten Zusatzabsicherung im Rahmen einer betrieblichen Krankenversicherung. Energie tanken: Kalte und warme Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir kostenlos zur Verfügung. Gemeinschaft, die trägt: Freu dich auf regelmäßige Team-Events, gemeinsame Erlebnisse und echten Zusammenhalt. Mitgestalten statt nur mitarbeiten: Bringe deine Ideen ein und gestalte aktiv unsere gemeinsame Zukunft. Aus Fehlern lernen: Eine offene und positive Fehlerkultur sorgt für Vertrauen, Entwicklung und echtes Teamwork. DU BIST EIN GUTER FIT? title: Senior People Specialist (HR Operations & Strategy) (m/w/d)
description: Kurzbeschreibung SPREAD baut Engineering Intelligence für komplexe Produkte. Unsere AI-native Plattform gibt Automobilherstellern, Rüstungsunternehmen und Industriekonzernen eine vernetzte Sicht auf ihre Produktdaten. Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Bosch und Rheinmetall arbeiten bereits damit. Hinter uns stehen HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia und Salesforce. Wir haben den SPARK AI Innovation Award gewonnen und stehen auf LinkedIns Liste der Top-Startups in DACH. Die Rolle. Du baust die People-Programme von SPREAD auf: Performance, Karrierepfade, Compensation und Leadership Development. Von Februar bis November übernimmst du vertretungsweise unsere HR-Operations-Prozesse, die bereits gut eingespielt sind. Daneben bleibt genug Zeit, um parallel mit den ersten Strategiethemen zu starten. Ab November kommt unser Kollege aus HR Operations in Teilzeit zurück und übernimmt die Prozesse wieder. Ab dann liegt dein Fokus klar auf Strategie und Programmen. Du berichtest an Jasmina (People Lead). Unser People-Team ist bewusst schlank: Neben dir und Jasmina gehört eine Werkstudentin dazu, die das Office Management verantwortet und in HR hineinwächst, und ab November wieder unser Kollege aus HR Operations. Wir setzen auf Talentdichte statt Headcount, und deine Programme sorgen dafür, dass Leistung sichtbar wird und sich lohnt. KI gehört bei uns überall dazu, im People-Team genauso. Sie setzt deine Gedanken schneller um, das Denken bleibt bei dir. Du bist mindestens drei Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office an der Köpenicker Straße, das ist gesetzt, denn HR passiert hier vor Ort. Wenn du Bock hast, People-Arbeit nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern aufzubauen, lies weiter. Deine Verantwortung Du gestaltest und fährst unseren Performance-Zyklus, von Evaluation-Frameworks über Kalibrierung bis zum Talent Board, damit Entscheidungen über Entwicklung und Gehalt nachvollziehbar sind. Du entwickelst Career Frameworks und Leveling weiter, damit jede:r weiß, wo sie oder er steht und was als Nächstes kommt. Du bereitest Compensation-Entscheidungen mit Daten vor, von Benchmarking über Gehaltsrunden bis zum Bonus. Du bringst Leadership- und Manager-Formate an den Start, die unsere Führungskräfte spürbar besser machen. Du steuerst interne Kommunikation und Pulse Surveys und leitest daraus Maßnahmen ab, die auch wirklich umgesetzt werden. Du legst jedes Thema so vor, dass entschieden werden kann, mit Optionen und einer klaren Empfehlung. Von Februar bis November verantwortest du vertretungsweise die HR-Administration von Vertrag bis Offboarding, betreibst Personio als Single Source of Truth und koordinierst die Payroll mit DATEV, pünktlich und ohne Gedöns. Du automatisierst wiederkehrenden Papierkram selbst, damit Ops schlank läuft und dir Zeit für die Programme bleibt. Du leitest unsere Werkstudentin an und entwickelst sie Richtung HR, damit sie dir Schritt für Schritt mehr Ops abnehmen kann. Deine Erfahrung Must-have Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, idealerweise in (Wirtschafts-)Psychologie oder mit klarem HR-Schwerpunkt. 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im HR Bereich, gerne im strategischen Bereich oder auch im operativen. Das heißt du kennst gängige best-practices, aktuelle Themen in der HR Welt und verschiedene Perspektiven auf wiederkehrende Herausforderungen in der Branche Erfahrung in HR Operations, in denen du z.B. Verträge, On- und Offboarding oder die Payroll-Vorbereitung verantwortet hast. Du hast ein HRIS eigenständig betreut und weißt, wie saubere Stammdaten aussehen. Du hast mindestens ein People-Thema konzeptionell verantwortet, zum Beispiel Performance-Zyklen, Career Frameworks, Compensation oder Leadership-Entwicklung. Arbeitsrecht kennst du so gut, dass du die meisten Fälle selbst löst und weißt, wann unsere Kanzlei ran muss. Du baust einfache Automatisierungen selbst, nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude jeden Tag, weißt, was ein MCP ist, und prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch. Du hältst Tagesgeschäft und ein, zwei Konzeptthemen parallel am Laufen, ohne dass etwas liegen bleibt. Du denkst bei jeder Entscheidung mit, wie sie bei den Leuten ankommt, führst schwierige Gespräche ruhig und klar, und Vertrauliches bleibt bei dir. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. Strong plus Du kennst Personio und DATEV aus der Praxis. Du hast einen Master. Du hast schon eine Werkstudentin, einen Werkstudenten oder Juniors angeleitet. Du hast in einem schnell wachsenden Startup gearbeitet. Du hast einen Führerschein. Warum SPREAD? Wir verkaufen KI für Engineering an große Automobil- und Industrieunternehmen, mit einem Produkt, das bei unseren Kunden produktiv läuft. Jedes Team bei uns arbeitet mit Claude-Agents, HR auch. Du baust die People-Seite eines Scale-ups auf, nicht die Verwaltung eines Konzerns, und arbeitest dabei direkt mit der People Lead und den Foundern. Dazu bekommst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, ein jährliches Lernbudget, ein Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club, 30 Urlaubstage plus einen bezahlten Volunteering-Tag und dreimal pro Woche Lunch im Office. So stellen wir ein. Ein Erstgespräch, ein Fachgespräch und dann ein Auswahltag mit einer praktischen Challenge, einem Fit-Interview und gegebenenfalls einem Founder-Interview. Vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Angebot vergeht meist weniger als ein Monat. Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir schauen uns jede Bewerbung genau an. That’s why we’re looking for developers who share ideas, explore options, and communicate openly.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <p>You’ll be part of a team with end-to-end responsibility for its own microservices, collaborating across disciplines to build, operate, and continuously improve our products.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build end-to-end</strong> by designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and improving scalable microservices and features.</li> <li><strong>Own what you deliver</strong>, taking responsibility for the quality, resilience, and maintainability of your team’s services throughout their lifecycle.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate across disciplines</strong> while closely working with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile engineers to share ideas and deliver product innovations.</li> <li><strong>Improve how we work</strong>, identifying opportunities to make our engineering processes more effective and efficient.</li> <li><strong>Strengthen our engineering culture</strong> by documenting and advocating for development best practices across the team.</li> <li><strong>Raise product quality</strong> by fixing bugs and refactoring the codebase where necessary to keep our products reliable and maintainable.</li> <li><strong>Learn and experiment</strong> by testing new technologies and participating in Technical Week - a week dedicated to creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains after every two product sprints.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></h3> <p>You understand the full lifecycle of web development, identify opportunities, explore solutions, and keep customer needs at the center of your work. Our stack is mainly focused on Ruby; however, prior Ruby experience is not essential if you’re passionate about learning new things.</p> <ul> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Strong software engineering foundations</span>: 7+ years of software development experience, specifically with object-oriented programming.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Relevant product experience</span>: 3+ years of experience working with customer-facing products in industries such as e-commerce, fintech, or SaaS.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Backend service expertise</span>: Experience designing, implementing, and deploying backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency, and consistency.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">API and data knowledge</span>: A good understanding of API design, SQL, and relational databases.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Clear communication</span>: Excellent English communication skills and comfort raising concerns, sharing ideas, and documenting your work.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Collaborative mindset</span>: You contribute to the team, take initiative, and step in to help when needed.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Solution-oriented thinking</span>: You actively identify opportunities and explore alternative approaches to solving problems.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Commitment to growth</span>: You take ownership of developing your skills by learning new technologies and seeking new opportunities.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>How We Work</strong></h3> <p>Our engineers work in small, fully autonomous, and highly collaborative Agile teams aligned with one of three verticals: Demand, Supply, or Fulfilment.</p> <ul> <li>Teams are responsible for their own microservices from design and development through deployment, maintenance, and improvement.</li> <li>Engineers collaborate closely with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile colleagues.</li> <li>We value bold thinking, curiosity, openness, initiative, and a strong customer focus.</li> <li>Technical Week creates dedicated space for experimentation, creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains.</li> </ul> <h3>Where You'll Be</h3> <p>This is a <em>Hybrid</em> role based in Amsterdam. <strong>You will work from our <span style="text-decoration: underline;">Amsterdam HQ</span> a minimum of 2 days per week.</strong><br>At this time, we are only considering candidates who are already based in<strong> </strong>the <strong>Netherlands</strong>. As a result, <span style="text-decoration: underline;">relocation support is not available for this position</span>. We can, however, <span style="text-decoration: underline;">provide visa transfer from current Dutch employer</span>.</p> <h3>In Return</h3> <p>You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of <strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">800+ Catawikians</span>.</strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">A competitive <u>Annual Gross Base Salary</u> depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.</li> <li value="2">A <u>Work From Home Allowance</u> to help with your monthly household bills.</li> <li value="3"><u>Commuting</u> between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.</li> <li value="4">Amazing <u>Office</u> right in the centre of Amsterdam.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="text text-align-left "> <h3><strong>Why You'll Love Working with Us</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Create a visible impact </strong>by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. title: Senior Researcher, Human Rights and Artificial Intelligence
description: <p><strong>FULL-TIME JOB VACANCY</strong><br><strong>Senior Researcher on Human Rights and Artificial Intelligence</strong><br><strong>Technology, Rights and Investigations Division</strong><br><strong>Multiple Office Locations Considered</strong><br><strong>Application Deadline: December 13, 2026</strong><br> <br>Human Rights Watch (HRW) is seeking a highly qualified Senior Researcher on Human Rights and Artificial Intelligence to investigate, analyze, and advocate against human rights abuses worldwide related to artificial intelligence. The role of the Senior Researcher will include documenting and conveying the rights implications of various forms of artificial intelligence and other algorithmic decision-making being developed and deployed by governments and private sector actors around the world for exclusion and repression, including  information control and censorship and discriminatory decision making, especially in high-risk contexts, for example by law enforcement and immigration authorities. Experience working on the impact of AI or other technology issues in Asia is preferred.</p> <p>The role sits in the Tech and Human Rights team within the broader Technology, Rights and Investigations Division and will report to the Deputy Director based in New York. The Senior Researcher on Human Rights and Artificial Intelligence will collaborate with other team members in the Technology, Rights and Investigations Division, and colleagues in regional and thematic divisions, and other relevant departments of HRW, including media, legal and policy team, and the advocacy department.</p> <p>The successful candidate will have deep domain expertise, as well as a track record of conducting research and investigations at the intersection of human rights abuses and AI. The role will be based in any of the following locations where HRW has an office, and will be expected to work from the office on an as-needed basis: New York, Washington DC, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Toronto, Sao Paulo, London, Brussels, Amsterdam, Berlin, Nairobi, Johannesburg, Beirut, or Stockholm. </p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></span><br>1. Develop a plan for strategic research and advocacy for influencing the development, application, and regulation of artificial intelligence and similar technologies by governments and the private sector to ensure respect for internationally recognized human rights, including non-discrimination and accountability;<br>2. Research, document, and analyze policies and practices related to AI, machine learning, and big data technologies that raise human rights concerns by collecting and analyzing information from a wide variety of sources, including governments, media, academia, NGOs, victims of abuses, open-source information, technologists, and others; Interview persons whose rights have been harmed by AI technologies, as well as related professionals and experts (e.g., organizations representing impacted communities, engineers who build AI technologies, data and computer scientists, etc.); <br>3. Identify and document where use of AI may have disparate impact on vulnerable or marginalized groups or may exacerbate economic inequality, and place abuses or potential for abuses within the broader political, social and economic contexts;<br>4. Write and publicize reports, op-eds, press releases, briefing memos, statements, testimony and other materials to disseminate our research findings and policy recommendations for preventing or ending human rights abuses linked to artificial intelligence applications; <br>5. Work with colleagues in the Communications Department to develop innovative multimedia and social media strategies to communicate our positions in clear and compelling ways and to advance advocacy;<br>6. Develop and implement advocacy strategies in collaboration with HRW colleagues to change or prevent abusive government laws, policies, and practices, as well as abusive corporate policies and practices; <br>7. Press companies and governments to ensure human rights protections are built into artificial intelligence by design from the outset and articulate how existing human rights standards should apply to emerging AI technologies;  <br>8. Build partnerships across key communities, including other human rights NGOs, groups representing vulnerable populations, data scientists, machine learning programmers, tech industry leaders, and academics; <br>9. Contribute to the shaping of public debates on AI around human rights internationally through clear and prompt responses to queries from policy makers, the media, colleagues, and human rights communities; <br>10. Work collaboratively with an international team of researchers within the Technology, Rights and Investigations division, including the Digital Investigations Lab, other thematic and country HRW researchers, and other relevant departments of HRW, including Communications, Legal and Policy, Advocacy, and the General Counsel’s office;<br>11. Travel domestically and internationally, as required, to conduct research, media work and advocacy; and<br>12. Be prepared and willing to work flexible hours to accommodate developing and urgent events;<br>13. Carry out other tasks as required.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Candidate Profile </strong></span></p> <p>Candidates who are traditionally underrepresented in the technology and/or human rights sectors (such as people who identify as BIPOC, LGBTQIA+, women, migrants, people with disabilities, or people who have other related lived experiences) are enthusiastically encouraged to apply if they feel they have the ability to succeed in this role, even if they do not have all the skills and qualifications listed below.</p> <p><strong>Education:</strong> An advanced degree in journalism, law, public policy, national security, computer science, or a related field or equivalent experience is required.</p> <p><strong>Experience:</strong> A minimum of seven years of experience is required. This experience could come from a<br>variety of previous roles including, but not limited to journalists who have covered technology,<br>community activism, work at impact litigation organizations, academics, or industry professionals.</p> <p><strong>Related Skills and Knowledge</strong>:<br>1. Extensive knowledge of artificial intelligence, in particular the threats and complexities it poses to the major human rights challenges of our time is required.<br>2. Experience working on the impact of AI or other technology issues in Asia and fluency in an Asian language are desirable. <br>3. Strong commitment to understanding how technology can impact the rights of women, racial and ethnic minorities, children, older people, people with disabilities, people living in poverty and low-wage workers, and other populations whose rights may be disproportionately impacted by AI is desirable.<br>4. Proven track record of producing timely and high-quality written research and investigations, as well as editing experience is required.<br>5. Ability to present and defend complex technology-related issues and positions to officials in governments, companies, and other bodies and institutions is preferable.<br>6. Being comfortable with generating and executing research projects, and the curiosity and creativity to follow through and follow up is required.<br>7. Exceptionally strong research, analytical, writing, and editing skills are required.<br>8. Experience conducting challenging investigative research globally is required, as is the ability to dig deep and tenacity in finding hard-to-get information, sources and records.<br>9. Good oral and written communication skills in English, and strong public speaking skills, are required; proficiency in other languages, is highly desirable.<br>10. Experience with TV, radio, print, and social media is highly desirable.<br>11. Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as successfully with a team and across other teams is required.<br>12. Strong interpersonal skills to work collaboratively within HRW, as well as develop constructive relationships with NGO partners, and company and government officials are required.<br>13. Demonstrated awareness and sensitivity to the needs and concerns of individuals from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and orientations is required.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Salary and Benefits</strong></span>: HRW offers competitive compensation and employer-paid benefits. HRW offers relocation assistance package and will assist employees in obtaining necessary work authorization in all listed locations except Nairobi, if required; citizens of all nationalities are encouraged to apply. If based in the United States, the salary range would be 88,000 – 104,000. Salary ranges outside of the United States vary based on location.<br> <br><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>How to Apply</strong></span>: Please apply by December 13, 2026, by visiting our online job portal at careers.hrw.org and submitting a cover letter and CV or resume. No calls or email inquiries, please. Only complete applications will be reviewed and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. <br> <br>If you are experiencing technical difficulties with your application submission, or if you require disability-related accommodation, please email ----- Rights Watch is strong because it is diverse</strong>. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Human Rights Watch does not discriminate on the basis of disability, age, gender identity and expression, national origin, race and ethnicity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, or criminal record. We welcome all kinds of diversity. Our employees include people who are parents and nonparents, the self-taught and university educated, and from a wide span of socio-economic backgrounds and perspectives on the world. Human Rights Watch is an equal opportunity employer. </em><br><em> </em><br><em><strong>Human Rights Watch </strong>is an international human rights monitoring and advocacy organization known for its in-depth investigations, its incisive and timely reporting, its innovative and high-profile advocacy campaigns, and its success in changing the human rights-related policies and practices of influential governments and international institutions. </em></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Forward Deployed Engineering Manager
description: <p>As the Forward Deployed Engineering Manager, you will lead the team that puts Auterion's robotic systems to work with customers in the field. We build complete systems: vehicles, sensors, onboard compute, radio links, autonomy software, and ground control. Your job is to understand how all of it fits together and to make it work in real missions.</p> <p>You will lead your team through the entire customer engagement, from discovery and integration to field trials and handover. You are not a hardware specialist. You are a systems engineer who can trace a problem across every layer of the system, lead people well, and earn the trust of demanding customers.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Team Leadership & Mentorship:</strong> Lead and grow a cross-functional team of Forward Deployed Engineers covering systems integration and software. Hire, coach, and develop your engineers. Build a culture of ownership and proactive problem-solving.</li> <li><strong>Accountability:</strong> Keep the bar high for yourself and your team. Work directly with stakeholders across the company. You will have a close relationship with the CTO, CEO, VP of Engineering, and the engineering directors.</li> <li><strong>Field Deployment Oversight:</strong> Own technical delivery of customer deployments in demanding, non-standard environments. This covers system configuration, connectivity, mission readiness, and operation under environmental constraints.</li> <li><strong>System Integration:</strong> Act as the technical lead for high-stakes customer integrations. Ensure the full system works end to end: vehicle, payloads, onboard compute, communication links, autonomy software, and ground control.</li> <li><strong>Field Troubleshooting:</strong> Diagnose failures across hardware, firmware, software, and communications. Use logs, telemetry, and structured debugging to find root causes fast.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:</strong> Serve as the primary technical contact for defense and enterprise customers. Translate operational requirements into deployment plans that account for system performance, link quality, power, and mission constraints. Run technical meetings, demos, and field days.</li> <li><strong>Feedback Loop & Release Coordination:</strong> Work closely with Product and R&D to feed field results and real-world edge cases back into the product. Coordinate with R&D on platform releases so customer deployments stay current and stable.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications and Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Systems Engineering:</strong> 7+ years in technical roles in robotics, drones, autonomous vehicles, or comparable complex embedded systems. You understand the full system end to end and how a change in one subsystem affects the others.</li> <li><strong>Leadership Experience:</strong> 3+ years managing a technical, customer-facing team (Field Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Solutions Architects, or similar). You have dealt with underperformance and built team culture deliberately.</li> <li><strong>Software Skills:</strong> Comfortable working in Linux. You write Python, read C++, and use Git. You debug from logs and telemetry, not only at the bench.</li> <li><strong>Hardware Fluency:</strong> You understand hardware at integration level: power, sensors, interfaces, and RF basics. You do not need to be a hardware designer.</li> <li><strong>Field Deployment Expertise:</strong> Hands-on experience with field-deployed systems where "turning it off and on again" isn't always an option. Understanding of networking and radio communication is a major plus.</li> <li><strong>Crisis Management:</strong> Proven ability to troubleshoot critical failures in the field under high pressure and with limited physical access to the hardware.</li> <li><strong>Customer Presence:</strong> Composure and credibility in front of demanding customers. You communicate clearly with engineers and decision-makers alike.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluent English. German is a strong plus.</li> <li><strong>Work Authorization:</strong> Must hold EU citizenship and be eligible to work in the European Union without restriction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, or ROS2</li> <li>Background in defense or government programs</li> <li>Eligibility for German security clearance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Flexible working hours</li> <li>Stock Options</li> <li>Generous holiday allowance</li> <li>Pension plan </li> <li>Extended social security package </li> <li>Enhanced maternity & paternity leave</li> <li>Wellpass membership </li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Auterion</strong></h3> <p>We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.</p> <p>At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Data Science Lead
description: Data Science Lead The adjoe Ads Data Science team owns the entire bidding algorithm that decides which ad you are most likely to enjoy from start to finish: conversion prediction, user quality estimation, and bid shading. Every bid adjoe placed in an ad auction is the output of ML models making 50 billion predictions daily , trained on data from our mobile SDKs that capture real user behavior at scale. The team moves fast: new ideas tested offline, A/B tests launched in production within minutes. We rely on industry-proven state of the art technology, adapted to our needs and self-hosted where it matters: PyTorch and TensorFlow for modeling, Trino and Athena for querying a 350TB Iceberg data lake , Airflow and Ray for orchestrating our different training pipelines across multiple GPU clusters. Models are built on 600+ features and trained on 200 million data points , with the full ML lifecycle owned by the team from research and experimentation to deployment and real-time inference at sub-200ms latency. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: Hands-on People Leadership: You are a good listener and navigator, you inspire and empower your colleagues to florish. You will directly manage a team of Data Scientists and Data Analysts, owning 1-on-1s, performance reviews, and career growth. You are able to spot great modeling work, catch blockers like GPU limits or data quality issues, and brainstorm directly with the team rather than passing questions along. Pragmatic Execution & Adaptive Process: You will build lightweight workflows for A/B testing, code reviews, incident management, and AI agent usage, introducing stricter structures only as our products mature. With a "hacker mindset," you prioritize shipping over bureaucracy, know when to balance experimentation with focus, and embed code hygiene into daily routines instead of one-off cleanup days. Technical Fluency & Root-Cause Instinct: While not coding daily, you read Python, write SQL, use Git, and understand how technical systems work and what they cost under the hood. You use your analytical background to spot early warning signs in data, code, or team dynamics and trace them to their root cause. Roadmap Co-Ownership & Business Alignment: You will partner with Staff Data Scientists to shape the roadmap while bridging business stakeholders and tech teams. You prioritize ideas by business impact, translate requirements into technical realities for the team, and align competing perspectives when multiple valid opinions exist. Problem-First Ownership & Pace: You drive projects forward, refusing to accept "it doesn't work" as an answer and finding ways to make solutions viable. You push back when execution slows down, start with the problem before the solution, and know when to move fast versus when to double-check everything. Plus: A formal background in mathematics and prior hands-on experience as a Data Science IC. What’s in It for You? At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day. Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries. Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum. Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams. Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other. Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy. We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company. We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company. title: Customer Success Partner
description: Customer Success Partner, Enterprise As a Customer Success Partner at CreatorIQ, you will serve as a strategic advisor to a portfolio of high-level enterprise customers, helping them achieve meaningful business outcomes through their creator marketing programs. You’ll work closely with customers to understand their goals and align them with CreatorIQ’s platform capabilities, driving long-term adoption, value realization, and program success. This role will support some of our largest and most sophisticated European customers, with significant representation across beauty, fashion, and luxury. We’re looking for someone who brings a strong understanding of the creator and influencer marketing ecosystem and can confidently advise customers on how to evolve and scale their programs. You’ll build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with key stakeholders, both virtually and in person, and serve as a proactive partner throughout the customer lifecycle. Customer Success Partners are experts in the CreatorIQ platform, fluent in creator and influencer marketing strategy, and passionate about delivering measurable business impact. You will own the health and retention of your portfolio and will be measured on outcomes including gross retention, platform adoption, customer health, and value realization. As a Paris-based member of a broader European team, you’ll also need to be highly self-directed, comfortable operating with autonomy, and able to build strong internal and customer relationships across locations. What you’ll do: Serve as the primary strategic partner for a portfolio of complex enterprise customers, aligning CreatorIQ’s capabilities to their business goals and driving measurable value. Bring creator and influencer marketing expertise to customer conversations, helping customers evolve their strategies, solve challenges, and build sophisticated, scalable creator programs. Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day users to senior and executive stakeholders. Drive platform adoption and customer success by understanding each customer’s strategy, analyzing engagement, and identifying opportunities to increase value. Lead strategic engagements including success planning, business reviews, roadmap discussions, and in-person meetings as appropriate. Own customer health and retention across your portfolio, proactively identifying risk and coordinating action plans to support long-term success. Maintain strategic account plans that capture customer goals, key stakeholders, adoption opportunities, risks, and growth opportunities. Identify opportunities to deepen customer adoption and expand the value of CreatorIQ across their organizations. Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, Services, Support, and Product to deliver a cohesive customer experience and resolve needs effectively. Act as the voice of the customer internally while staying current on CreatorIQ capabilities and creator marketing trends, strategies, and best practices to bring relevant insights to customers. Collaborate effectively with colleagues across Europe and globally while operating with a high degree of ownership and independence from Paris. description: Role You’ll improve and extend the decision logic behind our battery fleet. These are the areas where we want to add strength: Improving and extending our optimization models for sequential decision-making on time series, across customer savings, grid fee rules and market value. Making decisions more robust to forecast uncertainty (load, PV, prices). Developing the on-site decision logic of our local control system: MPC, constraint handling and fallbacks. Making sure hard constraints always hold in operation: grid connection limits, feed-in restrictions, state of charge. Analyzing where we lose value compared to what was possible, and simulating new use cases before go-live. Bringing models into production together with our engineers. What we are looking for Strong in optimization or control under uncertainty, e.g. LP/MILP, MPC, stochastic or robust optimization, state estimation or Kalman filtering. title: Marketing Manager, ANZ
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is looking for an enthusiastic B2B Enterprise marketing manager, who is dynamic, creative, and analytical. The individual has a track record of delivering creative and smashing programs that generate new prospects and grow the marketing revenue pipeline. This person will be dedicated to growing our businesses in ANZ across enterprise and public sector accounts. </p> <p>You will support the creation, launch, and execution of campaigns that span a variety of channels - email, social, and webinars as well as supporting end-to-end execution of our in-person and virtual events, either direct or with our partners. You have a natural inclination to measure the effectiveness of marketing activities, strong project management skills, and the ability to think strategically and orchestrate many moving parts. You must have strong working knowledge and expertise in demand generation marketing funnel and lead flows. The right candidate will have the ability to work cross-functionally with all teams in-region, across APAC and in headquarters in San Francisco. This is a regional role based in Sydney or Melbourne, Australia. Market experience and expertise is required for this role.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Report into the Head of Marketing APAC, based in Singapore</li> <li>As the ANZ Enterprise marketing manager, you will plan, promote, and execute field marketing initiatives across the region that capture mindshare, drive prospects into customers and support Cloudflare customers on their journey to build and secure on Cloudflare.</li> <li>You will be accountable for online, trade shows, conferences, executive dinners, workshops, developing communities, and the full range of regional marketing tactics and execution for Australia across enterprise & public sector.</li> <li>Manage campaigns from strategic planning and execution to evaluation, ensuring smooth project management throughout. Oversee timelines, track ROI, and implement data-driven optimisations to continuously improve performance and communicate campaign results to key stakeholders.</li> <li>Work in cross-functional teams and collaborate closely with global & regional demand centre teams, the partner team, BDR, product marketing, sales, marketing operations, sales ops and others in the development, execution and measurement of high-impact integrated marketing campaigns (global or regional) that are optimised and relevant across the marketing mix - online, offline, ABM, communities and more.</li> <li>Align marketing initiatives to directly support sales objectives, focusing on full lead lifecycle and funnel management, from lead generation to opportunity progression and customer loyalty and expansion.</li> <li>Assess campaign performance using SFDC and Tableau reporting, evaluate ROI, and provide data-driven recommendations for improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>5 to 8 years proven experience in B2B marketing (enterprise software, cybersecurity, SaaS, regional marketing and/or info security experience a plus)</li> <li>BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, or other quantitative field</li> <li>On the digital side, you will be supporting our digital teams to help with execution and optimisation of online marketing campaigns across multiple channels (e.g. email, webinars, social media, etc.). </li> <li>Excellent channel experience working with partner marketing, distribution, resellers and systems integrators. </li> <li>In addition, you must have experience in planning, budgeting and managing trade shows, events, and conferences from start to finish</li> <li>Have proven track record of launching successful online and offline marketing campaigns and driving qualified leads in the funnel</li> <li>Strong project management/organisational skills and the ability to successfully manage multiple initiatives at once</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills, collaborative, and the ability to coordinate across multiple departments in different time zones</li> <li>Results oriented with experience using qualitative and quantitative metrics with a focus on revenue, conversion, sales and other marketing goals</li> <li>Analytically inclined, exceptional organisational skills, with rigorous attention to detail</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment with tight deadlines</li> <li>Having a strong sense of curiosity and passion for learning</li> <li>Exhibit strong stakeholders’ management and communication skills</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Marketo, and Tableau, will be an advantage.</li> <li>Previous experience in a high growth company in the SaaS, security, or network space, combined with knowledge of how the Internet works is a plus</li> <li>An established player in the business and marketing community with a strong business network which included media, marketing agencies, events organisers, social media platforms amongst others.  </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: AI-Native Software Engineer (Human)
description: What's it about? At Event Inc, we make meetings, events and business travel easier. Our platform connects companies with hotels, venues and service providers and automates processes that would otherwise take days. We work AI-first: AI agents aren’t an experiment for us, they’re a core part of our everyday engineering. As an AI-Native Software Engineer (Human) you use AI agents to build features across repositories, languages and systems that genuinely help our customers. And you always stay accountable for the result: AI writes along, you decide. Your role Build user-facing features where UX comes first: think about the user’s problem, the flow and the small details before you write code. Bring product instincts: question requirements, suggest better solutions and help decide what is worth building. Build new features spec-first: define requirements and edge cases, implement with AI, review critically, and ship in small, clean steps. Get up to speed quickly in unfamiliar codebases and languages with AI support, and refactor across repositories. Integrate external APIs, cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure) and SaaS tools securely and cleanly, including secrets and access management. Own reliability: monitoring, structured debugging and safe releases, so problems are caught before customers notice. Work directly with Product, Design and non-technical stakeholders to turn unclear requirements into clear solutions. Make the whole team more AI-fluent by sharing actively your agents, tools, workflows and learnings in code reviews and team syncs. What we like Functional mindset and understanding of Elixir’s process model (processes, message passing, supervision), plus how Phoenix LiveView works. Hands-on Elixir experience is a plus. Experience building end-user facing products with a strong sense of UX and product thinking. Back-office or data-pipeline-only backgrounds are not a fit for this role. title: Staff Robot Control Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Your tasks Imagine fleets of autonomous forklifts, each weighing several tons, lifting heavy loads into racks up to 14 meters high, safely and around the clock, right next to people. That's what we build at Jungheinrich Robotics, and AI-assisted engineering plays an important role in how we do it. In this role, you ensure that every one of these vehicles moves exactly as intended. We are hiring at both Senior and Staff levels. Apply for the role that fits you best, and we'll find the right fit together! You take ownership of the control software for our autonomous forklifts, from a unified hardware abstraction layer and actuator control based on ros_control/ros2_control to the interfaces with localization and navigation. You model and implement vehicle kinematics for different forklift types, including acceleration- and jerk-limited motion. You integrate motor controllers, drives, and actuators using fieldbus systems, particularly CANopen. You integrate and calibrate robot sensors, including encoders, IMUs, laser scanners, cameras, and lift height sensors. You improve the reliability of our robots in real-world environments through intelligent error handling, automated recovery mechanisms, and logging and analysis tools. You define and execute integration and system-level tests on real robots, test benches, and in simulation. You shape and drive the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across the team, from coding and test generation to AI-supported log analysis. You develop technical concepts and architectures for robot control, analyze requirements and trade-offs, and align design decisions with system architects, safety experts, and navigation specialists. You drive cross-team initiatives and mentor colleagues, depending on your experience and expertise. Requirements You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field, or bring equivalent practical experience. You bring at least 6 years of professional experience in robotics software development, including at least 3 years working with real mobile robots. You actively use AI-based tools, such as coding assistants, in your daily work and are eager to explore their potential further. You have proven experience developing technical concepts and architectures for robotic systems. You have a solid understanding of mobile robot kinematics, including acceleration-limited motion, and how localization and navigation interact with the hardware. You bring extensive experience with ROS1/ROS2 or comparable middleware, as well as ros_control/ros2_control or similar frameworks. You have experience integrating sensors, actuators, and fieldbus systems, ideally CANopen. You have strong programming skills in C++ and solid knowledge of Python. Experience with Rust is a plus. You bring in-depth expertise in at least one of the following areas: Safety PLC applications, such as Siemens S7 / TIA Portal Safety, Beckhoff TwinSAFE, or SICK Flexi Soft. Low-level, hardware-related software development, including CAN drivers, PROFINET, timing, and synchronization in sensor networks, ideally combined with microcontroller or embedded systems knowledge. Autonomous software for real robots, such as localization, navigation, and motion planning, combined with an interest in developing deeper expertise in low-level control. You are passionate about developing software that enables heavy autonomous vehicles to move smoothly and safely, and want to help shape the future of large robotic fleets in real warehouse environments. You ideally have experience with jerk-limited motion, setting up complete mobile robot software stacks, or intralogistics applications involving automated forklifts, AGVs, or AMRs. You communicate fluently in English and have intermediate German language skills (B1 level or higher). You are willing to work on-site at our Munich location. What we have to offer Cutting-edge technology: As pioneers in robotics we can navigate and manipulate without rails and guides and offer solutions to processes that no one could automate ever before! Team: We are an international team with more than 25 nationalities. You’ll work in a team with exceptionally smart, humble, collaborative and hardworking individuals. Culture: Come as you are! Join a vibrant, inventive, and diverse team that values collaboration over hierarchy. To innovate you need to fail from time to time — we always learn and improve. Workplace: Our office is located near the S‑Bahn station “Hirschgarten”. We work in a loft-style office with great equipment, our own workshop and testing area. Full Board: You don’t feel like thinking about what you want to have for lunch tomorrow, not to mention preparing it? Luckily, our french cook treats us with a freshly cooked free lunch everyday! And as the cherry on top, there is a packed fridge with drinks, fresh fruits and of course coffee! Flexibility: Flexibility is a top priority for us. Our hybrid working model for positions where presence is dispensable helps to achieve a healthy work-life balance. Benefits : We offer attractive holiday, EGYM, health care, and compensation packages. Learn more about our current benefits here. Not sure if you meet every single requirement? That's okay. We know that great people don't always tick every box. If you're excited about the opportunity to help shape the future of robotics and believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Your experience may be a great fit for this role or another opportunity at Jungheinrich Robotics. At Jungheinrich Robotics, where Magazino GmbH found its place, fostering inclusivity is very important to us. We are dedicated to create an inclusive environment for all candidates and provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, national origin, sexual orientation, culture, or education. If you need any reasonable adjustments to make the application process accessible for you, we’ll do our best to accommodate you. Feel free to approach us for that! Hardware-nahe Softwareentwicklung, beispielsweise CAN-Treiber, PROFINET, Timing und Synchronisation in Sensornetzwerken, idealerweise mit Kenntnissen im Bereich Mikrocontroller und Embedded Systems. Vollverpflegung: Du hast keine Lust, darüber nachzudenken, was Du morgen zu Mittag essen willst, geschweige denn, es vorzubereiten? Zum Glück verwöhnt uns unser französischer Koch jeden Tag mit einem frisch gekochten kostenlosen Mittagessen! Und als Sahnehäubchen gibt es einen gefüllten Kühlschrank mit Getränken, frischem Obst und natürlich Kaffee! Flexibilität: Flexibilität wird bei uns großgeschrieben. description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The team Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible, from compute orchestration and Kubernetes to bare metal, storage, and networking. European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it. The Role As a Storage Product Manager on the Cloud team, you will own the strategy and roadmap for Mistral's storage product portfolio. You have a deep understanding of the storage stack from block storage, distributed filesystems, object storage, and the evolving storage technology that accelerate AI/ML and HPC workloads. You understand what is slowing down the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud — translating those insights into products that are flexible, easy to build on, and performant at scale. You will work closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to build new products and enhance existing offerings, ensuring alignment with technological advancements, customer expectations, and market trends. This is a highly critical role with significant influence over the future of AI compute and storage products. What You’ll Do Product strategy: Define and execute the product vision for Mistral's storage offerings — including distributed filesystem, block, and object storage to keep pace with the needs of AI training and inference at scale. Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Cloud Software Engineering, and SRE to define technical specifications, execution timelines, and the performance, reliability, scalability, and cost targets the different storage products must hit. Data strategy and architecture: Drive the data lifecycle, tiering, durability, and failure-domain strategy in close partnership with engineering. Roadmap ownership: Own and prioritize the storage product roadmap, balancing customer requests, technical feasibility, and business impact. Customer discovery: Build deep relationships with the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud, understand their storage needs and pain points, and act as their voice inside the company. Market Analysis: Research trends, opportunities, and challenges in the storage domain, and use these insights to guide product development and positioning. Technical translation: Distill complex technical tradeoffs into clear, compelling narratives and decision documents for company leadership. Performance monitoring: Track and analyze product performance metrics and use data-driven insights to guide product enhancements and future direction. What We’re Looking For 8+ years of experience in product management, with a strong focus on storage and cloud infrastructure, particularly in high-performance or AI-driven environments Strong understanding of storage technologies, including file system, block and object storage. Solid technical foundation and cloud-infrastructure knowledge. You’re comfortable reasoning about API semantics, control-plane vs data-plane behavior, system events and lifecycle, multi-tenant operational realities. You can engage with engineering teams as a peer, not as a translator. You can challenge an engineering tradeoff, not just relay one. Track record of shipping technically complex platform products with measurable impact. Strong analytical instincts with the ability to use data to inform and defend multi-year infrastructure decisions. Ability to align and inspire cross-functional teams without direct authority, and to communicate credibly with executives, engineers, and customers. Low ego, high bias for action, and comfort in ambiguity — equally at home crafting a strategy narrative and diving into metrics, a UX detail, or a customer escalation. Bonus You can reason about cloud storage economics, and how tiering across hot, warm, and cold tiers affects cost You've designed, or worked closely on, backup, replication, or disaster recovery products You're comfortable discussing storage performance characteristics: throughput, latency, IOPS, and how they map to real workloads What We Offer We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Mistral's Solutions teams (Deployment Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers) co-create high-value AI use cases with customers in these environments. Travel to customer sites, including secure facilities, is a regular part of the job. You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them): Adoption track — embedded in flagship programs while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the evidence that proves value is landing. Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals. description: Your Mission: We are looking for a Senior Weight Management Engineer (all genders) to join our Central Engineering team and lead mass properties engineering activities for the Microliner aircraft. You will be responsible for establishing, maintaining, and communicating the aircraft mass properties baseline throughout the development lifecycle. Working closely with the Overall Aircraft Design, Airframe, Systems, Propulsion, Technology, Flight Physics, and Configuration Management teams, you will guide aircraft, system, and discipline owners in establishing reliable mass data and consolidate this information into a consistent, traceable, and configuration-controlled aircraft mass properties baseline. As a senior member of Central Engineering, you will provide mass properties expertise across the organization, support technical and programme decision-making, and ensure that mass properties objectives are consistently considered throughout design, verification, certification, and production. Your Day-to-Day: Lead mass properties engineering for the Microliner across aircraft, system, subsystem, and lower levels, ensuring reliable, traceable, and configuration-controlled mass data throughout design maturation, verification, certification, and transition into production. Maintain, further develop, analyse, and communicate the consolidated aircraft mass properties baseline. Manage and continuously refine mass targets, allocations, margins, and weight-saving objectives in collaboration with aircraft, system, and discipline owners. Guide aircraft, system, and discipline owners in estimating, substantiating, and maintaining mass properties data for their respective scope, providing methods, quality assurance, and configuration-control guidance. Perform aircraft weight and balance analyses, including operational loading conditions, centre-of-gravity envelopes, loading scenarios, and compliance with applicable airworthiness requirements. Evaluate mass properties across aircraft configurations, managing applicability, effectivity, and consistency within the aircraft mass model. Assess and communicate the mass-properties impact of design changes, technical trades, system integration decisions, and configuration changes. Define mass properties verification and weighing requirements, and coordinate with suppliers and system owners to ensure that measured data is appropriately substantiated, reconciled, and incorporated into the configuration-controlled aircraft mass properties baseline. Further develop and continuously improve mass properties processes, methods, tools, reporting, governance, and interfaces with configuration management and the wider engineering toolchain. Your Profile: Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline. Minimum 8 years of professional experience in aircraft mass properties engineering, preferably within the development and certification of civil aircraft under EASA CS-23 or FAA Part 23. Relevant experience from CS-25/Part 25, military or eVTOL development is also considered. Experience with the mass properties of battery-electric aircraft, electric propulsion systems, high-voltage systems, or other electric aviation technologies is a strong plus. Demonstrated experience managing aircraft mass properties throughout the product development lifecycle, including mass estimation, target setting, allocation, tracking, reporting, configuration control, and the incorporation of substantiated mass data into the aircraft baseline. Strong expertise in aircraft weight and balance, centre-of-gravity envelope development, loading analysis, moments of inertia, mass margins, uncertainty management, and mass-properties substantiation. Demonstrated experience working across the complete aircraft product hierarchy, from aircraft-level mass objectives and operational loading conditions through system, and lower-level hardware mass data, ensuring consistency and traceability between levels. Good understanding of aircraft design, systems integration, configuration management, certification, and the interaction between mass properties, aircraft performance, structures, stability and control, and operational capability. Proficiency with mass properties databases and analysis tools, as well as experience integrating mass data within product lifecycle management and configuration-controlled engineering environments; experience with Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE is a strong plus. Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong ownership of aircraft-level outcomes, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate mass properties implications effectively across technical disciplines and programme stakeholders. Working with AI AI is part of how we work every day, and it will be part of your role. You are accountable for the quality of what you ship, however it was written. You are comfortable designing data models from ambiguous or undocumented business logic, not just working from an existing spec. You see yourself as a strategic partner to the business who wants to understand the underlying question, and you can clearly communicate the impact of your technical work in plain language. You use AI tools in your analytics work and you have good habits for checking what they produce. You write tests and documentation with every model, and you keep an eye on warehouse cost and on how sensitive data is handled. You are familiar with Git fundamentals. We use dbt Cloud for orchestration and deployment, so we do not require deep pipeline engineering. There is nothing to prepare and no take-home task. 30-minute conversation with a senior leader. title: Geschäftsführer (m/w/d) – Skalierung & Automatisierung im Handwerk
description: Standort: Umkreis Lüneburg | Start: idealerweise ab März 2027 | Art: Vollzeit (On-Site) Wer wir sind & wo wir stehen: Kein “gemachtes Nest”, sondern eine echte Aufbau-Challenge Wir sind ein Handwerksunternehmen mit Herz und Technologie. Seit 10 Jahren reinigen und beschichten wir Dächer in Nord- und Mitteldeutschland. Unser Fundament: 4 Mio. € Umsatz, 30 Mitarbeitende und ein CRM mit 8.000 Kunden (darunter 500 B2B-Hausverwaltungen). Jetzt zünden wir die nächste Stufe und investieren massiv: Wir haben ein brandneues, doppelt so großes Gebäude bezogen, neue Köpfe in Sales, Marketing sowie Backoffice eingestellt und bauen unsere KI-gestützte Prozessautomatisierung weiter aus. Die ehrliche Realität: Wir stecken mitten im Umbruch. Wir sind kein fertiger Konzern, bei dem alles von alleine läuft. Der Gründer hat den Grundstein gelegt und widmet sich nach einer Übergabe- und Einarbeitungsphase neuen Projekten. Jetzt suchen wir einen Macher (m/w/d), der aktiv anpackt, um unsere Teams und Strukturen zu festigen und das hohe Marktpotenzial voll auszuschöpfen. Deine Mission bei uns: Gesamtverantwortung übernehmen: Du übernimmst nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung die volle kaufmännische, strategische und operative Führung vom Inhaber, damit dieser sich aus dem Tagesgeschäft zurückziehen kann. Strukturen festigen & Team führen: Du bist der Taktgeber für unser Büro und unsere Monteure auf dem Dach. Du steuerst das Tagesgeschäft, packst aktiv beim Recruiting an und sorgst für echten Teamgeist und Mitarbeiterbindung. Prozesse vollenden & Profitabilität sichern: Gemeinsam mit dem Gründer (der diesen Part als Experte begleitet) schließt du die Lücken in unserer digitalen Infrastruktur. Du verzahnst die Prozesse vom Marketing-Lead bis zur Rechnung zu einer hocheffizienten Maschine. Vollgas ins Wachstum & Expansion: Sobald das Fundament sitzt, drückst du aufs Gaspedal: Du skalierst den Umsatz auf 8 bis 15 Mio. € und baust das Geschäftsmodell aktiv aus – sei es durch bundesweite Expansion (z. B. Subunternehmer-Netzwerke) oder neue Gewerke (z. B. Dachdecker-Meisterbetriebe). Dein Profil: „Hart aber herzlich“ statt Buzzword-Bingo Dein Background: Du kommst aus einem operativen Umfeld (z. B. Handwerk, Industrie, Produktion, Gebäudereinigung oder GaLaBau) und hast bereits Unternehmen oder große Bereiche erfolgreich durch eine Wachstumsphase geführt. Führung auf Augenhöhe: Du sprichst die Sprache der Arbeiter auf der Baustelle genauso fließend wie die der Marketing-Leute im Büro. Du bist eine Respektsperson, die klar kommuniziert und Mitarbeiter entwickelt. Tech-Verständnis: Du musst nicht selbst programmieren, aber du weißt, wie man moderne Marketing-/Sales-Funnels steuert und hast Bock darauf, digitale Automatisierung ins Handwerk zu bringen. Die Rahmenbedingungen: Wir sind ein Handwerksbetrieb. Das bedeutet: Arbeitsbeginn ist um 7:00 Uhr vor Ort in Adendorf und erfordert deine volle Präsenz. Deine Benefits & Perspektiven: Vergütung: Ein starkes Fixum plus ein lukrativer, ungedeckelter variabler Anteil bei Erreichung der gemeinsamen Wachstumsziele. Unternehmensanteile: Wer wie ein Unternehmer handelt, soll auch so belohnt werden. Nach 6 bis 12 Monaten erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit sprechen wir über echte Unternehmensanteile (Beteiligung / VSOP). Gestaltungsspielraum: Ein starkes Team, Technik, Kundenstamm und ein Gründer, der dir den Rücken freihält, sind startklar. Die Basics: Ein nagelneues Büro, ein Firmenparkplatz direkt vor der Tür, monatliche Sachbezugskarten, starker Kaffee, Getränke-Flatrate und kurze Wege im Raum Lüneburg. Bock, das Handwerk auf das nächste Level zu heben? Wenn du etwa ab März 2027 bereit für diese Challenge bist, lass uns sprechen. title: Partnerships Operation Intern
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary As a Partnership Operations Intern, you will help turn partner relationships into repeatable growth. You will have real responsibility for making partners successful, helping opportunities move forward, and building the systems that allow our partner ecosystem to scale. This is a very hands-on role for someone who wants to learn how partnerships and the indirect channel really work. You will work directly with a wide range of external actors, including agency and consultancy leaders, partner sales and delivery teams, technology partners, and customers, while collaborating closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Product at Dust. You will not be limited to observing or executing a narrow checklist. You will own projects, see their impact, and help shape how Dust works with partners from the ground up. What you'll do Keep partners moving and growing Animate the partner community through regular updates, follow-ups, check-ins, and activation initiatives. Support partner onboarding and help partners find the right information, people, and resources at the right time. Reply to partner questions and requests promptly, with clear next steps and strong follow-through. Keep partner records, documentation, trackers, and workflows accurate and up to date across HubSpot, Introw, and Crossbeam. Help design and improve scalable partner infrastructure, including onboarding flows, partner tiering, enablement tracking, and partner activity monitoring. Track partner KPIs and help maintain dashboards covering activation, pipeline, attribution, engagement, and performance. Identify recurring friction points and turn them into clearer processes, automations, or reusable resources. Turn partner opportunities into revenue Support partners throughout the deal creation process, from the first opportunity to a qualified pipeline item and a closed deal. Create quotes and coordinate the information needed to move deals forward accurately and quickly. Help maintain clean deal registration and partner attribution workflows in HubSpot. Use tools such as Default, n8n, and Dust to reduce manual steps and improve visibility across the deal lifecycle. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work.
