title: Ketenregisseur | Directoraat-generaal Herstel Toeslagen
description: Omschrijving Wij zijn op zoek naar een ervaren Ketenregisseur voor het Ministerie van Financiën, binnen het directoraat-generaal Herstel Toeslagen (DGH). DGH coördineert het traject van en voor gedupeerden van de toeslagenaffaire en voert regie op zowel het herstelbeleid als de uitvoeringsketen en gemeenten. Binnen DGH richt de Taskforce Versnelling Bezwaren zich op het versnellen van de bezwaarafhandeling. Om deze versnelling effectief uit te voeren, is het belangrijk dat UHT samen met haar ketenpartners dossiers en deelproducten tijdig en in het benodigde volume oplevert. Hiervoor moet de gehele keten optimaal functioneren. Als ketenregisseur bewaak je directieoverstijgend en doorlopend deze keten. Je ziet toe op goed vraag- en aanbodmanagement, werkt samen met professionals aan procesoptimalisatie en adviseert verschillende directies over de aansturing vanuit ketenperspectief. Je legt verantwoording af aan de directeur BBI. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Je voert regie op de keten van het opvragen van dossiers tot het doorzetten naar de Bezwaar Advies Commissie (BAC). Je haalt prioriteiten op en stemt deze af met de betrokken partijen. Je bewaakt doorlooptijden en voorraden binnen de keten. Je initieert en leidt het wekelijkse ketenoverleg en zorgt voor een heldere actie- en besluitenlijst. Je signaleert en escaleert knelpunten en zorgt ervoor dat verbeteringen worden geborgd. Je zorgt voor een actueel ketenoverzicht met afspraken en aanspreekpunten, een wekelijkse monitor en een duidelijke escalatieroute. Je zorgt voor een goede overdracht aan de lijn. Wat vragen wij? Eisen: Je beschikt over minimaal WO werk- en denkniveau, aantoonbaar door een afgeronde WO-opleiding en/of minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring op WO-niveau. Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met functionele aansturing van medewerkers. Je hebt minimaal 8 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring in een schakelfunctie tussen beleid en uitvoering. Aanvullende wensen: Je hebt kennis van beleidsvorming, governance en bestuurlijke samenwerking met inhoudelijke technische kwalificatie van schaderoutes. Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van meerdere processen en/of projecten en samenwerking met diverse stakeholders. Je hebt ervaring en/of affiniteit met de organisatie. Competenties Resultaatgericht; Oplossingsgericht; Analytisch sterk; Communicatief sterk; Samenwerken; Besluitvaardig; Organisatiesensitiviteit; Omgevingsbewustzijn. Informatie Start: Zo spoedig mogelijk Aantal uur: 32 tot 36 uur per week Lengte opdracht: 6 maanden met optie tot verlenging Locatie: Den Haag Vorm: Detachering (niet geschikt voor zzp) Geïnteresseerd? title: Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer - Quantum Computing (f/m/d)
description: eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future. We are looking for a Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and own the real-time firmware that turns our control electronics into a working quantum computer. You will work on our next-generation system, where the control electronics are being integrated into a single, highly integrated chip. You sit at the heart of the machine, between the hardware that generates the pulses and the higher-level software that describes the experiments. Timing is not a detail here; it is the product. You are the person who makes sure the right signal reaches the ions at the right nanosecond, reliably, run after run. Responsibilities: Own the embedded firmware on our ARM-based control platform, from architecture through implementation to on-hardware debugging Develop and maintain the real-time software layer that coordinates pulse sequencing, timing, and data flow across our highly integrated control chip Write and maintain the low-level drivers and board support the hardware relies on Guarantee deterministic, low-latency behaviour under hard real-time constraints Lead firmware bring-up together with our electronics and physics teams, and debug at the boundary where software meets signal Define the firmware architecture and engineering practices — build, test, and release processes for the embedded layer as the system matures Contribute to the interfaces between the embedded layer and the rest of the stack, so experiments defined in software run correctly on the machine Required Skills: 5+ years of professional embedded software development for real-time or timing-critical systems Deep command of C (and ideally C++) on ARM platforms, working close to the hardware Experience with bare-metal and/or RTOS environments, and a clear understanding of when each is appropriate Comfortable reading schematics and datasheets, and debugging real hardware with oscilloscopes, logic analysers, and JTAG Strong grasp of real-time concepts: interrupts, DMA, timing, concurrency, and determinism A track record of bringing up firmware on new hardware, not only maintaining existing systems Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers, and to turn imprecise physical requirements into robust firmware Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset Good proficiency in English (written and spoken) Nice to have (Bonus) Experience on highly integrated SoCs, particularly ARM+FPGA platforms such as Xilinx Zynq / RFSoC Working alongside FPGA/digital-electronics engineers at the software–gateware boundary Rust for embedded systems Embedded Linux on ARM (Cortex-A), including driver and kernel-module work Signal processing or control-loop implementation on embedded targets Experience with high-speed data acquisition or precision timing systems Familiarity with laboratory, scientific, or measurement instrumentation Prior experience with quantum computing or other deep-tech domains What you can expect from eleQtron: Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements Flexible working hours : We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the culture Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development Wellness Package : We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being Bike Leasing: Stay Mobile and Sustainable with Our Company Bike Leasing Program Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus At the forefront : Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices and meeting rooms We value diversity and equal opportunities, and are committed to fostering an inclusive working environment where all qualified individuals are welcome to apply, regardless of nationality, ethnic or social origin, skin colour, religion or belief, disability, gender, sexual orientation or gender identity. The person in this role will also assist in creating and articulating compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations</li> <li>Maintain a robust sales pipeline</li> <li>Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Minimum 3 years of experience selling technical solutions or products to the Public Sector (Federal Government) ; <strong>all</strong> FedCiv agency experience open to consideration</li> <li>Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles`</li> <li>Basic understanding of computer networking and “how the internet works”</li> <li>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus)</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication and organizational skills.</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment</li> <li>Experience selling to the Federal customer base</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>For Washington DC, based hires: The expected salary range for this role is $269,000 - $370,000,  depending on experience and qualifications. Job level and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience and alignment to role expectations.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>OVERVIEW:<br></strong></p> <div>We're looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to help build the technology that support Gymshark's global growth. Working with industry best tools including Golang, Event-Driven Architecture, and AWS Serverless technologies such as Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, and DynamoDB, you'll design and deliver scalable solutions that support key business priorities. As part of a Tech function you will work with Product Engineering, Data Engineering, Operations, Platform Engineering and Delivery, playing a key role in building both customer-facing and internal products that drive the business forward.</div> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:</strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>Leading technical implementations of projects to help your team deliver high-quality work on time</li> <li>Using Golang to design, build and maintain APIs, services and integrations</li> <li>Implementing event driven solutions to support critical business processes</li> <li>Creating, maintaining and developing CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Building scalable and valuable software leveraging AWS Serverless technologies such as; Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, DynamoDB</li> <li>Focus on creating testable, maintainable and scalable code, following Engineering standards</li> <li>Following an Agile development approach</li> <li>Maintaining existing services, ensuring a high standard of observability and proactive monitoring, in addition to responding to incidents. (Especially during peak sale periods which is critical to business success!)</li> <li>Mentoring and coaching other engineers</li> <li>Improve engineering standards and best practices</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL NEED:<br><br>Essential Criteria:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must have experience in software engineering and writing production code in Golang or another strict typed language</li> <li>Experience using cloud based serverless services (such as AWS Lamba, Google Cloud Run or Azure Functions)</li> <li>Must have a demonstrable knowledge building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Experience designing, setting up databases as well as have an understanding of relational and non-relational approaches</li> <li>Experience designing, building and maintaining scalable APIs</li> <li>An understanding of Event Driven Architecture concepts</li> <li>Experience using Git and understand branching strategies</li> <li>Experience implementing quality and testing best practices within the services you produce, such as unit testing and contract testing</li> <li>Commercial Awareness and a creative problem solver with the ability to think laterally and understand the cost and value drivers within a competitive business environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>CLOSING DATE: 12th October 2026</strong></p> <p><strong>LOCATION: </strong>Please note this is a hybrid role and requires the successful candidate to attend at least 3 days a week in GSIQ, Solihull, UK.</p> <p><strong>BELONGING AT GYMSHARK.</strong></p> <p>Our mission is to be a place where everyone belongs. We’re an equal opportunities employer, and for us that means we always strive to be as inclusive as possible in all aspects of employment, right from your application. We’re committed to finding reasonable adjustments* for candidates with specific needs or have a disability during our recruitment process, and all applicants will be considered fairly and equally. We do not tolerate discrimination of any kind. *If you’d like to request a reasonable adjustment please email <a ----- ----- <p><strong>ABOUT US.</strong></p> <p>We’re here to unite the conditioning community. We believe that putting the sweat in today, prepares us for tomorrow. So, we give people the tools they need to reach further, go faster, be stronger. We celebrate those who show up – for themselves – to be their physical or mental best, whatever that means for them. It’s what we want for our community, and our team. A team that’s growing rapidly around the world. A collective of talented individuals working together to invent Gymshark’s future. Our plans are ambitious, and we’re looking for people who want to join us for the ride – our growth will be your growth.</p> <p><strong>THE PERKS.</strong></p> <p>Standard benefits include:</p> <ul> <li>Performance-based Bonus opportunity</li> <li>Funded Healthcare benefit</li> <li>25 days holiday, additional day for your birthday & Bank Holidays</li> <li>Contributory Employer pension scheme</li> <li>Flexible benefits programme – including salary sacrifice EV scheme, dental insurance, cycle to work, tech scheme, holiday trading</li> <li>Gymshark Employee Discount & long service awards</li> <li>Access to High Street cashback and discounts</li> <li>Financial, Physical and Mental Wellbeing Support</li> <li>Enhanced Family Leave package</li> <li>Life Assurance</li> </ul> <p>Office location specific benefits include (IQ):</p> <ul> <li>Gym Membership to The Lifting Club (LC)</li> <li>Onsite lunch provision & coffee bars</li> <li>EV charge points available</li> </ul> <p><strong>Note:</strong> The bonus program and benefits have certain eligibility requirements. Gymshark reserves the right to amend these programs in whole or in part at any time without advance notice.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: <p>We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to contribute to cutting-edge Research & Development. As innovators in speech technology, our mission is to Understand Every Voice - a vision that has propelled us to be world leaders of Voice AI. Fuelled by innovation, inclusivity, and a passion for making a global impact through world-leading Speech AI, we're looking for an experienced Senior Machine Learning Engineer to accelerate our efforts towards exceptional speech solutions.</p> <p>Our Modelling Team trains diverse models, including large self-supervised ones, supporting Speechmatics towards being the most accurate speech recognition system globally. It also ensures their deployment into production, working with the latest developments in ML, but also with the best engineering practices for software engineering and model serving.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work on complex R&D projects, with a diverse group of engineers, to achieve ambitious goals.</li> <li>Stay current with the latest developments in Machine learning.</li> <li>Execute high-impact projects to ensure team success.</li> <li>Work collaboratively across departments and mentor team members (where appropriate).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who we are looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated experience in collaboratively pursuing ambitious R&D agendas.</li> <li>Precise attention to detail, but is also aware of how the big picture relates to company goals, and where the field of Machine Learning is headed towards.</li> <li>Understanding of the modern Machine Learning stack, for example:<br>- Knowledge of contemporary transformer architectures (e.g., GQA, KV-caching) and best practices.<br>- Experience in distributed training techniques.<br>- Familiarity with optimisation strategies for model inference (e.g., dynamic batching, flash attention, speculative decoding).</li> <li>With preferred backgrounds covering <span style="text-decoration: underline;">some</span> of the following:<br>- Publications in top-tier conferences.<br>- Contributions to popular open-source repositories.<br>- Technical writing skills as evidenced by relevant publications or blogs.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><span class="ui-provider a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ab ac ae af ag ah ai aj ak">We encourage you to apply even if you do not feel you match all of the requirements exactly. The list of requirements is intended to show the kinds of experience and qualities we’re looking for, but it is not exhaustive. If you are interested in the role, the team, and our mission, we would love to consider your application. We are always open to conversations and look forward to hearing from you.</span></em></p> <p><strong>Who we are:</strong></p> <p class="p1">Speechmatics is the leading expert in Speech Intelligence, and uses AI and Machine Learning to unlock business value in human speech worldwide. We work with an amazing mix of global companies, and our technology can integrate into our customers stack irrespective of their industry or use case – making it the go-to solution to harness useful information from speech.</p> <p class="p1">Joining us means working with some of the smartest minds around the world, focused on cutting-edge projects and deploying the latest techniques to disrupt the market. We believe in putting people first; we’ll do all we can to help you develop your skills and give you the tools you need to thrive. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.</p> <p class="p1">We have structured a hybrid approach that includes 2-3 designated office days each week. This arrangement ensures that while we embrace the advantages of remote work, we also maintain the vital connection and synergy that only in-person interactions can foster.</p> <p class="p1">This is only the beginning; we’re looking for amazing people like you to continue our journey…</p> <p class="p1"><strong>What we can offer you:<br></strong></p> <p class="p1">No matter what stage of your career you’re at - from paid internships and first-job opportunities through to management and senior positions - we’ll support you with the training and development needed to reach your career aspirations with us. There really is no shortage of opportunities here for you to get involved and collaborate with those around you to deliver your best work.</p> <p class="p1">We offer incredibly flexible working, regular company lunches, and birthday celebrations. But that’s not all. We’ve spoken to our teams to find out what they want. From Private Medical, and Dental for you and your family, through to global working opportunities, a generous holiday allowance and pension/401K matching, we want to make sure our employees and their families are looked after. Every employee will receive a working from home allowance for tech or home office equipment (on top of your choice of laptop and accessories of course). Our approach to parental leave is designed to support employees globally. While this varies by geo, we have support in place for parents (including adoption assistance and reproductive health services) to ensure they have the time and financial resources needed to care for their growing families.</p> <p><strong>At Speechmatics, our mission is simple: Understand Every Voice out there.</strong> </p> <p>That's not just about our tech – it's the heart and soul of who we are. We welcome different experiences, viewpoints, and identities. For us, it’s not just the right thing to do; it’s our catalyst for sparking innovation and creativity. Our teams thrive in an environment that celebrates and supports everyone – no matter their gender, identity or expression, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief, marital status, national origin, veteran status, pregnancy, or maternity status.</p> <p>But we don’t just open the door to diversity – we actively welcome it. Why? Because we believe every unique voice adds something special to our team, leading us to smarter solutions and a better workplace.</p> <p><strong>So, come as you are and join our Speechling community.</strong> We’re building a place where every voice not only gets heard but is also respected and valued.</p> <p>For more information on us<sub>, </sub>please visit <a href="https://www.speechmatics.com/">our website</a> and follow Speechmatics on our social channels via <a href="https://twitter.com/Speechmatics/">Twitter</a>, <a href="https://www.facebook.com/speechmatics/">Facebook</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/speechmatics/">LinkedIn</a>, and <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaZUN77-Wq0XQg5ICHLxKVw/">YouTube.</a></p> <h5><strong><em>We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. </em></strong></h5> <h5><span style="color: #ffffff;"><strong>#LI-Hybrid</strong></span></h5></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager - Bookkeeping
description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Product Principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In almost 7 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €225 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1300+ happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor . 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 1M+ small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 4,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission Autopilot is Pennylane’s AI add-on for accounting firms, designed to automate bookkeeping and move accountants from execution to supervision—with a clear ambition: a 1-click VAT return . The challenge is no longer only to build a powerful product, but to activate it at scale, prove its value and turn adoption into revenue . As the first PM of the new Bookkeeping / Autopilot Growth squad, you will play a central role in making that happen. You will help hundreds of thousands of companies adopt Autopilot, connect firms to the value it already delivers and shape Pennylane’s AI monetization strategy. HOW you will contribute to the company as a Product Manager As a Senior Product Manager, you will join a 100+ person Product organization, working with 300+ engineers to make Autopilot the default way firms run their bookkeeping. You will: Understand what drives adoption. Talk to firm owners and accountants, analyse product data with SQL, Amplitude and Metabase, and identify where firms hesitate to activate Autopilot. Turn insights into measurable growth. Define clear hypotheses, metrics and stop criteria, then run B2B experiments through holdouts, cohort analysis and staged rollouts. Own the growth strategy. Set your OKRs, shape the roadmap and focus the squad on the initiatives that drive activation, trust, usage and revenue. Build with a cross-functional squad. Partner closely with a Product Designer, Engineering Manager and product-focused engineers, starting with MVPs and iterating based on what you learn. Work across the ecosystem. Collaborate with the squads building Bookkeeping and Autopilot, as well as Data, Product Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Customer Success and Account Management. Scale adoption beyond the product. Design in-product and lifecycle experiences that help firms self-serve, while providing commercial teams with the signals they need to support adoption. Build for France and Germany from day one. Design configurable solutions rather than simple translations, and work with the German team to make what works in France scalable internationally. Help define a new way of building product. Work agentic-first, design for supervision and stay relentlessly user-obsessed—using AI tools and agents every day to explore data, prototype and move faster. WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane Within one month You'll learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week You'll familiarize yourself with the product, the accounting industry and the accountant channel (you will have access to a lot of documentation and will attend trainings organized by your peers) You'll understand how Autopilot works: what it automates, how confident it is, and where it still needs a human You'll have mapped the Autopilot adoption funnel, at company and firm level: eligible, enabled, expanded, paying Within 3 months You'll have set the adoption baseline and targets with your manager You'll have shipped and read your first experiments on activation, hand in hand with your Product Designer and Engineers You'll have impacted positively at least one OKR You will have set up your continuous discovery routine with firms and be ready to build your roadmap Within 6 months You'll be autonomous at defining your OKRs and your roadmap You'll have shipped at least one step change in how firms activate Autopilot You'll have made the time Autopilot saves visible to firm owners You'll have prepared the switch to paid with Pricing, Product Marketing and Sales You'll have equipped Account Managers and CSMs with an adoption playbook they actually use You'll share your learnings and playbooks with the other Autopilot squads and with Germany What do we do to make your work life easier 🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from anywhere in Europe, as long as your contract allows you to; 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us; 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it; ⛹️Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness; 🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French; 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment; 🎉 You’ll be part of a vibrant social community : we do lots of sports together (Foot, running, climbing...), we love to hang out and have a drink together (thursday afterwork drinks on our rooftop is a usual thing. Twice-a-year we do company seminars, last time we went on a trip to the French Alps and it was fabulous !). And.. If you're based in 🇫🇷 : 🏢 You’ll be able to work fully from your home or any co-working space in France, or from our wonderful office in the center of Paris 🏝You’ll get 10 additional days off (to the 25 standard ones) to rest and do what you love each year 🍜 You’ll have lunch credits (Swile card) to buy your favorite food every day 🏥 You’ll have a great healthcare cover (Alan Blue) to take care of yourself and your family We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries. What does the recruitment process look like? You will first have a general chat with Charlène , Talent Acquisition Manager (45 min) You'll then have a discussion with one member of our Product team to assess the fit and the Product culture (45 min) You'll then pass a live case study on an Autopilot adoption problem with 2 Product Managers from our team (1h15) You'll have a final round with Tancrède (our CPO) and a Group PM or a Head of Product (60 min) We make sure we move fast; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total. Language For this specific role, a full fluent level in French 🇫🇷 is required. What you’ll bring Proven experience driving growth, adoption or monetization , ideally in B2B SaaS or a scaled B2C product, with measurable results; Strong data fluency and hands-on analytical skills: you can go from SQL query to dashboard to actionable decision, using Amplitude or equivalent tools—even when the data is imperfect; Rigour in experimentation: you know when sample sizes are too small for A/B testing and can design robust holdouts, cohorts and staged rollouts instead; A strong understanding of AI-powered products: you can assess automation quality across confidence, accuracy, coverage and evaluation—and know what it takes to build user trust; Excellent product sense and user research skills: you can uncover what makes professional users comfortable delegating critical work to a machine; Strong cross-functional leadership: you influence and align multiple squads and commercial teams without relying on formal authority; Clear, structured communication skills , with fluency in French and professional proficiency in English; Previous Product Management experience in a scale-up or large technology company. Experience in accounting is not required, but curiosity for the domain and comfort with complexity are essential. Experience with pricing and packaging, free-to-paid transitions, paid add-ons, lifecycle/CRM or sales-assisted PLG would be a strong plus. 🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : Notre data policy 🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 🇪🇸 Datos personales Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS Fintech Scale-up, Berlin
description: Du willst als Team Lead Sales in Berlin ein Vertriebsteam führen und gleichzeitig mitgestalten, wie Pennylane Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland gewinnt? Als erste Sales-Teamleitung für unser deutsches Kanzleisegment baust du ein Team regionaler Account Executives auf, das Kanzleien aktiv gewinnt – Outbound wie Inbound: Du coachst im Kundengespräch, steuerst die Vertriebsleistung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Firms Director den Ansatz für den deutschen Markt – mit dem Rückenwind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas. Deine Mission Du wirst die oder der erste Team Lead Sales (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland sein. Deine Mission ist es, mit deinem Team von Account Executives Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du führst, coachst und baust das Team aus. In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das bewährte Playbook und passt es gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Firms Director, an den du direkt berichtest, an den deutschen Kanzleimarkt an. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Tobias Janiesch, Managing Director Deutschland, zusammen. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Sales Firms Director, Case Study, Onsite-Gespräch mit dem Team in Berlin. Dein Team Full-Cycle Sales: Deine Account Executives verantworten den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management ihrer Kanzleien. Outbound ist Kern: Einen wesentlichen Teil eurer Pipeline baut ihr selbst auf – per Telefon, LinkedIn, Branchenevents und Kanzleibesuche. Wer nur auf Inbound wartet, wird hier nicht glücklich; wer gern aktiv Türen öffnet, umso mehr. Starkes Setup: Dabei seid ihr nicht allein: Unser eigenes Customer-Success-Team in Berlin unterstützt euch bei Onboarding und Betreuung der Kanzleien, damit deine AEs genug Zeit für die Neukundengewinnung haben. Regional organisiert: Jede:r AE betreut eine feste Region in Deutschland – per Inside Sales und vor Ort in den Kanzleien. Im Aufbau: Du übernimmst aktuell zwei Account Executives und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Talent-Acquisition-Team weitere ein – das Team wächst mit dir. Beratender Vertrieb: Dein Team gewinnt Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten. Ihr macht den Nutzen von Pennylane für den Kanzleialltag konkret und schafft Vertrauen in die Einführung einer neuen Plattform. Standort Berlin: Das Team wird aus unserem Berliner Office geführt – du bist an zwei Tagen pro Woche vor Ort, den Rest flexibel. Rund 30 % deiner Zeit bist du bei deinen AEs und in Kanzleien in Deutschland unterwegs, in der Regel ein Termin pro Woche, den du selbst planst. Du wirst für die Leistung dieses Teams verantwortlich sein durch: Du verantwortest die Vertriebsleistung deines Teams: den MRR aus deutschen Steuerkanzleien und die Marktdurchdringung von Pennylane im deutschen Kanzleisegment. Du baust mit deinem Team eine systematische Outbound-Akquise für Kanzleien auf – Zielkundenlisten, Sequenzen, Events, Vor-Ort-Besuche – und hältst die Aktivitätsquoten hoch. Du schaffst klare Erwartungen, coachst regelmäßig anhand konkreter Kundengespräche und nutzt Pipeline- und Conversion-Daten, um dein Team gezielt weiterzuentwickeln. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of Sales den Go-to-Market-Ansatz für Kanzleien weiter (Inside Sales + Field Sales) und setzt ihn mit deinem Team um. Du begleitest deine AEs im Feld – bei Kanzleibesuchen, Branchenevents und Key Deals. Du arbeitest eng mit dem französischen Sales-Team zusammen und überträgst, was vom Playbook für Deutschland funktioniert. Als Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien sind deine Ziele vielfältig: Du erreichst die Vertriebsziele des Teams und steuerst das Tagesgeschäft – im Office wie bei den AEs in ihren Regionen. Du verantwortest das Sales Enablement deiner Account Executives: Techniken, Messaging und der gesamte Pennylane-Sales-Prozess. Du begleitest neue AEs durch Onboarding und Ramp-up und führst sie zu ihren Zielen. Du baust Teamgeist, Engagement und Wohlbefinden auf – mit Challenges, Teambuildings und Formaten, die du selbst gestaltest. title: Lead Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Introduction: No barriers, no paper tickets, just seamless parking powered by software. Our platform keeps thousands of parking lots running every day, from the services in the cloud to the apps our customers and drivers use. As a Lead Software Engineer, you’ll turn ambitious product goals into software that moves our business forward. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership to tackle our team’s hardest challenges, raise the bar for quality and delivery, and enable engineers to achieve more together than they could individually. Our Objectives and your Role: Drive the Technical Vision: Define and evolve the architecture of the systems your team owns, ensuring they are scalable, secure and aligned with long-term product strategy. Align Engineering with Strategy: Act as a technical counterpart to product and business stakeholders, translating company objectives into engineering initiatives with measurable impact. Shape the Product: Work closely with Product and Design to improve what we build, and ship features end to end, from API to UI, that create real value for our customers. Own Delivery End to End: Take accountability for projects from concept to production and beyond, defining clear scope and milestones, and communicating delivery risks early while maintaining reliability and quality. Champion Engineering Excellence: Set the bar for clean, performant and maintainable code; foster a culture of high standards and technical curiosity. Technical Leadership & Mentoring: Guide engineers through mentorship, coaching and clear technical direction to grow the team's capabilities and autonomy. Elevate Operational Maturity: Monitor and continuously improve the performance of your systems; lead improvements to observability, CI/CD and developer workflows, ensuring systems are resilient and teams can ship confidently. Embed Security by Design: Take responsibility for the security posture of your systems, ensuring they meet best practices and compliance from the ground up. Be a Force for Innovation : Stay ahead of trends and emerging technologies, including AI-assisted development & push those into the department; drive continuous improvement in how we build, scale and operate our systems. Your Expertise, Skills & Mindset: Real Seniority: Not defined by years of experience but by a drive for continuous improvement, direct business impact, and ownership. You've worked at a senior or lead level and owned production systems end to end. Technical Leadership: Proven experience guiding engineers through mentoring, code reviews and clear technical direction. Strong Engineering Foundation : Strong proficiency in at least one of TypeScript/Node.js, Python or C++, and hands-on experience with the corresponding frameworks, such as NestJS, Fastify, FastAPI or Flask, or Vue.js on the frontend. End-to-End Mindse t: Experience shipping product features across the stack, with a solid understanding of both backend concerns (APIs, data models, services, performance) and frontend concerns (UI, usability). Cloud Expertise: Solid understanding of AWS (or a comparable provider) and cloud architecture. CI/CD: Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and containers; experience with Kubernetes or Terraform is a plus. High-Throughput Systems: Experience building and running high-traffic systems in production. Monitoring & Observability: Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog. Security & Networking: Security Awareness: Good understanding of security best practices in software and the cloud. Agile & Fast-Paced Environments: Experience in agile teams in dynamic, fast-growing tech environments. Excellent Communication: Strong English communication skills (C1+) and the ability to collaborate across teams. German proficiency is not required. Technologies We Work With: We embrace modern, cutting-edge technologies to build robust and scalable solutions. Backend: Event-driven microservices Typescript (NestJS). Frontend: Monorepo powered by Turbo, pnpm, changesets, and Storybook, primarily using Vue.js. IoT: Linux-Based software running in C++, Python, Typescript or Go. Frameworks/Libraries: Adoption of TypeScript, NestJS, BullMQ, and Prisma for backends in an opinionated monorepo approach. Databases: Amazon RDS, DynamoDB, S3. Orchestration & CI/CD: We manage our container orchestration with Kubernetes (EKS), using Keda and Karpenter for dynamic autoscaling. Our CI/CD is powered by GitLab. Infrastructure as Code: Terraform for AWS provisioning. Serverless: Leveraging AWS Lambda and the Serverless framework for high-throughput endpoints. Work Setup: Hours : 40 hours per week (based on trust). Home Office Policy: Enjoy a hybrid model with 3 days in the office / 2 days remote. Contract : A permanent contract for long-term stability. Location : Our modern office in Munich, a vibrant city in the heart of Bavaria. What We Offer: We believe in supporting our team with an environment that fosters growth, well-being, and a great work-life balance. Your perks: company pension plan, corporate benefits, and JobRad bike leasing, plus, you can choose between a subsidized Deutschlandticket or an EGYM Wellpass membership. Your flexibility: flexible working hours and the option to temporarily work remotely from within the EU. Your setup: an onboarding experience that gets you up to speed right away, height-adjustable desks, and modern Apple equipment (MacBook (M5 Pro, 48GB Ram) and a 37-inch curved screen) for the perfect start from day one. Plus access to all major frontier AI models, MCP servers, and the agentic tooling you need to do your best work. Your well-being: a healthy energy boost with free snacks (fruit, nuts, muesli), subsidized office catering, and a weekly team lunch. Your fit: a lived start-up mentality in a financially secure and stable environment. Our Recruiting Process: Initial Contact: We’ll get back to you within 48 hours. HR Interview: Discuss your experience and expectations with our HR team. Live Assessment: Complete a technical exercise designed to challenge you with scenarios beyond your usual experience. Tech Challenge: Tackle a problem in a familiar context to demonstrate your technical skills and approach. Leadership Conversation: Dive deeper into the role and expectations with a member of our technical leadership. On-Site Meeting: Visit our Munich office, meet more of the team, and experience our culture firsthand. Interested in joining our team? Apply now and be part of something great! title: (Senior) Product Manager (m/w/d)
description: Einleitung Du brennst dafür, Produkte zu gestalten, die echten Mehrwert schaffen und jeden Tag das Leben von Millionen Nutzer:innen verbessern? Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, gestalten und vorantreiben? Als Product Manager (m/w/d) bei Peter Park gestaltest du mit unternehmerischem Denken die Weiterentwicklung Deines Produktbereichs – von der Vision über Discovery und Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung. Du arbeitest eng mit einem interdisziplinären Team und relevanten Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Lösungen echten Kundennutzen stiften und unsere Marktposition stärken. Anforderungsanalyse: Du führst Anforderungsanalysen durch und entwickelst detaillierte Produktspezifikationen unter Einbindung innovativer Technologien. Produktanalyse & Optimierung: Du führst datenbasierte Analysen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Produktperformance durch. Backlog-Management: Du verantwortest die Pflege, Priorisierung und Optimierung des Produkt-Backlogs, immer mit Blick auf strategischen Mehrwert und ROI. Agile Führung: Du leitest agile Zeremonien, förderst agile Arbeitsweisen und unterstützt das Team dabei, agile Prinzipien effektiv umzusetzen. User Experience Advocacy: Du arbeitest eng mit UX/UI-Designern zusammen, um exzellente Nutzererlebnisse sicherzustellen. Innovation: Du identifizierst kontinuierlich neue Technologien – insbesondere im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz – und integrierst sie gezielt, um Prozesse zu optimieren sowie Effizienz und Qualität in der Produktentwicklung auf das nächste Level zu heben. Für die Senior-Stufe erwarten wir zusätzlich mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung sowie: Du verantwortest die Roadmap Deines Produktbereichs eigenständig und richtest sie an den Unternehmenszielen aus. Du entwickelst andere Produktmanager:innen weiter und etablierst Standards, die über Dein Team hinaus wirken. Deine Fähigkeiten: Du lebst Ownership, Growth Mindset und echten Business Impact jeden Tag vor. Du verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, idealerweise in einem SaaS-, IoT- oder schnell wachsenden Umfeld. Du lebst ein Agile Mindset und verfügst über ein tiefes Verständnis für agile Methoden (Scrum, Kanban). Du bist in der Lage, komplexe Produktanforderungen in klare, priorisierte User Stories und Aufgaben zu zerlegen. Du hast ein solides Grundverständnis über die Entwicklung von Software (SaaS, Cloud, Webtechnologien) und Hardware (IoT). Du hast eine ausgeprägte analytische Denkweise und arbeitest datenbasiert, um fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. description: <p><strong>This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP is a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week.</strong></p> <p><strong>About TULIP</strong></p> <p><a href="https://tulip.co/">TULIP</a> is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries.</p> <p>In January 2026, TULIP <a href="https://tulip.co/press/tulip-secures-120m-series-d/">closed its $120M Series D</a>, at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum's Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum's Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community. </p> <p><strong>The opportunity in DACH for TULIP</strong></p> <p>DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value.</p> <p>TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP’s headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. Local customers trust our product in regulated, high-precision environments. </p> <p><strong>About You</strong></p> <p>You're an engineering leader who cares about getting security-critical systems right and who wants to reach customers fast, not sit buried in a backlog. You think in specs and failure modes, you stay close to the code, and you're already using AI tooling to change how your team builds, not just how quickly they move. You'll take over a small, strong team and own how the world's most demanding manufacturers authenticate, provision, and govern access for their people and, increasingly, the AI agents acting on their behalf. </p> <p><strong>What skills do I need?</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of software engineering experience, with direct involvement building and operating security-critical or identity/access systems in production</li> <li>3+ years of people management experience leading a software team, where you've hired, given constructive feedback, and grown engineers</li> <li>Hands-on depth with OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, and SCIM in enterprise environments — you understand the specs and their failure modes, not just the libraries</li> <li>Experience building multi-tenant systems where tenant isolation is a hard requirement</li> <li>Working knowledge of IAM, secrets management, and access policy across AWS and Azure, including the tradeoffs when customers span both</li> <li>A track record of shipping clean, tested code and holding a team to the same standard</li> <li>Active use of AI tooling in your own practice, with a point of view on how it changes the way teams build</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent working experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the architecture and roadmap for identity & access — SSO/SAML/OIDC federation, SCIM provisioning, multi-tenant account structures, and the authorization layer across Tulip's multi-cloud infrastructure.</li> <li>Represent Identity & Access in cross-functional architecture reviews and roadmap decisions.</li> <li>Lead and grow a small, high-caliber team — run regular 1:1s, set quality standards, give direct feedback, and develop engineers on security-critical systems.</li> <li>Protect operations where failures carry tangible stakes—from halted production lines to scrapped material and compliance risks. What you ship here has a direct impact on customers. </li> <li>Drive adoption of AI tooling in how the team builds — code review, test generation, spec drafting, and agent loops — and share what works across engineering.</li> <li>Create and own difficult tradeoffs on IAM and access policy where tenant isolation and enterprise compliance are non-negotiable.</li> <li>Ship work that reaches customers quickly and reliably, with operational excellence as the default.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Collaborators</strong></p> <ul> <li>Security & Infrastructure  </li> <li>Platform Engineering </li> <li>Product Management</li> <li>Customer Success</li> </ul> <p><strong>Working At Tulip</strong></p> <p>We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don’t match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered. </p> <p>We’re building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. Benefits of working with us include:</p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Direct impact on product and culture</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Company equity</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Competitive benefits package including commuter benefits, learning and development stipend, team events, catered lunches 3 days a week</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Flexible work schedule and unlimited vacation policy</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Virtual and in-office global company events and happy hours</span></li> </ul> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.</p> <p class="p1">Please note that we may use AI-based tools to support parts of our hiring process. All data processing is carried out in compliance with local data protection laws, ensuring all personal candidate information is handled securely and ethically.</p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Delivery Manager
description: <p><strong>Working at CreateFuture</strong><strong><br></strong><br><a href="https://createfuture.com/">CreateFuture</a> is a Version 1 company and <strong>AI-native consulting partner</strong> where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.</p> <p>We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.</p> <p>Our UK Benefits </p> <ul> <li>35 days leave (including bank holidays). </li> <li>Private medical insurance.</li> <li>Enhanced parental and adoption leave. </li> <li>Financial coaching + 5% pension match.</li> <li>40 hours of paid learning and development.</li> </ul> <p><a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-uZ_KOuW1SI-xoZ0Sd0WJCisULzkYox4/view?usp=sharing"><em> View our full list of UK benefits.  </em><br><br></a>CreateFuture is a<a href="https://www.greatplacetowork.co.uk/certified-company/1572759"> Great Place to Work-Certified™ company</a> and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.</p> <p>Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today</p> <h4 data-renderer-start-pos="2571">About the role and team:</h4> <p>You own delivery outcomes end-to-end across scope, time, budget, and quality. You bring control and transparency to the accounts and/or engagements you run, and you leverage AI to enable yourself and others to focus on the real value add work. Your consulting experience allows you to adapt quickly into different client environments and you are comfortable operating with pace and ambiguity. </p> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Managing overall project timelines and track progress against key milestones (across time, budget & quality).</li> <li>Managing team performance and delivery health.</li> <li>Identifying and managing risks, issues, and dependencies.</li> <li>Building relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring effective and transparent communication.</li> <li>Providing regular progress updates and escalation of issues when necessary.</li> <li>Removing blockers and supporting your team in overcoming challenges.</li> <li>Navigating and resolving conflicts where needed.</li> <li>Maintaining a good level of governance i.e Keeping a clear record of decisions and progressing action items.</li> <li>Organising and facilitating key meetings and ceremonies.</li> <li>Providing constructive input and challenge to stakeholders to ensure best outcomes.</li> </ul> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong data-stringify-type="bold">We’d love to talk to you if you have:</strong></div> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li>Proven experience leading complex technical delivery within a digital transformation consultancy.</li> <li>Experience taking client programmes from discovery and strategy through to completion.</li> <li>A solid understanding of the full software development lifecycle (SDLC).</li> <li>Experience of End-to-end AI delivery, or hands-on use of AI in the delivery process.</li> <li>Experience creating and managing SOWs, including scope change and change requests.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management, building trusted relationships.</li> <li>Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across several workstreams.</li> <li>The ability to adapt Agile or hybrid delivery approaches to suit each client.</li> <li>A recognised delivery certification such as Scrum (PSM/CSM), SAFe, PRINCE2 or PMP would be an advantage.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3 id="What-we’ll-offer-you:" data-renderer-start-pos="8044"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What we’ll offer you:</strong></h3> <p>We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.<br><br>We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.</p> <p>We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.</p> <h3><strong>Our hiring process</strong></h3> <p>We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.</p> <p>It usually looks like this:</p> <ul> <li>Call with our Talent Acquisition Team </li> <li>Role specific capability interview </li> </ul> <p>Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.</p> <h3><strong>Inclusion at CreateFuture </strong></h3> <p>We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.</p> <p>If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.</p> <p>We look forward to your application!</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Manager, Agentic Commerce
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>We build the infrastructure that makes the web <strong>Payable</strong>, powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.</p> <p>Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/the-agentic-internet/">Agentic Internet</a>. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We are building tools that help make the new internet <strong>payable</strong> by giving our users the ability to take control over how AI agents pay for resources across the Internet.</p> <p>Building these capabilities requires solving problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols. We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale. We’re looking for someone excited to deliver products so domain owners can control this experience, while identifying the problems Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to solve next.</p> <p>We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <h3>About the role</h3> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across Agentic Commerce.</p> <p>You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that power machine-to-machine payments and monetization, such as our <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/monetization-gateway/">Monetization Gateway</a>. You will partner closely with Product Management and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions around payment rails and cryptographic auth, ask the right questions when something is going wrong, and step into a technical problem when the situation calls for it.</p> <p>At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. title: Finance Controller Lead (all genders)

title: Founders' Associate
description: Wir sind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden, bootstrapped Startups im deutschen Pflegemarkt. In nur zwei Jahren haben wir ein Team von ca. 50 Mitarbeitenden aufgebaut und stehen kurz davor, die Marke von 10 Millionen Euro ARR zu knacken - ganz ohne externes Kapital. Gegründet wurde Pflegehelfer24 von drei Unternehmern von WHU und EBS mit Hintergrund bei Bain & Company, Morgan Stanley, Tourlane und VC-Firma BITKRAFT. Wir setzen Al in nahezu jedem Prozess ein - unser Anspruch ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was sich automatisieren lässt. So bleibt ein kleines Team außergewöhnlich produktiv. Als Nächstes expandieren wir unser Geschäftsmodell in der DACH-Region und ergänzen es um ein weiteres Produkt. Aufgaben Als Founders' Associate bist du die rechte Hand der Gründer. Du übernimmst eigenständig Projekte über alle Funktionen hinweg, arbeitest an den Themen mit der höchsten Priorität und sorgst dafür, dass sie umgesetzt werden - nicht nur geplant. Diese Rolle ist das Sprungbrett für alle, die in kürzester Zeit lernen wollen, wie man ein profitables Unternehmen baut und skaliert. Strategie & Wachstum: Strategische Projekte direkt mit den Gründern - von der Expansion in neue DACH-Märkte bis zum Aufbau unseres nächsten Produkts. Operations: Operative Prozesse aufsetzen, verschlanken und mit Al automatisieren Finanzen: Reporting, Forecasting und die Vorbereitung auf zukünftige Wachstumsund Finanzierungsschritte verantworten. Marketing & Vertrieb: Initiativen entlang des Funnels treiben, messen und skalieren. Alles, was anfällt: Als rechte Hand der Gründer packst du eigenständig an, was gerade am wichtigsten ist Qualifikation Abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium mit herausragenden Leistungen - frisch von der Uni oder mit 1-2 Jahren Berufserfahrung. Scharfer analytischer Verstand und die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Themen einzuarbeiten. Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität, hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und der Drang, Dinge eigenständig zum Abschluss zu bringen. Strukturierte, pragmatische Arbeitsweise - du priorisierst klar und lieferst Ergebnisse. Echte Begeisterung für Al und Automatisierung als Hebel Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch sowie die Bereitschaft, vor Ort in Berlin zu arbeiten. Benefits Diese Rolle ist bewusst nach oben offen. Wir sind ein durch und durch unternehmerisches Team - wer liefert, bekommt bei uns echten Gestaltungsraum und wird am Erfolg beteiligt. Geschäftsführung & Gewinnbeteiligung: Bei starker Leistung hast du die Chance, Geschäftsführer:in einer unserer Einheiten zu werden - mit direkter Beteiligung am Gewinn. Eigene Ausgründung: Wir haben mehr Ideen als Kapazität. Vielversprechende Projekte, die wir bisher aus Kapazitätsgründen nicht verfolgt haben, unterstützen wir als Ausgründung Kurz: Wir suchen niemanden, der eine Stelle ausfüllt, sondern jemanden, der mit uns baut. title: Design Engineer, Notion.com
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT US: Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money. In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Web team builds Notion.com http://Notion.com to inspire current and future customers. We tell the story of what’s possible with Notion, give people ideas for what they might make themselves, and route them to the place of greatest impact: learning more, getting in touch with sales, or making their first workspace. We’re looking for a frontend engineer with a designer’s eye and a toolmaker’s instincts. Someone who can take an idea from a rough sketch to a working prototype to a beautifully finished experience. You care about the shape of a letterform, the rhythm of a page, and what happens in the few milliseconds after someone clicks. You also care about how it’s built—and whether a simpler way exists. The tools are changing what’s worth attempting. An idea you might once have set aside can become a working experiment; a tool you wished existed can become part of your practice. Working with agents should give you more room to follow those instincts—to try another direction, throw away an approach that isn’t working, or spend longer on the detail that makes the whole thing click. We’re interested in what you make with that room. The Web team at Notion is changing around that possibility. We are a small team that’s focused on making unusually good things, with fewer handoffs, simpler systems, and more time spent on work that deserves human attention. You’ll help us get there: making new experiences on notion.com http://notion.com and building tools that take care of the repetitive work. There’s plenty here to question, plenty to make, and room to surprise us. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - By your 90th day, you’ll be shipping to Notion.com http://Notion.com faster than we do today, working directly with Creative, Marketing, Growth, or Product Marketing, and leaving jigs and agent loops behind you: components, scripts, and workflows that review code, triage alerts, and watch flows like login and pricing. - By the end of your first year, you’ll be a daily driver of the site, from end to end, with your fingerprints all over the reusable pieces behind it, the monitoring that catches problems early, and the habit of retiring pages, code, and dependencies that stop earning their place. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Taste. You have a deep feel for typography, grids, proportion, and restraint. You can make something feel alive without adding more to it. You can explain why a detail matters—and recognize when it doesn’t. - Exceptional technical ability. Semantic HTML, modern CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript, React, and the browser’s layout, rendering, and animation systems are materials you know well. You build accessible, responsive, fast experiences, and your work feels as considered in the browser as it does in a mockup. - 8–12 years of experience in frontend development or design engineering, and a bachelor’s degree in design, computer science, human-computer interaction (HCI), or related field. - Ability to treat code as a creative medium. Your process includes quick experiments, discarded approaches, and prototypes other people can actually use. You can move quickly while an idea is uncertain, then slow down for the details that make it worth shipping. - You make tools that leave more room for craft. You notice when a task starts repeating and build the jig: a component, script, or agent workflow that makes the next pass easier and more precise. You know what to standardize and what to leave open, so the tool supports your eye without making every result look the same - Agents are already part of how you build.
