title: Applied AI Engineer, Enterprise AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an <strong>Applied AI Engineer</strong> at GitLab, you'll build and deploy AI-powered solutions for GitLab's own teams. You'll join Enterprise AI in the CIO organization, reporting to the Senior Director, Enterprise AI. This is a hands-on engineering role: you'll write production code and partner with senior engineers and internal business stakeholders to solve problems and deliver measurable outcomes. Your focus is GitLab's internal operations, rather than customer implementations or development of the GitLab product.</p> <p>Building fast matters, and we want engineers who ship. But speed without understanding the problem leads to the wrong solution shipped quickly. You'll partner with senior engineers and stakeholders to understand the real problem first: how work moves across teams, where the real constraint lives, and whether AI is the right intervention. From there, you'll take ownership of the build and deployment, combining strong engineering skills with curiosity about the business systems you're improving.</p> <p>Your initial focus will span GitLab's own Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support teams, where you'll embed AI solutions into the systems and workflows they use every day. This role offers the opportunity to grow as an engineer while shaping how GitLab team members work, in a remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Contribute to problem diagnosis alongside the team. Engage with stakeholders to understand the real constraint before reaching for a solution, and be willing to flag when AI isn't the right answer.</li> <li>Own the build and deployment of AI solutions, from technical design through implementation, deployment, and iteration. Partner with senior engineers on discovery and scoping.</li> <li>Design, develop, and ship AI-powered solutions quickly, delivering working prototypes in days, not months, with a focus on practical outcomes and measurable business value.</li> <li>Build solutions that reduce bottlenecks, shorten lead times, and increase throughput. Track flow, adoption, and ROI metrics defined for the work.</li> <li>Integrate AI capabilities into GitLab's internal business systems and workflows using APIs, orchestration tools, and modern AI platforms, including GitLab Duo Agent Platform, where appropriate. The right tool wins, whether that's custom code, a platform, or a well-crafted prompt.</li> <li>Be Customer Zero: use GitLab's AI products in our own internal workflows, assess how they perform in practice, and share feedback with R&D to help improve them.</li> <li>Partner with stakeholders to translate requirements into working solutions. Ask good questions, surface assumptions, and align with the team on outcomes before jumping to implementation.</li> <li>Track success against defined business metrics, flow metrics, and feedback loops that make performance visible and actionable.</li> <li>Contribute to documentation and reusable patterns that help the team scale its impact.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>A Technologist at Heart -</strong> Genuinely invested in technology, the foundational and the cutting-edge in equal measure. You're as energized by a well-designed API integration as you are by the latest foundation model release. You reach for the simplest solution that solves the problem well, rather than forcing new technology when proven approaches would do. AI is a powerful part of your toolkit, but it sits on top of solid engineering fundamentals, not in place of them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competent, Confident Coding Skills - You can build working solutions end-to-end, write clean and maintainable code, and debug effectively. Whether your skills were honed in a traditional engineering role, through building automations, or shipping side projects, what matters is that you can deliver production-quality work independently.</strong><strong>AI & LLM Technical Depth - Strong proficiency in at least one modern scripting language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) and a solid understanding of REST APIs, GraphQL, and integration patterns. Practical, hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, specifically:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Prompt engineering as a core discipline:</strong> designing effective system prompts, managing context windows, structuring multi-turn interactions, evaluating output quality, and iterating systematically on prompt design.</li> <li><strong>Model selection and cost-performance trade-offs:</strong> developing judgment on when a smaller fine-tuned model outperforms a general-purpose large one, when RAG is the right architecture versus expanding the context window, and how to think about capability versus cost.</li> <li><strong>Agentic architecture patterns:</strong> tool use, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop designs, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and production-grade reliability patterns.</li> <li><strong>Practical fluency across the LLM ecosystem:</strong> hands-on experience with models from Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source alternatives, and growing judgment about which to reach for and when.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>AI Safety & Risk Awareness -</strong> You think critically about how the solutions you build could be exploited, misused, or produce unintended consequences. You know how to design appropriate guardrails (input validation, output filtering, access controls, prompt injection defenses, and data leakage prevention) and you treat these as first-class engineering concerns.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity About Flow & Constraints -</strong> Comfortable engaging with workflow maps, end-to-end process diagrams, and constraint analysis. You instinctively ask "what's actually blocking flow here?" before asking "what model should I use?" You don't need to be the one leading the diagnosis yet, but you should be eager to learn and contribute.</li> <li><strong>Business System Awareness -</strong> Familiarity with the landscape of enterprise business systems: CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation (Marketo), support platforms (Zendesk), integration and orchestration tools (Workato), AI platforms (Relevance AI), and enterprise search and knowledge tools (Glean). You don't need deep experience with all of these, but you should understand what they do, be willing to learn how they fit together, and be ready to build with and across them.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Communication -</strong> Comfortable having conversations with stakeholders across diverse domains, willing to invest in understanding their unique needs, and able to translate between technical and business language.</li> <li><strong>Ownership Mindset -</strong> Track record of taking scoped initiatives from design through delivery. Comfortable operating with some ambiguity, and knows when to push forward independently versus when to ask for guidance.</li> <li><strong>Product Mindset -</strong> Ability to scope MVPs, prioritize ruthlessly, and deliver iteratively. In addition, consider adoption, user experience, and business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Experience with GitLab platform and CI/CD workflows</li> <li>Background in solutions engineering, solutions architecture, consulting, or other stakeholder-facing technical roles, combining strong engineering skills with stakeholder engagement, solution design, and root cause analysis. Experience personally building and shipping production-quality solutions is especially relevant.</li> <li>Familiarity with value stream mapping, flow metrics, or Theory of Constraints thinking</li> <li>Experience with low-code/no-code orchestration tools (n8n, Make, Workato) alongside custom development</li> <li>Previous startup or high-growth company experience</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>You will join the <strong>Enterprise Technology & AI</strong> team in the CIO organization. We build and improve the internal systems and workflows that help GitLab team members make decisions, operate at scale, and do their best work.</p> <p>We believe the best AI solutions start with understanding the system, not the technology. We value people who think in constraints and flow, who build with conviction, and who never stop learning. We work in an all-remote, asynchronous setting, guided by GitLab's operating principles of Speed with Quality, Ownership Mindset, and Customer Outcomes, built on a Culture of Excellence.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitla

title: Personal Branding & CEO-Kommunikation Manager:in (m/w/d)
description: Über uns Cléo Public Relations ist eine inhabergeführte PR-Agentur in Hamburg. Sie wollen sich als Thought Leader in ihrer Branche klar positionieren und ihre Expertise durch öffentliche Auftritte und Meinungsbildung sichtbar machen. Wir arbeiten nah an unseren Kund:innen, mit kurzen Wegen und viel Eigenverantwortung im Team. Die Rolle Wir suchen ab sofort eine Manager:in Personal Branding & CEO-Kommunikation (m/w/d) in Vollzeit in Hamburg. Du verantwortest Personal Branding und CEO-Kommunikation für Gründer:innen und Geschäftsführer:innen unserer Kund:innen – auf LinkedIn, in den Medien und auf Bühnen. Du führst Interviews mit Foundern, um Themen, Haltungen und Geschichten herauszuarbeiten, die zu ihrer Positionierung und zur Unternehmensstory passen. Du platzierst sie in Medien, Podcasts und auf Panels – gemeinsam mit unserem PR-Team. Du bereitest sie auf Interviews, Vorträge und Videoformate vor (Briefings, Kernbotschaften) und organisierst bei Bedarf Medientrainings. Du wertest Reichweite und Resonanz aus und leitest daraus nächste Schritte ab. Du bist feste Sparringspartner:in von Foundern, mit regelmäßigen Abstimmungen, ehrlichem Feedback und Unterstützung in der Krisenkommunikation, und arbeitest eng mit den jeweiligen Account-Teams zusammen. Du hast ein Gespür für Themen und Geschichten und erkennst, was eine Person relevant macht. Du trittst souverän gegenüber Gründer:innen und Geschäftsführer:innen auf und gibst auch kritisches Feedback. Du arbeitest strukturiert und behältst mehrere Kund:innen gleichzeitig im Blick. Gut zu haben: Netzwerk zu Redaktionen, Podcasts oder Veranstaltern. Was wir bieten Spannende Founder und Marken aus unterschiedlichen Branchen, von Startup bis Mittelstand. Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und direktem Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung. Raum, das Thema Personal Branding bei Cléo aktiv mitzugestalten. Ein Büro in Hamburg und Homeoffice nach Absprache. Gleitzeit, 30 Tage Urlaub, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Weiterbildung. title: Senior Manager, Human Resources
description: <h2><strong>Job Description</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a commercially minded, hands-on Senior Human Resources Manager to lead all People & Culture functions at our Australian fulfillment center. Serving as the dedicated HR Business Partner to the Site Director, you will own the end-to-end people strategy, workforce capability, and daily HR operations for a large, multi-shift frontline and salaried workforce.</p> <p>Operating within a matrixed People model, you will manage an on-site HR team while partnering closely with our specialised Centres of Excellence (COEs)—including Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, People Operations, and Work Health & Safety (WHS)—to translate people initiatives into practical, high-impact site execution.</p> <h2><strong>You will…</strong></h2> <p><strong>Strategic Business Partnering</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Site Leadership Partnership:</strong> Act as a trusted advisor and coach to the Site Director and site department heads on organisational design, leadership effectiveness, change management, and peak-volume workforce scaling.</li> <li><strong>Workforce Planning:</strong> Partner with Site Operations, Planning, and Workforce Staffing to forecast seasonal headcount requirements, optimise labour mix (permanent vs. casual/agency), and align staffing plans with production targets.</li> <li><strong>Local Organizational Design & Effectiveness</strong>: Act as a thought partner and provide strategic influence to the Site Operations team when it comes to performance management, team structuring, succession planning, and ensuring team members fully understand their job expectations and accountability measures. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Site HR Operations & Team Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>End-to-End HR Ownership:</strong> Oversee the execution and compliance of all Site HR operations, ensuring consistent, high-touch support for frontline associates, team leaders, and site managers both locally and through remote COE’s.</li> <li><strong>Team Development:</strong> (where applicable) Lead, mentor, and develop an on-site HR team,  building capability and ensuring clear accountability across the employee lifecycle.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Employee & Industrial Relations (ER/IR)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Australian Compliance & Governance:</strong> Ensure full site compliance with the <em>Fair Work Act</em>, relevant Modern Awards, Enterprise Agreements (where applicable), and Australian workplace legislation.</li> <li><strong>Complex Case Management:</strong> Lead and advise on complex employee relations matters, workplace investigations, performance management, absenteeism, and conflict resolution with fairness, speed, and commercial pragmatism.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Culture, Engagement & People Analytics</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Retention & Engagement:</strong> Analyze site turnover, attendance, and engagement survey data to identify root causes and execute targeted action plans that strengthen retention and morale.</li> <li><strong>Floor Presence:</strong> Maintain a visible, approachable presence on the fulfillment floor—listening directly to frontline teams and bridging communication between leadership and operational staff.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You have/are…</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years of progressive HR experience, including 3+ years as a Senior HRBP or HR Manager supporting a high-volume fulfillment center, logistics hub, FMCG, manufacturing, or supply chain site.</li> <li><strong>Australian ER/IR Mastery:</strong> Solid, practical knowledge of Australian employment law and managing workplace investigations.</li> <li><strong>Leadership & Matrix Navigation:</strong> Proven ability to manage and coach a site HR team while effectively influencing and collaborating with centralized COEs in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li><strong>Data-Driven Mindset:</strong> Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret HR metrics (attrition, absenteeism, overtime, engagement) and connect people initiatives to operational KPIs.</li> <li><strong>Operational Agility:</strong> Comfortable balancing strategic planning in leadership meetings with rolling up your sleeves on a chilled/ambient production floor.</li> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business, or a related field (or equivalent operational HR experience).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll get in return… </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The chance to have a significant impact in a leading global food technology company</li> <li>Flexible working arrangements </li> <li>Egoless environment, constant learning with room for personal growth</li> <li>Free access to Headspace</li> <li>Internal learning & development </li> <li>A diverse and vibrant international environment, with offices in 18 countries</li> <li>Company discount - 70% off HelloFresh & 40% off Youfoodz</li> </ul> <p><strong>Start Date: </strong>Immediately available - Can wait a notice period</p> <p><strong>Duration: </strong>Permanent full time role</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>Eastern Creek - Parking On site </p> <p><strong>Salary: </strong>Competitive salary & employee benefits</p> <p><strong>Flexibility:</strong> Roles at HelloFresh may be available for job share, along with other flexible arrangements. Get in touch if this is something you'd like to explore.</p> <p>#LI-Onsite</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Inside Account Executive | SMB MEA | Existing customers
description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="p1">At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.</p> <p>The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.</p> <p> </p></div><p style="text-align: justify;"><strong>What you’ll do at Jamf:</strong></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <div style="text-align: justify;"> <p>The Inside Account Executive is a key member of the EMEIA sales team, helping existing customers and channel partners understand how they can make the management and the security of their Apple devices robust and easy. title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity Lifecycle
description: About the team: You'll join one of the teams within SumUp's Identity Lifecycle Mission, working on some of the most critical building blocks behind the merchant journey, from onboarding and identity verification to KYC/KYB, regulatory data collection, and managing customer identity throughout the entire lifecycle. Today, many of these capabilities live across different flows, legacy services, and tightly coupled integrations. We're on a journey to bring these pieces together into a more coherent, scalable platform, with shared data models, reusable services, and clear ownership boundaries. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you won't just be maintaining existing systems. You'll have the opportunity to shape how our identity platform evolves, modernise critical services, and help build foundations that can support new regulations, markets, and product requirements without reinventing the wheel every time. You'll be part of one dedicated team, but the challenges we tackle often cross team and domain boundaries. You'll work closely with Engineers, Product, Design, Compliance, Risk, and Operations, giving you the opportunity to influence solutions well beyond your own team. If you enjoy solving complex backend problems, working in a highly collaborative environment, improving reliability, and building scalable capabilities that enable other teams to move faster, this could be an exciting opportunity to make a real impact at SumUp. What you'll do: Design, build, and operate scalable backend services, APIs, event-driven workflows, and system integrations. Build reusable capabilities that power merchant onboarding, identity verification, and KYC/KYB regulatory data collection. Drive reliability and resilience across critical services through better observability, failure handling, incident response, and long-term risk reduction. Work primarily with Go, while maintaining and progressively modernising existing services written in Java. Evolve domain models and service boundaries while reducing legacy complexity, duplicated logic, and tightly coupled integrations, always with a pragmatic, incremental mindset. Own your work end-to-end, from technical design and implementation to rollout and production follow-up. Work across team and domain boundaries, turning ambiguous product and regulatory requirements into clear, scalable technical solutions. Review code and designs, mentor engineers, and help raise engineering standards across the mission. You'll be great for this role if you have: Strong professional experience building and operating production backend systems with high business impact. Experience working with Go and Java and confidence in maintaining and evolving existing Java services. Strong knowledge of API design, distributed systems, asynchronous processing, data modelling, testing, and system design. Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka and modern observability tools such as Grafana or Honeycomb. Experience deploying and operating services in cloud environments such as AWS, ideally with Docker and Kubernetes. A strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take complex problems from definition through to production. Experience improving the reliability of business-critical systems and turning recurring incidents into lasting engineering improvements. Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working across Engineering, Product, Compliance, Risk, and Operations. Nice to have: Experience in fintech, payments, KYC/KYB, identity verification, or regulatory systems. Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich . What you'll be doing In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth. Day-to-day in this role you'll: Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing. Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty. Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt. Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives. Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process. Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches. Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale. Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach. Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team. Our humble expectations You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers. You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature. You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides. You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams. You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact. You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail. You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: Hybrid - </strong><strong>Munich, Germany or Amsterdam, Netherlands or London, United Kingdom</strong></p> <div><strong>About the Department</strong></div> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.<br><br><strong>About this Role</strong><br><br>The Senior Named Account Executive position effectively delivers the full sales cycle from prospecting to negotiating and closing sales with new & existing customers in line with business plans. title: Sales Planning & Strategy
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. 🧩 Context of the role You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training) Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being). 🎯 Your mission You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include: Business Strategy Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC) Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation Sales & Account Manager Planning Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives , ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team Performance monitoring & Steering Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...) 🧐 Skills we are looking for We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team. At least 3 years of experience within either: Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably) Management consulting, investment banking or private equity Critical thinking and problem solving skills: Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows. Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company Business sense: At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones Communication and presence: Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility Great written and oral structure and communication Fluency in English (French is a strong plus) Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris or Barcelona area Nice to have Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors Exposure to large sales teams (100+) For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range . 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary. Flexible Office . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or Barcelona office All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only) . Transport . Country-specific commuter benefits. Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture . Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents. Important note: we hire people, not roles. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application! 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. title: Mid-Market Account Executive DACH (m/w/d)
description: Wir bei SoSafe haben das Ziel, der führende Anbieter für Human Risk Management Lösungen in Europa zu werden. Unsere preisgekrönte Awareness-Plattform unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, nachhaltige Verhaltensänderungen durch effektive, interaktive Trainings rund um Cyber-Sicherheit und Datenschutz zu erzielen. Cyberkriminalität kostet die Welt jährlich >$10 Billionen, mit steigenden Kosten um 15 % pro Jahr – werde Teil der Lösung und gestalte die Zukunft der Cybersicherheit aktiv mit! Als Mid-Market Account Executive (m/w/d) wirst du Teil eines dynamischen, ambitionierten und internationalen Teams von Account Executives, das auf Zusammenarbeit, täglichen Wissensaustausch und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Vertriebsprozessen setzt. Erfolg treibt uns an – und mit unserer offenen, motivierenden Teamkultur macht das Erreichen von Zielen gleich doppelt so viel Freude! Gemeinsam mit dem Sales Development Representative (SDR) Team baust du täglich dein Kundennetzwerk aus und übertriffst deine Ziele. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen und Bedürfnisse deiner Kunden und weißt, wie du unser Cybersecurity-Angebot positionierst und eine Lösung präsentierst, auf die deine Kunden nicht verzichten können! Teamwork ist entscheidend – du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams wie Pre-Sales, Customer Success und Partner Managern zusammen, um ein reibungsloses und wirkungsvolles Kundenerlebnis zu gewährleisten. Deine Fähigkeit, Abschlüsse zu erzielen und neue Geschäftsfelder voranzutreiben, ist entscheidend für deinen Erfolg und dein Wachstum in dieser Rolle. So trägst du zum Erfolg bei: Akquise neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Mid-Market-Segment. Eigenverantwortliches Management des gesamten Sales-Zyklus – von der ersten Ansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss – mit dem Ziel, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und deine Vertriebsziele zu erreichen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit SDRs zur Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Leads und zur Sicherstellung einer stabilen Sales-Pipeline. Steuerung, Verhandlung und Abschluss von Cross- und Upselling-Möglichkeiten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Customer Success Managern. Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern potenzieller Kunden, um den Mehrwert der SoSafe-Cybersecurity-Lösungen überzeugend zu präsentieren. Durchführung von Online-Demos, Vor-Ort-Terminen und Events zur Präsentation unseres innovativen Produkts und zur Stärkung des Kundengeschäfts. Was dich auszeichnet: 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Closing-Rolle im SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Fokus auf SMB- oder Mid-Market-Kunden. Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Ownership – du übernimmst die Initiative, behältst Ziele im Blick und bringst Deals mit Disziplin und Konsequenz zum Abschluss. Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit cross- funktionalen Teams. Proaktivität und Eigeninitiative mit der Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten. Anpassungsfähig und in der Lage, Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld flexibel zu managen. Offen für Feedback und Bereitschaft, kontinuierlich zu lernen und dich weiterzuentwickeln. Erfahrung mit CRM-Tools (z. B. Salesforce, HubSpot), Prospecting-Software und LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Fließende Deutsch und Englisch- Kenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt. Standort: Köln/ deutschlandweit (Remote) - bei uns arbeitest du hauptsächlich remote und kommst für regelmäßige Teamtage nach Köln (z. B. monatlich). Was wir bieten*: Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 33 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche finanzielle Unterstützung während der Elternzeit Well-being und finanzielle Unterstützung: Zugang zur Open-Up App, Mitarbeiterrabatte Verbindung & Gemeinschaft: Virtuelle Events, gemeinsame Teamaktivitäten und Möglichkeiten für lokale Treffen Und vieles mehr: Technische Ausstattung, Empfehlungsprämien, ein individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget, hundefreundliches Büro *Die oben genannten Vergünstigungen gelten für Vollzeitmitarbeiter und können je nach Standort leicht variieren. Dies ist nur eine Auswahl – mehr erfahren Sie im Verlauf des Bewerbungsprozesses. Über uns Wir bei SoSafe haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die digitale Welt sicherer zu gestalten, indem wir den menschlichen Faktor in der Cybersicherheit in den Mittelpunkt stellen. Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Security-Awareness-Scale-ups weltweit nutzen wir verhaltenswissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse und datengesteuertes Lernen, um Menschen effektiv gegen Cyber-Bedrohungen zu stärken. Unser Human Risk Management-Ansatz unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihre Mitarbeiter*innen zum wirkungsvollsten Schutzschild gegen Sicherheitsrisiken zu entwickeln. Mit der Unterstützung führender VCs wie Highland Europe und Global Founders Capital expandieren wir weltweit in rasantem Tempo. Wir suchen Teamplayer, die sinnvolle Veränderungen im Bereich Cybersicherheit vorantreiben, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen wollen. Wenn du in einem lebendigen, zielorientierten Umfeld aufblühst, das Innovation, Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit großschreibt – dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! title: Customer Support Specialist
description: About us Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed. Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity. K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners. Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK or Germany. Please submit your CV in English About the role: Owkin is looking for a Customer Support Specialist to own first-level support for K-Pro, Owkin's AI research platform for biopharma R&D, used by AstraZeneca, Sanofi, Servier and Boehringer Ingelheim. Our clients have made major investments to access K-Pro, and their contracts come with strict response and resolution SLAs. You will be their first point of contact during business hours: the person who understands their problem quickly, keeps them informed, and gets the right engineering, product or customer success people moving. You will also help shape how support works at Owkin, including where AI and agentisation make it better. In particular, you will: Own the support flow Own incoming tickets during business hours as the first line of support for all K-Pro clients Triage every ticket: set priority (P1 to P4) and the impacted service, and route it to the right team Keep SLAs on track: follow up on open tickets, escalate early when a deadline is at risk Communicate clear, timely updates to users and CSMs throughout the ticket lifecycled Go deep on the product Diagnose issues directly with users: reproduce bugs, check data and configurations, and give engineers a clean, actionable report Learn K-Pro in depth (its features, the datasets clients use, how login, API access, exports and permissions work, and the research questions clients bring to it) so you can resolve most issues without escalating Recognise when a result looks scientifically wrong and when it's a usage question Turn support into insight Act as the Customer Success team's eyes on support: flag critical tickets, recurring issues, and signs that a client is becoming dissatisfied, so CSMs can act early Spot patterns across tickets and turn them into product feedback, doc updates or process fixes Track and report on support metrics (response time, SLA compliance, first contact resolution, volume) and give actionable insights to the team. Own the knowledge base Own the K-Pro help center: write, update and remove articles as new issues are resolved Turn one-off fixes into reusable answers for clients and for the support team Improve support with AI Identify where automation and AI tools (triage, routing, response drafting, knowledge retrieval) would save time or improve quality Work with R&Tech Operations to build, test and improve these workflows About you Required qualifications / experience: Proven technical support or customer support for B2B software, ideally SaaS, with enterprise clients A track record handling SLA-bound support with demanding customers, and staying calm under pressure Strong technical curiosity: comfortable with APIs, logs, data and configurations; basic SQL or scripting is a plus Hands-on experience with AI tooling and building or improving agentic support workflows (AI-assisted triage, automated routing, LLM-powered drafting), and the judgment to know when automation fits Excellent written and verbal communication, able to explain technical issues to scientists and to engineers alike Experience with support tooling such as Zendesk, Linear and PagerDuty, or equivalent Able to follow runbooks and escalation paths, and to know when to deviate from them A habit of turning fixes into documentation and patterns into insights Preferred qualifications/bonus: Experience in life sciences, biopharma or another regulated industry is a strong plus What success looks like in your first 6 months You handle the full ticket flow for all K-Pro clients with SLAs met CSMs rely on your signals to anticipate account risks The help center covers the most frequent ticket types You have shipped at least one automation that measurably improves support #LI-HB1 What we offer Flexible work organization Friendly and informal working environment Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds Recruitment Process & Security Please complete the form and submit your CV. Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability. Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information: Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn. From advanced estimation and control algorithms to embedded Rust optimization and flight-test analysis, you will set technical direction, make decisions based on real flight data and drive measurable improvements in aircraft performance. What is your Day to Day Mission: Take technical ownership of flight-control and state-estimation architecture, priorities and validation. Improve state estimation using Kalman filters, IIM, particle filters and model based approaches. Fuse IMU, radar, camera and ToF data into robust vehicle and target-state estimates. Increase the accuracy of velocity and position estimation in GPS-denied environments. Optimize sensor filtering, synchronization, outlier rejection and latency compensation. Own the design, implementation and tuning of flight-control algorithms for maximum agility, precision and stability. Identify real flight dynamics from recorded data and use them to improve models, estimators and controllers. Improve sensor and vehicle models used in simulation, SIL and HIL environments. Profile and optimize flight-critical Rust code for deterministic execution and minimum latency. Plan and lead flight-test analysis, identify performance limits and turn every flight into the next improvement. What You Bring to the Team This is a senior flight-control role. We are looking for deep expertise in flight-control design and tuning, together with a strong understanding of how control, state estimation, sensing and embedded implementation interact as one complete system. At least four years of professional experience developing and tuning flight-control systems, including implementation and testing on real systems. Experience with drones or other UAVs is strongly preferred. Exceptional candidates coming directly from university may be considered only if they can demonstrate at least three years of substantial hands-on flight-control experience through projects, research programs, student teams or comparable work, including implementation and testing on real systems. Deep foundations in control theory, state estimation, sensor fusion and flight dynamics. Hands-on experience with Kalman filters, nonlinear estimation or probabilistic filtering. A proven track record of designing, tuning and validating controllers for highly dynamic systems. Strong implementation skills in Rust, C++ or another systems programming language. A strong understanding of real-time execution, numerical stability, sensor timing and latency. Hands-on experience with simulation, system identification, flight-log analysis and flight testing. The drive to challenge existing performance limits, test ideas quickly and keep iterating until the data proves the improvement. The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in the defense, security, and public sectors. title: Senior Named Account Executive (AI & Digital Natives)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Atlanta, Georgia</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>The Enterprise AI and Digital Natives segment is Cloudflare's fastest growing and highest visibility market. This segment is dedicated exclusively to the largest organizations in the modern tech economy including premier SaaS platforms, hyperscale digital marketplaces, and leading AI labs. This is a deep infrastructure, developer centric play where technical alignment and deep engineering partnerships are our most critical currencies, resulting in Cloudflare’s largest and most complex enterprise agreements.</p> <p>Digital Native AEs at Cloudflare sell into the most innovative companies in North America. In targeting high-growth, technologically advanced, and venture-backed companies, AEs are positioned to drive in-depth product discussions while communicating and demonstrating value quickly to customers.  This role within the digital native segment focuses on both the acquisition of prospective Digital Native accounts, as well as the expansion of existing customer accounts.  The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Develop, execute, and maintain your territory plan to exceed quarterly sales targets and annual quota assignment.</li> <li>Be an expert in three unique sales motions; new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory.</li> <li>Build a robust sales pipeline utilizing the four sourcing funnels: AE led outbound, BDR, Channel, and Marketing Inbound.</li> <li>Develop and strategically leverage a deep technical understanding of the problems Cloudflare solves in order to drive a consultative sales motion.</li> <li>Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates.</li> <li>Accurately forecast, build commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations.</li> <li>As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews.</li> <li>Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers.</li> <li>Position Cloudflare's platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer.</li> <li>Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years sales experience selling B2B SaaS</li> <li>Strong B2B discovery skills</li> <li>Candidates have a point of view of industry trends and able to customize a client centric why change narrative</li> <li>Track record of beating annual targets of $1M+ and successfully managing complex six figure deals</li> <li>Experienced in multithreading into the C-suite and across an organization to manage a complex sales cycle</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required</li> <li>Software and system skills are a must (SFDC, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite)</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Praktikum im Bereich Customer Success Management
description: Dein Impact zur Mission: Bei voiio arbeiten wir daran, die Arbeitswelt zu revolutionieren – nicht als „Nice-to-have“, sondern als messbarer Erfolgsfaktor für führende Unternehmen in Deutschland. Als Teil unseres Customer Success Teams übernimmst vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung an der Schnittstelle zwischen Datenanalyse, Kundenberatung und interner Prozessoptimierung. Unser Ziel: Maximale Nutzung und Begeisterung bei unseren Partnerunternehmen – und für dich eine steile Lernkurve mit dem klaren Ziel, dich langfristig als Werkstudent:in an Bord zu halten. Deine Aufgaben bei voiio: Kundenbeziehungen aktiv mitgestalten: Du unterstützt in der Betreuung unserer Partnerunternehmen und gehst lösungsorientiert auf ihre Bedürfnisse und Anliegen ein. Kommunikation & Content: Du erstellst eigenständig Kommunikationsunterlagen (online und offline) sowie unterschiedliche Textformate für die interne Kommunikation unserer Kunden. Daten & Insights: Du wertest Nutzungszahlen unserer Partnerunternehmen aus, pflegst unsere internen Dashboards weiter und leitest daraus konkrete Empfehlungen für die Kundenberatung ab. Voice of the Customer: Du trägst branchen- und kundenspezifische Bedürfnisse, Wünsche und Hinweise unserer Partnerunternehmen in alle Abteilungen bei voiio weiter. Das zeichnet dich aus: Studium & Perspektive: Du studierst aktuell und noch für mind. 1 Jahr (langfristige Zusammenarbeit als Werkstudent:in). Analytisches & strategisches Denken: Du arbeitest dich schnell in Zahlen ein und bringst ein gutes Gespür für strategische Zusammenhänge mit. Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist eine offene, einnehmende Persönlichkeit und kannst andere mit deinen Ideen begeistern. Digital- & Tech-Kompetenz: Du bist sehr versiert im Umgang mit den gängigen MS Office Produkten, bringst ein gutes technisches Verständnis sowie Offenheit für KI-Tools mit. Erste Praxiserfahrung: Idealerweise bringst du erste relevante Berufserfahrung durch Praktika oder Werkstudierendenjobs aus dem Startup oder Consulting-Umfeld mit. Sprachen: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. Struktur & Resilienz: Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich und behältst auch in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld stets den Überblick. Teamspirit: Du bist Teamplayer:in, hast Lust auf eine wertschätzende Kultur und spaßige Bürotage mit dem Team. Wir wissen, dass diverse Teams besser performen. title: Founder's Associate Intern (m/w/d), B2B & Venture Development
description: Deine Mission Bling ist Deutschlands führende Familien-Finanz-App: Taschengeldkarte, Sparfunktionen und Finanzbildung für über 150.000 Familien.
