perfect</strong>: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.</li> <li><strong>More than just a job</strong>: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.</li> <li><strong>Be yourself</strong>: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Das bewegst du:</strong></h2> <p><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Als <strong>(Senior) Content Producer (Mensch) </strong>in unserem Content & Partnership Team bist du das operative Rückgrat für die Aussteuerung komplexer Content-Produktionen und Media-Partnerschaften, dediziert für unseren Kunden Google.</span> Mit einem starken Social-First-Fokus, einer agilen Hands-on-Mentalität und höchstem Qualitätsanspruch an eine <em>flawless execution</em> sorgst du dafür, dass freigegebene Konzepte wirksam und mit lokaler Relevanz im deutschen Markt zum Leben erweckt werden.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Projektplanung & Agilität:</strong> Souverän übersetzt du komplexe Briefings und Media-Partnerschaften in detaillierte Produktionspläne, leitest Kick-offs sowie wöchentliche Status-Calls und hältst interne wie externe Beteiligte verlässlich auf Kurs.</li> <li><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody"><strong>End-to-End-Produktionssteuerung:</strong> Du verantwortest die operative Umsetzung komplexer Video-, Content- und Event-Produktionen, von der Planung über die professionelle Koordination und Aussteuerung vor Ort am Set bzw. beim Dreh bis hin zur finalen Auslieferung.</span></li> <li><strong>Social-First & Media Delivery:</strong> Du prüfst Deliverables gewissenhaft auf Qualität (QA) und stellst sicher, dass alle Assets – insbesondere Social-First-Formate – exakt den technischen Spezifikationen der jeweiligen Plattformen und Media-Owner entsprechen.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:</strong> Als zentraler Knotenpunkt zwischen Kunde, Media-Teams und externen Partnern baust du vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, prüfst die produktionstechnische Machbarkeit von Ideen und moderierst operative Zielkonflikte stets lösungsorientiert.</li> <li><strong>Mentoring & Teamführung:</strong> <span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Du teilst dein Know-how aktiv im Team, bringst dich in die Optimierung unserer Workflows ein und unterstützt bei der Einarbeitung sowie, je nach Erfahrungslevel, als fachliche:r Mentor:in für weniger erfahrene Kolleg:innen (z. B. auf Junior-Level).</span></li> <li><strong>Digitale Innovation & KI:</strong> Mit Begeisterung für technologische Weiterentwicklung evaluierst du den gezielten Einsatz von KI-Tools in Produktions-Workflows und befähigst das Team, diese effizient im Alltag zu nutzen.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Das zeichnet dich aus:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Erfahrung:</strong> Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung als Content Producer in einer integrierten Agentur, einem Media-Netzwerk oder bei einem Publisher mit und hast einen klaren Track Record in der Steuerung von Media-Partnerschaften und Digitalkampagnen.</li> <li><strong>Operative Exzellenz:</strong> Du besitzt herausragende Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten, bringst Struktur in anspruchsvolle Prozesse und behältst auch in dynamischen Phasen stets einen kühlen Kopf.</li> <li><strong>Social-First- & Produktionswissen:</strong> Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis für die Content-Produktion digitaler Assets und Creator-Workflows; Mediapläne musst du nicht selbst schreiben, kannst sie aber fehlerfrei lesen, verstehen und produktionstechnisch ableiten.</li> <li><strong>Plattform-Expertise:</strong> Du kennst die Spezifikationen moderner Kanäle und Plattformen (Social-First, interaktive Formate, DOOH) aus dem Effeff und stellst eine nahtlose Einbindung aller Assets in die Media-Landschaft sicher.</li> <li><strong>Kundenorientierung:</strong> Du überzeugst durch Kommunikationsstärke im Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Stakeholdern und fühlst dich im schnellen Takt eines globalen Tech-Umfelds wohl.</li> <li><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody"><strong>Sprachkompetenz:</strong> Verhandlungssicheres Englisch in Wort und Schrift (unsere tägliche Geschäftssprache im internationalen Austausch) sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse für die lokale Marktumsetzung.</span></li> <li><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody"><strong>Reisebereitschaft:</strong> Du begleitest Produktionen und Events zuverlässig vor Ort und bringst eine entsprechende Reisebereitschaft für Dreh- und Produktionstage mit.</span></li> </ul> <p>Darüber hinaus bist du: <strong>#agil #strukturiert #qualitätsbewusst </strong></p> <p>Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Arbeiten bei WPP Media:</strong></h2> <p>Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.<br> <br>WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.</p> <p>Bitte lies unsere <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">Datenschutzerklärung</a> für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz, um weitere Informationen darüber zu erhalten, wie wir die von dir bereitgestellten Daten verarbeiten. #LI-Promoted (ID: 13914)</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Commercial Legal Counsel (Contractor)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.</span></p></div><p>Liftoff is looking for a Commercial Legal Counsel that will assist the in-house legal department with Insertion Orders (Agreements), third party contracts and other legal needs. This position will support the Commercial, Finance and Accounting teams, located around the world. <br><br>As a Commercial Legal Counsel at Liftoff, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of contracts that drive our business forward. You will be at the intersection of legal expertise, meticulous organization, and collaborative teamwork. Your responsibilities will encompass contract drafting, negotiation, process improvement and training. As an essential part of our team, you'll contribute to the foundation of our business relationships and help us navigate the complex world of contracts with precision and efficiency. If you're passionate about detail-oriented work, contract law, and making a meaningful impact, this role is your opportunity to shine. Join us in shaping the way we manage contracts and elevate our commitment to excellence.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts, including vendor agreements, customer contracts, and licensing agreements, to ensure compliance with company policies and legal requirements.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal teams, including legal, sales/commercial, product, engineering, finance and accounting to understand contract terms, resolve issues, and provide guidance on contractual matters.</li> <li>Maintain an organized and up-to-date contract ticketing system, respond to each contract ticket in a timely manner and track contract milestones and deadlines.</li> <li>Assist in  contract compliance, addressing any deviations or breaches.</li> <li>Assist in the development and improvement of contract templates and standard clauses.</li> <li>Support the contract approval process, ensuring proper authorization and documentation.</li> <li>Provide guidance and training to employees on contract-related matters and best practices.</li> <li>Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations impacting contract management.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements: </strong></p> <ul> <li>4-8 years' PQE</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Law, or a related field.</li> <li>Proven experience as a Contracts Counsel/Legal Counsel or in a similar role.</li> <li>Strong understanding of contract law and legal terminology.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Detail-oriented with exceptional organizational and time management abilities.</li> <li>Proficiency in contract management software or tools.</li> <li>Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment globally.</li> <li>Prior experience in ad-tech is a plus.</li> </ul> <hr> <p><strong>Location:</strong></p> <p>This position is based in London or remotely within the United Kingdom, occasionally going into the office.</p> <p>This position is a contract position. The expected hours of work required for this position are 35 to 40 hours per week, with occasional early evening hours for team meetings, as the manager is located in our Redwood City office in California.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-REMOTE</p> <p>#LI-NM1</p> <p> </p> <hr> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next.</p> <p> </p> <p>Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence.</p> <p> </p> <p>Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <p><strong>Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. No placement fees will be paid to any firm unless such a request has been made by the Liftoff Recruiting Team and such a candidate was submitted to the Liftoff Recruiting Team via our Applicant Tracking System.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Account Director - F/H - CDI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p></p> <p></p> <p><em>Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. <br><br></em><strong><em><u>A propos de WPP Media</u></em></strong><strong><em><u> </u></em></strong><strong><em><u>:</u></em></strong> </p> <p><strong><em>WPP is the creative transformation company.</em></strong> Nous utilisons le pouvoir de la créativité pour construire un avenir meilleur pour nos collaborateurs, notre planète, nos clients et nos communautés. Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wpp.com/fr-fr">wpp.com</a>. </p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/">wppmedia.com</a>. </p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media : </p> <ul> <li>Être <strong>Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Créer un environnement <strong>Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Diriger avec <strong>Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation. </li> </ul> <p><strong><em><u>A propos d’Openmind : Une marque de WPP Media A Leading WPP Media Brand</u></em></strong><strong><em><u> </u></em></strong><strong><em><u> </u></em></strong></p> <p>Openmind by WPP est un modèle d'agence intégrée puisant dans les talents de l'ensemble de WPP. Il a été créé pour accélérer la transformation européenne de la fonction média de Nestlé. Au cœur de cette solution se trouvent les meilleures capacités avancées de données et de technologie, alimentées par l'investissement de WPP dans l'IA, pour maximiser l'impact de l'investissement média de Nestlé.</p> <p></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>RESPONSABILITÉS :</strong></p> <p>L’équipe Openmind est une équipe experte du paysage médias français et de la manière dont les consommateurs interagissent avec celui-ci. <br>En tant qu’Account Director, vous aurez comme responsabilités de :</p> <p>- Leader la partie opérationnelle de l’équipe, sous la supervision du Business Director, en vous assurant de la gestion du workflow et de la qualité des rendus.</p> <p>- Développer et mettre en œuvre les stratégies média annuelles, en pilotant les prises de parole offline et digitale</p> <p>- Rédiger des recommandations média claires et convaincantes, en justifiant vos choix stratégiques</p> <p>- Sélectionner les canaux et superviser la production des plans média</p> <p>- Collaborer étroitement avec les experts média pour la planification opérationnelle des campagnes</p> <p>- Gérer les relations avec les autres fonctions internes de l'entreprise - conseil, stratégie, études, experts autres leviers/media, finance, ainsi que les relations avec les acteurs externes - clients, régies et partenaires</p> <p>- Assurer un contact direct et proactif avec les clients, en les conseillant et en répondant à leurs besoins, et veiller au respect des délais</p> <p>- Superviser la production et la présentation des bilans de campagne</p> <p>- Manager et encadrer une équipe en l'accompagnant dans son développement professionnel.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>COMPÉTENCES REQUISES :</strong></p> <p>· Formation supérieure Bac +4/5 en Marketing/Communication.</p> <p>· Expérience de 6 à 7 ans en agence média, régie ou chez l'annonceur.</p> <p>· Connaissances approfondies des leviers média online et offline, de leur orchestration et de leur exécution.</p> <p>· Une expérience dans l’opérationnel digital serait un plus.</p> <p>· Excellentes compétences rédactionnelles et de présentation.</p> <p>· Esprit d'analyse, de synthèse et de rigueur.</p> <p>· Curiosité, autonomie et proactivité.</p> <p>· Sens de l'organisation et souci du détail.</p> <p>· Anglais courant.</p> <p></p> <p class="x_MsoNormal"> </p> <p><strong><em><u>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :</u></em></strong></p> <p><em>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité. </em></p> <p><em>Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée. </em></p> <p><em>Nos avantages comprennent</em><em> </em><em>: </em></p> <ul> <li><em>Télétravail : jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année </em></li> </ul> <ul> <li><em>Deux jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte  </em></li> </ul> <ul> <li><em>Jours de congé additionnels par pallier de 5 ans d’ancienneté  </em></li> </ul> <ul> <li><em>5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaborateurs souffrant d’endométriose  </em></li> </ul> <ul> <li><em>Politique handicap : 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel, et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH  </em></li> </ul> <ul> <li><em>Missions solidaires possibles via le programme We care and we act  <br><br></em></li> <li><strong>Un Cadre de Travail Inspirant :</strong> Chez <strong>Openmind</strong>, vous aurez l'opportunité de contribuer à des projets passionnants et de collaborer avec des marques renommées. Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif où chaque talent peut s'épanouir et se développer.</li> </ul> <p><strong><em><u>Process de recrutement :</u></em></strong></p> <p><strong>Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : </strong>Un premier entretien téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec un membre de notre équipe. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise. </p> <p><strong>Étude de cas</strong> : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée.</p> <p><strong>Entretien opérationnel </strong>: Vous échangerez ensuite avec la Business Partner et la Lead Openmind France.</p> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process. </p> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle. </p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">politique de confidentialité</a>. </p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.<br><br>#LI-Promoted</p> <p> </p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span>&l

title: Centre of Excellence Senior Engineer
description: <h2>About Nscale</h2> <p>Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.</p> <p>At Nscale, our Infrastructure Operations team plays a critical role in maintaining service availability, driving operational excellence, and ensuring our global data centre estate operates safely, reliably, and efficiently.</p> <p>We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.</p> <hr> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are hiring a Centre of Excellence Senior Engineer to help define, standardise, and continuously improve the way Nscale operates its global data centre estate.</p> <p>This is a senior technical role for someone with deep infrastructure operations experience who enjoys solving complex problems, leading operational improvements, and driving consistency across multiple data centre locations.</p> <p>You'll work closely with Infrastructure Operations, Engineering, Deployment, and Platform teams to establish best practices, improve operational efficiency, lead major infrastructure initiatives, and help shape the future operating model for one of the fastest-growing AI infrastructure companies in the world.</p> <p>This role requires occasional travel to Nscale data centres across multiple countries to support deployments, operational improvements, and critical infrastructure initiatives.</p> <hr> <h2>What you'll be doing</h2> <h3>Infrastructure Operations & Continuous Improvement</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Lead complex infrastructure projects, including hardware installations, upgrades, and operational improvement initiatives.</p> </li> <li> <p>Drive standardisation across Nscale's global data centre estate by developing repeatable operational processes and best practices.</p> </li> <li> <p>Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and service reliability.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support the development of Nscale's Centre of Excellence as the operational authority for infrastructure operations.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Incident Management & Technical Leadership</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Take ownership of complex infrastructure incidents from diagnosis through to resolution.</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead major incident response activities and coordinate technical teams during critical events.</p> </li> <li> <p>Conduct root cause analysis and implement long-term corrective actions to improve platform resilience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Provide technical leadership and mentorship to operations teams across multiple locations.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Capacity Planning & Infrastructure Optimisation</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Partner with cross-functional teams on capacity planning and infrastructure optimisation initiatives.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support operational readiness for new deployments and infrastructure expansion.</p> </li> <li> <p>Help develop scalable operational models that support rapid business growth.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Documentation, Standards & Governance</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Own the creation and continuous improvement of operational documentation, standards, and runbooks.</p> </li> <li> <p>Define and maintain operational procedures for incident management, planned maintenance, and communications.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ensure consistency of operational execution across all Nscale data centres.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Cross-Functional Collaboration</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Work closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Deployment, Platform Engineering, Network Engineering, and Operations teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Travel to data centre sites to support deployments, resolve complex technical issues, and improve operational excellence.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build strong relationships across the business to drive alignment and influence operational best practices.</p> </li> </ul> <hr> <h2>About You</h2> <h3>Required Experience</h3> <ul> <li> <p>5+ years of experience in a technical infrastructure, data centre, or operations environment.</p> </li> <li> <p>Extensive experience working within large-scale data centre environments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven ability to solve complex, title: Accountant – Inventory & Fixed Assets Accounting (f/m/x)
description: Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One +, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market. Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy. What you’ll do As part of our Accounting team, you will support the accounting of inventory and fixed assets across the Enpal Group. Working closely with your Team Lead and other Finance and Operations teams, you will help ensure accurate accounting records, timely closing activities and reliable financial information. You support the day-to-day accounting of inventory and fixed assets for various Enpal entities, ensuring transactions are recorded accurately and on time. You prepare and post accounting entries related to inventory movements, asset additions, disposals, depreciation and other relevant transactions. You support monthly, quarterly and annual closing activities, including preparation of reconciliations, accounting entries and supporting schedules. You perform inventory reconciliations between ERP, warehouse and accounting records, identify discrepancies and support their resolution. You maintain and update fixed asset registers, including asset additions, transfers, disposals and depreciation. You assist with inventory valuation and fixed asset accounting activities in accordance with applicable accounting policies. You work closely with Supply Chain, Logistics, Procurement and other Finance teams to clarify accounting-related questions and resolve discrepancies. You prepare supporting documentation and analyses for HGB statutory reporting, IFRS Group reporting and external audits. You contribute to the improvement and standardization of accounting processes by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting practical improvements. What you’ll bring You have completed a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, a commercial apprenticeship or a comparable qualification. You have experience in Financial Accounting, General Ledger Accounting or a similar accounting function. You have a basic understanding of accounting principles and closing processes. Experience with inventory accounting, fixed asset accounting or account reconciliations is a plus. You are comfortable working with Excel and financial data. You have experience with ERP systems; knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 is an advantage. You communicate confidently in English; German language skills are an advantage. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you. Join us if you want to Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. Experience in driving the performance and development of individuals and teams against ambitious targets. Analytical skills, with the ability to interpret a range of data sources (dashboards, QA, customer feedback) to inform coaching and process improvements. Demonstrated ability to motivate, coach, and develop a diverse team; skilled at recognising and nurturing emerging talent. Comfortable working with CRM/case management systems, digital platforms, and supporting technology-driven change (automation, AI, etc.). Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage, motivate, and influence at all levels. Personally resilient, adaptable, and accountable; able to balance customer, business, and risk priorities. title: Lead Platform Engineer
description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Department Description Platform Engineering is the centralised team that builds, provisions and runs the infrastructure every other engineering team at Allica depends on. Whether a product serves a business banking customer or a colleague inside the bank, it lands on a platform this team designed. The team owns both halves of that, building the platform and running it, against the availability and resilience standards a regulated bank is held to. Well-architected is the operating standard, not an aspiration: reliability, security, cost and operational excellence are design inputs from the start. The job is to make the right thing the easy thing, through paved roads, self-service provisioning, sensible defaults, and controls encoded in the platform rather than bolted on afterwards. Every control the platform enforces is one a product team does not have to think about, and one we can evidence on demand. Role Description The Lead Platform Engineer is the senior technical leader for a core domain of Allica's platform. You set its technical direction, you are accountable for how it behaves in production, and you build it yourself. This is a hands-on role. Expect to spend a real share of your week in infrastructure as code, pipelines and live systems, and the rest setting standards, reviewing designs and making the calls that are too consequential to delegate. Your customers are internal. Product engineering and data engineering choose whether to use what you build, so adoption and the friction you remove are the measures that matter. Principal Accountabilities Platform Architecture and Engineering Own the architecture of Allica’s Cloud platform: landing zones, subscriptions and network topology, container runtime, and the integration and resilience patterns that sit on top. Design again Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework as working disciplines.  Build the reusable core: Terraform modules, deployment templates and platform services that let a team stand up production-grade infrastructure without reinventing the security, networking and observability plumbing each time. Infrastructure as Code and Automation  Deliver and manage all infrastructure through Terraform and secure CI/CD, so that every change is automated, repeatable, version-controlled, tested, and reversible. Drive manual change and configuration drift towards zero.  Set and evolve engineering standards for the function: code quality, peer review, policy as code and, release management. Security, Governance, and Compliance  Embed security, governance, and compliance throughout the platform lifecycle, implementing effective policies, access controls, encryption, vulnerability management, monitoring, and configuration standards.  Collaborate with Allica’s Security, Engineering, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure platforms meet organisational, regulatory, and control requirements, supported by clear documentation and auditable evidence.  Identify and manage architectural risks, security vulnerabilities, control gaps, and technical debt, ensuring remediation actions are prioritised, tracked, and completed. Platform Operations and Service Ownership  Own availability, reliability, and run cost for the platform, backed by service objectives, monitoring you can operate from, and tested recovery arrangements. Lead the response to complex incidents, own the root-cause analysis, drive out repeat causes rather than repeat fixes.  Use service data, operational experience, and FinOps practices to continuously improve platform automation, resilience, engineering standards, cost visibility, forecasting, and resource optimisation. Team Leadership  Lead, mentor, and develop a team of platform engineers while remaining personally hands-on in architecture, design reviews, and the hardest technical problems.  Set the technical bar and raise it, through coaching, design review and the example of your own work. Personal Attributes & Experience  A strong track record architecting, and running production Azure environments at scale. Fluent in landing zone and subscription design, private networking, containerised compute, API management and resilience patterns across zones and regions. Line Management Experience Extensive hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure at scale, infrastructure as code, containerised runtimes, identity and observability.  Has carried production accountability for systems that matter. Comfortable in handling incidents.  Treats developer experience as a product. Talks to engineering teams, watches how they actually work and designs for adoption rather than mandate.  Treats regulatory and security requirements as engineering constraints to design around, not obstacles to route past. Prior regulated or high-assurance experience helps but is not a prerequisite.  Gets adoption by building things engineers want to use and by making a clear case, not by escalation.  Prefers the boring, well-understood solution unless the problem genuinely demands otherwise. Willing to remove things. Desirable Experience  Architecture or engineering experience with Google Cloud Platform.  Experience working in complex, regulated, or security-sensitive environments. Knowledge of Kubernetes, container platforms, serverless services, and cloud-native application patterns.  Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD technologies.  Familiarity with FinOps, operational resilience, regulatory compliance, and cloud-control frameworks.  Relevant Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Terraform, security, or architecture certifications. Working at Allica Bank At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers. Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind: Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities Options for flexible working Regular social activities Pension contributions Discretionary bonus scheme Private health cover Life assurance Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave Don’t tick every box? Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you! Flexible working We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate. Diversity We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like. title: Stage Ingénieur Data (6 mois) - F/H - Lyon
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques. Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. Vos missions : Rattaché.e à l'équipe Business développement, vous contribuez à la construction d'une infrastructure de données fiable au service de l'activité opérationnelle. Vous concevez un processus complet qui collecte des données issues de sources externes variées, les fiabilise et les met à disposition dans nos outils SIG. Vos principales missions : Identifier et qualifier les sources de données : recenser de manière exhaustive les sources externes pertinentes (open data, bases institutionnelles, données géographiques…) et évaluer leur format, leur fréquence de mise à jour et leur fiabilité. Croiser les sources entre elles : définir et mettre en œuvre une méthode de rapprochement (record linkage), afin d'identifier de façon fiable les mêmes éléments présents dans plusieurs sources. Consolider les données : nettoyer, harmoniser et compiler les données dans un format cohérent, prêt à être intégré à notre base de données existante. Garantir la cohérence entre sources : mettre en place des contrôles de qualité et des règles de mise à jour, pour éviter qu'une modification dans une source ne crée des incohérences dans l'ensemble de la base. Publier les résultats : intégrer les données consolidées à la base et les rendre exploitables dans les outils SIG de l'entreprise. Automatiser le processus : industrialiser la chaîne de traitement pour permettre des mises à jour régulières et reproductibles, sans intervention manuelle. Documenter la méthode : rédiger une documentation claire de la démarche et des choix retenus, pour assurer la maintenance et la transmission du dispositif. title: Engineering Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p>About the department</p> <p>Cloudflare's Engineering team builds and runs the software that handles a large share of the Internet's requests. We also build the internal tools and platforms that software depends on. Teams own large areas with real impact and work autonomously within them, whether their customers are external or other Cloudflare engineers.</p> <p>About the team</p> <p>Developer Productivity builds the internal tools and platforms Cloudflare engineers use to take code from commit to production. We own developer infrastructure (CI/CD, build systems), developer insights and ADLC metrics, AI-assisted development, and Cloudflare-on-Cloudflare dogfooding.</p> <p>We're responsible for AI-assisted development across all of Cloudflare engineering, and adoption has grown 4 to 6 times over in the last year. We also own the tooling behind Cloudflare's Engineering Codex, the standards every engineering team is expected to meet.</p> <p>About the role</p> <p>This is a front-line engineering manager role leading a team of 6+ engineers in Bengaluru. The team's initial focus will be on two areas:</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>AI tools for engineers.</strong> Agents, agentic systems, MCP servers, evals, and context engineering that change how Cloudflare engineers write, review, and ship code.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Engineering standards and the tooling that enforces them.</strong> Continuing to transform our Engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and feedback engineers can act on, instead of checklists and manual review.</p> </li> </ul> <p>You'll own the product direction for both areas. There are no dedicated product managers on the team. Our users are Cloudflare engineers, and our engineers work as product engineers who talk to users, watch how tools get used, and help decide what to build next. You'll lead that work, deciding what to build and why, and making sure it gets adopted and solves real problems.</p> <p>You don't need to write code every day, but you should be able to review a design, debug a broken pipeline, or prototype an agent when the team needs it.</p> <p>We move fast. AI tooling changes month to month, so a six-month plan is stale in six weeks. We ship small, put it in front of engineers early, and change course based on what we hear. We'd rather ship a rough version this week and improve it next week than spend a month polishing a design doc. We add process only when it solves a real problem.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with engineering managers and principal engineers in the US, UK, and Europe, and work with teams across Cloudflare's global organization. The team starts in Bengaluru. As it grows, it may include engineers in other regions.</p> <p>What you'll do</p> <ul> <li> <p>Hire, onboard, and grow your team. Coach engineers to think like product engineers, run career conversations, give direct feedback, and handle performance.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own the product roadmap. Spend time with the engineers who use your tools, decide which problems matter most, and say no to the rest.</p> </li> <li> <p>Keep the team shipping. Release in small increments, get feedback from users quickly, and cut process that slows the team down without adding value.</p> </li> <li> <p>Deliver in both focus areas: agents, MCP servers, and evals the rest of engineering relies on, and Codex standards turned into CI/CD checks, templates, and policy-as-code, with remediation and exception workflows to match.</p> </li> <li> <p>Measure whether the work is landing: tool adoption, Codex compliance, and what engineers actually think of the experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own operations for the platforms your team runs, including on-call and incident response.</p> </li> </ul> <p>What we're looking for</p> <ul> <li> <p>3+ years managing software engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and developing people.</p> </li> <li> <p>8+ years of total software engineering experience, with enough recent hands-on work to hold your own in code and design reviews.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with AI in engineering organizations, such as building agents, running agentic systems in production, or governing how a company uses AI. This is not a model-training or ML research role.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building or running developer tools, internal platforms, or CI/CD systems.</p> </li> <li> <p>Product and user thinking. You've owned a roadmap, with or without a PM, and you can point to decisions you made because of what users told you or how they actually used what you built.</p> </li> <li> <p>A bias to action. You've led teams that shipped often and changed direction when the evidence called for it, while still delivering on commitments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Clear judgment and clear writing. You make sound trade-offs and explain the "why" as well as the "how". Much of your work with partners will happen asynchronously across time zones.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Bonus points</p> <ul> <li> <p>You've built MCP servers or LLM evals, or worked on context engineering for agents.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with policy-as-code or compliance automation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience measuring developer productivity, using frameworks such as DORA or SPACE, or developer surveys.</p> </li> <li> <p>You've built a team from scratch or started an engineering presence in a new location.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with TypeScript, Go, or Kubernetes-based systems.</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, Spain
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. This role will be based in either Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. - Fluency in Spanish. NICE TO HAVES: - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €174,000 - €186,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. However as you’ll likely work on a variety of projects your responsibilities may also include:</p> <ul> <li>Designing, building, and optimizing data pipelines and ETL processes for large-scale data ingestion and transformation.</li> <li>Developing and maintaining data platforms and warehousing solutions to support analytics and business intelligence needs.</li> <li>Implementing scalable data storage solutions and ensuring high availability and performance.</li> <li>Enhancing performance in data processing workflows for maximum speed and scalability.</li> <li>Collaborating with data scientists, analysts, and stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into data engineering solutions.</li> <li>Ensuring data quality, governance, and compliance across all systems.</li> <li>Supporting CI/CD processes for data pipeline deployments and implementing best practices in DevOps for data workflows.</li> <li>Conducting code reviews and enforcing best practices in version control, automation, and testing.</li> <li>Assisting with defining structured source code management and deployment processes.</li> <li>Working with and supporting Technical Leaders in project execution and timely delivery.</li> <li>Collaborating with client teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in this person</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience delivering at a Senior Engineer level, specialising in Data engineering. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem! </li> <li><strong>Paid Time Off Package -</strong> We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.</li> <li><strong>Remote Working Allowance - </strong>Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.</li> <li><strong>Training and Development Allowance -</strong> We understand the importance of continuously learning so we offer an allowance of up to €1000 (equivalent in GBP) you can use to upskill yourself.</li> <li><strong>Healthcare -</strong> It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.</li> <li><strong>Pension & Insurances</strong> <strong>-</strong> We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Interview Process</strong></p> <p><strong>Talent Call</strong> (30 mins via Zoom)<br>An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. We'll also provide a high-level overview of Nearform and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Technical Assessment</strong> (1 hour via Zoom)<br>A live coding challenge with one of our trained interviewers. You'll be asked to build a working solution to a problem via screen sharing, demonstrating your data engineering expertise, problem-solving ability, and coding best practices in a real-time environment.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Hiring Manager Interview</strong> (45 mins via Zoom)<br>A conversation with a Hiring Manager focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.</p> <p><em>There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project</em></p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Ready to Join Us?</strong></h3> <p>If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p>Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.</p> <p><br><br><em>Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence. </em></p> <p><em>If you require any adjustments to the interview process as part of your application, please let someone from our Talent Team know so they can help.  </em></p> <p><em>Salary up to £90,000 + Bonus & Benefits </em><br><br></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Chief of Staff
description: Overview Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence. At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence. We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us. The Role You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role. This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone. What You Will Do Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships. Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps. Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action. Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is. Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks. Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes. Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination. Who You Are A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle. Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched. Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers. A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity. High ownership and bias toward action. Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others. Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out. Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck. A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too : Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering. Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience. Requirements Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate. Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia. Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycles. Professional experience, relationships or network relevant to Jua's industry and customer base preferred. At Jua, we foster a performance culture and value people who embody our beliefs of service and adventure. We prioritize agility, operating at the highest clock speed to adapt quickly to change. We innovate on behalf of our users and leverage data supremacy to maintain our competitive edge. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence. With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. We value the unique perspectives that each individual brings to the table and believe that embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences enriches our collective journey towards growth and success. title: Senior Customer Success Manager (Dutch speaking/ Nederlandstalig)
description: Over de rol 🎯 Als Senior Customer Success Manager bij DataSnipper zorg je ervoor dat onze klanten hun doelen bereiken met onze innovatieve, AI-gedreven oplossingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de klantreis, van onboarding tot langdurige waardecreatie en retentie, en bouwt sterke relaties op basis van vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je helpt klanten sneller waarde te halen uit onze producten en draagt bij aan de groei en het succes van ons bedrijf. Deze rol biedt een unieke kans om nauw samen te werken met professionals die de wereldwijde kapitaalmarkten draaiende houden, door uitzonderlijke service te leveren en een actieve en betrokken community voor onze klanten op te bouwen. Word jij enthousiast van Customer Success en pak je graag zelf de regie? Dan horen we graag van je! Over DataSnipper Wij geloven dat vertrouwen essentieel is voor hoe de samenleving werkt. Elke dag vertrouwen we op informatie die onafhankelijk is gecontroleerd, van jaarrekeningen tot de producten die we kopen en de duurzaamheidsclaims van bedrijven. Achter dat vertrouwen staan audit- en financeprofessionals die bewijs onderzoeken, informatie verifiëren en organisaties ter verantwoording roepen. Bij DataSnipper bouwen we AI-oplossingen waarmee deze professionals die beoordelingen kunnen maken. Met Alwin by DataSnipper, ons nieuwe agentic platform, nemen AI-agents audit- en financeprocedures van begin tot eind over, terwijl elke conclusie terug te voeren is op de bron. Zo houden professionals ruimte voor het oordeelsvermogen en de expertise die hun werk zo belangrijk maken. Meer dan 600.000 professionals bij ruim 3.000 organisaties in 175 landen vertrouwen op ons platform. Daaronder vallen Fortune 500-bedrijven, overheidsinstanties en alle Big Four-accountantskantoren. Alleen al in 2025 leverde DataSnipper zijn klanten een productiviteitswinst op ter waarde van meer dan 1,4 miljard dollar. Met een Series B-financieringsronde van 100 miljoen dollar onder leiding van Index Ventures, bij een waardering van 1 miljard dollar, leggen we een solide basis voor onze volgende groeifase. Als lid van 1% for the Planet kijken we niet alleen naar hoe snel we groeien, maar ook naar hoe we groeien. Voor onze Customer Success-teams wordt het nu extra spannend. Alwin is net gelanceerd, de vraag groeit en we breiden uit naar nieuwe markten en segmenten. Met een product waar klanten al op vertrouwen, heb je de kans om echt je stempel te drukken op de volgende stap. Wat ga je doen Trusted Advisor zijn: Je bent een strategische partner voor belangrijke beslissers, zoals auditpartners en -managers, controllers, finance directors en IT-besluitvormers, en begeleidt hen bij de transformatie van hun organisatie met DataSnipper. Business transformatie aanjagen: Je helpt klanten hun workflows en processen opnieuw uit te vinden en laat zien hoe de AI-mogelijkheden van DataSnipper meetbaar bijdragen aan efficiëntie, kostenbesparing en kwaliteit binnen audit en finance. Strategische, consultatieve oplossingen bieden: Je denkt mee over de uitdagingen van elke klant en vertaalt dat naar praktisch advies, zodat zij hun audit- en financeworkflows optimaliseren en hun strategische doelen bereiken met DataSnipper. Klanten helpen om meer waarde uit DataSnipper te halen: Je geeft uitgebreide trainingen, organiseert regelmatige Business Reviews en ontwikkelt succesplannen, zodat klanten de functionaliteiten van DataSnipper omarmen en aantoonbare waarde halen uit ons platform. Hechte klantrelaties opbouwen: Je bouwt sterke, langdurige partnerschappen op basis van vertrouwen, diepgaand inzicht in de sector en oprechte betrokkenheid bij het succes en de resultaten van je klanten. Over teams heen samenwerken: Je werkt samen met Product, Engineering, Sales en Solutions Engineering en deelt klantinzichten over workflowuitdagingen, use cases en technische vereisten om productinnovatie te stimuleren. De stem van je klant zijn binnen DataSnipper: Je begrijpt de auditmethodologie, compliance-eisen en bedrijfsdoelen van je klanten goed en geeft feedback intern door, zodat DataSnipper antwoord geeft op echte behoeften uit de praktijk. Strategische groei ondersteunen: Je signaleert en realiseert uitbreidingskansen binnen je portefeuille. Samen met Sales toon je de ROI aan, faciliteer je pilots en vergroot je de adoptie binnen teams en service lines. Zorgen voor soepele technische implementatie en fungeren als platformexpert: Je ondersteunt klanten bij onboarding, inclusief setup, AI-configuratie en het op maat maken van workflows, en blijft up-to-date met het platform van DataSnipper, de AI-mogelijkheden en best practices voor automatisering. Strategische sessies leiden: Je plant en faciliteert persoonlijke en virtuele sessies met audit- en financeteams om adoptie te stimuleren. Daarnaast deel je best practices voor een succesvolle transformatie en pak je uitdagingen aan die het klantbehoud in gevaar kunnen brengen. Heldere succesplannen opstellen: Je maakt strategische roadmaps voor elke klant met transformatiedoelen, adoptiemijlpalen, uitbreidingskansen, engagementtactieken en succesmetrics. Health en business impact monitoren: Je volgt en voorspelt belangrijke metrics, zoals gebruikersengagement, featuregebruik, geleverde bedrijfswaarde, uitbreidingskansen, retentierisico's en technische health-indicatoren. Wat breng je mee Customer Success-ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting of een andere customer-facing functie in B2B SaaS, met een goed begrip van de customer success-aanpak (onboarding, adoptie, verlengingen en uitbreiding). Trusted Advisor-mindset: Passie om een strategische partner voor klanten te zijn, duurzame relaties op basis van vertrouwen op te bouwen en transformatie aan te jagen die uitzonderlijke waarde levert. Focus op business transformatie: Aantoonbaar vermogen om klanten te helpen hun processen en workflows opnieuw te bekijken en te laten zien hoe technologie meetbare bedrijfsresultaten oplevert. Verantwoordelijkheid en ownership: Een sterk gevoel van ownership en de drive om je vak te beheersen, initiatief te nemen en te zorgen dat geen details over het hoofd worden gezien. title: IT & Infosec Director
description: Protect our digital frontiers. Scale our enterprise systems – so our radar tech stays secure while we grow. As our IT & Infosec Director, you own our end-to-end digital architecture and cybersecurity posture. You work side-by-side with Operations, Legal, I&D, and Commercial teams – connecting core business tools while safeguarding critical IP and customer data. You report directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), leading our Business Applications, IT Infrastructure & Cloud, and Information Security teams as we expand globally. What you'll do Strategic roadmap and business systems: Drive our multi-year IT roadmap to support global growth. Integrate enterprise systems seamlessly across ERP, CRM, PLM, and business intelligence tools. Ensure our software ecosystem scales efficiently alongside expanding business operations. Cybersecurity architecture and risk management: Establish, govern, and enforce company-wide security policies and zero-trust architectures. Oversee threat detection, incident response plans, and secure data handling procedures. Conduct regular risk assessments, penetration tests, and vendor security audits. Defense and aviation compliance: Lead compliance across global frameworks including ISO 27001, CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, and ITAR/DFARS controls. Protect sensitive defense and aviation customer data against evolving threats. Partner with external auditors and compliance assessors to maintain top certifications. Global infrastructure and cloud operations: Oversee network resilience, cloud environments, and hybrid workplace hardware deployments. Manage enterprise identity systems like Azure AD and Entra ID. Run routine disaster recovery testing to guarantee operational stability across sites. Leadership and executive advisory: Serve as the primary tech advisor to executive leadership on digital investments and cybersecurity risks. Lead, coach, and develop high-performing technical teams across applications, infrastructure, and security. Manage external IT partners, software vendors, and managed security service providers. What you bring BA or MSc in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field 10+ years of progressive IT and Information Security leadership experience Proven background in high-tech hardware, defense, aerospace, software, or engineering environments Deep working knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, GDPR, and ITAR/EAR protocols Hands-on experience with enterprise ERP, PLM, and business intelligence architecture Recognised security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CCISO preferred Confident communicator who balances strict security controls with organizational agility Cool-headed leader capable of driving calm, rapid response during critical system incidents Willing to travel up to 5% to strategic partners and international sites N.B. Don't worry if you don't tick every box. Our mission is a journey, and there's plenty to learn along the way. If most of this fits, we'd love to hear from you. A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and a background check are part of our screening process. We appreciate your understanding. What we offer Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company; Comprehensive pension plan; Commuting allowance; 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days); Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications; High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role; An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks! Robin Radar is a technology leader in tracking and classifying small objects.
