description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. The company is growing fast, and we are now seeking the best talents to come and join our exciting and ambitious team in the fight against cancer - join us! Position overview Orakl runs its data and AI platform on AWS: Dagster pipelines, a versioned PostgreSQL warehouse, ephemeral Fargate and EC2 compute, eight microservices. Unique in-house and hospital-provided biological, clinical and omics data flow through it every day. We continuously train our proprietary AI models on this every day to create new scientific insights that will benefit patients. We are hiring a Platform Engineer across three missions: infrastructure, security and scalability. You will be our first dedicated platform hire, and you will decide what this platform looks like for the next years. This is a high-stakes, high-ownership position. Our stack Cloud: AWS (Paris region), cross-cloud backup to a second European provider Compute: ECS and Fargate, EC2, ephemeral provisioning per job Data: PostgreSQL, S3, versioned transformations Code: Python everywhere, Docker, Terraform, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Dagster orchestration, Nextflow What you will be doing 1. title: Lab Automation Lead
description: About us, and our mission At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI. Position overview Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams. Key responsibilities Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities. Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership. In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project. Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds. Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests. Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists. Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step. Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly. Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs. Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management. In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer. Key qualifications Must-have Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience. Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes. Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects. Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting. You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes. Autonomy: you tell your manager what you decided and why, not what you need decided. Fluency in English is required. Nice-to-have You have put automated lines, cells or special machines into service end to end: requirements, vendor selection, negotiation, integration, factory and site acceptance, ramp-up, budget. This doesn’t have to be in a lab environment : plant, food and fermentation, pharma or cosmetics are other examples of relevant experience. Automation in life-science or regulated environments: cell culture, biotech, food and fermentation, pharma, cleanroom or BSL-2 work. A working understanding of cell culture and what it demands: sterility, contamination risk, variability between samples, and steps governed by the biological pace. Liquid handling, plate-based workflows, incubators and imagers; laboratory scheduling software. Experience hiring and leading an automation team. What we offer You will be Orakl's first automation hire. You will have a unique degree of ownership and scope with a strong mandate to deliver. Short decision lines and fast execution. An interdisciplinary environment with a results-driven culture. Cross-functional interviews with the technicians who run the culture, Platform Operations, the Senior Laboratory Engineers and the Data team — 60 minutes Reference calls: a former manager, a vendor or integrator you negotiated with, and an operator who ran a line you delivered Founder conversation — 45 minutes Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Client Enablement & Coaching Lead (F/H/X)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now. You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills. You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio. When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt. Key Responsibilities: what you'll do Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement: Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme. Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation. Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions. Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation. Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations. Project Management: Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised. Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track. Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs. Mentorship & Coaching: Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation. Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies. Analytical & Problem-Solving: Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct. Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes. Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations. Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration. Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality. Driving Organisational Change: Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach. Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success. Skills: what you'll have Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions. Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies. Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions. Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience. Fluent English & French is a prerequisite Experience Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level. Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively. Change management using agile methodologies. Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. Other Requirements: Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs. You are based in and around Paris and are willing to go to the office 2-3 times per week Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages. Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports. Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions. Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration. title: Customer Success Associate - Renewable Energy
description: Customer Success Associate – Renewable Energy Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Unsere Mission für dich Gestalte mit uns die nachhaltige Energieversorgung von morgen und werde Teil unseres wachsenden Customer-Success-Teams. trawa baut Europas führende B2B-Plattform für saubere Energie auf. Unsere Mission ist es, Industrieunternehmen mit nachhaltigen Energielösungen zu versorgen. Mit unserem integrierten Ansatz aus Energieversorgung, moderner Energiemanagementsoftware und intelligenter Optimierung des Energieverbrauchs helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, wettbewerbsfähig zu bleiben und den Weg in eine klimafreundliche Energiezukunft zu ebnen. Als Customer Success Associate unterstützt du unsere Kund:innen dabei, den vollen Mehrwert aus unserem nachhaltigen Produktportfolio zu ziehen. Du sorgst für eine reibungslose Betreuung, koordinierst wichtige Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Kund:innen langfristig erfolgreich mit trawa arbeiten. Das Team Unser Customer Success Team begleitet Kund:innen von der ersten Anfrage bis zur langfristigen Partnerschaft – mit dem Ziel, echten Mehrwert zu liefern, Wachstum im Bestand zu treiben und exzellenten Service zu skalieren. Wir stehen unseren Kund:innen nicht nur operativ zur Seite, sondern beraten sie auch aktiv zu Fragen rund um den Energiemarkt – damit sie in einem komplexen, volatilen Umfeld die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen können. title: Optical Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply. We are seeking a skilled and driven Optical Engineer to design, analyze, and help realize the next generation of high-energy and high-average-power laser systems that underpin Focused Energy’s fusion program. In this role, you will be responsible for turning advanced optical concepts into robust, manufacturable, and operable experimental and production laser systems. Your work will directly enable the performance, stability, and scalability of our fusion laser infrastructure — ensuring that optical designs meet extreme power, precision, and reliability requirements while remaining practical to build, integrate, and operate. What you’ll do Optical System Design: Design, model, and optimize complex optical systems for high-energy and high-average-power laser applications, balancing performance, robustness, and manufacturability. Simulation & Analysis: Use advanced optical modeling tools (e.g., Zemax / OpticStudio) to perform ray tracing, tolerance analysis, stray light analysis, and wavefront propagation to predict and validate system behavior. Performance Specification: Define detailed optical specifications including component selection, materials, coatings, and tolerances to meet demanding power, fluence, and stability requirements. Integration & Commissioning: Partner closely with technicians, laser engineers, and mechanical and electrical teams during assembly, alignment, testing, and commissioning of optical systems, troubleshooting issues as they arise. System Optimization: Identify and resolve performance limitations related to aberrations, thermal effects, alignment sensitivity, and stray light to ensure stable, repeatable operation at high power. Documentation & Communication: Produce high-quality technical documentation, analyses, and design reviews to support internal development, knowledge sharing, and external collaboration. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work across disciplines to ensure optical designs integrate cleanly into larger laser, mechanical, electrical, vacuum, and control system architectures. Who you are A degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with professional experience designing and analyzing optical systems for laser or photonics applications. Deep hands-on experience with Zemax (OpticStudio) or comparable optical design and simulation tools, including tolerance and stray light analysis. Strong understanding of classical optics, Gaussian beam propagation, laser physics, and material behavior under high-intensity or high-fluence conditions. Comfortable moving between modeling and the lab — supporting alignment, testing, debugging, and iteration of real optical hardware. You bring rigor to your designs, anticipate failure modes, and care deeply about accuracy, documentation, and long-term reliability. You can work effectively with scientists, engineers, and technicians and communicate complex optical concepts clearly across disciplines. Preferred: Experience with MATLAB, Python, or similar tools for analysis, modeling, or automation of design workflows. Preferred: Familiarity with cleanroom practices, vacuum-compatible optical design, large-aperture optics, or advanced components such as adaptive or deformable optics. Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits. We have acquired two new businesses in the last twelve months. A hungry team of over 50 people (and 5 dogs) in offices in Switzerland, Germany and the United Kingdom. And we are raising our next round. We do not have a finance function yet. We have an external accountant, a signed audit, and a CEO and COO who know exactly what they need to run this company — but cannot build it alone. That is the opening. Tasks What you will own Everything financial: Banking architecture across multiple currencies, countries, and entities. Monthly close that actually closes on time. Compliance in multiple jurisdictions via external partners you recruit and manage. The financial diligence in our roll-up strategy when we acquire — and the structuring of acquisition financing when deals need to be funded. A financial model that investors love to look at. The data room when we raise. You will report to David (CEO) and work closely with Lad (COO), who owns the P&L and will be your closest counterpart on the operational side. You will present to the board. You will be in the room for every capital allocation decision. There is no team. There is no process to maintain. There is a blank sheet and a business that is ready to run properly. The first year Your first year at quinn is one of the rare opportunities where you get to make every decision that matters. Which tools. Which banks. Which partners. How we report, how we model, how we show up to investors. All of it is yours to design. You will spend the first months getting under the hood — taking over the books, understanding the gaps, and fixing what needs fixing first. You will build the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership real visibility to steer the company across every product and revenue stream. You will analyze the first potential merger and acquisition targets and sit in rooms where the financial direction of the company gets decided, and you will be the person with the numbers. By the end of the year, you will have built something real: a finance function that works, a roll-up strategy that has financial legs, and a leadership team that trusts you completely. Most people at this level spend years waiting for that kind of ownership. Here it happens within months. Requirements Who we are looking for You have been CFO or Head of Finance at a scale-up — a SaaS, marketplace, or tech-enabled services company. You have worked across more than one international market. You are comfortable closing the books yourself, not just reviewing what others produce. You have built financial infrastructure before — not inherited it. You are equally at home in B2C and B2B — and you understand what it means to manage the unit economics, reporting, and compliance obligations for both within a single business. You think in MRR, ARR, NRR, CAC payback, and LTV:CAC ratio. You have worked with investors. You understand what a roll-up strategy looks like financially, and you have the accounting basics to back it up. You know the difference between managing a finance function and doing the finance — and you are built for the latter. Most importantly: You want this. Not a senior finance role at a large company. This one. The blank sheet, the multiple markets, the acquisitions to integrate, the round to prepare, the opportunity. The kind of thing you only get to do once. title: OEM Alliance Director
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced <strong>Global Alliances Director</strong> to join our strategic partnerships team who will be responsible for leading the Dell Technologies alliance team  globally. Reporting to the Head of IHV Alliances, the Dell Global Alliance Director will work closely with Dell and Canonical teams in all geographies to develop and maintain strong relationships with senior executives at strategic partner organizations, fostering collaboration and alignment on joint business objectives. The Dell Global Alliance Director will manage and grow a global team of Business Development Managers and help them identify and pursue new business opportunities with Dell, driving revenue growth and market expansion, develop and execute go-to-market strategies for joint offerings, oversee the day-to-day management of the alliance including contract negotiations and performance tracking, and issue resolution. The Dell Global Alliance Director will also contribute to thought leadership initiatives, such as joint publications and joint customer events.</p> <p>Location: This role will be based remotely in AMER regions.</p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build and own the strategy and the development of the Alliance on a global level</li> <li>Expand strategic relationships and enable Dell teams on the partnership</li> <li>Grow business motions with Dell Technologies, across sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions  </li> <li>Grow Dell’s awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu</li> <li>Manage, develop and grow a team of experienced business development managers</li> <li>Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem</li> <li>Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner</li> <li>Travel internationally - to drive partnerships in person</li> <li>Align and support internal canonical field teams - identify, support, grow, transact</li> <li>Expand existing footprint with Dell customers with an aim to upsell to broader portfolio</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Proven experience as an Alliance Manager/Director </li> <li>Solid experience in Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong relationships with executives at all levels.</li> <li>Strong business acumen and a strategic mindset, with a focus on driving revenue growth and market expansion.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively present complex ideas to a variety of audiences.</li> <li>Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality</li> <li>Passionate about Canonical products and mission</li> <li>Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals</li> <li>Team player with superior accountability and customer support skills</li> <li>Experience managing cross-functional teams and track record of operational excellence</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. international Shipments: Perform export compliance reviews and release holds on international outbound shipments, verifying end-use, licensing coverage, and documentation prior to dispatch.</li> anti-bribery and anti-corruption (ABAC) policies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Actively enrolled in an accredited university program in Business Law (LL.B.), description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h1><strong>Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager</strong></h1> <p>At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.</p> <p>As our Retail business continues to grow, we’re looking for a <strong>Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager</strong> to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You’ll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. <strong>This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich .</strong></p> <h2><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></h2> <p>In this role, you’ll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You’ll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt’s selection, coverage and long-term growth.</p> <p>Day-to-day in this role you’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.</li> <li>Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.</li> <li>Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners’ businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.</li> <li>Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt’s long-term business objectives.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.</li> <li>Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.</li> <li>Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.</li> <li>Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.</li> <li>Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our humble expectations</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.</li> <li>You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.</li> <li>You’re an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.</li> <li>You’re comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.</li> <li>You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.</li> <li>You’re highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.</li> <li>You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English. </li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <p>This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt’s Retail growth. You’ll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.</p> <p>You’ll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.</p> <p>You’ll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.</p> <h2><strong>Next steps</strong></h2> <p>If this sounds like an opportunity you’d be excited about, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p>After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. title: Business Development Representative (German speaking)
description: About Wayflyer Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer. Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan. You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney. The challenge We've deployed over $6bn to small businesses that traditional banks were too slow, too rigid, or too disinterested to back. Now we're growing fast, and we need a world-class sales team to continue the momentum, finding the founders who need us before they know we exist. What you'll actually do You'll be the first voice a lot of founders ever hear from Wayflyer. That matters. Your job is to cut through the noise - smart outreach, real conversations, and get the right businesses in front of our Account Executives. You'll qualify funding needs, build genuine rapport with founders, and figure out pretty quickly that the best reps here aren't order-takers. They're curious, they hustle, and they care about getting it right. What this role could turn into We'll be honest -this isn't a role we're hiring you to stay in forever. It's a launchpad. Most BDRs move into Account Executive or Customer Success roles within 12–18 months, and we plan for it actively through our Revenue Academy - a structured programme that builds the skills, deal exposure, and commercial fluency you need before you ever step into your next seat. Your manager isn't just hitting you with pipeline reviews; they're invested in where you want to go and what it takes to get there. We're building careers here, not just filling headcount. The people who thrive with us are the ones who are hungry to grow - and we take it as our responsibility to make sure the path is there when they are. Who thrives here You've worked in a target-driven environment before and you didn't just survive it, you wanted more. You're the kind of person who reads a rejection email and immediately thinks about what to try differently. You spot problems outside your lane and you can't help yourself. You'll probably end up doing things that aren't in this job description. That's not a warning, it's the point. We hire for range We care more about trajectory than tenure. Relevant sales experience is important, but what we're really looking for beyond that is someone who's hungry, commercially sharp, and genuinely excited by the challenge. Fluent English & German is a must. Startup experience is a bonus, not a requirement. Location and working policy 📍 Berlin, hybrid (3-4 days per week in the office) The good stuff 25 days off, plus public holidays. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want. title: wo-stage Economie & Data-analyse: onderzoek naar omzetverwachting
description: wo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Duik jij graag in data om patronen en verbanden te ontdekken? Krijg je energie van statistisch onderzoek en wil je ontdekken wat bedrijfsverwachtingen ons vertellen over de economie? Dit is jouw uitdaging Iedere maand vragen we tussen de 6000 en 7500 bedrijven in Nederland naar hun verwachtingen voor de omzet van hun bedrijf. Bij elkaar verzameld en gemiddeld blijkt dit een goede voorspelling voor de omzetontwikkeling van bedrijfstakken. We willen graag deze link ook op microniveau leggen en inzichtelijk maken voor verschillende doeleinden: Het publiceren van ondersteunende informatie voor gebruikers van onze enquête om deze beter te kunnen interpreteren en gebruiken voor voorspellingen. Het gebruiken van deze informatie om 'verdachte opgaven' in enquêtes later in het proces te ontdekken. Een eerder (kort) onderzoek leverde verwarrende resultaten op waarbij de verbanden tussen verwachting en omzet niet duidelijk te zien waren. We hebben echter de bevestiging dat vergelijkbare onderzoeken in andere landen wel gelukt zijn. Het is dus waarschijnlijk dat we hier nog zaken gemist hebben. Dit is jouw eerste uitdaging! Vervolgens ga je op zoek naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen: Hoe kunnen we deze data zo beschikbaar maken dat externe onderzoekers hier optimaal nut uit kunnen halen? Wat vinden belanghebbende op dit gebied hiervan? Hoe kunnen we intern deze verbanden inzetten om verdachte opgaven in andere enquêtes en bronnen te detecteren? Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Het team Bedrijvenconjunctuur & Coördinatie bestaat uit ongeveer 25 medewerkers. Variërend van zeer ervaren medewerkers tot jonge mensen die nog aan het begin van hun loopbaan staan. We werken met elkaar op een collegiale en professionele manier aan statistieken over het bedrijfsleven die voor beleidmakers en journalisten er echt toe doen! Tijdens je stage heb je ook regelmatig contact en werk je samen met collega’s van de andere teams binnen de sector Bedrijvenstatistieken in Den Haag. Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een wetenschappelijke opleiding met als studierichting economie, bedrijfseconomie, statistiek of dataverwerking. Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met: Statistiek; Python en/of R; Bedrijfseconomische begrippen zoals omzet, bedrijfsgrootte, rechtvorm en indexcijfers. Je bent een enthousiaste en proactieve student die flexibel inspeelt op verschillende situaties. Je bent sociaal, weet tactvol te handelen en werkt graag samen met anderen om tot een goed resultaat te komen. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: jouw onderzoek vaardigheden vergroot; ervaring opdoet met statistische en economische concepten; leert om begrijpelijk te programmeren in R/Python; jouw communicatieve vaardigheden verder ontwikkelt zodat je de uitkomsten van jouw onderzoek optimaal presenteert en de boodschap helder overkomt. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. Dit zijn onze voorwaarden Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken. Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking. title: (Senior) Copywriter
description: At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. Every email, push notification and in-app message we send should feel like it was written for the person reading it, not for us. Right now, nobody owns that. That’s where you come in. As our Copywriter, you will own every message our users get across email, push and in-app, plus the updates they read when something goes wrong. AI will write most of the first drafts. You’ll build the system that writes them, judge what it gets wrong, and add the creative edge AI always misses. Take Ownership 🚀 You’ll own the words our users read every day. Here’s how you’ll do it: Build, maintain and improve AI copywriting agents for email, push and in-app, and feed your edits back in so their output keeps getting better. Turn every draft into copy that starts from the user’s world, not ours (“your rate just jumped to 3.01%” instead of “we increased your rate”), with hooks, subject lines and tone that make people act. title: Thermal Test and Modelling Engineer
description: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life. What is the role: We are seeking a Thermal Engineer to own the thermal analysis and testing of our space products, such as sensors and actuators. The role centers on building thermal models and correlating them with test data, and on planning and running thermal test campaigns in house. It is a hands-on position: you will instrument and run tests yourself and use the results to improve both the design and our test infrastructure. This position is based in our Toulouse office. What you will do: Develop and maintain thermal models (analytical and numerical) of units such as sensors and actuators, from early design trades to flight predictions. Perform thermal analyses (steady-state, transient, worst-case hot and cold) to support design reviews and recommend design changes. Define thermal test campaigns : test plans, predictions, temperature profiles, instrumentation, and pass/fail criteria from requirements and qualification margins. Operate our in-house thermal test facility : run thermal cycling tests, coordinate thermal vacuum (TVAC) campaigns, and own the test reports. Correlate models with test data to refine predictions and margins and feed the results back into the design. Improve our test infrastructure : identify capability gaps, specify and procure equipment, design fixtures and thermal interfaces, and commission new setups. Act as the thermal point of contact for our units toward the spacecraft team: unit thermal budgets, interface boundary conditions, and unit models for the spacecraft thermal model. Support spacecraft Assembly, Integration, and Test (AIT) through system-level thermal balance testing. What you bring to this role: BS + 8 years / MS + 5 years in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Thermal Engineering, or equivalent, with professional experience in thermal engineering of space or electronic hardware. Solid grounding in space heat transfer : radiation in vacuum, conduction and contact conductance across bolted interfaces, and multi-layer insulation (MLI). Hands-on experience building thermal models with standard thermal analysis tools, running worst-case analyses, and correlating models with test data. Hands-on experience planning and running thermal tests (thermal cycling or TVAC) on space or electronic hardware, from test plan to test report. Ability to instrument a test article : thermocouple selection and bonding, heater sizing and placement, thermal interface materials, and data acquisition and real-time monitoring, with ESD-safe, clean handling of sensitive hardware. Excellent teamwork, communication, and documentation skills, with professional proficiency in English ; comfortable in a hands-on, fast-paced startup environment . Bonus points: Experience with Python to post-process test data and automate model correlation. Experience designing or specifying thermal test equipment such as TVAC chambers, thermal plates, or shrouds. Knowledge of spacecraft thermal control hardware : heat pipes, radiators, coatings, and heater circuits. Experience using AI/LLM tools to accelerate development, analysis, and documentation, with sound judgment about their limits. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Soft Skills: Entrepreneurial drive, solution-oriented mindset, high agency and the ability to take direct responsibility in a fast-paced startup environment. Environment: A modern, central workspace in Munich with a collaborative, international culture. Want to shape the future of industrial robotics? We look forward to meeting you! international travel to the EU, USA, Taiwan and China</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A Bachelor or higher degree in STEM, preferably Computer skills</li> <li>Familiar with C, Python and Bash</li> <li>Familiar with linux boot up process</li> <li>Linux kernel, boot and system-level architecture skills</li> <li>Experience of bootloader development, such as u-boot</li> <li>Software development on Arm or non-X86 platforms</li> <li>Linux debugging and resolution abilities</li> <li>Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team</li> <li>Ability to learn fast to work on cutting edge technologies</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience with system firmware, including uboot, UEFI, ACPI, DSDT, boot loaders, device firmware</li> <li>Experience debugging power management on PCI ASPM, SATA ALPM, low power profiles</li> <li>Experience in board design, bring up, and validation</li> <li>Experience with electrical engineering design tools (e.g. schematic capture, layout)</li> <li>Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC-V</li> <li>Familiarity with Ubuntu development model</li> <li>Shell/Python scripting skills</li> <li>Fluency in written and spoken Mandarin Chinese</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. title: Senior Product Manager - ASRS
description: Chez Exotec , nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s. Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française. Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités. La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ? Au sein du département Product Management , vous prenez la responsabilité de la Product Line ASRS — Automated Storage and Retrieval System, le produit phare des systèmes Exotec. L’ASRS regroupe la partie robotique du Skypod System. Cette Product Line constitue un élément central de la proposition de valeur d’Exotec et mobilise environ 100 personnes au sein de la R&D. En tant que Product Director ASRS, vous définissez la vision, la stratégie et les priorités de cette Product Line. Vous donnez une direction claire aux équipes et travaillez au quotidien avec les fonctions R&D, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success et les équipes projet afin de faire évoluer une solution industrielle critique, performante et différenciante. Missions En tant que Product Director ASRS, vos missions consistent à : Définir la vision, la stratégie et le positionnement de la Product Line ASRS, en cohérence avec la stratégie globale d’Exotec Orienter une organisation R&D d’environ 100 personnes autour de priorités produit claires et partagées Définir et piloter la roadmap ASRS, en arbitrant les priorités entre valeur client, performance opérationnelle, différenciation technologique, qualité et capacité de développement Comprendre les enjeux des opérations logistiques et les besoins des clients utilisant le Skypod System Collecter et analyser les besoins du marché, en lien étroit avec les clients, les équipes commerciales, les équipes projet, le marketing et les intégrateurs Identifier les opportunités d’évolution de la robotique Garantir la cohérence fonctionnelle de l'ensemble de nos produits, en particulier aux interfaces Définir les critères de succès des évolutions produit et suivre leur adoption, leur performance et leur impact opérationnel Contribuer au positionnement de l’offre, à la définition de sa proposition de valeur et à son évolution commerciale Préparer et accompagner les lancements de produits et de fonctionnalités sur les différents marchés internationaux Communiquer la vision, les choix et les évolutions du produit auprès des équipes internes, des clients et des partenaires Anticiper les risques, dépendances et contraintes liés à des systèmes industriels complexes, en s'appuyant sur les équipes techniques Structurer les processus de décision produit et favoriser une culture de collaboration, de responsabilisation et d’amélioration continue Profil : Vous êtes diplômé·e d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’une formation équivalente Vous disposez d’ au moins 10 ans d’expérience en Product Management , idéalement dans un environnement industriel, robotique, logiciel ou technologique complexe Vous avez une expérience significative dans la définition d’une vision produit et le pilotage d’une roadmap impliquant plusieurs équipes et parties prenantes Vous avez exercé un leadership reconnu dans des organisations matricielles, en donnant une direction claire à des équipes pluridisciplinaires et en créant l’alignement nécessaire à la réussite d’ambitions produit complexes Vous êtes à l’aise avec les problématiques mêlant hardware, software, robotique, automatisation et systèmes industriels Une expérience dans l’intralogistique, les entrepôts automatisés, les systèmes ASRS, la robotique mobile, le WCS ou le WES constitue un véritable atout Vous savez comprendre des sujets techniques complexes et les traduire en décisions produit claires et créatrices de valeur Vous êtes centré·e sur le client et appréciez le contact direct avec le terrain, les sites title: TYPO3 Developer
description: TYPO3 Developer (Mensch) Andere zählen Schafe. Du zählst TYPO3-Major-Versionen, die du schon migriert hast. Und hast Lust, die Websites großer, internationaler Unternehmen technisch zu verantworten? Zur Übersicht Der ultimative TYPO3-Check Du bist bei uns richtig, wenn du… … bei „Wir brauchen nur ein kleines Feld mehr im Backend“ im Kopf schon TCA, Datenbank-Migration und die drei Fluid-Templates aufklappst , die es wirklich braucht. … für dein wichtigstes Werkzeug hältst. Direkt nach dem Cache-Leeren. … beim Satz „Das ging in TYPO3 v7 aber noch“ freundlich lächelst und den Extension Scanner startest . … sofort merkst, wenn dir die KI eine TypoScript-Lösung aus dem Jahr 2014 andreht. Und sie trotzdem jeden Tag nutzt, weil sie dich schneller macht . … und dein Gewissen dir verbietet, freitags um 16 Uhr ein Major-Update auf Production zu schieben . Auch nicht „nur schnell“. … dann gilt für uns nur noch eins: composer require netfed/du Worum geht es? Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Technik großer Corporate-Websites. Von der Aufwandsschätzung über Konzeption und Neuaufbau bis zu Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates. Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte auf einem sauberen technischen Fundament stehen. Warum diese Rolle bei uns anders ist? Wir arbeiten für namhafte Konzerne und große Mittelständler, bei denen die Website ein strategisches Aushängeschild ist. Du baust hier nicht Website Nummer 47 nach Schema F. Du triffst die technischen Entscheidungen und verantwortest die Architektur. Dabei vertrauen wir voll auf deine Erfahrung. Dazu kommen eine eigene, von uns betriebene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung und eine gelebte DevOps-Kultur, die sich am Stand der Technik orientiert. Und was ist mit KI? Gehört bei uns zum Alltag. Nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Werkzeug. Du arbeitest mit KI als Sparringspartner: beim Refactoring, beim Testen, beim Dokumentieren, beim schnellen Zweitblick auf eine Migration. Die KI schlägt vor, du entscheidest. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden mit echter TYPO3-Erfahrung, der erkennt, wann ein Vorschlag gut ist und wann er Unsinn ist. Was sind deine Aufgaben? Du erstellst die technische Konzeption neu aufzubauender TYPO3-Websites. Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Aspekte großer Kundenprojekte: Aufwandsschätzung, Neuaufbau, Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates. Du setzt KI-Tools im Entwickleralltag ein und bringst unseren KI-Einsatz in der Entwicklung weiter voran. Du dokumentierst so, dass andere weiterarbeiten können. Auch dein zukünftiges Ich. Beratung und Support Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden bei technischen Themen, zum Beispiel bei der Wahl der CMS-Architektur. Du bearbeitest Kunden-Tickets und Support-Anfragen, die unser First-Level-Support nicht direkt lösen kann. Du übersetzt Technik in Kunden-Deutsch und Kundenwünsche in saubere Technik. Was bringst du mit? 4 bis 8 Jahre Erfahrung mit der Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Websites auf Basis von TYPO3. Du kennst dich mit den umgebenden Tools und Technologien aus, zum Beispiel Composer, JSON, JavaScript und XML. Du beherrschst den Umgang mit SQL-Datenbanken, zum Beispiel MariaDB. Du arbeitest mit KI-Coding-Tools und weißt, wo sie helfen und wo nicht. Du arbeitest gern agil mit Jira, Confluence und GitLab. Wäre gut, aber kein Muss Erfahrung mit WordPress. Erfahrung mit Solr oder Elasticsearch. Praxis mit Docker, Kubernetes und DevOps-Methoden. Rahmenbedingungen Werkzeuge: Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Office 365, Docker, Kubernetes Infrastruktur: Eigene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung mit technologischem Freiraum, in der Entwicklung und im Live-Betrieb Starkes Netzwerk: Als Teil der team neusta Gruppe hast du kurze Wege zu über 800 Expert:innen, wenn dein Projekt zusätzliche Spezialpower braucht. Zeitraum: ab sofort Interesse? Wir verzichten auf klassische Anschreiben. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und gerne 2 bis 3 kurze Beispiele aus deinen TYPO3-Projekten: TYPO3-Version, Umfang des Projekts, deine Rolle, größte technische Herausforderung. Und ein Satz dazu, wie du KI beim Entwickeln einsetzt, hilft uns sehr. Teilst du uns dabei auch deinen Gehaltswunsch und deinen frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin mit? Das wäre prima. Nutzen Sie den Button auf dieser Seite für Ihre Bewerbung. Unser Team, deine Vorteile Wir bei NetFed sind davon überzeugt, dass es ein gutes Arbeitsklima und gegenseitige Wertschätzung benötigt, um produktiv arbeiten zu können. Unsere Erfolgsformel für NetFed-Wachstum heißt deshalb: Wir schaffen gemeinsam mit unseren Mitarbeiter:innen ein optimales Arbeitsumfeld, das Spaß und Leidenschaft bei der Arbeit ermöglicht und gleichzeitig genügend Spielraum für das Privatleben lässt. Das sind unsere Vorteile: Fort- und Weiterbildung Family Life Balance Flexible Arbeitszeiten Homeoffice Freiwillige Sozial­leistungen Urban Sports Club Lust auf mehr? Unser Team stellt sich dir gerne persönlich vor. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: IT-Systemadministrator
description: Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes IT-Systemhaus in Chemnitz und betreuen seit 2016 die IT von Geschäftskunden – vom Arbeitsplatz über Microsoft 365 und Server bis zu Netzwerk, Security und Cloud. Wir suchen jemanden für den First und Second Level Support unserer Kunden. Nicht als Dauerposition am unteren Ende einer Support-Pyramide, sondern als Einstieg, aus dem sich in den nächsten Jahren eigene Kunden und eigene Fachthemen entwickeln sollen. Was dieser Job ist, steht unten. Was er nicht ist, auch. Aufgaben Du nimmst Störungen unserer Geschäftskunden an – per Telefon, per Remote-Support und bei Bedarf vor Ort beim Kunden. Du analysierst, priorisierst und löst eigenständig: Arbeitsplätze, Windows Clients und Server, Microsoft 365, Benutzer und Berechtigungen, Netzwerk, Drucker, Software, sonstige Infrastruktur. Du dokumentierst nachvollziehbar im Ticketsystem. Nicht für die Statistik, sondern damit die Kollegin oder der Kollege nach dir nicht bei null anfängt. Du kommunizierst mit Anwendern, die keine IT-Leute sind – verständlich und ohne sie dumm dastehen zu lassen. Wenn du nicht weiterkommst, eskalierst du an unsere Engineers. Aber vollständig: Fehlerbild, deine Analyse, was du schon probiert hast. Wie sich das entwickelt Bei uns ist First Level kein Endzustand. Je sicherer du in einem Thema wirst, desto mehr davon bekommst du. Konkret heißt das: zuerst einzelne Second-Level-Themen, dann Verantwortung für feste Kunden, dann ein eigener technischer Schwerpunkt – zum Beispiel Netzwerk, Microsoft 365, Server, Firewall oder Cloud. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einer Beförderungsstufe im Organigramm. Wer zuverlässig arbeitet, bekommt bei uns mehr Entscheidungsspielraum, nicht mehr Kontrolle. Welche Weiterbildung du machst, besprechen wir nach Bedarf und Interesse, nicht nach Katalog. Qualifikation Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, z. B. als Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration – oder vergleichbare praktische Berufserfahrung. Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft-Umgebungen: Windows Clients und Server, Microsoft 365. Ein solides Grundverständnis von Netzwerken: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, VPN. Eine strukturierte Fehleranalyse. Du rätst nicht, du grenzt ein. Führerschein Klasse B für Kundeneinsätze. Von Vorteil, aber keine Bedingung: Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen, Remote-Support und Benutzer- und Rechteverwaltung; Kenntnisse in Firewall, Virtualisierung, Backup, Monitoring oder Cloud. Was wir ausdrücklich nicht voraussetzen: Eine lange Liste an Zertifikaten. Uns interessiert, ob du ein Problem sauber eingrenzen kannst und ob du sagst, wenn du etwas nicht weißt. Beides lässt sich in einem Gespräch schneller klären als über Kürzel im Lebenslauf. Benefits Entwicklung statt Stillstand: Mit wachsender Kompetenz übernimmst du anspruchsvollere Aufgaben, eigene Kunden und einen eigenen technischen Schwerpunkt. Entscheidungen ohne Umweg: Wenn du etwas verändern willst, sprichst du direkt mit der Geschäftsführung. Nicht mit drei Instanzen dazwischen. Weiterbildung nach deinem Bedarf: individuell abgestimmt, nicht als Pflichtprogramm. Firmenwagen oder JobRad nach Vereinbarung. Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung. Individuelle Situationen regeln wir individuell, nicht nach Schema F. Unterschiedliche Kunden und IT-Umgebungen statt einer einzigen Infrastruktur, die du nach zwei Jahren auswendig kennst. title: Senior Platform & Security Engineer – Cloud, DevSecOps & AI Agents
description: 🏢 About 21bitcoin We are 21bitcoin. We believe in a future where Bitcoin is a natural part of everyone's life – simple, secure, and easy to understand. We're looking for people who want to help build a real mission – not just do a job. With us, you'll take on responsibility early, work with a highly motivated international team and actively shape the future of money. 👋 The role As a Senior Platform & Security Engineer , you are the hands-on solution architect for our cloud platform, our security, and our AI agent infrastructure. You work within the Platform & Security team and support the Backend team in our AWS environment. The role combines DevOps, Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, and Security Engineering. You design solutions, build them yourself, and run them in production. You also bring practical AI experience and help us build and operate AI agents in a regulated environment. Moreover, you provide guidance to engineers on other teams when it comes to infrastructure and security. Tasks 🚀 Your mission You build the foundation our product and our engineers rely on every day. This is what you own, and what good looks like: A platform teams can rely on: You architect and run our AWS infrastructure as code, with CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows that let teams ship faster and with greater confidence. Security by default: You secure our AWS environment across all accounts and build security checks into our pipelines, so engineers ship securely without manual gatekeeping. Findings are fixed on time. Detection and response that works: You build monitoring and alerting where every alert is worth acting on, and you lead security incident response from investigation to post-mortem. AI agents in production: We are moving to agentic coding, and you build the infrastructure for it, for example dedicated, secure environments in which agents can act. You also design, deploy, and operate AI agents that take over repetitive platform and security work in a controlled, auditable way. Architecture and guidance: You turn product and engineering requirements into clear designs and guide other teams through implementation. 🌱 Your first months Your impact starts on day one. You dive straight into our AWS platform and ship your first changes to production within weeks, not months. From there, core parts of our infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security, and AI agents become yours: you set the direction, make the calls, and watch your work run in production. You do none of this alone: together with the team, you drive the work that makes our platform and IT secure and puts AI agents into production. You challenge each other's ideas, share what you learn, and get further together than any of you would alone. We are looking for self-driven engineers who would rather shape a platform than work through a task list. If that is you, you will find the room, the trust, and the responsibility to do it here. Requirements 🛠️ Your toolbox These are examples of the technologies we work with, not a complete list. Cloud & infrastructure: AWS in a multi-account setup, with serverless and container workloads and networking (VPC, AWS Network Firewall) Infrastructure as Code: for example CDK, OpenTofu, and Terraform, run on a platform such as env0, Scalr, or Terraform Cloud CI/CD & containers: for example GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or CircleCI, with GitOps and Docker Observability & incident management: monitoring, alerting, and on-call, for example with Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic, and PagerDuty, Rootly, or incident.io Security: code and pipeline scanning with tools such as Snyk, Semgrep, or Aikido (SAST, DAST, dependency, container and secrets scanning, IaC security), plus AWS security services such as Amazon Inspector and AWS Security Hub Identity & access: central identity management and zero-trust network access AI & agents: agent platforms such as Amazon Bedrock (AgentCore) or the Claude platform Languages: Python, Node.js (TypeScript), Terraform ⭐ What you bring We are looking for a high performer with an engineering mindset. You think in systems, automate what repeats, and build for where our platform needs to be next year, not only for today's ticket. Senior and hands-on: 5+ years in software engineering and DevOps, Platform, DevSecOps, or Security Engineering. You have designed cloud, platform, and security solutions end to end and can explain the trade-offs. You code (must-have): Python, Node.js, and Terraform, at a level where you direct agentic coding tools, review their output critically, and own the result. AWS in depth: Multi-account setups with AWS Organizations and Control Tower, containers and serverless, VPC security design, AWS Network Firewall, AWS Security Hub, and Amazon Inspector, all managed as code with tools such as CDK, OpenTofu, or Terraform. Security in the pipeline and in production: You have built CI/CD pipelines with integrated security scanning (tools such as Snyk, Semgrep, or Aikido), operated security controls with logging, monitoring, and alerting, and handled security incidents end to end. You are comfortable being on call. AI in practice: You have applied AI in engineering work and know how to run it responsibly in production. Ideally, you have already built on agent platforms and frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock (AgentCore) or the Claude platform. Ownership and teamwork: You take responsibility for outcomes, explain technical topics clearly to any audience, and treat security as a partnership with engineering, not a gate. A plus: workflow orchestration with Temporal, Restate, or Inngest, and production experience with a Terraform platform such as env0, Scalr, or Terraform Cloud, as well as GitLab and JumpCloud. Benefits 💡 Why join 21bitcoin Hybrid work: Work flexibly and meet the team in person at our hubs in Vienna, Salzburg, or Munich a few times per month. Top tech stack: Work with a modern, cloud-native stack across AWS, Infrastructure as Code, observability, security tooling, and AI agents. Learn and improve: Grow across platform, security, architecture, and AI, with real problems to solve and room to develop your skills. Impact across the stack: Your work shapes the platform, the security posture, and the systems that power the product. Ownership and responsibility: Take full ownership of critical systems in a fast-paced, regulated environment. Collaborative team: Join a highly skilled team where collaboration and shared ownership are part of everyday work. Shape the future: Be part of a mission-driven company building Bitcoin financial services and setting new technical standards. 💶 Salary Salary range: €75,000 – €120,000 gross per year. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, previous experience, and location. 📝 How to apply Please reach out and include a bit about yourself, your resume or CV, examples of past projects, and a few bullet points on why you want to join 21bitcoin and what you expect. CVs are important, but don't forget to include your favorite Bitcoin meme in your application. 🤝 Interview process Exploratory call: In a 30-minute call, we discuss what excites you about this role and ask a few questions based on your past experience. Engineering deep dive: We discuss the specific skills for the role in a 1.5-hour whiteboard session. Culture and engineering mindset: We get to know each other and talk about how you work, take ownership, and make engineering decisions. Decision time. 📍 This is a hybrid role . You are based in or near Vienna, Salzburg, or Munich and join us at our hubs a few times per month. Applications are limited to candidates currently residing in the European Economic Area (EEA). Prendre part à la préparation et à l’expédition des commandes (emballage, envoi postal). As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>At Anduril we are developing multi-domain unmanned systems that will leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of integrated multi-mission capability to our customers.
