title: Senior Manager, Fraud Analytics, OM, UK/EU
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3>ABOUT THE TEAM: </h3> <p>At Tide, we are building a finance & admin platform designed to save small businesses time and money. We provide our members with business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of connected administrative solutions from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Launched in 2017, Tide is now the leading business financial platform in the UK with 575,000 SME members (10% market share) and more than 250,000 SMEs in India. Headquartered in London, Tide has over 1,800 Tideans across the UK, Bulgaria, India, Serbia, Romania, Ukraine and Germany. </p> <p>Tide is rapidly growing, expanding into new markets and always looking for passionate and driven people. Join us in our mission to empower small businesses and help them save time and money.</p> <h3>ABOUT THE ROLE: </h3> <p>Exciting opportunity for an experienced leader to work in our Ongoing Monitoring team. As a member of the team, we're looking for someone who is passionate about customer experience and fighting financial crime and wants to help drive our business forward as we continue to grow and expand in new markets. <br><br>Ongoing Monitoring sits in our first line of defence (1LOD) operations’ department, responsible for monitoring the activity of our SME customers (‘members’) for the purpose of preventing, detecting and reporting sanctions, money laundering, terrorism financing, tax evasion, bribery and corruption, money mules and fraud. </p> <p>It's an opportunity to work with an amazing team across multiple geographies, including analysts, team leaders, product and engineering managers, data scientists and operations managers. The role has exposure to many senior stakeholders across the business and is at the heart of what we do to protect our customers. </p> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: </h3> <ul> <li>Work in a collaborative and cross-functional way to identify, quantify and own complex data driven business decisions to reduce our exposure to fraud</li> <li>As part of the Fraud Analytics programme, use data to balance fraud losses, user friction and regulatory obligations</li> <li>Work collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders across the entire business to prioritise and translate compliance and business requirements into innovative solutions</li> <li>Identify improvement opportunities to current business processes, create and contribute to the Fraud analytics roadmap</li> <li>Build relationships with leadership and articulate the Fraud Analytics strategy to the business in a structured, data-driven manner - simplifying complex concepts for non-technical audiences</li> <li>Build and lead the day-to-day analytics processes, ensuring Fraud risks are mitigated in an efficient manner and are meeting KPIs</li> <li>7+ years experience in analytics - financial crime experience preferred</li> <li>Strong SQL, excel and visualisation skills (python as well would be preferable) and able to handle complex data structures from multiple sources</li> <li>Experience in rule building, back testing and optimisation</li> <li>Experience of Fraud compliance and regulation</li> <li>Excited about working in a fast-changing environment and have the ability to adapt to the business challenges in front of you</li> <li>Communicating clearly with other parts of the business, explaining financial crime, our processes whilst also managing expectations.</li> <li>Experience building, reviewing, documenting and optimising business processes, isn’t a must have but would be advantageous</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: </h3> <p>Make work, work for you! We are embracing new ways of working and support flexible working arrangements. With our new Hybrid working model & Working Out of Office (WOO) policy our colleagues can work remotely from home or anywhere in their home country. Additionally, you can work from a different country for 90 days of the year. Plus, you’ll get:</p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary </li> <li>Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing</li> <li>Hundreds of perks and discounts through Vitality Health Insurance (fitness watches, Waitrose cashback, gym membership etc.)</li> <li>24/7 Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days</li> <li>Professional L&D budget per year</li> <li>Referral bonus when you bring your friends to join Tide </li> <li>Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution</li> <li>Spacious brand new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar</li> <li>Enhanced family-friendly leave</li> <li>24 hours paid volunteering time off per year</li> <li>Flexible work from home or at the office arrangements</li> <li>Monthly team socials (we’ve had themed bingo, online cocktail making sessions, wellbeing challenges and themed virtual pub quizzes)</li> <li>Sabbatical leave </li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. </p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.</p> <h3> </h3><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. </p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.</em></p> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Disclaimer</strong></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><em>It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij: · Salaris : We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis; · Middelen : Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon; · Werkdagen : Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur; · Vergoeding voor thuiswerken : Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten; · Workation : Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken; · Leuke teamactiviteiten : Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night; · Vakantiedagen : Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen; · Groei en ontwikkelin g: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS; · Vakantiegeld : Jaarlijks 8,33%; · Voordelen : Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. title: HR Operations Specialist, Tokyo (12-months contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Tokyo, Japan</strong></p> <p><strong>What You Would Do Here:</strong></p> <p>Our focus is getting the best people to work at Cloudflare and then allowing them to do their best work. We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented People Operations Specialist to join our team and champion this mission within the APJC region. In this vital role, you will be the first point of contact for our employees, ensuring their journey is smooth and positive. You will be instrumental in creating a seamless experience by resolving inquiries, managing data with precision, and ensuring our People processes are efficient and effective. This is an exciting opportunity to provide exceptional support to our internal teams and contribute to building a world-class employee experience as our organization expands.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Champion key employee lifecycle process:</strong> Take ownership of end-to-end employee lifecycle processes across APJC, including onboarding, internal transfers, organizational changes, and offboarding, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and positive experience for employees throughout the APJC region.</li> <li><strong>Be a subject-matter expert for employee inquiries:</strong> Provide timely, high-quality support to employee inquiries through Zendesk. Act as a trusted liaison between employees and People/Payroll teams, resolving issues efficiently with empathy and accuracy.</li> <li><strong>Elevate the employee experience through cross-functional collaboration:</strong> Act as a proactive liaison between employees and specialized teams such as Payroll, Benefits, and Legal to address and resolve complex issues efficiently and effectively.</li> <li><strong>Ensure data integrity and governance: </strong>Maintain and update employee records across People/Payroll systems, performing regular and ad hoc audits to guarantee 100% data accuracy and compliance with regulatory requirements.</li> <li><strong>Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence:</strong> Analyze employee feedback and process metrics to identify opportunities for process enhancements. Partner with regional teams to implement scalable solutions that improve the overall People Operations function across APJC.</li> <li><strong>Support strategic HR initiatives and projects:</strong> Contribute to HR system implementations, vendor management, and regional programs such as annual performance and compensation cycles, benefits enrollment, and year-end Payroll preparation, making them easy to understand and navigate for our employees.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills/experience</strong> </p> <ul> <li>2+ years in HR administration and comfortable handling sensitive employee information with discretion.</li> <li>Highly organized with strong attention to detail, excellent problem-solving abilities, and effective time management skills. </li> <li>Proficient in working with data and skilled in Excel or Google Sheets for analysis and reporting.</li> <li>Customer-focused mindset with a genuine passion for supporting colleagues and delivering exceptional service.</li> <li>Effective communicator, able to clearly articulate information both verbally and in writing to employees across the APJC region.</li> <li>Adaptable and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with the ability to manage shifting priorities efficiently.</li> <li>Familiarity with Workday or Zendesk would be an advantage.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Kafka or Redpanda and event-streaming infrastructure. RabbitMQ , particularly quorum-based configurations. Redis and distributed caching. Bare-metal infrastructure and data-center environments. Observability and monitoring of stateful systems. Capacity planning, performance analysis and load testing. You are comfortable taking responsibility. You don't need to be a manager to have an impact or take the lead on a technical problem. Why join us Own critical infrastructure: your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of Diabolocom’s platform. Solve complex technical challenges: work with large-scale databases and stateful services, including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, Redis and RabbitMQ. title: Software Engineer, Simulation (Digital Twins)
description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill. You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator. What You'll Work On Map to twin: a pipeline from our lidar maps to simulation-ready digital twins: geometry, semantics, materials, sensors. Training environments: RL environments for learned skills such as multi-robot patrol and search, randomised so nothing overfits one site. Rare events: generate the scenarios real sites rarely produce: intrusions, sabotage, weather, sensor failures. Sensor simulation: RGB, thermal and lidar realistic enough that what is learned in the twin holds on the robot. Sim-to-real: measure the gap on real deployments and close it. Scale: many parallel environments on GPUs, fast enough that a new skill trains in hours. Who We're Looking For A simulation engineer who treats the simulator as production infrastructure and measures success by what transfers to real robots. Your Background 3+ years building robotics simulation or RL training environments. Hands-on with Isaac Sim or Isaac Lab; MuJoCo or Gazebo also considered. Strong Python; C++ a plus. 3D data: point clouds, meshes, scene formats such as USD. GPU-parallel simulation and reinforcement learning workflows. Nice to Have Legged robots. Photogrammetry, Gaussian splatting or other scene reconstruction. ROS 2. Thermal or lidar sensor modelling. What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships. Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data. Experience with anomaly or novelty detection where positives are rare. Strong PyTorch and the engineering to run your own experiments at scale. Nice to Have Scene graphs, multi-object tracking or trajectory forecasting. Bayesian or probabilistic deep learning. Robotics or embodied AI. Simulation for data generation. Our data, compute and production infrastructure let you test ideas quickly, understand where they fail and decide what to investigate next.</p> <p>Our researchers believe in academic discourse and invite fellow researchers, traders and engineers to challenge each hypothesis. title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description: <p>At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?</p> <p>As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.</p> <p>This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.</p> <p>Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.</p> <h2>What You'll Work On</h2> <p>You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:</p> <ul> <li>Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events</li> <li>Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them</li> <li>Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading</li> <li>Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise</li> <li>Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible</li> <li>Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales</li> <li>Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models</li> <li>Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper</li> <li>Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems</li> <li>Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge</li> </ul> <p>No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.</p> <h2>What Success Looks Like</h2> <p>Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.</p> <h2>Who We're Looking For</h2> <p>We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.</p> <ul> <li>Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning</li> <li>No active backlogs</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++</li> <li>Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects</li> <li>Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking</li> <li>A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly</li> </ul> <p>Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.</p> <h2>Our Culture</h2> <p>More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.</p> <p>At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.</p> <p>Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.</p> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. <p>Canonical’s Partner Engineering Team is looking for open-source enthusiasts to work across the full Linux stack to ensure new silicon technologies, such as new hardware accelerators, AI stacks, confidential computing, networking, virtualization, and containerization stacks, are optimized for new silicons. </p> <p>Partner Engineering works closely with worldwide silicon companies to optimize Ubuntu for their new silicon, from x86, ARM, RISC-V, PowerPC and s390x architectures.  </p> <p>Location: This is a Globally remote role</p> <h2>The role entails</h2> <ul> <li>Collaborating proactively within a distributed team</li> <li>Fostering a software ecosystem with seamless user experience for all Ubuntu users</li> <li>Evaluating contributions of other engineers to maintain high-quality software standards.</li> <li>Playing a role in shaping the future of Ubuntu via both - new ideas in your areas of interest and advising on work being done elsewhere</li> <li>Collaborating with other teams in the Ubuntu and Debian communities, with upstream projects, and commercially supported customers</li> <li>Debugging issues on open source code and team maintained code.</li> <li>Helping our our customers to integrate their apps, SDKs, build OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server</li> <li>Working with a team to maintain Ubuntu, silicon features, and silicon-optimized packages across platforms and technologies such as:</li> <ul> <li>Servers, HPC and AI systems, IoT devices, PCs, SmartNICs and automotive systems</li> <li>AI stacks</li> <li>Graphics, audio and multimedia stacks</li> <li>Virtualisation and Containers</li> <li>Hardware enablement stacks</li> <li>New architectures, architecture variants and optimized toolchains </li> <li>Package management and dependencies</li> <li>Platform security (secure boot, FDE, Ubuntu Core, Confidential Computing)</li> </ul> <li>Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal events</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for in you</h2> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path</li> <li>You love technology and working with brilliant people</li> <li>You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable</li> <li>You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated</li> <li>You value building partnerships with a diverse set of internal and external groups</li> <li>Strong fundamentals in C, C++ and Python</li> <li>Experience or interest in learning Linux distribution packaging </li> <li>Experience or Interest in open source maintenance or contribution and licenses</li> <li>Fundamental understanding of package management and dependency resolution</li> </ul> <h2>Additional skills that you might also bring</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with one or more of the following:</li> <ul> <li>Graphics, audio, or multimedia stacks</li> <li>Virtualization and containers (Docker, OCI, Kubernetes)</li> <li>Hardware enablement for platforms and devices, including SmartNICs, NVMe storage, GPUs, audio components, and sensors</li> <li>Performance optimization</li> <li>Toolchain development and maintenance</li> <li>Networking protocols and technologies (TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST)</li> <li>Security best practices</li> <li>IoT and embedded systems, including board-level hardware, SoCs, BMCs, bootloaders, firmware, operating systems, applications, and services</li> </ul> </ul> <h2>What we offer colleagues</h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. </p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

title: Senior Director EMEA South
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2>What You’ll Do:</h2> <p>The Southern Europe Sales organization is responsible for establishing CoreWeave as the preferred AI cloud platform for enterprises, AI labs, digital-native companies, and emerging AI builders across France, Italy, Iberia, and the wider Mediterranean region. The team creates new markets, develops strategic customer relationships, and helps customers use CoreWeave’s infrastructure and software platform to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of AI.</p> <p><strong>About the role: </strong>The Senior Director of Sales, Southern Europe reports to the VP and Managing Director of EMEA. As the senior sales leader for the region, you will own CoreWeave’s commercial strategy and execution across all customer segments, with responsibility for both new-logo acquisition and the growth of existing customers. You will inherit an established customer base and a team spanning Account Executives, Account Managers, and Account Solutions Architects, while carrying a significant mandate to design and build the broader regional coverage model. This is a hands-on, first-on-the-ground leadership role for someone who can build the business, recruit and develop exceptional talent, and support market growth in coordination with EMEA leadership, and personally lead the region’s most strategic customer opportunities.</p> <ul> <li>Own the Southern Europe business, including regional strategy, revenue performance, consumption growth, pipeline creation, customer acquisition, retention, and expansion.</li> <li>Develop and execute a multi-year market-capture plan across France, Italy, Iberia, and the wider Mediterranean region, aligned to CoreWeave’s EMEA and global priorities.</li> <li>Design the regional segmentation, territory, account, and coverage model across Enterprise, AI Labs, Digital Natives, and Startup customers.</li> <li>Build and scale the regional sales organization, recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing leaders and individual contributors as the business grows.</li> <li>Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives and Account Managers, establishing clear expectations, strong inspection disciplines, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Partner closely with Account Solutions Architects to connect customer business objectives with CoreWeave’s infrastructure, platform, and developer capabilities.</li> <li>Personally develop relationships with senior executives, founders, technical leaders, and strategic stakeholders across the region.</li> <li>Lead from the front on the region’s most strategic opportunities, remaining actively involved from initial engagement through solution development, commercial negotiation, and closure, with final contracting execution by EMEA/HQ.</li> <li>Own the acquisition of new strategic customers while developing account strategies that increase adoption, consumption, retention, and long-term customer value across the existing customer base.</li> <li>Build a high-quality, appropriately covered pipeline and establish a consistent operating cadence for opportunity inspection, account planning, forecasting, risk management, and corrective action.</li> <li>Deliver accurate and transparent forecasts, with clear visibility into customer demand, consumption, commercial risk, capacity requirements, and execution dependencies.</li> <li>Develop and close, subject to HQ review and execution, complex, high-value, multi-year commercial agreements, including strategic capacity commitments and enterprise-wide platform relationships.</li> <li>Drive adoption of CoreWeave’s broader platform and software capabilities, ensuring customers see CoreWeave as a strategic technology partner rather than solely an infrastructure provider.</li> <li>Partner across Field Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Capacity, Product, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and executive leadership to deliver coordinated customer outcomes.</li> <li>Support CoreWeave’s partner, venture capital, startup ecosystem, sovereign AI, and government-relations strategies across the region.</li> <li>Represent regional customer requirements and market dynamics within CoreWeave, ensuring that global product, capacity, investment, and go-to-market decisions reflect the opportunities and needs of Southern Europe.</li> <li>Establish CoreWeave’s reputation in the region through active participation in the AI, technology, business, research, and investment communities.</li> <li>Build a regional culture that reflects CoreWeave’s values, rewards ownership, develops talent, encourages collaboration, and delivers best-in-class customer experiences.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are:</h2> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, including significant experience selling cloud infrastructure, AI platforms, data platforms, enterprise software, or similarly complex technology solutions.</li> <li>8+ years of sales leadership experience, including responsibility for senior sellers, managers, or multi-country commercial teams.</li> <li>Demonstrated success building or materially scaling a country, regional, or multi-market sales organization.</li> <li>A consistent record of meeting or exceeding significant revenue, bookings, consumption, pipeline, and customer-growth objectives.</li> <li>Experience leading both new-logo acquisition and the expansion of complex, strategic customer relationships.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to develop and close high-value, multi-year agreements involving senior executives, technical stakeholders, procurement teams, legal teams, and other complex buying groups.</li> <li>Experience selling into multiple customer segments, ideally including large enterprises, high-growth technology companies, AI-native businesses, research organizations, and startups.</li> <li>Experience designing segmentation, account allocation, territory, coverage, hiring, and resource-investment models.</li> <li>Strong command of enterprise sales methodologies, account planning, opportunity management, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and performance management.</li> <li>Proven ability to recruit, coach, and develop high-performing sales talent, including leaders and senior individual contributors.</li> <li>The ability to engage credibly with both commercial and deeply technical audiences, translating customer objectives into infrastructure and platform strategies.</li> <li>Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience structuring complex agreements and balancing customer requirements with capacity, risk, margin, and long-term strategic value.</li> <li>A hands-on leadership style and willingness to remain personally involved in strategic selling, executive engagement, and critical negotiations.</li> <li>Proven ability to operate effectively within a fast-growing, globally matrixed organization and align regional execution with global priorities.</li> <li>Fluent English and French language skills.</li> <li>The ability to travel frequently across the region and internationally as required.</li> </ul> <h2>Preferred:</h2> <ul> <li>Leadership experience within an AI cloud, hyperscale cloud, infrastructure, enterprise platform, or consumption-based technology company.</li> <li>Experience building a new region or significantly expanding an early-stage market presence.</li> <li>Experience selling GPU infrastructure, accelerated computing, machine learning platforms, developer tools, or large-scale data and AI solutions.</li> <li>Experience managing commercial opportunities where customer commitments depend on capacity availability, infrastructure deployment, supply, or service readiness.</li> <li>Experience engaging with founders, research organizations, venture capital firms, sovereign entities, or national AI initiatives.</li> <li>Spanish or Italian language skills.</li> <li>An established executive and technology network across Southern Europe.</li> <li>A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <h2>Wondering if you’re a good fit?</h2> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.</p> <ul> <li>You are a builder who is energized by the opportunity to create a market, design an organization, and turn an ambitious regional strategy into a scaled business.</li> <li>You lead from the front, combining executive presence and strategic thinking with a willingness to engage deeply in customers, opportunities, and execution.</li> <li>You create clarity and accountability while giving talented people the trust, coaching, and support required to perform at their best.</li> <li>You are comfortable making decisions in an environment where demand, customer requirements, capacity, and priorities are evolving rapidly.</li> <li>You build durable customer relationships by combining commercial ambition with technical curiosity, transparency, and consistent follow-through.</li> <li>You think beyond an individual transaction and seek to establish CoreWeave as a long-term strategic partner to the customers and markets you serve.Why CoreWeave?</li> </ul> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be Curious at Your Core</li> <li>Act Like an Owner</li> <li>Empower Employees</li> <li>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</li> <li>Achieve More Together</li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. description: <div class="content-intro"><p> </p> <p><strong>Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. </strong>​</p> <p>For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  </p></div><p></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Position Summary</strong></p> <p>The Supply Chain Planner – Customer Engagement & Engineering serves as the key link between customers, engineering teams, operations, and supply chain functions to ensure material availability, demand fulfillment, and customer satisfaction. This role is responsible for demand planning, inventory optimization, supply risk management, and customer engagement activities while collaborating closely with engineering teams on product changes, new product introductions (NPI), and technical supply chain requirements.</p> <p>The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills, customer-focused communication, and technical understanding to drive supply chain performance and enhance the overall customer experience.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Supply Chain Planning & Inventory Management</strong></p> <ul> optimize stock availability while minimizing excess inventory.</li> <li>Coordinate with procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and suppliers to ensure uninterrupted material flow.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Customer Engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary contact for assigned customers and manage escalations effectively to drive customer satisfaction through proactive engagement and communication.</li> <li>Conduct regular customer reviews to understand demand trends, forecast changes, and business requirements while communicating order status, material constraints, lead times, and recovery plans.</li> <li>Support strategic customer programs and long-term planning activities.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Engineering Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> Engineering Change Order (ECO) implementation.</li> <li>Evaluate supply chain impacts of design changes and recommend mitigation strategies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data Analysis & Reporting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop forecasting and demand analysis reports.</li> <li>Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as:</li> <li>Identify trends and recommend corrective actions to improve supply chain efficiency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or related field.</li> <li>5+ years of experience in supply chain planning, customer service, operations, or engineering support.</li> <li>Experience working in a customer-facing or cross-functional planning role.</li> <li>Strong understanding of inventory management, demand planning, and supply chain processes.</li> <li>Proficiency in ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics.</li> <li>Advanced Microsoft Excel and data analysis skills.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities.</li> <li>Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>APICS/ASCM CPIM, CSCP, or similar certification.</li> <li>Experience in semiconductor, industrial equipment, manufacturing, tools.</li> <li>Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Apply today to be part of title: Supply Data Analyst
description: Location: Any MSF office* Contract: 100% Duration: 12 months Starting date: 04th of January 2027 Deadline to apply: 01st of December 2026 Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract *By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that. At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics. MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour. We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process. MSF International Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested. I. CONTEXT MSF consists of 6 Operational Centres (OCs) and 3 European Supply Centres (ESCs). In the supply domain there is a joint Supply Tansformational Topics Roadmap composed by several inter-OC and inter-ESC projects, and their number is growing due to the need to increase cooperation between MSF entities while improving the quality of MSF's supply chain. The capacity to measure performance and analyse data across different entities is therefore essential and is contributing to MSF ambitions on interoperability and climate. The role of the International Office is to foster cooperation and coordination between MSF entities. The Supply Data Analyst will therefore act as a facilitator between the OCs and ESCs: bringing their representatives together, helping them build shared approaches on supply data and performance, and turning these agreements into concrete deliverables. The Global Supply Data & Analytics (GSDA) team (previously SCPM) has been actively working to build the analytical and data foundations needed to support a global approach to supply chain performance management, and to contribute to the governance of supply data across entities. The team is led by the Supply Chain Analytics Manager and includes one Data Analysts and one data governance specialist; the Supply Data Analyst will join it as an additional analyst. Reporting hierarchically and functionally to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager, the Supply Data Analyst will: collaborate closely with the supply chain professionals responsible for BI and performance management within the 6 OCs and 3 ESCs; work in close link with the ShARP (Shared Analytics and Reporting Project) team in SITS (Shared IT Services); on the existing UniField intersection reports; work alongside the GSDA team and the IO Supply team on projects related to supply chain data analytics; and interact with stakeholders across MSF, including finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics and operations teams. II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB The Supply Data Analyst supports supply chain performance analysis and decision making across MSF by delivering reliable data, KPIs, reports and actionable recommendations. The position also fosters cooperation between the OCs and ESCs around shared supply data, turning agreements into concrete deliverables. Within GSDA, the Supply Data Analyst will support the growing need for data management, reporting and analytics from the supply chain teams, including the monitoring of KPIs and the analysis of data coming from MSF information systems (such as UniField, Isystock or Akiba). III. ACCOUNTABILITIES The Supply Data Analyst is accountable for the following expected results and the activities deployed to achieve them. 1. UniField intersection reports are reliable, relevant and meet the needs of the OCs a. Take over the existing UniField intersection reports in close link with the ShARP team and improve them (reliability, relevance, usability) based on users' feedback and identified gaps b. Collect the reporting needs of each OC and consolidate them into a clear, prioritised set of requirements c. Design and deliver new intersection reports in coordination with the ShARP team, with validation from the OC representatives 2. Supply data is available and of reliable quality for analysis a. Extract, clean and consolidate supply data from UniField and other information systems b. Check data consistency and quality, and report anomalies to the relevant teams c. Document data sources, definitions and calculation methods 3. KPIs and reporting solutions support decision making a. Calculate and update a set of KPIs on a regular basis, in coordination with the teams concerned b. Build and maintain ad hoc data reporting solutions (Power BI) providing visuals that accurately summarise supply chain activities while providing actionable insights c. Support the teams in the definition of additional KPIs as needs arise 4. Stakeholders receive relevant data analysis and actionable recommendations a. Support stakeholders on supply data analysis b. Respond to ad hoc data and analysis requests using supply data from different stakeholders (supply, finance, medical…) c. Present analysis results and recommendations in a clear way to non-technical audiences 5. Cooperation between the OCs and ESCs on supply data produces concrete deliverables a. Convene and facilitate working groups and meetings with representatives of each OC and ESC, from preparation (agenda, pre-alignment of positions) to follow-up (minutes, actions, deadlines) b. Lead discussions between entities with different needs and practices, and build compromises and consensus on shared definitions, KPIs and ways of working c. Turn agreements into concrete deliverables (e.g., shared KPI definitions, dashboards, documentation) and follow their delivery 6. Data-related tools and processes improve continuously and stakeholders are kept informed a. Contribute to the improvement of data-related tools and processes within the team b. Proactively identify data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and propose solutions autonomously c. Manage stakeholders and expectations: identify their needs, keep them informed, and escalate blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY Challenges and decisions that the job faces to achieve the accountabilities: Autonomy to think and act: works with limited supervision; takes initiative, prioritises and drives work to completion, proactively identifies data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and escalates blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed. Complexity of the environment: works across 6 OCs and 3 ESCs with different needs, practices and information systems (UniField, Isystock, Akiba); builds compromises on shared definitions and KPIs, handles multiple priorities at once, and interacts with technical and non-technical stakeholders (finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics, operations) in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others. Education Bachelor's level or above in data analytics, statistics, business management, supply chain or a related field, or a combination of relevant education and professional experience (essential) Experience Minimum of 2 years of experience as Data Analyst (essential) Direct work experience involving significant data management (essential) Experience in facilitating meetings or working groups involving multiple stakeholders and in delivering concrete outputs from them (essential) Supply chain, logistics and Finance experience in NGO's operational settings (desirable) Previous work experience with UniField, MSF's main ERP software (desirable) Skills Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills: ability to bring together representatives of different entities, lead effective meetings, negotiate compromises and deliver concrete outcomes Strong analytical skills Good organisational skills, ability to handle multiple priorities at one time Autonomous and proactive: ability to take initiative, prioritise and drive work to completion with limited supervision Good level skills in Excel, Power BI and database management Ability to work in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment Drive for change, improvement and innovation Languages Fluent spoken and written English (essential) Good command of French (strongly desirable) Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding and acceptance of these recruitment procedures. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Chief Business Officer (gn) @ Clean Data Centres Venture, France (hybrid)
description: This is an Atlantic porfolio company. The opportunity Demand for AI compute is outrunning the infrastructure to deliver it, and the environmental bill is growing with it: more fossil power, more freshwater, more land. New capacity on land also means waiting years for power, sites and permits. We take a different route: we bring compute to the power. Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on land, and no grid will ever reach it. Using it lets AI scale without adding carbon or competing with communities and nature for water and land. We're building fleets of autonomous ships that turn that wind into AI compute at sea. Each ship carries its own wind turbines and computing on board, and navigates on its own across the open ocean, following the strongest and steadiest winds. No mooring, no cables to shore: the fleet goes where the energy is. It's AI infrastructure built from the ground up for the open ocean, from power systems and autonomy to high-density computing, engineered to run in one of the harshest environments on Earth. No grid queue. No freshwater. No land. Zero-carbon compute that scales with the fleet. Firm, low-carbon power at a target cost of ~€50/MWh, one of the biggest costs in running AI compute 70%+ capacity factor: offshore wind that behaves like baseload First demonstrator at sea in late 2027 Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs and industrial leaders. Backed by major international investors. The mandate You'll work directly with the CEO and the board and own the company's business strategy as we go from first demonstrator to fleet. Our platform opens several paths to value across compute and infrastructure, from capacity to hardware to the services around them. You'll decide which to pursue first, build them into the core of the company, and open new ones as the fleet grows. What you'll own Business model & strategy. Shape the business model and evolve it as we scale: products, markets, pricing and unit economics. Turn a breakthrough technology into a bankable one. Strategic partnerships. Decide which partners and customers we build the company with, from AI labs and cloud providers to chipmakers and sovereign compute programmes, and secure the relationships that shape our first fleet. Capital strategy. Work with the CEO on how the business case underpins project finance and fundraising, and own that story with investors and the board. Product direction. Make sure what we build at sea is shaped by where the market is going, working hand in hand with our marine, power and systems engineers. Ecosystem & alliances. Build the partnerships a new infrastructure class needs: chip and systems vendors, cloud platforms, data center operators, ports and financiers. Category leadership. Be our external voice on summit stages, with policymakers and in the press, and make us the reference for AI infrastructure at sea. The business organisation. Build and lead the team across strategy, partnerships and commercial that takes us from demonstrator to fleet. Who you are You've built businesses in deep tech or infrastructure. You've led strategy, business development or a P&L in AI, cloud, data centers or semiconductors, and shaped large, multi-year partnerships. You've taken frontier technology to market. You've brought new, capital-intensive technology to its first major customers and closed the off-take agreements, capacity reservations or long-term contracts that made it bankable. You build, not just run. You've built something from zero, whether a company, a business line or a market, and you're at your best when the playbook doesn't exist yet. You see the whole board. You move between unit economics, partnerships, financing and long-term strategy in the same afternoon. You know AI infrastructure from the inside. Compute economics, workload constraints, and where the market is heading. Compute and infrastructure are your world. GPUs, data centers, power and the economics that tie them together. You hold your own with engineers and turn technical depth into business strategy. The mission matters to you. A business built on AI infrastructure at sea excites you, and you want your work to help AI grow without costing the planet. You work in English. Fluent English is required; French is a plus. How you operate Ownership. You treat the company's outcomes as your own, well beyond your remit. First principles. You reason from the economics and the physics, not from how the market has always worked. Bold and rigorous. You make big bets and do the work to back them. AI-native. You use modern tools to think, decide and move faster. Why this role A C-level mandate across strategy, product and capital, working directly with the CEO and the board The chance to define how compute infrastructure at sea becomes a business, and to keep redefining it as it scales An uncompromising team of repeat entrepreneurs and industrial leaders, backed by top-tier international capital Based wherever you do your best work, with a global mandate and flexible hours. Our home port is Nantes. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Offre de stage de recherche Master 2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieur
description: Dates : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027 Contexte du projet : L’allègement des structures automobiles reste un levier majeur pour réduire la consommation et les émissions des véhicules, tout en répondant à des exigences croissantes de rigidité et de tenue au crash. Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin. L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques. Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants. L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile. Les missions pourront comprendre : •Un état de l’art des méthodes d’optimisation topologique conduisant à des structures minces de type coque (contrôle d’épaisseur par filtrage et projection, contraintes de longueur caractéristique, approches par composants explicites ou level-set). •Le développement d’un algorithme d’optimisation 3D appliqué à une pièce automobile soumise à des chargements statiques. •L’extension de la méthode à des solutions plus avancées proposées par ArcelorMittal. Les missions pourront être adaptées en fonction du profil du candidat et de l’avancement du projet. Profil recherché : étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou équivalent (stage ingénieur) dans le domaine de la mécanique numérique, du calcul des structures ou des mathématiques appliquées. Compétences souhaitées : méthode des éléments finis, optimisation numérique, programmation scientifique (Python, MATLAB ou C++). Des connaissances en optimisation topologique ou en dynamique rapide (LS-DYNA, Radioss) seront appréciées. Encadrement : Frédéric Gillot (LTDS, École Centrale de Lyon) ; Daoming Yu, Alexandre Blaise et Cristian Alvarez (ArcelorMittal Global R&D). L’accueil au laboratoire est soumis à une autorisation préalable (procédure FSD, 2 à 3 mois de délai) : les candidatures (CV, lettre de motivation, relevés de notes) sont à adresser dès que possible. title: CDI - Senior AI Engineer - Paris
description: <h2>Mission</h2> <p>De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.</p> <p>Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Activités et responsabilités</h2> <p>Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.</p> <p>Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.</li> <li>Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.</li> <li>Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.</li> <li>Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.</li> <li>Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.</li> <li>Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.</li> <li>Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>Profil recherché</h2> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li>Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.</li> <li>Votre code est testé et maintenable.</li> <li>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</li> <li>La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.</li> <li>Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.</li> <li>Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.</li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.</li> <li>Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.</li> <li>Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.</li> <li>Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.</li> <li>Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</h2> <p>Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (responsabilité en production, bases de la sécurité de l’IA).</p> <p>Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Processus de recrutement</h2> <p>Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.</p> <ol> <li><strong>Entretien RH</strong> (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.</li> <li><strong>Appel avec le CTO</strong> (15 à 30 min, à distance).</li> <li><strong>Screening technique</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.</li> <li><strong>Code review et live coding</strong> (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.</li> <li><strong>Cas technique</strong> (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.</li> <li><strong>Entretien final</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.</li> </ol> <p>Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rémunération </strong>: 66 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + variable selon expérience et séniorité</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. About the Job The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. You will build control modules that run on many different machines , across many sites, with different soil conditions. Contexte Les modèles marketing sont mis à jour à mesure que de nouvelles données arrivent : ventes hebdomadaires, résultats de campagnes, comportement des clients. Ils comprennent les marketing mix models (MMM), qui estiment le retour sur investissement de chaque canal média, ainsi que les modèles de demande et de promotion et les modèles de réponse client. Chaque mise à jour fait bouger les estimations, et la première question des métiers est : pourquoi ont-elles bougé ? Notre équipe a développé une méthode qui y répond de façon exacte pour les modèles bayésiens. Elle répartit le déplacement de toute quantité a posteriori entre des groupes d'observations : semaines, campagnes, régions, segments de clients ou expériences. La méthode est en cours d'évaluation par les pairs. Un premier prototype sur le MMM suit déjà une estimation semaine après semaine et lève une alerte quand une mise à jour la déplace plus que prévu. Volet recherche (environ 3 mois) • Étendre l'attribution à l'apprentissage bayésien en ligne : mises à jour séquentielles, effets variables dans le temps (modèles linéaires dynamiques, filtre de Kalman), oubli des données anciennes. • Distinguer les trois causes d'un déplacement à chaque mise à jour : les nouvelles données, un vrai changement du marché et une erreur dans un flux de données. • Calibrer l'alerte de mise à jour : taux de fausses alertes et délai de détection, sur des données simulées dont la vérité est connue et sur des données publiques, pour le MMM et pour au moins un autre modèle marketing. • Rédiger un article destiné à un public de statistique ou de marketing science.
