title: Intern AI Researcher: Anomaly Detection for Predictive Maintenance in Distributed Storage
description: About Scality Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies. Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F Follow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog. Context & Motivation A distributed storage cluster continuously emits telemetry at every level, from the platform and S3 service down to each server and disk. A failing disk, server or storage node leaves traces in these multivariate time series, from subtle shifts in a few metrics to system-wide disruption. Detecting and diagnosing these anomalies early is critical for: Predictive maintenance: isolating or replacing a component before it impacts service Faster diagnosis: pointing support engineers to the root cause, not just to an alert Higher availability and durability of customer data This internship is part of a joint research project between Scality and an INRIA research team. The project released SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection), an open benchmark published at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). It contains 215 real 171-dimensional time series from Scality RING clusters, annotated for injected disk, server and storage-node failures. SHAD's baselines show the problem is far from solved. No detector handles every failure type, per-dimension attributions find root causes no better than chance, and off-the-shelf LLMs cannot interpret the anomalies. This internship builds on SHAD to close these gaps. More details on the project: scality.github.io/shad Your Mission As part of our R&D team and in close collaboration with INRIA researchers, you will develop AI models that detect, explain and interpret anomalies in storage-cluster telemetry. Your work will include: 1. State of the Art Review the literature and open-source projects on multivariate time series anomaly detection, root-cause attribution and LLM-based interpretation of time series. Also survey recent work on AI agents that automate research and experimentation. Starting points include SHAD and the TSB-AD benchmark. 2. Anomaly Detection & Diagnosis Models Design, train and benchmark models that improve on SHAD's baselines at each stage of the pipeline: Detection that stays accurate across disk, server and storage-node failures (e.g., ensembles, hybrid models, time series foundation models) Explanation: attributing each anomaly to the dimensions that actually cause it Interpretation: turning detections into actionable diagnoses (failure type, criticality, affected component) Early detection of progressive degradations, the core of predictive maintenance 3. Fleets of AI Agents for Research Set up and manage fleets of AI agents that run your studies at scale: Design agent workflows that launch experiments, run benchmarks and compare methods Orchestrate and monitor many agents working in parallel Build safeguards for rigor: experiment tracking, reproducibility, independent verification of results Assess what agent-driven research changes in practice: speed, coverage, failure modes 4. Evaluation & Validation Evaluate every model with rigorous, reproducible protocols. title: Head of Distribution
description: 🍇 About grape: Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first. At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you! Your role As Head of Distribution, you own grape’s commercial engine end to end: Broker Sales, Direct Sales, Brand & Marketing, Customer Success and Revenue Operations. You carry the new nARR and renewal targets and lead the team leads who deliver them. You take this function over from our co-founder, grow it further, and represent Distribution on grape’s Leadership Team. What you'll do: Own the numbers: Deliver new nARR and renewal targets across broker, direct and partner channels. Own forecast accuracy, pipeline health and the channel mix. Lead the commercial organisation: Lead five team leads, set OKRs, hold the performance bar, develop the next layer of leaders and hire ahead of growth. Win the broker channel: Own decision-maker relationships with key broker houses and steer the tender season on quality, speed and win rate. Build the end-to-end funnel: Set clear stage ownership and KPIs from first touch to renewal. Align closely with underwriting on deal flow and pricing, and steer RevOps on tooling, data quality and forecasting. Retain and grow the book: Own the renewal rate and retention playbook, drive platform and grape connect adoption, and turn customer and broker insight into product input. Work across the company: Represent Distribution on the Leadership Team and in board reporting. Partner with Product, Insurance Supply and Operations. What you'll need: 10+ years in commercial roles, including 5+ years leading a multi-team organisation through team leads. A track record of delivering multi-million B2B revenue targets repeatedly. Experience in a B2B market sold through intermediaries; Swiss insurance, employee benefits or pensions is a strong plus. Experience scaling a commercial organisation, ideally in a venture-backed company. Strong pipeline, forecasting and funnel analytics; uses CRM (ideally HubSpot) as a steering tool. Understanding of, or a fast route to learning, insurance commercial mechanics: premium, loss ratio and renewal pricing. VBV registration, or readiness to obtain it promptly. Fluent German and English; French and Swiss German are a plus. Credible with brokers, your team and the Board; direct, data-driven and comfortable disagreeing upward. What makes you stand out: Existing relationships in the Swiss broker market. You’re both builder and operator: you write the growth model and sit in the tender review. The leaders who reported to you grew, and they stayed. 🤝 What we offer in return: 🌱 Empowering workplace: Join a passionate team and an empowering workplace where you are given the ownership, tools, and support to make decisions and take initiative. Together we grow and build innovative solutions. 💻 Hybrid setup: Enjoy the flexibility of our hybrid work schedule, with the freedom to work remotely or from our office in Zurich. On Thursdays, our team day, we meet together in our Zurich office. 🪑 Home office stipend: To enable our hybrid setup, we allocate a one-off CHF 200.- home office budget to help you set up your dream workspace in the comfort of your own home. 🌐 Internet allowance: We give you a monthly internet allowance to help cover your internet costs at home and enable you to work seamlessly from your home office. ⏳ Flexible working time: You can distribute your working hours the way you want to. 🧠 Learning budget: We support you in improving your skills, acquiring new knowledge and advancing your career. We also allocate a CHF 1'500.- budget annually ❤️‍🩹 Well-being: Work-life balance is important to us and we foster a supportive work environment. We support you with mental health sessions with our partner Aepsy. 🎫 Team events: Every month we gather for fun and engaging events where we can connect and bond with our colleagues and our teams. ✈️ Team retreats: Once a year we travel somewhere nice to bond with our colleagues. 🚂 Travel and commute: We will cover your SBB half fare card, so we can spend some time together in the office. 🌴 Paid vacation: You get 5 weeks (25 days) of paid vacation every year and 2 additional days of paid vacation to compensate for canton-related holidays, religious holidays, birthdays, etc. The total amount of paid vacation days per year is 27 days. 🧖‍♀️ Wellness budget: Health and well-being looks different for everyone. You can optimize your wellness budget to best fit your needs. 👨‍👨‍👦‍👦 Parental and adoptive leave: We offer additional time off to support employees who are balancing family and work time in the most crucial stages of family life. ✈️ Digital nomad: For every 3 years of employment, you can work for an extended period of time from anywhere in the world (location subject to review). 🏁 Our recruitment process We place particular emphasis on four areas when making our selection decision: professional and technical skills, mindset & values. We evaluate these through the following steps: Step 1 - Your motivation To get to know you better, we invite you to a 30-minute motivational interview with our Talent Acquisition Team. Step 2 - Role fit In the first interview, we assess how well your qualifications and skills align with the role requirements. This discussion will take place with your Hiring Manager. Step 3 - Case study For roles with higher technical demands, we will invite you to complete a case study or technical assessment. This allows us to better evaluate your specific skills and problem-solving abilities. Step 4 - Our culture connect Throughout the interview process, you'll gain insight into our company culture, and we'll explore how your values and mindset align with our ways of working. The final interview will offer a deeper look into this connection, along with broader discussions about the role and our vision. Our diverse experiences, perspectives, and voices make us the company we are, and we would love to learn more about you! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- Health is our foundation. Innovation drives our mission. Together, we’re building the future of employee insurance. At grape, collaboration isn’t just a buzzword, it’s the foundation of how we work, live, and succeed. From bold brainstorms and lessons learned, we overcome challenges side by side. Our time together is our greatest asset. Disrupting an industry that truly needs change takes courage, creativity, and team spirit and that’s exactly what defines us. With well-being at the core, we foster an environment where ideas and people thrive. Your growth matters as much as our mission. Whether it’s supporting your self-care, developing new solutions, or redefining how health and insurance connect, we grow together. Our values guide us every step of the way: keeping Health at Heart , Invent ing Together , and always striving to Embrace Clarity . Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Asset Manager
description: ABOUT US P3 is a long-term investor, manager and developer of European warehouse properties with more than 10.2 million m² of assets under management and land bank of 1.7 million m² of future gross lettable area for further development. P3 has commercial activities in 11 countries and has been investing and developing in European markets for over two decades. And because we care about our customers and communities where we operate, we develop environmentally friendly, sustainable warehouses to the highest international standards. Headquartered in Prague, P3 employs more than 320 people with 25+ nationalities across 11 offices in key European cities, offering integrated development, asset and property management services. P3 has an investment grade BBB credit rating by Standard & Poor’s. Attracting the right talents is key for our future. We are looking for ambitious and passionate experts who can help us make P3 THE leading logistics warehouse provider in Europe. OUR CULTURE Our company values - Integrity, Teamwork, Excellence, Ambition - are embedded deeply within the organisation, and guide our steps every single day. P3’s size and stability enable us to take a global view and yet at the same time we are just the right size to maintain our agile and flexible approach on local real estate markets. Together, we create an environment that encourages personal growth because we know we are successful mainly thanks to the people who make P3. We recognise and reward outstanding performance and motivate people to contribute to our mutual goals and turn their good ideas into great outcomes. We encourage people to have ownership, make decisions and accept responsibility for them. WE ARE LOOKING FOR A Senior Asset Manager who would be responsible for maximizing the value and performance of P3’s logistics real estate portfolio in France. The role focuses on strategic asset planning, value creation, leasing performance, capital investment management, and stakeholder coordination across the full lifecycle of the assets. The role is set to drive asset-level business plans, executes value-enhancing initiatives, manages leasing strategies, and coordinates cross-functional teams to optimize financial, technical, and operational performance while aligning with P3’s overall investment strategy. SOME OF THE INTERESTING CHALLENGES AHEAD OF YOU Asset Strategy & Investment Develop and execute asset business plans aligned with P3’s investment strategy, driving NOI, occupancy and long-term value. Identify value-creation opportunities: leasing optimisation, repositioning, redevelopment and cost efficiencies. Perform hold/sell analyses and support acquisitions and disposals. Prepare investment memos, financial models and recommendations for the Investment Committee. Financial Performance & Reporting Own the financial performance of assigned assets, including revenue growth and cost control. Prepare budgets, reforecasts and long-term business plans, and track performance against KPIs and underwriting. Manage valuation inputs and support external valuations. Report on asset and portfolio performance to senior management in line with internal governance. Leasing & Tenant Management Define leasing strategies to maximise occupancy, tenant quality and rental growth. Work with leasing teams, brokers and Legal to secure new leases and renewals. Build strong relationships with key tenants and identify lease restructuring opportunities. Technical, Capex & ESG Oversee technical performance, capex projects and lifecycle planning against budgets, timelines and market standards. Ensure compliance with local regulations, safety and environmental requirements. Drive ESG initiatives such as energy efficiency, solar PV, EV infrastructure and certifications. Stakeholders & Market Work closely with Development, Construction, Finance, Leasing, Property Management and Legal. Supervise external property and facility managers, brokers and technical advisors. Monitor logistics market trends and competitor activity, and represent P3 at industry events. WHAT YOU NEED TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE Min 7 years of experience in asset or investment management within logistics/industrial real estate. Strong analytical and financial skills, including cash flow modeling and performance analysis. Commercial acumen, solid knowledge of french commercial lease and negotiations skills Proven experience driving asset business plans, leasing strategies, and value creation initiatives. Solid exposure to technical asset management, including capex planning, asset performance, and lifecycle management. Good understanding of building systems, technical due diligence, and property/facility management. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Fluent in French and English WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US These are some of the benefits we offer: Stability of an international company (one of the leading industrial real estate developers on the European market) Dynamic collaborative working environment with a passionate team of colleagues across 11 countries Attractive annual bonus Generous budget for trainings and continuous development opportunities Individual language courses Employee assistance programme (individual coaching/mentoring opportunities in wellbeing area) Flexible/hybrid working policy Extra paid days off (vacation, sick days – based on local legislation) Meal allowance We care and we like spending time together so we enjoy company events, team buildings and networking opportunities connected with the support of various charity causes Delicious coffee, refreshments and healthy snacks at workplace Attractive employee referral bonus in case you make a successful referral for any of the job roles we have open Benefits are regulated by P3 internal policy which contains the full details regarding the entitlement and conditions for the benefits. Benefits policy and components may vary by location. Come and join us and allow your career to flourish in line with the strong and stable growth of the P3 business. Build your career in a way which is meaningful to you! IMPORTANT: PLEASE PROVIDE YOUR APPLICATION AND RESUME IN ENGLISH LANGUAGE. Benefits Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: CDI - Senior AI Engineer - Paris
description: <h2>Mission</h2> <p>De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.</p> <p>Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Activités et responsabilités</h2> <p>Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.</p> <p>Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.</li> <li>Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.</li> <li>Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.</li> <li>Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.</li> <li>Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.</li> <li>Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.</li> <li>Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>Profil recherché</h2> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li>Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.</li> <li>Votre code est testé et maintenable.</li> <li>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</li> <li>La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.</li> <li>Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.</li> <li>Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.</li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.</li> <li>Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.</li> <li>Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.</li> <li>Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.</li> <li>Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</h2> <p>Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.</p> <p>Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.</p> <p>Le reste s’approfondit sur les projets : évaluation, conception d’agents, adaptation de modèles, avec l’appui de la communauté AI Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (responsabilité en production, bases de la sécurité de l’IA).</p> <p>Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Processus de recrutement</h2> <p>Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.</p> <ol> <li><strong>Entretien RH</strong> (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.</li> <li><strong>Appel avec le CTO</strong> (15 à 30 min, à distance).</li> <li><strong>Screening technique</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.</li> <li><strong>Code review et live coding</strong> (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.</li> <li><strong>Cas technique</strong> (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.</li> <li><strong>Entretien final</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.</li> </ol> <p>Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rémunération </strong>: 53 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + variable selon expérience et séniorité</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (responsabilité en production, bases de la sécurité de l’IA).</p> <p>Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Processus de recrutement</h2> <p>Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.</p> <ol> <li><strong>Entretien RH</strong> (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.</li> <li><strong>Appel avec le CTO</strong> (15 à 30 min, à distance).</li> <li><strong>Screening technique</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.</li> <li><strong>Code review et live coding</strong> (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.</li> <li><strong>Cas technique</strong> (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.</li> <li><strong>Entretien final</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.</li> </ol> <p>Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rémunération </strong>: 66 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + variable selon expérience et séniorité</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Account Executive | New Logo | MEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="p1">At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.</p> <p>The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.</p> <p> </p></div><p style="text-align: justify;"><strong>What you’ll do at Jamf:</strong></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <div style="text-align: justify;"> <p>The <strong>Enterprise New Logo Account Executive MEA </strong>is a results-driven hunter responsible for identifying, pursuing, and closing new enterprise logos for Jamf. Focused exclusively on net-new acquisition within the enterprise segment (organizations with 1,000+ employees), this role requires strong prospecting discipline, the ability to manage complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and the consultative acumen to position Jamf's Apple Enterprise Management solutions at the executive level. Success in this role is defined by consistent pipeline generation, new logo attainment, and laying the foundation for long-term customer partnerships.</p> <p>This role is offered in <strong>The Netherlands only</strong>, preferably for candidates located in the Randstad and used to travel to MEA #LI-Remote</p> <p> </p> <p><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What you can expect to do this role:</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>New Logo Prospecting & Pipeline Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and manage a targeted outbound prospecting motion to identify and engage net-new enterprise accounts within an assigned segment or territory.</li> <li>Develop segment fluency — understanding buyer personas, common objections, industry-specific compliance needs, and Apple ecosystem maturity within target accounts.</li> <li>Partner with Marketing, Business Development, and Channel partners to execute coordinated account-based prospecting that feeds a healthy, qualified pipeline.</li> <li>Maintain consistent pipeline coverage and hygiene, ensuring sufficient volume and stage diversity to meet and exceed quota targets.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Enterprise Sales Cycle Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage the full sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close — navigating the complexity typical of enterprise buying processes.</li> <li>Identify and engage multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and executive leadership to build multi-threaded relationships within target accounts.</li> <li>Apply a structured qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) to assess deal health, prioritize effort, and improve forecast accuracy.</li> <li>Navigate enterprise procurement processes, including security reviews, DPAs, and SLAs, with support from Jamf Legal and internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Develop and deliver compelling business cases, demonstrations, and ROI presentations tailored to the priorities of diverse buying audiences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Commercial & Deal Execution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Structure initial commercial agreements that are competitive, value-aligned, and appropriately sized to facilitate a strong land — with long-term expansion in mind.</li> <li>Negotiate contract terms with support from Jamf Legal and Finance, maintaining deal momentum while protecting Jamf's commercial interests.</li> <li>Maintain competitive positioning in deals where incumbents or alternatives are present; articulate Jamf's differentiated value with confidence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partner & Ecosystem Engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build productive working relationships with Apple's enterprise sales team and Jamf's channel and reseller partners to generate introductions and support deal execution.</li> <li>Engage partner resources appropriately to accelerate pipeline and strengthen account access, especially within named accounts or complex organizations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Forecasting, Reporting & Team Contribution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce, including account activity, pipeline stage, and deal notes, to support individual and team forecasting.</li> <li>Provide consistent, reliable monthly and quarterly forecasts, with clear visibility into deal status and expected close timelines.</li> <li>Share learnings from the field — win/loss patterns, competitive intelligence, objection themes — to contribute to team and segment knowledge.</li> </ul> <p> </p> </div> <p style="text-align: justify;"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What we are looking for:</strong></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <ul> <li>Minimum of 5 years of B2B SaaS or technology sales experience with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota (Required)</li> <li>Professional working proficiency in English is required and Arabic is preferred.</li> <li>Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, including IT and executive-level buyers (Required)</li> <li>Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and marketing collaboration (Required)</li> <li>Familiarity with a structured sales qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN) and ability to apply it to assess deal health (Required)</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work effectively in both direct and indirect (channel/partner) selling models (Required)</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to deliver clear and persuasive presentations to technical and business audiences (Required)</li> <li>Proficiency with Salesforce or equivalent CRM for pipeline tracking, forecasting, and activity documentation (Required)</li> <li>Consultative, solutions-oriented selling approach with the ability to connect technology to business outcomes (Preferred)</li> <li>Familiarity with Apple enterprise ecosystem, endpoint management, or SaaS security solutions (Preferred)</li> <li>Experience navigating enterprise procurement processes including DPAs, SLAs, and security reviews (Preferred)</li> <li>Self-directed and resilient; able to manage long sales cycles and ambiguous buying processes with discipline and focus (Preferred)</li> <li>Travel in the MEA territory around 40%.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS</strong><span class="markedContent"><br></span></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.</li> <li>Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.</li> <li>Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Why Jamf?</strong></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <ul> <li style="text-align: justify;">Named a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, 2021.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 70,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">We put people over profits – which is why our customers keep coming back to us.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">We encourage you to simply be you. We constantly seek and value different perspectives to ensure Jamf is a place where everyone feels comfortable and can be successful.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">23 of 25 world’s most valuable brands rely on Jamf to do their best work (as ranked by Forbes).</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What it means to be a Jamf?<br></strong>We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.  </p> <p>Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.  </p> <p>Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement. </p> <p><br><strong>What does Jamf do?</strong><strong><br></strong>Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</em></p> <p><em> </em></p> <p><strong>A propos de WPP Media :</strong></p> <p><strong><em>WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance. </em></strong>Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie. <br>Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing. <br>Pour plus d’informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wpp.com/">www.wpp.com</a>.</p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li>Être <strong>Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li>Créer un environnement <strong>Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li>Diriger avec <strong>Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Le contexte</strong> :</p> <p>Au sein de StudioM, l’agence de brand content de WPP Media, vous rejoindrez la Business Unit dédiée à une marque leader de la grande consommation (FMCG) et contribuerez à ses stratégies d’influence en France.</p> <p>Aux côtés de l’équipe Influence, en lien avec les équipes clients, média, créatives et les agences partenaires, vous participerez à des campagnes pour des marques iconiques, entre création de contenu, entertainment et pop culture : musique, gaming, sport, food ou lifestyle.</p> <p><strong><br>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Contribuer aux stratégies d’influence :</strong> participer à la construction des recommandations stratégiques et créatives, proposer des idées d’activation et assurer une veille sur les tendances, la culture Gen Z, les usages des plateformes sociales, les créateurs émergents et les activations concurrentes.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Participer au casting des</strong><strong> créateurs de contenu :</strong> identifier des profils, de la nano-influence aux célébrités, et analyser leurs performances, leurs audiences, leur univers éditorial et leur affinité avec les marques.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Accompagner le suivi opérationnel des campagnes :</strong> participer à la rédaction des briefs, au suivi des agences partenaires, à la préparation des scripts et contenus soumis à validation, aux rétroplannings ainsi qu’au suivi budgétaire, administratif et contractuel.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Participer aux activations et aux productions de contenus :</strong> accompagner l’équipe lors des tournages, événements, expériences immersives et activations terrain avec les créateurs de contenu.</li> <li><strong>Contribuer à la mesure des performances et à l’innovation :</strong> suivre les KPI organiques et paid, notamment via CreatorIQ, participer aux bilans de campagne et aux pistes d’optimisation, et explorer l’apport des outils d’intelligence artificielle dans nos réflexions et méthodes de travail.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compétences requises :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Formation Bac +4/+5 en communication, marketing ou publicité, à la recherche d’une alternance.</li> <li>Un vif intérêt pour l’influence, l’entertainment et la pop culture, et une bonne connaissance des créateurs de contenu et des plateformes sociales (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitch, Snapchat).</li> <li>Curiosité, créativité, réactivité, rigueur et sens de l’organisation pour suivre plusieurs sujets en parallèle.</li> <li>Aisance rédactionnelle et relationnelle, esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, bonne maîtrise de PowerPoint et d’Excel, et bon niveau d’anglais (B2 souhaité).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Un plus :</strong> la connaissance d’outils de marketing d’influence (comme CreatorIQ) et de social listening.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contribuer à des campagnes d’influence d’envergure nationale pour des marques iconiques à dimension internationale.</li> <li>Évoluer au sein d’une Business Unit dédiée, dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire.</li> <li>Travailler aux côtés de créateurs de contenu, d’agences partenaires et d’experts média et créatifs.</li> <li>Acquérir une vision complète du marketing d’influence, de la stratégie à la mesure de la performance.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.</p> <p>Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Ce que nous offrons :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Une <strong>expérience professionnelle unique</strong> au sein d'une compagnie média renommée, où vous pourrez acquérir des compétences précieuses et développer votre réseau professionnel.</li> <li>L'opportunité de travailler avec des <strong>clients de premier plan</strong> et de contribuer à la création de campagnes publicitaires de grande envergure.</li> <li>Un <strong>accompagnement personnalisé</strong> pour tous les Padawans (stagiaires/alternants chez WPP Media) de votre intégration à votre départ … ou pas !</li> <li><strong>Des déjeuners, cafés, afterworks</strong> ainsi que différents évènements qui rythmeront votre année chez nous.</li> <li>Un <strong>campus</strong> à Levallois-Perret qui rassemble toutes les agences WPP (WPP Media et ses sœurs) au terminus de la ligne 3 !</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Process de recrutement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier pré-entretien téléphonique de 5mn, puis un entretien de 30mn en visio-conférence par un membre de notre équipe recrutement. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise.</li> <li>Entretien opérationnel : Pour évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences et de votre profil par rapport aux exigences du poste.</li> <li>Étude de cas : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée.</li> </ul> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.</p> <p> </p> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. Consulting</strong></p> <p>Vous souhaitez découvrir le conseil en travaillant sur des problématiques concrètes de transformation ?</p> <p>Au sein de la BU <strong>Business Consulting de WPP Enterprise                                                                                               </strong>Ce stage s'adresse à des étudiants souhaitant faire du conseil leur premier métier, avec la title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. </p> <p>On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach. </p> <p>We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.</p> <p><strong>This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world: </strong>Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You are the architect of your own career: </strong>If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.</li> <li><strong>You love talking to people: </strong>In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.</li> <li><strong>You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: </strong>One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.</li> <li><strong>You treat rejection as a learning experience:</strong> In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best: </strong>Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>In this role, you will:</strong> </h4> <ul> <li>Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin</li> <li>Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.</li> <li>Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling</li> <li>Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles</li> <li>6-12 months sales experience as a minimum</li> <li>Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales</li> <li>Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, verbal and written</li> <li>Curious and able to ask insightful questions</li> <li>A champion of a Growth Mindset</li> <li>Highly proficient in English and fluent in French</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in closing-sales roles</li> <li>Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)</li> <li>Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment</li> <li>Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways</li> <li>Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADR pathways</strong></p> <p>Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.</p> <ul> <li><strong>ADR I</strong> representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>The next level in the program is <strong>ADR II</strong>, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>The highest level within our organization is <strong>ADR III</strong>. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations </strong></p> <p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email <a ---------- or <a href="https://forms.gle/DrM6DFQUiSgfPtCVA">click here</a> if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Authenticity</strong></p> <p>We use <a href="https://hiretofu.com/privacyPolicy">Tofu</a>, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and all

title: Senior Paid Marketing Strategist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Who we are</h3> <p>Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.</p></div><p><span class="s1" style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal, Spain or The Netherlands</span></span></p> <h3>About the role</h3> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re looking for a Senior Paid Marketing Strategist to help us rethink how Typeform approaches paid acquisition.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll own and grow key channels including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads, while helping us test new opportunities across areas such as audio and CTV.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">This is a hands on role with real ownership. You’ll manage significant media budgets, build channel strategy, develop campaigns, work closely with our creative teams, and help us understand the true business impact of our investment through MMM, incrementality testing and other measurement approaches.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll join the Acquisition team within Marketing and partner closely with Creative, Product Marketing, Data, RevOps and Finance.</p> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <ul data-spread="true"> <li>Own the strategy and day to day performance of key paid social and display channels, including TikTok, YouTube, Google title: Chief Operating Officer COO

We’re a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives, with a commitment to the traveler above all else. title: Senior Backend Engineer, Backend Platform (PHP and Python)
description: WHO WE ARE 🌍 Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does. Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work. We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟 Want to own how the backend works for everyone, not just one corner of it? We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who works across PHP and Python and wants a say in the bigger picture. You’ll lead company-level projects like our Auth Service: one authorization layer for PHP and Python, so Python products can handle their traffic directly instead of going through PHP. When things are unclear, you’ll research first, weigh the trade-offs and write them down. Then you’ll ship in small, safe steps. You’ll also decide where code should live based on what’s best for the system, not on which language you know best. Product teams will come to you for advice, reviews, and a way through when they're stuck. The team is still taking shape, so you'll also help define ownership, standards, and how we work. If that mix of deep technical work and influence across teams sounds like you, keep reading. YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋 Meet the Backend Platform team: We're a small team of engineers from core PHP, Infra, and AI backgrounds. We lead technical initiatives across the whole backend and own its health. Product teams build and run their own components, and we give them the tools, standards, and expertise to do it well. Each of us leads our own project, from planning to agreeing with other teams to production. We work in weekly cycles and write our decisions down. Right now we're bringing PHP and Python platform work together into one common backend platform. WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀 Lead company-level technical projects end to end, from design and planning to rollout and support, such as completing our Auth Service development and shaping authorization as a separate layer for PHP and Python. Shape the shared PHP and Python platform, and decide where each module should live based on the needs of the whole system. Build the foundations that let new Python products launch and scale without being wired through PHP each time. Define clear ownership of technical components across the backend, including who owns monitoring and knowledge for each. Improve how we spot and handle problems: bug and incident management, less noise in alerts and error tracking, and Grafana Cloud dashboards for how services interact. Find root causes across PHP and Python services using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing. Make performance part of everyday work, not something we fix after incidents: clear performance metrics, tools that show where things slow down, and analysis of unusual user behavior that causes degradation. Make architecture decisions with high load in mind, working with databases, servers, proxies, and DNS alongside the Infra team. Work with the Security team to fix vulnerabilities, build in security practices, and keep libraries and dependencies up to date. Improve developer experience: dev environment, CI/CD, routine automation, one documentation approach for PHP and Python, and tools for AI coding assistants. Turn product teams' requests into solutions: find what really hurts, propose the best fix, and support them with architecture advice and reviews in shared components. TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥 You'll need: Production backend experience in PHP or Python, and the ability to read and work with the other. You'll write production code in both. Experience with high-load production systems and improving their performance. Experience designing multi-component systems with clear boundaries, planning for failures, rollout, and rollback, with security in mind. Experience comparing technical options, naming the trade-offs, and explaining your choice in writing (ADRs, Design Docs). Hands-on observability experience: metrics, dashboards, alerts, logs, and distributed tracing, and using them to find root causes. Experience leading a project that spans several teams: breaking it into small, testable steps, getting other teams on board, and taking it to production. A track record of improving engineering quality beyond your own tasks, for example setting up error monitoring, or a new process when things kept breaking. Enough infrastructure knowledge (databases, servers, proxies, DNS) to work well with Infra and see how your changes affect them. Clear communication: you explain your point of view, find the real problem behind a request, and flag risks early. Experience leading work independently while supporting your team: taking feedback, helping colleagues grow, and changing your mind when the arguments are good. It would be great if you have: Experience on a Platform or Core team. Strong production experience in both PHP and Python. Experience with authentication and authorization systems (for example, JWT or Ory Oathkeeper). Experience defining SLOs and building symptom-based alerts. description: <p>We’re on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. You will keep the team’s standards high while the way of working changes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your profile</strong></p> <ul> <li>3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures.</li> <li>Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.</li> <li>Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.</li> <li>Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.</li> <li>Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! Own the relationship end to end : commercial, contractual and partnership, with multiple decision makers per group (group management, finance, medical information, IT) Drive the rollout at groups that are already live, across their facilities Expand : onboard newly joined groups onto our SMR optimization product, and open the discussion on MCO Run each account like a program : every group has many workstreams at once. title: Staff System Architect -SNSPD Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&index=8&md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=and&index=9&md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=AstraZeneca&index=10&md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><span class="s1"><span class="TextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0"><strong>What to expect</strong></span></span></span></p> <p>We are looking for a Staff System Architect to be fully dedicated to the SNSPD product line, with a strong focus on leading the technical architecture and roadmap for our next-generation rack-mountable SNSPD (Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detector) platform. This role is critical to defining and guiding the technical evolution of our cutting-edge cryogenic photon detection systems, ensuring architectural coherence across hardware, software, and integration domains while supporting our product vision and market requirements.</p> <p>We are looking for a proven architect of complex, multi-domain instruments, whether from space systems, astronomical instrumentation, scientific or medical imaging, electron or advanced optical microscopy, semiconductor equipment, or comparable fields who can bring that system-level rigour to our platform.</p> <p><span class="s1"><span class="TextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0"><strong><span class="TextRun SCXW243108471 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW243108471 BCX0">What you'll be doing</span></span></strong></span></span></span></p> <p>In this role, you will be an integral part of the development process for IDQ's SNSPD platform, with applications across quantum computing, networking, and sensing. You will be at the intersection of quantum photonics, cryogenic systems engineering and embedded systems to create scalable, maintainable architectures for autonomous 24/7 detector operations.</p> <p>You will take ownership of the end-to-end system architecture of the SNSPD platform, ensuring alignment with a shared long-term product vision while translating product requirements into clear system-level designs and specifications. This includes defining system structure, interfaces, and key architectural decisions, as well as driving critical trade-offs across performance, cost, scalability, and integration. You will also align engineering execution with the architectural vision, guiding system integration and resolving complex cross-domain design challenges.</p> <p>In addition, you will play a key role in shaping the technology roadmap and driving the evolution of the platform, continuously evaluating and introducing new technologies where relevant to maintain innovation and competitiveness.</p> <ul> <li>Lead system architecture, design decisions, and cross-functional alignment to ensure a scalable and high-performing SNSPD platform</li> <li>Drive technology roadmap, integration, and innovation by evaluating and implementing new technologies</li> </ul> <p><strong><span class="s1">What you'll bring</span></strong></p> <p>We are seeking an experienced professional with a Master's degree (PhD preferred) in physics, electrical engineering, photonics, or a related field, and 7+ years of experience in the design of complex, multi-domain systems, with demonstrated ownership of system architecture. The ideal candidate has architected instruments or platforms of comparable complexity, combining optics or photonics with electronics, mechanics or thermal design, and embedded or software components and has proven experience integrating these technologies into cohesive, high-performing products.</p> <p>You will demonstrate strong technical leadership across multidisciplinary teams, with the ability to clearly communicate complex system architectures to a wide range of stakeholders. This includes ensuring alignment, supporting informed decision-making, and driving successful collaboration across functions to deliver robust and scalable system designs.</p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in system architecture and multi-domain integration, with strong system-level thinking</li> <li>Proven technical leadership and communication skills, enabling alignment and effective decision-making across diverse teams</li> </ul> <p><strong><span class="s1">You'll be a great fit with</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in domains of comparable complexity: space instrumentation, astronomy, high-end microscopy or imaging, semiconductor or scientific equipment</li> <li>Experience with photonics, low-noise electronics, cryogenics, or vacuum systems</li> <li>Experience with SNSPDs, single-photon detection, or quantum systems</li> <li>Experience bringing industrialized or rack-mountable systems to market</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs. </strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  </p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs. </strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
