title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
description: Help fix customer-centricity at scale Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact. Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture. Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world. If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together. The role Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act. Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter. You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan . You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe. Why this role, now The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it. Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next. This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do. What you'll do This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does. Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book. Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature. Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook. Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates What this role isn't We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in. It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role. It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline. It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing. What we're looking for 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations. A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers. Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before. Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP. A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know. Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders What we offer our permanent employees: 💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed! 🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility. 🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location. 🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December. 🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career. 🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership. 👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover. 👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered. 🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France. ⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously. 🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions. About TheyDo Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make. We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’ , never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘ Simply to accelerate ', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process. TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race. Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner. If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. title: Technical Project Manager - France
description: Build something monumental for Healthcare! At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care. We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you! About the Role You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped. At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners. You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind. This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem. What You'll Do Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations. Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners. Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm. Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables. Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform. Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity. Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery. Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly. Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers. What You Bring Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment. Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders. Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers. Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum. Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery. Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction. A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time. Native level french speaking. Bonus Points Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards Experience working with platform or API products Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding) Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners Location We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Paris office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm. How to Apply We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English. Our interview process consists of 4 stages: Screening interview with Talent Acquisition Technical interview with some of our Engineering team Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads Home case and presentation at our Paris office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action. Culture at Tandem At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started. Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together. Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection. We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

At Mirakl, AI is a core part of our product strategy - from Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce. This is where you come in.</p> <p><strong>The position is a permanent contract, based in Paris or Bordeaux, with up to 1 day of remote work per week. <br><br></strong></p> <h2><strong>2. What You'll Bring to the Role</strong></h2> <p><strong>Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer with strong software engineering skills, or as a Software/Data Engineer with hands-on AI and ML experience</li> <li>Proven track record of deploying AI/ML systems in production products, with an automation-first approach</li> <li>Proven experience building AI agents with LLMs, RAG, MCP and related technologies, including architectural design</li> <li>Strong experience in data-driven iteration, from experimentation to evaluation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>LLM orchestration and agentic systems design (RAG, MCP, LangChain, etc.)</li> <li>Software engineering proficiency in Python</li> <li>Solid grounding in machine learning algorithms and fundamental</li> <li>Rigorous metrics-driven evaluation and experimentation</li> <li>A "0 to 1" mindset: able to thrive in ambiguity and take an idea from exploration to production</li> <li>Product sense: understanding end users’ pain points and balancing technical excellence with customer impact </li> <li>Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills</li> <li>Frontend development (TypeScript, React) is a plus<br><br></li> </ul> <h2><strong>4. Tech Stack</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Python, SQL, TypeScript</li> <li><strong>Backend:</strong> FastAPI, LangChain, OpenSearch, Kafka, PostgreSQL</li> <li><strong>Frontend:</strong> React (micro-frontend architecture)</li> <li><strong>AI:</strong> LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)</li> <li><strong>Data Platform & Orchestration:</strong> Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows</li> <li><strong>Observability:</strong> Langfuse, MLflow</li> <li><strong>Infrastructure:</strong> Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, AWS, GCP<br><br></li> </ul> <h2><strong>5. title: Systems Engineer - Network Data Plane Software
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Locations: Austin TX, Champaign IL, Lisbon Portugal, London England, Atlanta GA, Washington DC, </strong></p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Cloudflare is redefining the way networks are run at scale, and some of the largest networks in the world now run their traffic through us. Cloudflare's network runs in hundreds of cities on general-purpose Linux servers, not dedicated routers, so the routers, firewalls, load balancers, and proxies that carry our customers' traffic are software that we write, ship, and operate ourselves.</p> <p>Our Packet Processing team builds and operates that software: high-performance code that processes customer traffic at the packet level as it moves through Cloudflare's network, in every Cloudflare data center. That includes the L4 load balancer at the front door of every server, a per-customer routing and forwarding data plane, a stateful network firewall, and a TCP/UDP reverse proxy (the engines behind products like Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare Network Firewall, and Spectrum).</p> <p>We are a team of engineers who obsess over performance, correctness, and reliability at massive scale. We own what we build in production, a lot of our work happens close to the kernel and the NIC.</p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>We're looking for engineers who want to build the software that forwards, filters, and load-balances packets for a meaningful fraction of the internet. If you've worked on routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, or SDN data planes, and you'd like to do that in software, at Cloudflare's scale, this is the role.</p> <p>We're moving towards a unified data plane platform that all of our L3/L4 products share. Instead of each product having its own data path, with its own configuration, performance work, and failure modes, we build a feature once and every product gets it.</p> <p>Some of the things you'd work on:</p> <ul> <li>The shared platform: packet I/O, a graph of processing stages, per-core steering, per-customer isolation, and upgrades that don't drop traffic</li> <li>A userspace forwarding plane that gives each customer their own routing and forwarding, with traffic arriving and leaving over tunnels (GRE, IPsec) and direct connections</li> <li>A stateful packet firewall written in Rust: rule evaluation, rate limiting, intrusion detection, packet capture, and dual-stack IPv4/IPv6</li> <li>An XDP-based L4 load balancer that touches nearly every connection into Cloudflare and forwards packets between servers and between data centers</li> <li>A fast path that uses XDP and eBPF to forward very large single flows at multiple Gbps</li> <li>Host networking: classifying each packet once and using that result everywhere on the server, instead of separate configs that can disagree</li> <li>Chasing down packet drops, latency, and throughput problems across a fleet of servers in hundreds of cities</li> </ul> <p>We write mostly Go and Rust (plus C for eBPF) on Linux, and the work ranges from XDP and the kernel network stack to userspace packet pipelines and the control planes that configure them.</p> <p>You'll build, deploy, and operate these systems on top of one of the largest edge networks in the world. You'll partner with some of the best engineers and product managers, on our team and across Cloudflare, to solve big problems that have a meaningful impact in the lives of our customers and users.</p> <p>We're looking for curious, empathetic engineers who are excited to join us in changing the way networking is done!</p> <h2>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience</h2> <ul> <li>Systems programming experience in Rust, Go, C, or C++</li> <li>A solid understanding of L3 and L4 networking: IP, TCP, UDP, routing and forwarding, tunneling (GRE, IPsec), NAT, connection tracking, and anycast</li> <li>Experience building data plane software: routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN gateways, or SDN/NFV systems</li> <li>Linux networking: eBPF/XDP, tc, netfilter/nftables, network namespaces, sockets, etc.</li> <li>High-performance packet processing in user space or the kernel (e.g., AF_XDP, DPDK, VPP)</li> <li>Debugging, profiling, and optimizing systems where throughput and latency matter</li> <li>Building and operating large-scale, reliable, distributed systems</li> <li>Operating what you build: on-call, incident response, and root cause analysis</li> <li>Reading unfamiliar code and safely evolving systems that have been in production for years</li> <li>Owning work end to end, from design through deployment, and working across teams to land shared solutions</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication; we design in written specs and review each other's work</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus points</h2> <ul> <li>Router, switch, or network OS development (e.g., at a network equipment vendor or cloud provider)</li> <li>Network firewalls, IDS/IPS (e.g., Suricata, Snort), or rate limiting</li> <li>L4 load balancing (e.g., Maglev-style consistent hashing, Katran, IPVS)</li> <li>Running large networks: ISPs, data center networks, or backbone operations</li> <li>Contributions to open-source networking projects (e.g., the Linux kernel, DPDK, VPP, FRR)</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,1,0">For Champaign IL based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $210,000.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,2,0">For Washington, DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $230,000.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,3,0">For Seattle, WA based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $230,000.</p> </li> </ul> <ul data-path-to-node="4"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="4,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - 83,000.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="5"><strong data-path-to-node="5" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="6"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,0,0">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="7"><strong data-path-to-node="7" data-index-in-node="0">Benefits</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="8"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,0,0">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,0">Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul data-path-to-node="8,1,1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,0,0">Medical/Rx Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,1,0">Dental Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,2,0">Vision Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,3,0">Flexible Spending Accounts</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,4,0">Commuter Spending Accounts</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,5,0">Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,6,0">On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,7,0">Global Travel Medical Insurance</p> </li> </ul> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,0">Financial Benefits</p> <ul data-path-to-node="8,2,1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,1,0,0">Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,1,1,0">Life & Accident Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,1,2,0">401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,1,3,0">Employee Stock Participation Plan</p> </li> </ul> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,3,0">Time Off</p> <ul data-path-to-node="8,3,1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,3,1,0,0">Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,3,1,1,0">Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</

title: Senior Social & AI Marketeer
description: Jouw impact als Senior Social & AI Marketeer Als Senior Social & AI Marketeer bij Indicia ben je het strategische aanspreekpunt voor grote klanten en vertaal je hun commerciële doelstellingen naar effectieve socialmediastrategieën. Je combineert strategisch advies met een hands-on aanpak en ontwikkelt en optimaliseert campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok. Daarbij werk je met grote mediabudgetten en krijg je volop ruimte om impact te maken. AI speelt een belangrijke rol in jouw werk. Je benut slimme tools en automatisering om campagnes, content en processen continu te verbeteren. Daarnaast signaleer je proactief commerciële kansen bij klanten en deel je jouw kennis en ervaring met junior marketeers. Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan het succes van klanten, maar ook aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team en de dienstverlening van Indicia. Over Indicia Indicia is een onafhankelijk tech, data en AI-bureau dat sinds 1996 organisaties helpt om digitaal te groeien. Vanuit de overtuiging dat succesvolle digitale oplossingen beginnen bij een goed begrip van de business, combineert Indicia technologie, data en ondernemerschap om organisaties verder te brengen. Met ruim 250 digitale specialisten biedt Indicia een breed scala aan diensten, waaronder online marketing, webdevelopment, HubSpot, AI en design. Van het ontwikkelen van websites en digitale platforms tot het realiseren van effectieve marketingcampagnes en slimme automatiseringen. Indicia bedient klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren en richt zich steeds meer op grotere organisaties en langdurige samenwerkingen. De organisatie bevindt zich in een fase van verdere professionalisering, waarbij de focus ligt op het verdiepen van specialismen, het versterken van de strategische klantrelaties en het realiseren van meetbare resultaten. AI speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. Indicia ontwikkelt eigen AI-tools om processen slimmer en efficiënter in te richten, waardoor meer ruimte ontstaat voor strategisch advies, innovatie en klantontwikkeling. De bedrijfscultuur is informeel, familiair en ondernemend. Collega's werken nauw samen, krijgen veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en worden gestimuleerd om zich zowel persoonlijk als professioneel te ontwikkelen. Tegelijkertijd groeit de ambitie om resultaatgerichter te werken en als organisatie verder te professionaliseren. https://www.indicia.ai/ Jouw verantwoordelijkheden: Ontwikkelen en presenteren van socialmediastrategieën voor grote klanten, waarbij je commerciële doelstellingen vertaalt naar concrete campagnes en meetbare resultaten; Actief bijdragen aan commerciële voorstellen, pitches en pre-salesgesprekken, waarbij je klanten adviseert over de mogelijkheden van social advertising; Fungeren als strategisch en inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, waarbij je periodiek campagneresultaten presenteert en proactief kansen voor upsell en cross-sell signaleert; Zelfstandig opzetten, beheren en optimaliseren van paid social campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok, inclusief het bewaken van instellingen, KPI's en budgetten; Analyseren van campagneresultaten, uitvoeren van A/B-testen en continu verbeteren van performance, conversies en rendement; Samenwerken met het interne AI-lab om AI en automatisering slim toe te passen binnen campagnes, contentcreatie, budgetoptimalisatie en werkprocessen; Signaleren en toepassen van nieuwe ontwikkelingen binnen social advertising en AI, waarbij je ook de verbinding legt met andere online marketingdisciplines, zoals SEO en SEA; Coachen en begeleiden van junior social marketeers, kennis delen en bijdragen aan hun professionele ontwikkeling; Aanbrengen van structuur, stimuleren van eigenaarschap en bewaken van de kwaliteit binnen het social team. Jouw plek binnen de organisatie: Als ervaren collega ben je een vraagbaak en sparringpartner voor de junior social marketeers. Je deelt je kennis over social en AI, en helpt hen zo verder te groeien. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Sophie Mees, Delivery Manager Online Marketing. Requirements Je bent een enthousiaste en ondernemende persoonlijkheid die energie brengt, initiatief neemt en het team weet mee te nemen in nieuwe ideeën. Je voelt je thuis in een informele en familiaire werkomgeving en draagt met jouw commerciële drive en resultaatgerichte instelling bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team. Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met paid social advertising, bij voorkeur binnen een groter marketingbureau, waarbij je gewend bent te werken met aanzienlijke mediabudgetten; Uitgebreide kennis van advertentieplatforms zoals Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok en ervaring met het zelfstandig opzetten, beheren en optimaliseren van campagnes; Een analytische instelling en aantoonbare ervaring met campagneanalyse, A/B-testen en performanceoptimalisatie; Een sterke strategische en commerciële blik, waarbij je businessdoelstellingen vertaalt naar effectieve socialmediastrategieën en kansen voor klantgroei signaleert; Ervaring als strategisch gesprekspartner voor klanten op management- en directieniveau, gecombineerd met sterke communicatieve en presentatievaardigheden; Een AI-minded en tech-savvy instelling, waarbij je AI actief inzet voor contentontwikkeling, campagneoptimalisatie en het automatiseren van werkprocessen; Ervaring met het coachen en begeleiden van junior collega's en het delen van vakinhoudelijke kennis; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Benefits Bij Indicia kom je terecht in een informele en ambitieuze werkomgeving waar je de vrijheid krijgt om initiatief te nemen en écht impact te maken. Je werkt voor aansprekende klanten, krijgt de ruimte om te experimenteren met de nieuwste AI-tools en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de dienstverlening. Een passend salaris; Een dienstverband van 32 tot 40 uur per week; 25 vakantiedagen, aangevuld met extra vrije dagen voor gezamenlijke bedrijfsactiviteiten; Arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd; Pensioenregeling 100% bijdrage door werkgever; Reiskostenvergoeding voor zowel auto als openbaar vervoer; Laptop van de zaak (MacBook of Windows); Dagelijks lunch, regelmatig leuke borrels, en de (buitenlands) bedrijfstrip! Contact René de Boer #LI-RD1 Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. title: Interim Senior Community Manager
description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues. What you’ll be doing You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline. The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues. You’ll be: Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline. Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch. Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers. Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand. Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social. Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them. Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off. Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts. What we’re looking for Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you. 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch. Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs. You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow. A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it. Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR. A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams. Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract. A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures. Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own. Curious to apply? Apply directly through our careers page . We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice. If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you. To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential. In the meantime If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values? Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com . Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Why Customs Matters More Than Ever</strong></h3> <p>International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis—sparked by Trump-era tariffs—has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.</p> <p>That’s where we come in. The <strong>Customs Technology team</strong> at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.</p> <h2>The opportunity: </h2> <p>Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.</p> <p>Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. technology</li> <li>Knowledge of performance benchmarking ; Previous experience in testing, measuring, and/or simulating hardware performance and an understanding of no-stone-left-unturned experimentation</li> <li>Knowledge of bash, python and basic Linux task automation</li> <li>Knowledge of Redfish, IPMI and server remote management protocols, and experience with firmware updates</li> <li>Curiosity and desire to learn about the Cloudflare hardware and products used by 20% of all web sites</li> <li>Desire to learn how a diverse server fleet is managed at scale with tools such as traffic management, capacity planning and failover mechanisms</li> <li>Desire to learn the tools Cloudflare uses to maintain and monitor our hardware</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> Jira</li> <li>Experience in a hyperscale cloud infrastructure role also valuable</li> <li>Knowledge of debugging server hardware faults and the ability to engage with our sourcing team and vendors to improve quality</li> <li>Knowledge of XPU/accelerator architectures is a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> description: We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing. With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors. As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers. We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them. Our Tech Stack At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development. Delivery : Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. Direction : Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose. Talent : Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent. Culture : Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture. Craft : Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends. AI-first engineering : Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams. Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design. Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work. Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. Participate in the design and evolution of cybersecurity solutions, architectures and service models. Support the team in complex technical customer opportunities where senior cybersecurity expertise is required. 4. Enterprise Customer & Cybersecurity Escalation Point Act as a senior cybersecurity point of contact for key enterprise customers. Be comfortable going into customer environments and engaging directly with technical teams, cybersecurity teams, IT leaders and executives. Lead or support customer discussions around cybersecurity strategy, architecture, compliance, cyber risk and major requirements. Act as the escalation point for critical cybersecurity topics, incidents and customer concerns. Be able to discuss technical cybersecurity topics at depth with experienced customer cyber and IT professionals. Build trust with customers by bringing strong technical expertise, credibility and business understanding. 6. Lead, coach and develop the cybersecurity team, creating a culture of technical excellence, ownership and continuous improvement. Stay current on relevant cyber threats, attacker techniques, technologies, regulations and industry standards, and translate them into actionable priorities for KIDAN. title: Platform Engineer - Data Resilience and Recovery platform
description: <p>Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable<br><br>Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? At Schuberg Philis, the world is shifting from traditional backup to data security and resilience. We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us build the next generation of our platform.<br><br>About the Team<br><br>The DMS team builds and runs a shared, fully segregated data resilience platform that serves more than 20 of our customers. Customer teams consume it through self-service, and they handle their own day-to-day backup and restore operations. That means you won’t spend your days on job monitoring, restore tickets or backup schedules. Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on.<br><br>You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership: you design it, you build it, you run it.<br><br>The Challenge<br><br>Running one platform for 20+ customers means solving the hard problems of platform engineering:</p> <ul> <li>Multi-tenancy by design: strict isolation of data, access, and performance between customers, on shared infrastructure.</li> <li>Self-service at scale: APIs, guardrails and automation that let customer teams onboard and operate independently, without tickets.</li> <li>Scale and resilience: 4,000+ protected endpoints and more than 25,000 recovery points generated daily, on a dedicated private cloud spanning multiple availability zones.</li> <li>Heterogeneous workloads: Oracle, MS-SQL, SAP, Sybase, PaaS, container platforms and VMs across VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Modern storage back-ends: public cloud services and S3-compatible object storage built on Pure FlashBlade//S and NetApp StorageGRID in our own datacenters, plus a long-term archiving tier.</li> <li>Security first: immutability, segregation and hardening in a highly secure environment where recoverability is the ultimate guarantee.</li> </ul> <p>Your Role<br><br>As a Platform Engineer, you take full responsibility for the lifecycle of the platform: architecture, deployment, evolution and reliability. You treat the platform as a product: you improve features, drive innovation and keep the user experience of customer teams in mind. You work closely with technology vendors (primarily Commvault) and push their product teams to improve, while applying standardized guardrails, driving automation and following best-in-class practices.<br><br>Your focus is on making day-2 operations simple and cost-effective, so there is room to implement new security features, streamline customer onboarding and enable new projects. You also guide customers in their data protection needs, contribute to RFIs/RFPs, and help scope and design new solutions.<br><br>What You’ll Do</p> <ul> <li>Own the architecture and lifecycle of a multi-tenant data resilience platform, in line with our plan-build-run methodology.</li> <li>Design and ship self-service capabilities that customer teams use independently, end to end.</li> <li>Automate everything repeatable: deployments, tenant onboarding, configuration and platform operations, using Infrastructure as Code.</li> <li>Ensure platform availability, aiming for 100% uptime and maximum customer satisfaction.</li> <li>Evolve a diverse storage back-end across public cloud and on-prem S3-compatible solutions.</li> <li>Enable customers to protect workloads on VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and more.</li> <li>Work with vendor product teams and drive their roadmaps.</li> <li>Provide hands-on advisory and technical support, contribute to RFI/RFP processes, and help design new solutions.</li> </ul> <p>Who Are You?</p> <ul> <li>First and foremost, you are a platform engineer at heart, and you like building things other engineers rely on. A passion for data protection, security and resilience is a plus, and you’ll grow it here.</li> <li>You enjoy teamwork, thrive on challenges and like collaborating with both peers and customers.</li> <li>You’re comfortable in highly secure, complex environments.</li> <li>You have a solid understanding of multi-tenant architectures and security concepts.</li> <li>You are proficient in Linux and/or Windows ecosystems.</li> <li>You have experience across private (VMware/OpenStack) and public cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).</li> <li>You’re skilled in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible and/or Chef) and in scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.).</li> <li>Experience with data management/protection tools is valuable, whether Commvault, Rubrik or similar, but not a must. We’ll teach you the domain; you bring the engineering craft.</li> </ul> <p>More information?<br><br>Do not hesitate to call Maggie: 06 23 75 70 86.</p> <p><em>Only application submitted through the website will be considered. </em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics. </em><br><em> </em><br><em>It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description: Ben jij ready voor Change? Bij Change zoeken we een Talent acquisition Lead die recruitment naar een hoger niveau brengt. Je werft zelf actief mee en bent daarnaast de senior op de afdeling: je coacht junior recruiters, brengt structuur aan in de dagelijkse operatie en helpt het team groeien in eigenaarschap, kwaliteit en resultaat. Daarmee maak je meteen helder: dit is geen gewone recruiterrol, maar een combinatie van zelf doen, richting geven en mensen beter maken . Hier ga je werken: Bij Change kom je terecht in een energieke en snelgroeiende organisatie waar ontwikkeling, samenwerking en beweging centraal staan. We werken voor bekende merken zoals Marktplaats, Odido en Eneco en zorgen iedere dag voor de beste klantbeleving. Onze organisatie groeit hard en recruitment speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We zoeken daarom iemand die zelf stevig in de werving staat, maar ook het recruitmentteam verder helpt ontwikkelen. Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management, HR en collega-recruiters. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte om mee te denken en de kans om zichtbaar impact te maken op de groei van Change. Waar ben je verantwoordelijk voor? Actieve sourcing en hunting Je zoekt actief naar commercieel talent via LinkedIn, jobboards en netwerken. Je weet latent werkzoekenden te vinden en te enthousiasmeren voor Change. Coaching en ontwikkeling van het recruitmentteam Je begeleidt en coacht recruiters in sourcing, selectie, stakeholdermanagement en kandidaatcommunicatie. Je deelt kennis en helpt het team groeien in kwaliteit en eigenaarschap. Operationele aansturing Je brengt structuur aan, bewaakt de voortgang van vacatures en helpt het team prioriteiten stellen. Businesspartner voor sales en operatie Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management en HR en vertaalt personeelsbehoeften naar effectieve recruitmentacties. Candidate experience Je zorgt voor een professioneel en persoonlijk recruitmentproces waarin kandidaten zich gezien voelen. Procesverbetering en data Je optimaliseert recruitmentprocessen en gebruikt data om resultaten en effectiviteit te verbeteren. Talentpools Je bouwt aan talentpools voor commerciële en specialistische functies, zodat we ook op de lange termijn succesvol kunnen blijven werven. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat wij bij elkaar passen. Herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden? Eerlijk – Je communiceert open, duidelijk en betrouwbaar. Beweging – Je pakt aan, denkt vooruit en brengt energie in elk project. Anders – Je ziet mogelijkheden, durft te vernieuwen en houdt het praktisch. Expertise – Je werkt gestructureerd, deelt kennis en maakt dingen af. Wat breng je mee? Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen recruitment, bij voorkeur in een dynamische, commerciële of snelgroeiende organisatie. title: Senior PMO Analyst
description: About the Role Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies. Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth. Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization. At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. What You'll Do Program Planning & Execution Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control. Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs. Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early. Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution. PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use. Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery. Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow. Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity. Risk, Issue & Performance Management Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges. Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time. Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership. Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention. AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking. Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate. Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs. Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making. Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned. Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders. Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration. Requirements What You'll Need Required Qualifications & Experience At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls. Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management. A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace. Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment. Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken. Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms. Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations. Eligibility to work in Switzerland. Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations. Strong Plus Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies. Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms. Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes. Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management. Nice to Have Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe. Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries. Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations. Who You Are You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results. You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle. You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture. You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans. You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations. You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward. You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation. You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables. You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company. You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues. You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs. What We Offer A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction. The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth. Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs. The chance to join a high-performing, international team working on advanced aerospace and defense technologies that matter. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
