title: Technical Marketing Engineer
description: The role Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories. You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market. Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications. This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams. Your mission Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable. You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it. The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate. What you will do Drive technical co-builds with partners Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept. Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks. Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure. Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories. Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets. Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility. Produce technical marketing content Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives. Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations. Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets. Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember. Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity. Build for the audience Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work. Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype. Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance. Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology. Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication. What we are looking for A strong engineering background The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred. Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems. Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video. A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation. Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value. Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams. The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept. Excellent written and spoken English. This role may suit you if You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing. You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value. You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market. You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems. You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message. This role is probably not for you if Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations. You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it. You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete. You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes. How the role complements Product Marketing Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity. The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content. What success looks like Within the first year, you will have: Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners. Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities. Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos. Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance. Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Territory Account Executive, Bengaluru
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p class="p2"><strong>Please note: This role will require you to be based in Bengaluru.<br><br></strong></p> <div>About the Department Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</div> <div> </div> <div>Based in Bengaluru, you will drive sales into commercial and enterprise accounts across Karnataka and South India for Cloudflare’s solutions. Your strategic selling activities will include "hunter" type activities to proactively penetrate target named accounts, detailed account planning, focused relationship building and leading effective sales campaigns to successful closure of high-value, multi-product architectural transformations.</div> <div>The ideal candidate will possess both a major account sales background in technology solutions, primarily software and cloud-based, that enables them to drive engagement with senior level decision makers (CISOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering) within Cloudflare’s target customers. Industry experience selling into Digital Natives, IT/ITES, SaaS scale-ups, and other Enterprise verticals is desired in this role. You must be capable of orchestrating complex six-figure ($100K+) expansions encompassing Zero Trust/SASE, Developer Platforms (Workers/R2), and Application Security.</div> <div> </div> <div>As an Account Executive, you'll be responsible for developing and executing against a Sales strategy/plan for assigned vertical or accounts, as well as driving large account sales into India markets to achieve revenue targets. Therefore, you must have a strong network of contacts with decision makers in enterprise accounts across the region, and have experience selling complex solutions to these accounts. YYou will have an intuitive understanding and experience with the key business and technical needs of these large accounts and will create and deliver compelling value propositions to them for Cloudflare solutions, specifically targeting competitive displacements</div> <div> </div> <div>Additional responsibilities will include</div> <ul> <li> <div>Manage complex contract negotiations for high-AOV, multi-product enterprise deals</div> </li> <li> <div>Maintain a robust sales pipeline through proactive outbound targeting and whitespace mining within your installed base</div> </li> <li> <div>Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts to convert variable usage into committed enterprise contracts</div> </li> <li> <div>Collaborate closely with the regional partner ecosystem (e.g., Tech Data, Softcell) to accelerate deal velocity</div> </li> <li> <div>< 50% travel</div> </li> </ul> <div>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</div> <ul> <li> <div>Bachelor's degree required</div> </li> <li> <div>Fluent in English</div> </li> <li> <div>Relevant direct experience, track record, and relationships within corporate enterprise accounts in the India market (specifically Karnataka and South India)</div> </li> <li> <div>Minimum 10 years of direct B2B selling experience, preferably managing internet, cloud, and security accounts</div> </li> <li> <div>Direct experience selling network security, Zero Trust/SASE (Cloudflare One), and/or CDN / Application Security solutions preferred</div> </li> <li> <div>Proven track record of executing competitive takeout campaigns against legacy hardware and cloud point solutions</div> </li> <li> <div>Prior experience being part of an early sales team helping drive traction in India market for a US-based SaaS company highly preferred</div> </li> <li> <div>Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles and cross-functional evaluations</div> </li> <li> <div>Basic understanding of computer networking, cloud architectures, and “how the internet works”</div> </li> <li> <div>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus)</div> </li> <li> <div>Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organisational skills</div> </li> <li> <div>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</div> </li> <li> <div>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment</div> </li> </ul> <p class="p2"> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Candidate Experience Specialist, Team Lead (APJ)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As the Candidate Experience Team Lead for [Region], you'll own how candidates experience GitLab across your region by raising the capability of the specialists around you. You'll set the quality bar, balance workloads, onboard and develop specialists, and serve as the first escalation point when a process breaks down or a candidate situation needs judgment. You'll stay hands-on with interview coordination, background checks, and offers, while spending most of your time making the regional function run well. You'll use candidate experience data to surface patterns and risks to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement, and partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global process. At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Lead Candidate Experience Specialists in [Region], setting and modeling standards for interview coordination, candidate communication, contract and offer accuracy, and data hygiene in the applicant tracking system.</li> <li value="2">Balance coordination work across the regional team, monitor capacity against hiring volume, and flag resourcing gaps to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement before they affect candidates.</li> <li value="3">Resolve escalated scheduling conflicts, candidate issues, and process gaps, bringing clear recommendations to leadership when further support is needed.</li> <li value="4">Own onboarding, ramp, and ongoing development for new specialists through documentation, shadowing, and direct feedback on work quality.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate interviews, prepare offers and employment contracts, manage background and reference checks, and partner with People Operations on the handoff to onboarding.</li> <li value="6">Build and maintain reporting on candidate satisfaction, specialist response times, scheduling turnaround, and data accuracy to identify patterns, bottlenecks, and risks.</li> <li value="7">Partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global coordination process, contribute regional evidence to process and tooling improvements, implement agreed changes, and keep documentation accurate in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.</li> <li value="8">Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations across time zones to keep hiring moving, modeling GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Substantial experience in candidate experience or recruiting coordination, covering interview scheduling, offer and contract preparation, background checks, and onboarding handoffs, including serving as a senior or go-to team member.</li> <li value="2">Ability to lead and develop team members without formal authority through mentoring, onboarding, direct feedback, and influence.</li> <li value="3">Attention to detail in scheduling, contracts, and candidate data, with a record of professionalism, responsiveness, sound judgment under pressure, and maintaining confidentiality.</li> <li value="4">Experience anticipating risks, resolving scheduling and process problems early, prioritizing competing demands, and setting clear expectations about timelines, next steps, and trade-offs.</li> <li value="5">Experience building and maintaining candidate experience or scheduling reports, using data to identify bottlenecks and make a case for change.</li> <li value="6">Experience working across regions or functions to standardize processes, with the judgment to distinguish genuine regional requirements from inconsistent practices.</li> <li value="7">Clear written and verbal communication with candidates and stakeholders at all levels, including executives, and the ability to build collaborative relationships across functions and time zones.</li> <li value="8">Proficiency with an applicant tracking system or interview tool for scheduling, tracking, and stage management, plus Google Workspace and scheduling tools, and a willingness to learn additional tools. Greenhouse and ModernLoop experience is beneficial but not required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our Candidate Experience team supports candidates through interview coordination, offers and contracts, background and reference checks, and the transition to onboarding. As regional leads and specialists, we partner with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations to deliver a consistent global candidate experience. We work across time zones, using transparent documentation in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories to collaborate asynchronously. Our regional leads work together to resolve process differences and bring regional evidence into global improvements.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Director, Global Operations Excellence
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. title: Stage Consumentengedrag
description: Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat? Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten. Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen. En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken! 🌱 Wat ga je doen? Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen? Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld: consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren; onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden; ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen; onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop; kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid; kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen; jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen. Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen. De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding. Goed om te weten; onze farm is nog volop in ontwikkeling, we zitten nog in onze start-up/scale-up fase. Dit betekent dat je naast je onderzoek ook tijd zult besteden aan andere zaken in onze farm. Dit geldt niet alleen voor jou als stagiair maar voor ons hele team. Zo draait iedereen uit kantoor maandelijks een shift in de farm, waarbij we helpen met zaaien, oogsten of verpakken. 🌱 Wat kun je van ons verwachten? Een unieke stageplek; wij bouwen aan de toekomst van voedselproductie; Je wordt onderdeel van een klein team, er wordt naar je ideëen en input geluisterd; We werken fulltime vanaf onze farm in Amsterdam; Een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van 500 euro, we vergoeden geen andere zaken; Veel ruimte en tijd voor creativiteit en een ‘ga het maar proberen!' mentaliteit Een gezellige werksfeer waarin we graag samen na werk nog leuke dingen ondernemen 🌱 Wat breng jij? Je volgt een HBO of WO opleiding in Nederland en staat daar ingeschreven gedurende de hele stage periode. Qua studies denken wij in de richting marketing, bedrijfskunde of (commerciële) psychologie, maar wie weet volg jij een andere studie die ook goed aansluit 🙂 Fulltime beschikbaar voor 4 of 5 maanden, startdatum december 2026 of januari of februari 2027 Je hebt je rijbewijs B; je zult veel op pad zijn om supermarkten te bezoeken Een flinke portie nieuwsgierigheid Je bent sociaal; je stapt makkelijk op mensen af en maakt een praatje met ze Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt je ook goed redden in het Engels Je bent een zelf-starter; we zullen je uiteraard begeleiden tijdens je stage, maar het initiatief voor de invulling en aanpak ligt bij jou Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager Insurance P&C
description: Insify is looking for a smart, ambitious and relentlessly driven Insurance Product Manager to join our team. In this role you’ll be a driving force behind our product expansions and building the digital platform for SME insurance. A rare opportunity to take real ownership in a fast-scaling European insurtech and shape outcomes that matter. At Insify, we build insurance for entrepreneurs because we are entrepreneurs ourselves. We know what it’s like to build something from scratch, to take risks, and to carry responsibility that doesn’t switch off at 5 pm. Our mission is simple but ambitious: to make business insurance 10x simpler, faster, and fairer for entrepreneurs and SMEs across Europe . No paperwork. No fine print. No legacy complexity. Just modern software, smart automation, and a relentless focus on the customer. We are a high-growth European scale-up , backed by €43M from world-class investors , on a mission to become a global leader in digital insurance for entrepreneurs and SMEs. Starting in the Netherlands, we’ve expanded into France and Germany, and we’re only accelerating from here. At our core, we’re a tech company . We build our own insurtech platform and rely heavily on data, automation, and AI to redesign the end-to-end insurance experience: from underwriting to claims. Combined with a fully digital customer portal and strong UX, we’re turning insurance into something surprisingly simple, transparent, and fair. We’re led by seasoned entrepreneurs who’ve built and scaled companies before, and we bring that same ambition, urgency, and ownership mindset to everything we do. What you'll be doing: Insify is looking for an entrepreneurial and analytical Product Manager to drive the growth and evolution of our Property & Casualty (P&C) portfolio . This role focuses on the essential "bread and butter" products for SMEs: including General Liability, Professional Indemnity, and Property insurance. Unlike traditional PM roles, you won't just be managing features; you will be the "CEO" of your products. You will bridge the gap between complex insurance logic and a seamless digital user experience. You use your deep understanding of our customers and data native approach to translate technical policy wordings and insurance products into automated underwriting flows and digital-first customer journeys taking away the complexity for our customers. This is a perfect role for someone with a background in business operations, consulting, or insurance who wants to move into a high-growth tech environment and take tangible ownership of a product's performance. What you’ll be up to (some examples): Drive Product Strategy: Manage the roadmap for your products, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant, and easy to purchase online. Optimize the Funnel: Use data to identify friction points in the application process and work with Design and Tech to improve conversion rates. Scale New Markets: Support the launch of our digital proposition into new European markets, adapting local requirements into our scalable core platform. Stakeholder Management: Coordinate between Insurance, Tech, Marketing, and Customer Ops to ensure a unified product vision and smooth execution. Monitor Performance: Track loss ratios, retention, and customer feedback to iterate on the product and pricing strategy. This role is a strong fit if you are a "doer" who loves to solve puzzles. You can dive deep into the fine print of an insurance policy one hour and brainstorm a new UI flow with a developer the next. Specifically, you bring: 2–4 years of experience in a high-growth startup or strategy consulting (Insurance, Fintech, or E-commerce preferred). Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable with Excel/data tools and use metrics to back up your decisions. Product Curiosity: You don't need to be a coder, but you should be excited about how APIs, automated underwriting, and LLMs can transform insurance. Bias for Action: You prefer "shipping and iterating" over "analyzing and waiting." Communication: Excellent English skills (Dutch, German, or French is a major plus given our European footprint). Educational Background: A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field. Who this is not for: You prioritize a 40-hour work week : We operate in a high-intensity 'startup-plus' environment. This isn't a standard 9-to-5; driving global impact here requires a level of dedication and 'always-on' spirit that goes well beyond the typical 40-hour work week. You prefer your comfort zone : We operate at the edge of our capabilities; if you aren't comfortable with constant change and being challenged, you won’t thrive here. You prefer to stay high-level : While this is a strategic role, no task is too small. If you aren't willing to roll up your sleeves and get into the "weeds" of execution, this isn't the right fit. A steep learning curve feels daunting : We move fast and use cutting-edge AI; you need to be an aggressive self-learner who can master new domains in days, not months. What we offer: Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that. In-office - come join us in our HQ in the center of Amsterdam. Grow in a growing company - there’s no better place to develop your talents and learn new skills. Help us show the world that insurance can be simple, transparent and trustworthy. Experienced entrepreneurs - work with experienced and dedicated entrepreneurs as part of an international team. Energetic environment - as a start-up, we’re different from your usual insurers. We scale rapidly and you can pick your own initiatives, helping us grow as we help more and more customers across Europe. Our culture (read this carefully) We’re not just building a company, we’re building a category leader . That comes with ambition, responsibility, and pace. Our culture is defined by three things: High ownership People own problems end-to-end. If something is unclear or broken, we don’t wait - we step in and fix it. High pace Priorities shift, and decisions are made quickly. We value momentum and learning over perfection. High standards Outcomes matter more than optics. We care about results, quality, and follow-through. At the same time, you won’t be doing this alone . We believe great work happens through close collaboration . We work in-person, challenge each other’s ideas, and expect contributions from everywhere, regardless of title or tenure. The best ideas often come from unexpected places, and we create space for them to surface. This is a human-sized company . You’ll know the people you work with, you’ll be able to walk over to anyone to ask a question or test an idea, and you’ll be part of the day-to-day energy of building together: from whiteboard discussions to shared lunches, dogs in the office, and moments to pause and reset. We hire smart, ambitious people who think like owners, value intellectual honesty, and are motivated by impact rather than comfort. If you enjoy challenge, responsibility, and building something meaningful with others, you’ll likely thrive here. If you’re looking for predictability, narrow scopes, or a guaranteed 9-to-5, this likely won’t be the right fit - and that’s okay. We’d rather be honest upfront. description: About Insify We are a start-up offering an end-to-end digital insurance platform focussing solely on European entrepreneurs and SMEs. Everything we do is driven by our core values: grit , impact , care , and entrepreneurship . We show up with passion and perseverance. We solve real problems and put people first—especially our customers. And we’re always looking for smarter, faster, more human ways to do things. That’s also why we’ve chosen a pro-office approach. From spontaneous brainstorms to shared lunches, being in the same space makes the magic happen. Joining Insify means being part of a team that truly backs each other and the entrepreneurs we serve. If you’re ready to grow, innovate, and help reshape the insurance industry from the inside out—we’d love to meet you. Insurance Team We’re the team making insurance work for everyone and everything. At Insify, our Insurance crew is all about making sure the right coverages are available, affordable, and actually make sense for today’s entrepreneurs. We’re the bridge between customer needs and carrier capabilities—constantly exploring, negotiating, and building better insurance solutions. From partnering with top carriers to developing our own products, we ensure our platform delivers complete, seamless coverage. Whether it’s a roofer in Rotterdam or a freelance designer in Berlin, we’re here to make sure no one’s left out. Our team includes insurance pros, actuaries, and product ops experts working hand-in-hand with product, legal, and compliance to reshape insurance from the inside out. About the Role This is your chance to work in a dynamic company where innovation and precision go hand in hand to disrupt the insurance industry. You'll be part of our Insurance team, as lead to ensure the scalability and sustainability of our portfolio optimizing both the bottom and top lines. We are a data-driven company and we don’t lose time on tasks with little to no value therefore, on top of modeling the risk, price elasticity, customer lifetime value, and other key business drivers and trends, you will also be supporting the full End-to-end automation, set up of proper data flows, tooling and overall pricing platform solution. What you will be doing Pricing and Underwriting: Develop and refine pricing models, ensuring accurate underwriting and profitability while optimizing for growth. Dig for and leverage internal and external data to develop predictive models that enhance pricing strategies and improve portfolio performance. Evaluate and propose new ideas and collaborate with the team to develop and push in production innovative solutions (pricing elasticity and optimisation, behaviour and fraud scoring, exposure-based dynamic pricing…), Work with internal stakeholders to integrate actuarial insights into product, tech, regulatory compliance, and overall company strategy. Follow market trends to recommend adjustments to pricing and products. Lead relationships with risk carriers to drive impactful results. Be part, with the pricing team, of the development of our End-to-end, fully automated, pricing and analytics platform leveraging on data and innovative in-house proprietary solutions to scale in a sustainable and efficient way and always stay ahead of competition. What you'll need Actuarial diploma (or equivalent). 2–3+ years of experience in pricing and underwriting within Property & Casualty insurance or Life Insurance. Strong data analytics skills and a passion for leveraging data to drive innovation. A global mindset with exposure to developed insurance markets (e.g., UK, Germany, France) with a desire to disrupt a slow-moving industry. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a desire to build new things. Strong interpersonal skills—smooth communication and collaboration are key! Fluent in English Bonus points if you: Have experience with both risk and commercial price modeling. +2 points if you also have experience with survival models. Master in Python and/or R and/or SQL What we offer Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that. Pension plan - participation to Insify’s Pension Plan, with 6% employer contribution. Travel reimbursement - we help travelers with their commute. Hybrid - Possibility to work from home two times a week. 25 holidays days per year - (+ extra day on Christmas eve if it’s a weekday!) Subscription to Alleo - 50 EUR (net) monthly (cumulable) budget to spend on what you like - anything from gym memberships to UberEats! Quickly develop your career - there’s no better place to develop. We are growing and you can grow with us! Inhouse leadership programs and coaching High degree of autonomy - it’s time to ACTUALLY make an impact! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. title: Innovation Internship
description: About the role At SkyNRG, we’re on a mission leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high‑integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF). Our Innovation team plays a key role in this mission by scouting, assessing and developing technologies that can scale SAF production and strengthen the industry’s sustainability performance. As an Intern within the Innovation team, you will perform research focused on the sustainability performance of innovative technology routes to SAF. During this internship, you will build a framework for Life Cycle Analysis of various SAF production routes and evaluate the GHG reduction potential and fit with European Policy frameworks for selected routes. You will work closely with a technically skilled and experienced Innovation team and report directly to our Senior Analyst, Dusita de Hoop. This internship offers the opportunity to apply academic knowledge in a real‑world context, collaborate with industry experts, and contribute to innovation at the forefront of sustainable aviation. Your Responsibilities: Life Cycle Assessment: Build a framework to assess life cycle performance of various innovative SAF production routes. GHG reduction calculation : Calculate the GHG reduction potential of selected SAF production routes Policy Fit : asses the fit of selected SAF production routes with European SAF policy such as REFUELEU Aviation. Team collaboration: Work closely with external partners, contributing findings, insights and ideas to ongoing research and development activities. Your profile You recognize yourself in the following: Master’s student with a background in science or engineering (enrolled for the full duration of the internship) Strong interest in renewable fuels, energy transition or sustainable technologies Experience or academic exposure with Life Cycle Analysis and GHG reduction calculations is a must. Able to work independently, strong analytical skillset and a structured approach to complex technical questions Comfortable working with Excel, Word and PowerPoint Fluent in English, both written and spoken Full-time availability for a 6-month internship starting 15th of February 2027 About SkyNRG Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel. Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions. Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards. At SkyNRG, you’ll find: An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF What we offer We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet. title: Commercial Account Executive (Austin, TX or Raleigh, NC)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX or Raleigh, NC</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Department</strong></h3> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <p><strong>About this Role</strong></p> <p>AEs are positioned to drive in-depth product discussions while communicating and demonstrating value quickly to customers.  This role within this segment focuses on both the acquisition of prospective Commercial accounts, as well as the expansion of existing customer accounts.  The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.  </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop, execute, and maintain your territory plan to exceed quarterly sales targets and annual quota assignment.</li> <li>Be an expert in three unique sales motions; new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory.</li> <li>Build a robust sales pipeline utilizing the four sourcing funnels: AE led outbound, BDR, Channel, and Marketing Inbound.</li> <li>Develop and strategically leverage a deep technical understanding of the problems Cloudflare solves in order to drive a consultative sales motion.</li> <li>Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates. </li> <li>Accurately forecast, build commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations.</li> <li>As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews. </li> <li>Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers.</li> <li>Position Cloudflare's platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer.</li> <li>Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years sales experience selling B2B SaaS </li> <li>Strong B2B discovery skills</li> <li>Candidates have a point of view of industry trends and able to customize a client centric why change narrative</li> <li>Track record of beating annual targets of $1M+ and successfully managing complex six figure deals</li> <li>Experienced in multithreading into the C-suite and across an organization to manage a complex sales cycle</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required </li> <li>Software and system skills are a must (SFDC, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite)</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. You will establish foundations that are testable, well-documented, lightweight, and straightforward for customer engineering teams to integrate and operate.</p> <p>As a senior software engineer, you will set standards for compatibility, diagnostics, performance, and release quality across mobile platforms. You will work closely with product and engineering partners to turn a security problem into a dependable developer product, mentor native mobile engineers, and help resolve complex customer integration issues. You will be successful in this role if you combine strong native engineering judgment and a track record of carrying distributed software from design through production operation.</p> constrained developer-facing products</li> <li>Experience with <strong>mobile platform security concepts</strong>, including app and device integrity, secure key storage, application signing, authentication, and secure communications</li> <li>Familiarity with native <strong>mobile networking stacks</strong>, HTTP APIs, and the integration challenges introduced by different application architectures and networking libraries</li> <li>Experience <strong>diagnosing production issues</strong> that cross application, SDK, network, and service boundaries, while designing safe diagnostics native SDKs are consumed by cross-platform frameworks such as <strong>React Native and Flutter</strong> is a plus</li> <li>Familiarity with lower-level languages like <strong>C++ or Rust for high-performance</strong>, cross-platform security modules is a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. title: IT Operations Engineer
description: <p>At IMC, technology is not a department; it’s at the heart of everything we do. Developed in-house, our innovative software makes millions of trading decisions daily, and we win by making better and faster decisions than our competition. Our on-site IT Support team helps us move at a higher pace and quality each day, from hands-on support for end users to configuring and automating our systems to scale our support capabilities.</p> <p>In this fully on-site position, you are the first person people come to with any IT issue, whether it’s a MacBook, a SaaS application, identity and access management, or hardware and AV. You’ll work across a wide range of SaaS and custom systems. To succeed and grow, you take ownership, work autonomously, and keep improving an IT environment that runs smoothly and is ready to scale. </p> <p><strong>Your Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>First-to-third line support for our users, mainly on macOS.</li> <li>Managing and supporting our end-user platform, including Microsoft 365, Okta (SSO, MFA, lifecycle management), Slack and the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management).</li> <li>Device management and patching: Jamf for macOS and Intune for phones, including enrollment, configuration profiles, app deployment and compliance.</li> <li>Onboarding and offboarding, including account provisioning, access management and device setup.</li> <li>Installing, setting up and servicing hardware and peripherals, including laptops, monitors, printers, and audio and video conferencing systems.</li> <li>Troubleshooting, escalating and documenting network and connectivity issues.</li> <li>Automating repetitive tasks and keeping knowledge base articles and runbooks in Confluence up to date.</li> <li>Organizing and performing desk moves, room setups and physical equipment moves.</li> <li>Everything else that keeps us moving.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in an ICT-related field (BSc level ideally), or an equivalent qualification such as Informatiker/in EFZ.</li> <li>At least one year of experience in a similar role in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Strong macOS knowledge and hands-on experience with JAMF (Pro).</li> <li>Experience with Microsoft 365 administration and Intune; working knowledge of Windows.</li> <li>Familiarity with Okta or a similar identity provider (SSO, SCIM, MFA).</li> <li>Experience administering or supporting Slack and the Atlassian suite.</li> <li>Scripting experience (Bash, Zsh, Python or PowerShell) is a plus, and so is Linux experience.</li> <li>Excellent troubleshooting and diagnostic skills, with the ability to solve problems creatively and proactively.</li> <li>Willingness to take on physical tasks such as desk moves and room setups.</li> <li>A strong drive to grow (at IMC we are committed to helping with that).</li> <li>You work autonomously, with a sense of urgency, and prioritize based on business needs.</li> <li>Available and willing to work on-site full-time in Zug.</li> <li>Proficient in written and spoken English; German is a plus.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p><em>IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.</em></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You'll take ideas from concept to production quickly, prove what works, and turn the best of it into patterns the wider engineering organisation can adopt.</p> <p>You'll work closely with product and commercial leaders to find where AI changes the economics of our affiliate marketing platform: what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll be hands-on most of the time, writing code, shipping and measuring results, rather than coordinating others.</p> <p>You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real.</p> <p><strong>This is a step-up opportunity.</strong> We're looking for a bright, self-starting engineer who is ready for more scope than their current role allows. You might not have held a principal title yet. What matters is that you're already building this way, you learn fast, and you want the room to prove it. You'll have direct access to senior leadership, real problems with commercial weight, and the freedom to choose how you solve them.</p> <p><strong>Key tasks and accountabilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Build and ship</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build and run AI-powered products, tools and services from prototype to production</li> <li>Own outcomes end to end: problem framing, architecture, implementation, evaluation, release and operation</li> <li>Run fast, time-boxed experiments; scale what works and stop what doesn't, with the evidence to back either call</li> <li>Set up and evolve the AI infrastructure these builds rely on: model access, evaluation tooling, observability and guardrails</li> </ul> <p><strong>Shape direction</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with the VP Technology to set Awin's engineering-specific AI direction, grounded in what has actually been built and measured</li> <li>Scope strategic opportunities early with product and commercial leaders, with effort, cost and value made explicit</li> <li>Make clear recommendations on build vs buy, model and vendor choice, and where AI should not be used</li> </ul> <p><strong>Architecture and design</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design new capability so it connects safely to the existing platform: APIs, events, data and identity</li> <li>Select tools and technologies, and define the patterns and practices for AI-native development at Awin</li> <li>Weigh long-term maintainability, economic viability and reuse against speed, and document the trade-offs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Spread what works</strong></p> <ul> <li>Turn proven builds into reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, and share them so other teams can adopt them without hand-holding</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ways of working</strong></p> <ul> <li>Works autonomously, guided by the VP Technology's priorities rather than team-level delivery processes</li> <li>Engages directly with engineering, product, data, security and commercial stakeholders as each build requires</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Expertise</strong></p> <p><strong>AI-native engineering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Builds with coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as the default way of working. Can show how they decompose work, manage context and review agent output to get production-quality code at pace</li> <li>Has shipped LLM-powered features to production: prompt and context engineering, tool use and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval (RAG) and multi-step agent workflows</li> <li>Builds evaluations first: test sets, automated evals and regression checks for non-deterministic behaviour, with quality measured before and after release</li> <li>Connects models to enterprise systems and data safely, e.g. MCP servers, internal APIs and event streams, with clear permissions and audit trails</li> <li>Understands model selection, token economics, latency, caching and fallback strategies, and can explain cost and benefit trade-offs to commercial stakeholders</li> <li>Designs for AI-specific security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling under GDPR, and guardrails on what models can do</li> </ul> <p><strong>Engineering foundations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Expert in at least one modern language (Python or TypeScript ideal), and able to work in our existing Java, PHP and JavaScript estate when integrating</li> <li>Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)</li> <li>Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) and with relational and non-relational data stores</li> <li>Builds observability into everything: tracing, logging and monitoring, including LLM-specific telemetry</li> <li>Treats automated testing, CI/CD and secure-by-default design as standard, and automates as much of the delivery loop as possible</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ways of building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop</li> <li>Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft skills</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Bias to action:</strong> ships, measures and iterates rather than waiting for perfect requirements</li> <li><strong>Comfortable with ambiguity:</strong> frames vague opportunities into concrete, testable bets</li> <li><strong>Commercially minded:</strong> connects technical choices to revenue, cost and customer outcomes, and balances effort against value</li> <li><strong>Intellectually honest:</strong> kills their own ideas when the evidence says so, and says plainly where AI is not the answer</li> <li><strong>Clear communicator:</strong> explains technical trade-offs to executives, engineers and commercial teams in language each understands, in writing and in person</li> <li><strong>Influences without authority:</strong> gets teams to adopt new patterns because they work, not because they're mandated</li> </ul> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal multiple countries for this role. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.</p> <p>Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.</p> <p><span class="TextRun Highlight SCXW248400944 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8">Awin is part of the Axel Springer group.</span></span> <span class="TextRun Highlight SCXW248400944 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8">Learn more at </span></span><a class="Hyperlink SCXW248400944 BCX8" href="https://www.axelspringer.com/en/" target="_blank"><span class="TextRun Highlight Underlined SCXW248400944 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8" data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">axelspringer.com/</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW248400944 BCX8" data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">en</span><span class="NormalTextRun SC

title: Media Strategy Manager
description: Company Description At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table. Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand. Job Description Reporting to our Media Strategy Director, you will lead the translation of client briefs into cross-channel digital media plans (programmatic, search, social, video) that deliver and accountable outcomes for our client, including budget and flighting recommendations, audience targeting recommendations, performance forecasts, and channel tactics Your responsibilities will include: Lead the translation of client briefs into cross-channel digital media plans (programmatic, search, social, video) that deliver effective and accountable outcomes for our clients including budget and flighting recommendations, audience targeting recommendations, performance forecasts and channel tactics In partnership with your client leads, you will maintain a working relationship with paid media client partners Lead the collaboration with Jellyfish specialists from market intelligence, investment analytics, and paid media teams to create unique ideas and experiment with new methods and technologies to solve complex issues. Use attribution, media mix modelling and planning tools (GWI, YouGov, Reach Planner, ComScore) to pull audience use, reports and forecast target goals Work with the wider planning and analytics team to create insightful campaign reports with optimisation recommendations while media is live Work with teams (Paid Search, Display, Analytics) to ensure planning follows platform and buying best practices Collaborate with channel and measurement leads on campaign performance reporting to drive results through testing and ongoing optimisation Maintain professional relationships with the publisher and partner community Proactively monitor the digital landscape and identify trends/partners for upcoming campaigns. Qualifications Experience in a media strategy or planning role, or in a cross-channel buying role within an agency or multinational client organization Demonstrated expertise in developing brand, digital marketing and planning strategies, with a fluency in digital media planning An expertise in the use of data and market insights to inform decisions and develop business strategies Experience in generating unique ideas and pushing the agenda or experimental approaches that progress our clients' marketing practices Experience working in close collaboration with diverse team members to achieve common goals, valuing and respecting diverse contributions Experience adapting and integrity to navigate unforeseen challenges Fluency in English is required Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English. Additional Information Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs. 💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme. 💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours. 📈Growth, Your Way: Accumulate one paid day each month (2 hours per week) for self-development and access to Jellyfish Learn. As per standard market practice, all roles in The Netherlands are offered on a 1 year contract with the view to extend or make permanent beyond this point Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name.
