title: Engineering Manager, Customs
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Why Customs Matters More Than Ever</strong></h3> <p>International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis — sparked by Trump-era tariffs — has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.</p> <p>That’s where we come in. The <strong>Customs Technology team</strong> at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.</p> <h3><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h3> <p>Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.</p> <p>Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. Being a tech company, we can move much faster than our competitors, and give our customers the service they expect in this day and age. We can deploy things like LLM agents at scale, in an industry that is ripe to be disrupted by this technology.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <p>As an Engineering Manager in the Customs Technology team, you’ll lead a group of exceptional engineers to:</p> <ul> <li>Build world class tools like our Tariff Simulator, the only tool that gives businesses a real view of landed costs before they ship.</li> <li>Automate customs processes to an unprecedented level. Most customs are text based work, which is what agents excel at. </li> <li>Design scalable systems that automate classification, compliance, and filings—turning weeks of work into seconds.</li> <li>Partner with product, design, and operations to deliver technology that gives clients clarity, cost savings, and risk control.</li> <li>Mentor and grow a world-class 8-10 member engineering team that thrives on solving the hardest problems in logistics.</li> <li>Shape the future of customs into a transparent, efficient, and strategic advantage for businesses worldwide.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Things We ❤️</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leveraging AI in a safe way to eliminate mundane work for customs brokers and automate customs every step of the way</li> <li>Modeling complex and ambiguous domains into fully automated workflows</li> <li>Building highly performant and reliable Kotlin services on our cutting-edge infrastructure platform</li> <li>Collaborating with end users across the globe to create the best possible product: removing toil and surfacing interesting cases</li> </ul> <h3><strong>You Should Have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>3–5 years of experience leading software engineering teams</li> <li>Ability to break down complex problems into actionable plans. You need to go deep into details in a domain completely unfamiliar to you, and come out with an end to end understanding to automate it.</li> <li>Founder Mentality & Ownership: An entrepreneurial instinct. You operate like an owner, thrive in ambiguity, and take ideas from 0 to 1 without needing a predetermined playbook.</li> <li>A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>A bias for action — you see problems and solve them</li> <li>An aptitude for learning quickly (non-optional)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>How We Work</strong></h3> <ul> <li>The latest and greatest hardware and software to support you, including all AI tools.</li> <li>Agile ways of working — without being tied to a single doctrine like Scrum</li> <li>A modern stack: moving from a React/Flow + Ruby on Rails monolith to React/Typescript, Kotlin microservices on Kubernetes. We also use and love GraphQL, gRPC, Postgres, Kafka, and Snowflake.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What’s in It for You?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, with global impact</li> <li>Daily catered lunches (vegetarian options included), breakfast, snacks, coffee/tea and soft drinks in our office</li> <li>Covered commute expenses for employees living outside Amsterdam</li> <li>25 vacation days per year (full-time)</li> <li>Fully paid health insurance (basic and additional packages) through a collective plan</li> <li>A defined pension contribution scheme</li> <li>Equity program: become a shareholder in a multi-trillion-dollar industry disruptor</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (Aetna Resources for Living)</li> <li>Parental leave benefit for both mothers and partners</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="1704749847.557549" class="c-virtual_list__item" data-qa="virtual-list-item" data-item-key="1704749847.557549"> <div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message" data-qa="message_container" data-qa-unprocessed="false" data-qa-placeholder="false"> <div class="c-message_kit__hover" data-qa-hover="true"> <div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <h4>Commitment to Equal Opportunity</h4> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <h4>Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants</h4> <p>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at <a href="http://www.flexport.com/privacy" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://www.flexport.com/privacy&source=gmail&ust=1613840050053000&usg=AFQjCNHD63svlkD-hWHlGuGOM_bSYVrnpw">www.flexport.com/privacy</a> for additional information.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Junior Product Manager
description: Introductie Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? En krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van een productportfolio en het succesvol introduceren van nieuwe producten? Bij FAAC Technologies zoeken we een Junior Product Manager die verantwoordelijk wordt voor de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons productportfolio. In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie. We zoeken iemand die aan het begin van zijn of haar carrière staat en zich verder wil ontwikkelen binnen productmanagement. Of je nu net bent afgestudeerd en klaar bent voor een eerste uitdaging, of al circa 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring hebt opgedaan: enthousiasme, analytisch vermogen, commerciële interesse en de motivatie om je te ontwikkelen vinden we minstens zo belangrijk als ruime werkervaring. In deze veelzijdige hybride functie komen marktinzichten, commerciële analyses en technische kennis samen om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Je krijgt de ruimte om je kennis en ervaring verder uit te bouwen en te groeien in de rol. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Manager Techniek. Wat ga je doen / Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Als Product Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de positionering, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van het productportfolio van FAAC Technologies. Marktbehoeften en productontwikkelingen vertaal je naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat productinformatie, prijzen en communicatie actueel en consistent blijven. Analyseren van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften om deze te vertalen naar het productaanbod Uitvoeren van prijsanalyses en afstemmen van de prijspositionering met internationale productafdelingen Volgen van productontwikkelingen en vertalen van relevante innovaties naar kansen voor de organisatie Afstemmen van productintroducties en de lancering van nieuwe diensten met betrokken teams binnen FAAC Group Begeleiden van processen rondom productintroducties en het uitfaseren van producten Analyseren en optimaliseren van het bestaande productportfolio Coördineren van technische producttrainingen en in kaart brengen van de opleidingsbehoefte binnen de organisatie Leveren van input voor productcommunicatie, waaronder online communicatie en marketingmateriaal Bewaken van de kwaliteit, volledigheid en consistentie van productinformatie Beheren en actualiseren van artikellijsten, prijslijsten en productdocumentatie Zorgen voor toegankelijke en actuele productinformatie voor interne afdelingen en andere betrokkenen Samenwerken met Sales, Marketing, Techniek, internationale productmanagementteams en klanten Naleven van de geldende HSE-richtlijnen en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving Wat bieden wij Bij FAAC Technologies werk je in een stabiele, internationaal opererende en technisch gedreven organisatie met een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid. Een salaris tussen € 4.359,45 en € 6.198,54 bruto per maand , afhankelijk van ervaring 40 vrije dagen (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen) Een goede pensioenregeling via PME, het pensioenfonds voor de Metalektro Een veelzijdige hybride functie op het snijvlak van techniek, commercie en productmanagement De mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling en positionering van een internationaal productportfolio Intensieve samenwerking met verschillende disciplines en internationale teams Een professionele werkomgeving met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling Over FAAC Technologie FAAC Technologies, onderdeel van de wereldwijd opererende FAAC Group , is dé specialist in toegangsautomatisering. Van automatische deuren en poorten tot slagbomen en parkeersystemen – wij leveren innovatieve en veilige oplossingen. Bij FAAC werk je in een informele, technische en dynamische omgeving waar samenwerking en klantgerichtheid centraal staan. De FAAC Group omvat 32 bedrijven in 24 landen , met 18 fabrieken in 15 landen en 3 business units . Dankzij deze internationale schaal ontwikkelen en implementeren wij wereldwijd oplossingen voor personen- en voertuigenverkeer, met een sterke focus op kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid. Wie ben jij HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een commerciële, technische of bedrijfskundige richting. Aan het begin van de carrière, met de ambitie om verder te groeien binnen productmanagement. Een starter of circa 1 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld in productmanagement, productmarketing, sales of een vergelijkbare functie. Affiniteit met technische producten en commerciële vraagstukken. Analytisch sterk en in staat om marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften te doorgronden. Leergierig, initiatiefrijk en bereid om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om met verschillende interne en externe stakeholders samen te werken. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Wat breng je mee Een analytische en nieuwsgierige instelling. Goede organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden. Interesse in markt- en prijsanalyses en productpositionering. Het vermogen om informatie te vertalen naar concrete inzichten en acties. Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte en gestructureerde werkhouding. Oog voor detail en een goed gevoel voor kwaliteit. Het vermogen om technische informatie begrijpelijk te maken voor commerciële en niet-technische collega's. Affiniteit met internationale samenwerking. Solliciteren Zie jij jezelf als Junior Product Manager bij FAAC Technologies en wil je bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling en positionering van onze producten binnen een internationale organisatie? Solliciteer dan via de bekende weg of neem contact met ons op voor meer informatie. We maken graag kennis met je. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. title: Senior Product Manager
description: The challenge An entrepreneur chasing an unpaid invoice in Lagos. A shop owner confirming a shipment in Guangzhou. A consultant navigating a bank's phone menu in London. For a growing share of Talk360's 6 million+ users, a call is how they get paid, keep a client or close a deal. These business customers choose us because we're cheaper than carrier and roaming rates, reach mobile, landline and company numbers, need no contract, and use one balance for every country. Today we serve them with a consumer app. Tomorrow we want to be the obvious way small businesses call the world. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale the Calling for Work product proposition from 1 to 100. There's no mature roadmap to inherit: you'll write it, test it with customers and scale what works, with our Product & Tech team, to deliver a step change in segment growth. Ready to make an impact on the future of AI at DPG Media? Read on! What will you do? As a Backend Engineer, you take ownership of the platform capabilities that enable teams across DPG Media to securely use and manage AI products. You build backend services that unify user, access, usage and cost data while making architectural decisions that support the platform's continued growth. Your work ensures that new products and teams can be onboarded efficiently and consistently. You do this by: li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Defining how users, roles and permissions are managed centrally and applied consistently across every product on the GenAI Platform. Building backend services that collect, combine and expose usage, cost and user data for the platform portal and reporting. Designing scalable platform architecture that continues to perform as the number of products grows. Defining how platform resources are described so new products and teams can be added through configuration instead of custom development. Who are we? We are a small team that builds and operates the GenAI Platform used across DPG Media. The platform runs on Kubernetes and provides teams throughout the organisation with access to AI products, ranging from workflow automation to model hosting. What makes you the ideal candidate? For this role, we are looking for an experienced backend engineer who combines strong technical expertise with ownership and a pragmatic mindset. You are proactive, analytical and enjoy building scalable platform solutions. Experience integrating third-party APIs and combining data from multiple sources into one consistent view. Hands-on experience with OAuth2/OIDC, role-based access models and running services on Kubernetes. Experience adding metrics and alerts to the services you build. Additional experience with Go, Kubernetes controllers or operators, declarative reconcile-based systems, usage metering, FinOps data, Terraform or GenAI systems is considered an advantage. How do you work? You take ownership of your work from design through delivery and beyond. You focus on delivering practical solutions first and continuously improve them. You proactively identify opportunities for improvement, clearly explain your reasoning and remain open to alternative perspectives. You think ahead when making design decisions and build with long-term scalability in mind. Our stack li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Languages: Go for the platform control plane, TypeScript and Python for services and APIs. Platform: Kubernetes (EKS) on AWS, Terraform, Helm and ArgoCD. Observability: Grafana, Prometheus and OpenTelemetry. CI/CD: GitHub Actions. At DPG Media, we are open to all talent in society. Regardless of your background, we invite you to apply for this position. It is precisely through the differences between colleagues that surprising insights and innovative solutions emerge. And that fits very well with us as an organisation. We are curious about who you are and what qualities and experience you bring. Want to know more about our inclusive working environment, click here! What do we offer? At DPG Media, you will work in an inspiring environment that is constantly evolving. You will collaborate with colleagues who think in possibilities and you will have every opportunity to continue developing yourself through your work and the DPG Academy. li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> 💰 A competitive salary based on your work experience. 📝 A 36-hour work week in the Netherlands or a 38-hour work week in Belgium. 💰 8% holiday allowance and 4% personal choice budget. 💰 Annual profit sharing based on DPG Media's performance. 🎓 Opportunities to develop yourself both on the job and through the DPG Academy / DPG Campus. 🎉 The possibility to personalise your cultural public holidays. 🏢 Hybrid working, with office days agreed together with your team. Even more reasons to join DPG Media At DPG Media, we work for more than 90 leading news brands, magazines, television programmes, radio stations and online services such as Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, VTM and many more. Every month we reach more than 90% of people in the Netherlands and 8 out of 10 people in Flanders. We offer a professional working environment where freedom and personal development are highly valued. Through workshops and training, you are given every opportunity to invest in your future. Feel free to be an entrepreneur, a learner, a team player and, above all, yourself. Everyone is welcome at DPG Media. Discover everything we have to offer. And while you're at it, you can also find us on Instagram, LinkedIn and X. Applying, what's next? Are you ready to get started? Apply directly. title: Advertising Data Specialist
description: Amsterdam/Hilversum - Bereik 91% van alle Nederlanders met jouw werk! Als Advertising Data Specialist maak jij elke dag impact door middel van onze nieuwsmedia, magazines, online services, radio en TV. Je vertaalt de advertising doelstellingen van adverteerders naar slimme, datagedreven audience-oplossingen en draagt zo direct bij aan succesvolle campagnes. Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en onze mediaproducties versterken? Lees dan snel verder! Wat ga je doen? Als Advertising Data Specialist vertaal je de targeted advertising-doelstellingen van adverteerders naar de praktische implementatie binnen onze data- en advertentieplatformen. Met jouw technische inzicht en commerciële affiniteit ontwikkel en optimaliseer je audiences en dataproposities, zodat adverteerders hun doelgroepen effectief kunnen bereiken. Je neemt eigenaarschap over onze data offering, je volgt de prestaties, signaleert verbeterkansen en werkt continu aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons aanbod. Daarbij krijg je veel ruimte om met eigen ideeën te komen en initiatief te nemen. Zonder jouw expertise worden kansen op het gebied van doelgroepdata, automatisering en campagneprestaties niet optimaal benut. Dit doe je onder andere door: Verantwoordelijk te zijn voor het functioneel beheer en de optimalisatie van het Data Management Platform, inclusief de juiste inrichting, incidentmanagement en ondersteuning via verschillende kanalen. Segmenten en dataproposities te ontwikkelen, beheren en optimaliseren, zodat adverteerders gerichte campagnes kunnen inkopen op al onze titels, op (mobile) web, in-app en via connected audio & TV. Interne stakeholders te adviseren over de beschikbaarheid, mogelijkheden en inzet van doelgroepdata, audiences en privacyvraagstukken. Ontwikkelingen in de markt, nieuwe databronnen en AI-toepassingen te vertalen naar innovatieve audiences, producten en geautomatiseerde processen. Samen te werken aan projecten die de effectiviteit van onze data aantonen, analyses uitvoeren op audience prestaties en continu zoeken naar verbeteringen van onze data offering. Wie zijn wij? Je wordt onderdeel van het Advertising Data (BENE)-team binnen de afdeling Digital Sales Development. Vanuit Amsterdam of het Mediapark in Hilversum werk je in een omgeving die continu in ontwikkeling is. Ons team bestaat uit 17 collega's uit Nederland en België en richt zich op het ontwikkelen van nieuwe dataproposities, het aansluiten van nieuwe partners, het bouwen van eigen tools, het ontwikkelen van slimme AI-oplossingen en het aantonen van de kracht van onze data. Je werkt intensief samen met Product- en Innovatieteams, Ontwikkelteams en collega's binnen je eigen team om onze datagedreven advertentieoplossingen verder te ontwikkelen. Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat? Voor deze rol zoeken wij een gedreven mediaprofessional. Jij bent optimistisch, betrokken, gedreven en creatief. Daarnaast bezit jij: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding. Bij voorkeur 1 tot 2 jaar ervaring binnen digital advertising. Affiniteit met data, technologie en het ontwikkelen van datagedreven proposities, gecombineerd met een commerciële instelling. Je bent nieuwsgierig, ruimdenkend en proactief. Je neemt initiatief, onderzoekt wat wél mogelijk is en vertaalt jouw analytische blik naar verbeteringen, automatiseringsmogelijkheden, innovatieve oplossingen en nieuwe proposities. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, interesse in AI en het vermogen om collega's en sales te adviseren en enthousiasmeren over nieuwe mogelijkheden op het gebied van audiences en data. Bij DPG Media staan we open voor al het talent in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie. We zijn benieuwd wie jij bent en welke kwaliteiten en ervaring jij meebrengt. Wil je meer weten over onze inclusieve werkomgeving, klik dan hier ! Wat krijg je van ons? Bij ons krijg je een inspirerende werkomgeving die continu in beweging is. Collega’s die denken in mogelijkheden, het glas halfvol zien en we geven jou de kans je dagelijks te ontwikkelen. Dit doen we onder andere door onze DPG Campus/ DPG Academy. title: Teamleider Inbound

title: Senior Data Engineer
description: Data die het verschil maakt Data is pas waardevol als een organisatie erop kan bouwen. Als Senior Data Engineer bij LINKIT zorg jij daarvoor: je ontwerpt platformen die schaalbaar, betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn, en je kijkt verder dan de losse pipeline. Klinkt dat als jouw volgende stap? De uitdaging Als Senior Data Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in mobiliteit, energie en financiële dienstverlening. Je draagt bij aan platformen die er echt toe doen: data-oplossingen voor internationale treinreizen bij NS, moderne beleggingsplatformen bij Robeco en schaalbare data ecosystemen bij EDSN en Stedin. Je ontwerpt en bouwt schaalbare data pipelines in Cloud omgevingen, ontwikkelt betrouwbare datamodellen die organisatiebreed worden gebruikt en denkt actief mee over architectuur, performance en onderhoudbaarheid. Je werkt nauw samen met analytics- en data science-teams om data ML-ready te maken en verbetert bestaande oplossingen waar dat waarde toevoegt. Als Senior Data Engineer maak je zo het verschil op zowel technisch als strategisch niveau. Je plek binnen LINKIT Je werkt in de Data Engineering squad: een groep Explorers (zo noemen wij onze collega’s) die elkaar scherp houdt op vakmanschap en samen bouwt aan oplossingen voor complexe dataomgevingen. Als GenAI Engineer (medior/senior) maak jij het verschil tussen een interessante demo en een oplossing die elke dag werkt in een echt proces. Daarbij stuur je op drie dingen: sneller werken, betere antwoorden en minder repetitief werk voor de eindgebruiker. De uitdaging Generatieve AI ontwikkelt zich razendsnel. Toch willen organisaties voorspelbare en gerichte oplossingen die passen in hun informatievoorziening en processen. Als GenAI Engineer (medior/senior) kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, zoals de overheid, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM. Je werkt met de nieuwste frontier modellen en met platformen als Databricks, AWS Bedrock en Azure Foundry. Daarmee verken en bouw je robuuste implementaties: agentic workflows, LLM-teksttransformaties en RAG. Vaak pak je oplossingen op die in het lab veelbelovend bleken, en zet jij de laatste stap naar een echt proces. Evaluatie, feedback, monitoring en kostenbeheersing zijn daarbij geen bijzaak. Juist daardoor ontstaat de kwaliteit en het vertrouwen waarmee een oplossing landt. Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat wel én niet kan met AI. Je brengt pragmatische kennis in en zet door tot echte gebruikers jouw AI-output inzetten bij hun taken. Je plek Je sluit aan bij het AI&Data Engineering squad. Daar werk je met Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Samen bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot strak gemonitorde workflows met meerdere agents op Azure Foundry. Ons doel is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland worden, en daar heb jij directe invloed op. Om de twee weken komen alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag. Die dag is er tijd om te leren, kennis te delen en elkaar te spreken. Lees hier meer over de AI squad. Wat we vragen Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring als developer of data scientist, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar met GenAI toepassingen. Een stevige basis in data science of software engineering. Ervaring met het open source LLM-ecosysteem, zoals LangChain, DeepEval of DSPy. Ervaring met commerciële opties, zoals AWS AgentCore of Microsoft Agent Framework. Ervaring met serving tools, zoals FastAPI, FastMCP, serverless of containeromgevingen. Ervaring met monitoring en promptbeheer met MLflow of cloud native tools, of de drive om je daarin te verdiepen. Je begrijpt hoe LLMs en andere generatieve AI werken en je volgt de ontwikkeling van prompt naar context naar harness engineering. Je weet dat serieuze toepassingen strikte evaluatie, goede monitoring en feedbackloops vragen, en je bouwt die er vanaf het begin in. Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar ben je wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact. Wat je krijgt Salaris tussen €4.000 - €7.900 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld. Dit is een brede range omdat wij zowel op zoek zijn naar medior als senior Engineers. Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling. Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis. 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken. Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding. Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken. Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega’s terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag). Extra’s zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga. Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod. Vragen over deze rol? title: Product Manager (Web & App)
description: Shape how tens of thousands of patients experience Wellis digitally, from first website visit to long-term treatment. Own the roadmap for our web platform and mobile app, and drive experiments that improve conversion, retention, and satisfaction. Introduction The digital patient journey at Wellis is growing rapidly and becoming more complex. To take it to the next level, we're looking for a Product Manager Web & App. You will own the product roadmap and prioritization across our web platform and mobile app-from first visit and prescription flow through onboarding, subscriptions, and long-term engagement. Working closely with engineering, UX/UI, data, and key stakeholders across medical operations, marketing, and customer care, you'll turn insights into shipped improvements and experiments that lift conversion, retention, and satisfaction. This is a hands-on role with real ownership for an experienced product builder who wants to make Wellis' digital experience the benchmark in healthcare. About Wellis Wellis is a fast-growing healthtech scale-up that is reinventing one of the most traditional sectors: healthcare. What started just three years ago has already grown into a company with tens of thousands of customers, and we are only at the beginning. By combining medical expertise with technology and data, we make healthcare smarter, more efficient, and more personal. Our mission is to improve everyday lives by making care accessible, personal, and seamless. Through our platform, people can take control of their health journey with trusted medical support, smart digital tools, and tailored programs. We move fast, challenge conventions, and build solutions that truly make an impact, because we believe better healthcare should be within everyone's reach. About the Role As a Product Manager Web & App, you'll own the product direction for Wellis's web platform and mobile app across the full digital patient journey - from first visit through long-term treatment. You'll translate business goals, user needs, and medical requirements into a clear roadmap, and partner closely with design and engineering to ship improvements that drive conversion, retention, and satisfaction. With a strong eye for data and user insight, you'll identify friction points, run experiments with our CRO specialist, and align stakeholders across the business to keep the product vision sharp and execution moving fast. You will start by owning the web platform and the mobile app together across the full digital patient journey. Both are first-class products. As the team grows, ownership may concentrate more on the app. We want someone who thrives owning both at the start and can adapt if focus deepens into mobile later. Key Responsibilities Own the product roadmap and prioritization for Wellis's web platform and mobile app, translating business goals and user needs into clear features and improvements. Define, scope, and deliver product initiatives across the full digital patient journey - from first visit to long-term treatment and subscription management. Run product experiments together with our CRO specialist (A/B tests, feature releases) to improve conversion, retention, and user experience. Work closely with UX/UI and engineering to ship high-quality features that support weight management treatments, subscriptions, and the broader wellness platform. Analyze user behavior data, customer feedback (e.g., via Intercom), and medical team insights to identify friction points and opportunities for innovation. Set clear product objectives and success metrics, and continuously track outcomes (including conversion, app/feature adoption, and NPS for the digital experience). Align and manage stakeholders across medical operations, customer care, marketing, and leadership, while maintaining a clear product vision. Communicate roadmap progress, trade-offs, and learnings clearly, and help the organization make data-informed product decisions. About the Team In this role, you'll work day-to-day with Engineering and UX/UI to define, prioritize, and ship improvements across our web platform and mobile app. You'll also partner closely with colleagues in marketing & growth, data & analytics, medical operations, and customer care to translate business goals and patient needs into a clear roadmap and to validate decisions through research and experimentation. As our digital domain is growing fast, you'll have a key role in shaping how we build product at Wellis and how teams collaborate across the full digital patient journey. Who You Are Extremely entrepreneurial and resourceful . You invent paths when playbooks do not exist, and you ship without waiting for perfect conditions. Strong product instincts. You have a clear sense for what patients and the business need next, including when the data is incomplete. This role is 100% AI- and agent-enabled . You are comfortable with an agentic product development process and with working with agents as part of how you build. title: DevOps/Platform Engineer
description: Do you want to own the infrastructure under a health-tech operation that touches hundreds of thousands of lives? This is a dedicated infrastructure, security, and platform role, and there's a lot of ground to claim. Right now a handful of engineers keep the whole stack running between them. Your job is to turn that into something that runs and scales on purpose, and to make it more secure while you do. The more reliable we are, the more people we help lead healthier, happier lives. About Wellis Wellis is a fast-growing healthtech scale-up reinventing healthcare. We are building the first truly integrated health platform in the Netherlands, offering on-demand care for everyday health needs such as weight loss, hair loss, sexual health, and more. Our platform covers the full journey: from diagnosis and medical assessment to prescription and delivery at home. By combining medical expertise, technology, and data, we make healthcare smarter, more accessible, more personal, and easier to use. We are growing quickly, which means we are building the structures, teams, products, and processes that will help us scale responsibly. You will join an ambitious, international team where ownership is encouraged, collaboration is key, and impact is visible from day one. The Role You won't inherit a mature platform team here. You'll help build one. Our services already run across more than one cloud, most provisioning still happens by hand, and we have very little visibility into what's actually going on in production. Fixing that is the job: bringing order, portability, and security to all of it, and doing it the way our engineering team already works, which is agent-first. The role covers three areas, and we mean all three. On infrastructure, you'll own how and where we run. We want managed services that stay portable, so we can pick up a workload and move it between GCP, AWS, or anywhere else without rewriting it. On security, you'll own access provisioning, database security, secrets, and the controls a company handling patient data has to get right. On IT and platform admin, you'll own onboarding, offboarding, team access, and tooling: the unglamorous plumbing that keeps a growing team moving. What ties the three together is automation. We're not looking for someone to click through consoles all day. We're looking for someone who builds the systems and agents that make provisioning, deployment, and access self-serve. We're an AI-native engineering team. Agentic coding tools are how we work, and infrastructure is no exception. Think Terraform written and reviewed with an agent, runbooks that are actually scripts, an access request that a workflow fulfills on its own. You'll bring that habit to a corner of the company that usually gets it last. What You'll Own Provider-agnostic infrastructure. Define our infra as code so it's reproducible and portable. Containerize workloads, standardize how services get deployed, and keep us free to move between clouds instead of locked into one. Today we run across more than one provider mostly by accident. You'll make it a choice. CI/CD and release engineering. Build the pipelines that take code from merge to production safely: automated, repeatable, with the guardrails that let a small team ship often without breaking things. Observability and reliability. We have almost no monitoring, alerting, or error tracking today. You'll build the visibility layer from scratch, from metrics and logs through tracing, uptime, and the basics of on-call, so we catch problems before customers do. Security and access. Own IAM and least-privilege access across our systems, plus database hardening, secrets management, and the audit trails a regulated healthcare business needs. Access for people and services should be controlled and reviewable, never handed out ad hoc. Team provisioning and IT admin, automated. Onboarding, offboarding, accounts, and tooling access, built as workflows and agents rather than a ticket queue. When someone joins or leaves, the right things should happen without a person doing them by hand. Infrastructure agents and tooling. Build the skills, scripts, and agent workflows that let the whole team self-serve infra and access. This is the leverage that lets a small team run like a bigger one. What we offer Salary range €5,500 – €8,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance Pension plan Learning budget Monthly personal budget (Alleo) Hybrid working: partly from our new office in central Rotterdam (2 days) 20 days of remote working per year Working from home allowance (2 days a week) 25 holidays A culture of short lines, speed, and continuous improvement, where pragmatism and impact matter The chance to build a healthtech scale-up's entire infrastructure and security foundation from the ground up Essential 3+ years of professional DevOps, platform, SRE, or infrastructure engineering. You've owned production infrastructure, not just touched it. Fundamentals matter more than years here: what happens on deploy, how to recover, how to keep it running. Infrastructure as code, done properly. Terraform, Pulumi, OpenTofu, or equivalent. You provision through version control, not a console, and you know why that discipline matters. Cloud, with an eye on portability. Real experience with at least one major cloud (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and the container tooling (Docker, plus Kubernetes or a managed equivalent) that keeps workloads movable. You've thought about lock-in and how to avoid it. CI/CD ownership. You've built and maintained pipelines that other engineers depend on, with the automated checks and rollbacks that make frequent deploys safe. Security fundamentals. IAM and access control, secrets management, network basics, and database security. You know how to give people and services exactly the access they need and nothing more. Agentic AI development is how you work. You spend a real part of your day in tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Pi, or opencode, and you point them at infrastructure and ops, not just app code. Given a repetitive task, your instinct is to automate it. You've felt the pain. A migration that locked a table, a deploy that took down an endpoint, an access mistake you had to clean up at 2am. You owned it, fixed it, and built the guardrail so it couldn't happen twice. Nice to Have Building agents and agentic workflows, not just using them: plugins, skills, or custom automations that made infra or ops better for a team. Experience with regulated or sensitive data (healthcare, financial services, government). You know why 'move fast and break things' has no place near patient data. Observability tooling stood up from scratch: Sentry, Prometheus and Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or similar. IT administration at a growing company: SSO and identity providers, device and access lifecycle, automated on and offboarding. Audit logging and compliance in regulated environments (NEN 7513, GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar). Running Supabase, Postgres, or serverless and edge platforms (Cloud Run, edge functions) in production. Multi-cloud or cloud-migration experience, meaning you've moved real workloads between providers. Dutch and/or German (business English is the working language). Who You Are You take ownership from provisioning through deployment through monitoring, right up to the 2am page. You automate by instinct. Do something twice by hand and you're already writing the thing that does it for you. You're comfortable being the first and only person in your domain, making decisions that carry weight, with no team to hide behind yet. You treat security as the default. You handle access and data like someone's health depends on it, because it does. You work fast and stay careful. With Your Application Alongside your CV, share a transcript or a detailed walkthrough of the most interesting agentic session you've had recently, one where the agent did real infrastructure, ops, or automation work. Provisioning, a pipeline, a migration, an access workflow, whatever it was. Tell us what you were building, how you steered the agent, and what you'd do differently. We'd rather read that than a cover letter. Hiring Process We want the application process at Wellis to be fast, transparent, and personal. title: System & Infrastructure Engineer || Linux - Windows
description: We’re looking for a new colleague to join our Systems & Infrastructure team. In this role, you’ll work across the full WTSS IT infrastructure. And because of what we do, that infrastructure is genuinely interesting. It’s a broad technical role where Linux, Windows, networking, scripting and many different types of hardware all come together. Our infrastructure is essential to our daily operation. As a FinTech partner for banks, we run real-time banking and payment journeys. Day and night, we execute tests for our clients across all kinds of hardware — PCs, laptops, smartphones and tablets. That means your work directly contributes to our technical reliability, continuity and security. Together with two other colleagues, you’ll be responsible for keeping our environment running, maintaining it and continuously improving it. The goal is that you can fully cover for one another when needed. So we’re looking for someone who can work independently, keeps a clear overview and actually enjoys understanding multiple layers of infrastructure. Who is WTSS? Banks process millions of transactions every day. When something goes wrong, issues need to be found, understood and resolved quickly. That’s where we come in. WTSS is an independent FinTech partner for international banks. We act as a safe, patient and risk-free ‘pilot customer’, so banks don’t have to test new or critical journeys on their actual customers. We design structured test journeys — both manual and automated — across many different environments to detect issues early and help our clients understand what is really happening. From our HQ in Rotterdam, a small and highly technical team of around 20 people works for some of the world’s largest banks. We call ourselves ethical techies : curious technical people who enjoy breaking things in order to make them better. Incidents don’t scare us; they make us curious. What you’ll be doing This role is quite different from the average systems or infrastructure position. You won’t be one small part of a large DevOps transformation. The work is much more hands-on and technical — a bit like infrastructure work used to be, but without the slow-moving legacy environment. You’ll be working on things such as: Managing both Linux and Windows environments Scripting with Bash and PowerShell, and improving automation processes Managing and improving our network and firewall environment, including OPNsense firewalls with high-availability pairs and UniFi switches Working with virtualisation and backup environments, including Proxmox VE clusters, Ceph storage and Proxmox Backup Server In short: real, hands-on systems and infrastructure work. If you enjoy understanding how things work, solving technical problems and getting your hands dirty, your analytical brain will feel right at home here. Do you love technology as much as we do? You’ll join a team of people who genuinely enjoy tech. We’re the ones our families call when the printer won’t connect or the Wi-Fi starts acting strange. Some of us install a new operating system on our own laptop just for fun. On a Saturday. Voluntarily. If you have that same curiosity for new tools, technology and figuring out how things work, we’d love to hear from you. What you bring HBO-level working and thinking ability. Your exact degree matters less to us than how you think and how quickly you learn. A technical mindset that looks for solutions and enjoys solving problems, even under pressure. A careful and structured way of working: you follow steps accurately and quickly notice small differences or anomalies. Curiosity about hardware, banking, payments, security or FinTech is a big plus. What we offer A competitive salary A role you simply don’t come across very often Plenty of variety in a growing, tech-minded and no-nonsense team A solid pension plan, travel allowance and work-from-home allowance Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h4>Available Locations: <strong>London, New York City, Denver, Lisbon, Seattle, or Austin</strong></h4> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Millions of websites, applications, APIs, and AI agents run on Cloudflare, and the traffic we handle for them produces a lot of data. Some customers want to debug applications and investigate security events in Cloudflare. Others want that data in a stack they already trust, such as Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, or their own data lake. Many want both.</p> <p>We're hiring one Senior Product Manager for each of two areas. You apply once, and we'll work out together which role fits you best.</p> <p><strong>Observability Platform</strong> brings logs, traces, analytics, alerts, and dashboards together in one place, so customers can see what's happening and why. Today most observability ends with a notification, and the customer does the rest. We want a platform that understands the problem, takes action where it can, and asks before doing anything risky.</p> <p><strong>Telemetry Export</strong> delivers Cloudflare's data to the tools customers choose. Logpush handles most of that delivery today, and Workers Observability sends logs and traces over the OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP). description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <p>New York, NY<br>Washington, DC<br>Toronto</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare’s architecture is built on a homogeneous edge: every server in over 330 cities runs every service—from L4/L7 proxies (FL2, Pingora) and DNS to the Workers runtime, cache, and storage. While this design maximizes hardware utilization, it creates a difficult distributed attribution problem. Machine-level telemetry tells us how loaded a server is, but not which product, customer, or upstream service is responsible for that load.</p> <p><br>MAPS (Metrics and Analytics for Product Segmentation) is a newly formed team building the core instrumentation, collection, and data platform to solve this from the ground up. We are architecting a system to continuously measure CPU, network bandwidth, memory, and storage utilization across the entire global fleet without sampling—attributing resource consumption both to the underlying system service and to the specific product, account, and zone being served.</p> <p><br>The data MAPS produces serves two critical functions at Cloudflare:</p> <ol> <li>Real-Time Control Plane: MAPS is the primary telemetry input for Cloudflare’s next-generation global load balancer, shifting traffic management from open-loop heuristics to closed-loop routing driven by real-time, per-service resource capacity and consumption (within seconds).</li> <li>Fleet Economics & Capacity Planning: MAPS provides the long-term analytical dataset in ClickHouse used to map product demand forecasts to physical hardware requirements, calculate true cost-to-serve per product, and drive multi-year infrastructure investments.</li> </ol> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <p>You will work across the full lifecycle of a greenfield, high-throughput telemetry system running on every machine at the Cloudflare edge:</p> <ul> <li>Host-Level Instrumentation ("Outside View"): Build and maintain low-overhead Linux daemons (netacctd, maps_collector) in Rust and C that use eBPF (cgroup_skb) and cgroup v2 accounting to measure per-service resource consumption directly from the kernel.</li> <li>High-Performance Client Libraries ("Inside View"): Architect non-blocking, zero-allocation reporting SDKs in Rust and Go used by Cloudflare’s highest-throughput data-plane services to report per-request resource usage and product attribution over local Unix domain sockets.</li> <li>Edge Aggregation & Streaming: Build the per-machine collector daemon that ingests millions of events per second, performs bounded in-memory time-window aggregation, serves low-latency gRPC streams to the global load balancer, and flushes batch rollups to ClickHouse.</li> <li>Reconciliation & Correctness: Solve complex attribution problems—such as reconciling kernel-level cgroup measurements against application-reported metrics, and attributing resource usage when one multi-tenant service executes work on behalf of another.</li> <li>Cross-Team Architecture: Partner directly with the engineering teams behind Cloudflare’s core proxies, runtimes, and storage engines to instrument their critical paths without degrading tail latency.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <ul> <li>Strong systems programming experience in Rust, Go, or C, with a solid grasp of memory layout, concurrency, and performance-critical code paths.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating latency- and resource-sensitive server infrastructure or high-throughput data pipelines at scale.</li> <li>Strong fundamentals in Linux systems internals—processes, cgroups, sockets, and how the kernel accounts for compute, memory, and I/O.</li> <li>Proven ability to work across organizational boundaries: reading unfamiliar codebases, aligning with other infrastructure teams, and driving complex integrations to completion.</li> <li>A pragmatic approach to owning outcomes—from kernel-level data collection and wire protocols (protobuf/Cap'n Proto) all the way to the analytical tables consumers query.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience writing and verifying eBPF programs, or deep familiarity with the Linux networking stack and scheduler.</li> <li>Experience designing schemas and query patterns for distributed columnar databases (particularly ClickHouse) at high ingestion rates.</li> <li>Background in profiling, benchmarking, and debugging performance bottlenecks in production Linux environments (perf, PMU counters, flamegraphs).</li> </ul><div description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An Overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Senior Release Engineer to help design, standardize, and operate reliable enterprise application delivery across the Enterprise Technology & AI team. This role will establish scalable CI/CD practices for business-critical platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora and other Business Systems while enabling engineering teams to ship changes safely, quickly, and with clear operational controls.</p> <p>The ideal candidate combines strong release engineering and automation skills with practical experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications. You will build and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines, develop reusable scripts and deployment tooling, improve release governance, and partner with application, security, compliance, and business teams across the release lifecycle. Daily use of approved AI-assisted engineering tools, including Claude, Duo Agent Platform or comparable enterprise-approved tools, is a mandatory expectation for DevOps, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and automation activities.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications, including validation, testing, packaging, deployment, promotion, rollback, and post-release verification.</li> <li>Develop reusable automation using scripting languages such as Python to reduce manual release activities and improve repeatability.</li> <li>Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude or similar tools every day to accelerate pipeline development, scripting, test creation, troubleshooting, documentation, release analysis, and operational automation.</li> <li>Define and implement CI/CD patterns for platforms such as <strong>Salesforce, Zuora, </strong>and other <strong>Business Systems.</strong></li> <li>Establish environment and promotion strategies across development, test, staging, and production, including configuration management and deployment sequencing.</li> <li>Implement quality gates, automated checks, approvals, audit trails, and policy controls appropriate for enterprise application releases.</li> <li>Partner with application owners and development teams to define branching, versioning, release cadence, and rollback standards.</li> <li>Improve release observability through deployment dashboards, pipeline metrics, change records, notifications, and operational reporting.</li> <li>Investigate failed deployments and release issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable corrective actions.</li> <li>Contribute to release calendars, change planning, blackout-period coordination, and risk-based release decision-making.</li> <li>Build documentation, runbooks, reusable templates, and enablement materials so teams can title: Senior Data Engineer, Cloudforce One
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>London, UK</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudforce One is Cloudflare’s threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world’s largest global networks can provide. The team is able to analyze these unique data points, at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <p>You will join the data science team within Cloudforce One. We power much of the insight and intelligence delivered in Cloudflare’s <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/security-center/cloudforce-one/#analyze-threat-events">Threat Events</a> product, which customers can use to better protect themselves — for example, by <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/realtime-threat-intel-waf-rules/">turning our threat indicators into real-time WAF rules</a>. We own data pipelines that power analysis of Cloudflare’s DDoS and WAF data, including Cloudflare’s quarterly <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/ddos-threat-report-2026-q3/">DDoS Threat Report</a>. We also support internal Trust & Safety initiatives such as identifying and addressing network abuse, and collaborate directly with the Threat Intelligence team.</p> <p>As a Data Engineer, you will build the data foundation that makes this possible: designing and operating the scalable pipelines, analytical data stores, and data marts that turn raw Cloudflare telemetry into trusted, well-modeled datasets for threat researchers, data scientists, analysts, and customers.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operate scalable batch data pipelines on Kubernetes-hosted Airflow and Spark clusters that extract, enrich, and publish threat and abuse signals from Cloudflare’s network and platform telemetry.</li> <li>Build and evolve our data stores in Apache Iceberg (R2) and the curated data marts that serve Threat Events, Trust & Safety initiatives, and Threat Intelligence investigations.</li> <li>Model datasets deliberately — choosing grain, partitioning, and schema evolution strategies that keep data correct, queryable, and cost-efficient.</li> <li>Write and optimize SQL against large-scale analytical data in ClickHouse, balancing completeness, performance, and cost.</li> <li>Make pipelines safe to retry, resume, and backfill, so downstream consumers receive exactly the data we intend to publish.</li> <li>Build data quality checks, reconciliation, and monitoring that catch problems before they reach analysts, detections, or customers.</li> <li>Treat privacy and data minimization as design requirements from the start.</li> <li>Enable Threat Intelligence and Trust & Safety partners with the data they need for tooling and investigations, translating ad hoc requests into reusable datasets.</li> <li>Partner with data scientists to turn exploratory analysis into repeatable, production-quality data products and ML-ready datasets.</li> <li>Raise the team’s engineering bar through code review, testing, CI/CD, and documentation.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience designing, building, and operating scalable production data pipelines.</li> <li>Proven experience building analytical data stores and data marts, including data modeling, partitioning, and schema evolution.</li> <li>Strong Python for data engineering, including testing and maintainable, well-structured code.</li> <li>Strong SQL, including window functions, query optimization, and performance tuning on large datasets.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow in production, including Kubernetes-hosted deployments.</li> <li>Experience with distributed data processing (e.g. Spark or similar) at large scale.</li> <li>Experience with Apache Iceberg (or a comparable open table format) on object storage such as R2 or S3.</li> <li>Experience with ClickHouse or a comparable columnar analytical database.</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD, version control, and containerized deployments.</li> <li>Clear communication and the ability to turn ambiguous requirements from researchers and analysts into well-defined data products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with security, threat intelligence, fraud, or trust & safety / abuse data.</li> <li>Solid understanding of how the Internet works (DNS, HTTP, TLS, BGP).</li> <li>Experience supporting data science or ML workflows (feature stores, training datasets).</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, R2, R2 Data Catalog).</li> <li>Trino/Presto or other distributed query engines.</li> <li>Experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of your workflow.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span s

That means shaping usage into clear proposals, aligning pricing and packaging, giving the field repeatable motions, and feeding real-world signals back into Product. We work closely with Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, RevOps, and Marketing.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Frontier labs hire former CTOs as senior Members of Technical Staff: high-impact individual contributors tasked with solving the hardest problems without the overhead of team management. This role applies that model to go-to-market. We are seeking former sales leaders and founders to own Cloudflare's Developer Platform growth inside a select portfolio of the most important technology companies in the world.</p> <p>As a Strategic Account Director, you will own the long-term Developer Platform strategy and consumption growth for one to three of Cloudflare's top 10 accounts including frontier AI labs and the most innovative software companies. Over time, the largest of these accounts will move to a dedicated 1:1 model. You'll partner with the account team to guide strategic decisions, lead engagement with key executives, and bring developer fluency married to deep business acumen.</p> <p>You'll collaborate as a peer with Cloudflare's sales leadership and work closely with Solutions Architects, Forward-Deployed Engineers, and Product. You are fluent in both developer workloads and commercial mechanics. You can set a multi-year account strategy in the morning and work through a live deal in the afternoon.</p> <p><strong>What You Will Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Architect the account strategy.</strong> Build and execute a multi-year Developer Platform plan for each account: defining priority workloads, how adoption grows, competitive position, and the commercial path to get there.</li> <li><strong>Accelerate the customer journey (drive activation → expansion → commercial structure):</strong> Use usage telemetry to find next-best actions, expansion paths, and risks. Compete credibly against hyperscalers and other platforms.</li> <li><strong>Lead executive engagement.</strong> Build trusted relationships with CTOs and heads of infrastructure, AI, and engineering, as well as the commercial decision makers. Run impactful executive business reviews and leverage Cloudflare leadership at the right moments.</li> <li><strong>Mobilize Cloudflare.</strong> Align the account team, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Product, and Support on the account's priorities, establishing clear owners and driving flawless follow-through. Run GTM motions in step with the workloads where we've proven fit.</li> <li><strong>Close the loop with Product.</strong> Turn what you see in the account into clear, quantified recommendations on positioning, packaging, limits, and roadmap.</li> <li><strong>Elevate the field:</strong> Turn your account experience into workload blueprints, deal patterns, and playbooks. Coach sales leaders and account teams in a train-the-trainer model to scale your impact globally..</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years in technology sales, including senior sales leadership (Director, VP, or CRO) or strategic named-account roles at developer-platform or consumption-based companies, such as AWS, GCP, Vercel, MongoDB, Databricks, Snowflake, or an AI lab.</li> <li>A track record of growing consumption and revenue in large, complex, highly technical accounts over consecutive years.</li> <li>Executive presence and credibility with C-level and VP audiences at the fastest-moving technology companies.</li> <li>The ability to turn technical workloads into compelling commercial outcomes, and to navigate complex deal approvals with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Security.</li> <li>Deep experience with usage-based pricing and commit structures.</li> <li>Analytical rigor: you can read product usage telemetry and size opportunities at the level of Sheets or SQL.</li> <li>A clear persuasive writer and presenter, equally effective with developer ICs and executive sponsors.</li> <li>A builder's mindset: you lead through influence and get cross-functional work done without relying on hierarchy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience selling to, or working inside, frontier AI labs or AI-native companies.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI infrastructure workloads such as inference, agents, sandboxed code execution, large-scale storage, and globally distributed apps.</li> <li>Former startup CROs, Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <h3 class=

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | London, UK (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Cloudflare's Developer Platform powers stateful, data-intensive applications across our network. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work across the database stack, from query planning and execution to transaction processing and durable storage.</p> <p>You'll make decisions that shape the consistency, durability, and latency guarantees that customer applications rely on.</p> <p>Correctness under concurrency and failure is central to the role. You'll define and implement how queries read and modify data, how concurrent transactions become visible, and how durable state is recovered. You'll validate these systems using deterministic simulation, workload testing, and evidence from production.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Improve query planning and execution, including index selection, row reads and writes, and performance as data volumes and access patterns change.</li> <li>Build transaction and storage paths that make writes durable and reads consistent. Define when changes become visible, how commits survive failure, and how recovery restores a correct view of the data.</li> <li>Design deterministic simulations that make rare event orderings and failures reproducible.</li> <li>Plan stateful upgrades that cannot be reversed by rolling back software. Carry them through staged rollout, failover, and recovery without putting existing data at risk.</li> <li>Participate in the service's on-call rotation and incident response.</li> <li>Own major changes from design through production. Coordinate implementation across teams when a change spans multiple parts of the service, and help trace failures across those parts.</li> <li>Mentor other engineers through design reviews, debugging, and incident analysis involving concurrency, durability, and recovery.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You have owned a database, storage engine, transaction system, or similarly correctness-sensitive stateful system from architecture through production. You can make architecture and implementation decisions when requirements or system boundaries are incomplete.</li> <li>You understand how query execution, indexing, transaction processing, and durable state shape what developers and operators observe.</li> <li>You understand how concurrency control, isolation, replication, and snapshots shape consistency, durability, and recovery.
