title: Product Security Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX</p> <h4><strong>Role Summary</strong></h4> <p>As a Product Security Engineer, you will support security assessments and vulnerability operations for Cloudflare’s core software products. In this role, you will analyze system architecture, threat model new features, and ensure that product-related security findings are accurately triaged, routed to the correct engineering owners, and mitigated within our SLAs.</p> <p>On any given day, you might conduct a deep-dive security review on a new feature design, triage a complex bug bounty submission, or work directly with engineering teams to resolve vulnerabilities from different sources like bug bounties, SAST, fuzzing and penetration tests. You will also work autonomously to identify areas where our manual processes slow down. You will write code and integrate AI/LLM solutions to automate initial triage and data enrichment, building tools that help the team handle security findings at scale. In short, your work will sit at the intersection of Product Security, Vulnerability Operations, and internal AI Tooling. Ideally, you have experience in conducting academic/vulnerability research with a focus on systems security.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Implement AI Security Solutions:</strong> Identify process bottlenecks and build AI-driven tools or scripts to help automate code analysis, optimize triage, and streamline Product Security workflows.</li> <li><strong>Security Reviews & Threat Modeling:</strong> Conduct structured security reviews and threat modeling sessions (e.g., STRIDE) across product features, defining security requirements early in the development lifecycle.</li> <li><strong>Product Vulnerability Management:</strong> Manage the operational lifecycle of product security findings. Ensure vulnerabilities are verified, mapped to the correct engineering owner, and tracked to mitigation in alignment with established SLAs.</li> <li><strong>Bug Bounty Triage:</strong> Perform the technical triage and validation of Cloudflare’s external Bug Bounty submissions, verifying exploitability and evaluating business risk.</li> <li><strong>Pentest Coordination:</strong> Support internal and external penetration testing engagements by reviewing findings, clarifying technical context, and assisting development teams with remediation strategies.</li> <li><strong>Engineering Collaboration:</strong> Partner closely with DevOps and product teams, acting as a reliable security point of contact and helping developers implement secure coding practices.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Product/AppSec Expertise:</strong> 5+ years of experience in Product or Application Security within large-scale distributed cloud environments or SaaS platforms.</li> <li><strong>Practical AI & Automation Engineering:</strong> Demonstrated ability to build production-grade automation scripts and tools. Must possess hands-on engineering experience leveraging AI/LLMs to solve operational or technical challenges.</li> <li><strong>Threat Modeling & Risk Analysis:</strong> Competency in threat modeling methodologies and the ability to evaluate code flaws to determine their actual engineering and security impact.</li> <li><strong>Vulnerability Lifecycle Operations:</strong> Experience tracking, routing, and driving the remediation of software vulnerabilities across engineering groups while working against defined SLAs.</li> <li><strong>Strong Collaboration & Communication:</strong> Ability to collaborate effectively across teams, clearly communicating technical security risks to software engineers and resolving ownership ambiguity constructively.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Offensive Security Tooling:</strong> Familiarity with modern exploitation techniques, fuzzing frameworks, or automated scanning utilities.</li> <li><strong>Program Management Experience:</strong> Experience scaling crowdsourced security programs (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd) or optimizing agile project management workflows within JIRA.</li> <li>Experience in integrating hardware security features into production code bases</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Outcomes Architect, Nordics (Customer Success)
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 3+ years experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working NICE TO HAVES: - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale. - Fluency in additional languages Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €94,000-€105,000per year. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: We’re hiring the first recruiter on the ground in Singapore to build Notion’s GTM team across Southeast Asia. You’ll own GTM hiring end to end and help build the next evolution of our go-to-market organization, recruiting for new and evolving customer-facing roles, including BDRs, Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and field sales leadership, that bring stronger technical fluency, deeper customer ownership, and fewer handoffs to enterprise selling. You’ll partner closely with the Country Manager, Singapore, sales leadership, and cross-functional teams to turn an emerging business strategy into clear profiles, thoughtful processes, and exceptional hires. You’ll inherit a global recruiting playbook and develop the operating rhythm for the region. You’ll also have a direct hand in shaping the culture of the SEA team as it forms, and be the subject matter expert on the ground. You’ll use Notion every day in the same way our customers do, giving you firsthand insight into the workflows and AI transformation behind the roles you are hiring for, and help build a new GTM motion at the intersection of AI, workflow design, enterprise transformation, and customer outcomes. The work requires craft, clarity, speed, and strong judgment, balancing business urgency with a high bar for talent density. We work from our Singapore office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own Singapore and SEA GTM hiring, from BDRs and Solutions Consultants to Outcomes Architects and field sales leadership, and help shape what the team looks like as it scales. - Establish the recruiting motion locally by building the process, systems, stakeholder rhythms, and candidate experience for SEA. - Help shape the culture of the SEA team as it forms, setting the hiring bar and the candidate experience that define what it feels like to join Notion here. - Partner directly with APAC GTM leadership on org design, role definition, market realities, and hiring decisions, and be the advisor they trust on what is achievable in the market. - Own complex and ambiguous searches end to end, setting strategy, diagnosing problems, pivoting when needed, and driving toward an outcome without waiting for direction. - Build deep Singapore and APAC talent networks and market intelligence, and use both to improve where and how Notion competes for talent. - Navigate high-stakes candidate and stakeholder situations, including compensation and closing conversations, with clarity and strong judgment. - Identify patterns across roles and regions and drive solutions that improve how the wider Recruiting team works. - Mentor teammates and share repeatable practices as the APAC team scales. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - A strong record of GTM hiring in Singapore and APAC across BDR, sales, solutions consulting, and field leadership roles. - Deep recruiting craft across sourcing, assessment, candidate engagement, offer strategy, and close. - A strong record of delivering complex, ambiguous, or first-of searches and building the playbook when one does not exist. - Experience influencing senior sales leaders as a talent advisor and recruiting subject matter expert. - Strong situational awareness and business maturity, with the judgment to navigate competing priorities and know when to push back or escalate. - A systems mindset and evidence of improving team practices beyond your own portfolio. - Curiosity, learning agility, and a hands-on approach to AI tools that improve recruiting quality and leverage. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience as an early recruiting hire in a market or region, setting up the motion while hiring at pace. - Experience owning the end-to-end hiring process at a global SaaS company. - Experience hiring across multiple APAC markets. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Principal Growth Marketing Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>New York, US</li> <li>San Francisco, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>As a Principal Growth Marketing Manager on the Product Led Growth team, you set the growth strategy for a major set of audiences and product areas. You decide where Cloudflare should invest to win customers, how product-led and sales-assisted motions connect, and how marketing adapts as people increasingly discover and evaluate tools through AI.</p> <p>You still build. You write the theses, the messaging standards, the journey architecture, and the measurement model yourself. You also raise the capability of the growth marketers around you. Product leaders bring you in early to hear what they want amplified, and you give them a clear, evidence-based read on which messages are landing and which are not.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Set PLG growth strategy.</strong> Develop audience-centered growth theses that connect market insight, product usage, and business goals.</li> <li><strong>Lead product partnership.</strong> Work with senior product and engineering leaders to understand what they want amplified, and give them a clear read on which messages are landing and which are not.</li> <li><strong>Remove adoption friction.</strong> Diagnose signup-to-adoption funnels across products, prioritize the largest sources of friction, and drive cross-functional fixes to completion.</li> <li><strong>Build instrumentation and data pipelines.</strong> Design event instrumentation, data models, and pipelines that support growth goals: funnel and cohort reporting, attribution, and audience segmentation. Work with data and engineering teams to keep the data trustworthy.</li> <li><strong>Lead AI-era discovery.</strong> Set the strategy for how Cloudflare is discovered and adopted through AI assistants, docs, and free tools, and define how success is measured.</li> <li><strong>Set the messaging bar.</strong> Define messaging frameworks and copy standards for growth programs, and personally write or edit high-stakes launch and campaign copy.</li> <li><strong>Drive measurement and investment.</strong> Establish the metrics model, experiment program, and attribution approach.</li> <li><strong>Represent growth.</strong> Present results and recommendations to senior leadership and partner organizations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <ul> <li>A clear growth strategy for your area that is measurably moving activation and retention.</li> <li>Friction fixes shipped with Product and Engineering that show improvements in onboarding metrics.</li> <li>Product teams routinely ask for your read on which messages are landing.</li> <li>Growth reporting runs on instrumentation and pipelines that teams trust.</li> <li>Senior and mid-level marketers growing in scope and quality under your guidance.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</span></em></p> <ul> <li>8+ years in growth, lifecycle, performance, or product marketing, including leading multi-channel programs at scale.</li> <li>A track record of growth strategies that changed adoption or revenue outcomes, not only campaign activity.</li> <li>Advanced data fluency: you design experiments and metrics frameworks, challenge weak attribution, are fluent in SQL, and have built or specified event instrumentation and data pipelines.</li> <li>Understanding of how different types of customers evaluate and adopt complex products.</li> <li>Strong hands-on craft: you still write copy, build journeys, and can tell when work is not good enough.</li> <li>Executive communication: you can frame a complex program for leadership in a few clear points.</li> <li>Proven ability to influence across Product, Engineering, GTM, and Marketing without direct authority.<br> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> </li> <li><strong>Prior success</strong> marketing infrastructure, security, or other technical products to technical buyers</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated ability</strong> to build or scale a product-led growth or lifecycle function from an early stage</li> <li><strong>Passion for</strong> mentoring junior team members</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $195,000 - $245,000</li> <li>For NYC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $180,000 - $230,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Engineering Manager, Bots & Fraud
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Washington D.C.; New York City</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>Our team builds the products that answer "Can we trust this traffic?" Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we deliver to our customers.</p> <p>Our products address a broad and evolving range of traffic integrity challenges. Examples include managing unwanted scraping, controlling access for bots and AI agents, and identifying fraud and abuse while minimizing friction for legitimate users. Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment, using Cloudflare's global network signals, threat intelligence, and machine learning. We turn those signals into analytics and controls that customers can understand, trust, and act on. These are challenging engineering problems at the intersection of distributed systems, data, security, and customer experience.</p> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <ul> <li>You have a track record of leading engineering teams, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and supporting professional growth. Your past teams respect you as both a technical leader and a people manager.</li> <li>You have a strong foundation in software engineering, with experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and services.</li> <li>You have taken projects from inception to production and overseen execution to meet commitments in a fast-paced, iterative engineering environment.</li> <li>You connect business goals with technical decisions, explain both the "why" and the "how," and make thoughtful tradeoffs when requirements are uncertain.</li> <li>You work effectively across Product, Engineering, and other functions to align priorities, remove blockers, and deliver shared outcomes.</li> <li>You communicate clearly with engineers, customers, and senior leadership, adapting the level of technical detail to your audience.</li> <li>You use AI fluently in engineering workflows and have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where it falls short.</li> <li>You are curious about web security, bot management, fraud and abuse, and the evolving role of AI agents on the Internet. You do not need to know our exact stack, but you should be eager to go deep in the domain.</li> </ul> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team building and scaling Cloudflare's products for bot management, fraud detection, and abuse mitigation. You will recruit, mentor, and grow talented engineers, provide technical leadership, and partner closely with Product Management to shape and deliver the engineering roadmap.</p> <p>You will partner with detection and research teams to turn their signals into reliable, performant, and easy-to-use customer solutions. Our systems span real-time services running across Cloudflare's global network, APIs and configuration, and high-volume data and analytics pipelines. You will collaborate across engineering and product teams to bring new capabilities into production and continuously improve the customer experience.</p> <h3><strong>Key responsibilities:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team.</strong> Hire, mentor, and empower engineers through clear feedback, thoughtful career development, and a culture of ownership and technical excellence.</li> <li><strong>Shape and deliver the engineering roadmap.</strong> Partner with Product Management to translate customer problems into incremental deliverables, balancing new capabilities with reliability, performance, and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Provide technical leadership.</strong> Participate in design discussions and guide decisions about scalable distributed services, product integrations, APIs, and analytics.</li> <li><strong>Turn detection signals into customer capabilities.</strong> Partner with detection and research teams to deliver actionable analytics and configurable controls, helping customers balance security, user experience, and privacy.</li> <li><strong>Measure and improve customer outcomes.</strong> Work with Product and detection partners to use feedback and production data to improve effectiveness, reduce unnecessary friction, and make products easier to adopt.</li> <li><strong>Own operational health.</strong> Ensure your team's services have effective observability, safe releases, incident response, and follow-through on improvements.</li> <li><strong>Drive cross-team execution.</strong> Resolve dependencies, align priorities across teams, and work with customer-facing partners to address recurring product problems at their roots.</li> </ul> <h3>Additional Experience We Value</h3> <ul> <li>Experience building bot management, fraud detection, application security, or other products that make decisions in an adversarial environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with HTTP, browser technologies, JavaScript, and the tradeoffs between security, privacy, and user experience.</li> <li>Experience integrating machine learning models into production systems or partnering closely with data science and machine learning teams.</li> <li>Experience with high-volume data pipelines, analytics services, or columnar databases such as ClickHouse.</li> <li>Experience with technologies used title: Telco Cloud Field Engineer

description: <p><strong>The role of a Telecommunications Field Engineer at Canonical</strong></p> <p>The telco industry is moving to software-defined services. This transformation is driven by open source software, cloud computing and the move to VNF / CNF approaches. Canonical Ubuntu is a key platform for telco innovation, and we are growing our team of specialists who work in the industry to accelerate the change.</p> <p>Canonical enables operators and communications service providers to embrace this new world, with a focus on platforms such as Ubuntu, OpenStack, and Kubernetes, and reusable, high quality automation for operations at scale.</p> <p>As part of the Canonical Field Engineering organization, you will lead customers through the design and delivery of OpenStack, Kubernetes, and software-defined networking solutions. Your passion for open-source technologies will enable customers to understand and operate advanced infrastructure substrates to meet the demands of 5G, sovereign AI, and beyond.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Remote-based, Americas and EMEA</span></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What your day will look like</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Translate Service Provider requirements into practical telco cloud platform architectures, enabling VNF/CNF, NFV, and MEC workloads at scale</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Provide technical pre-sales consulting to Service Provider teams</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Design and implement telco-grade open source multi-tenant private clouds and micro clouds</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Investigate, report and/or fix software defects uncovered during customer deployments</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Demonstrate advanced Infrastructure as code (IaC) techniques relevant to telco</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Architect and implement advanced, resilient Service Provider Cloud and Application solutions</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Design and deliver software defined infrastructure with OpenStack, Kubernetes, MAAS and Ceph</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Help customers adopt advanced Bare Metal, Public, Private and Hybrid Cloud solutions</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Support customer tenant onboarding, participate in architectural and business capability discussions, and enable successful adoption and production readiness of customer use cases</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Learn from customer engagements and drive meaningful product improvements</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Shape our roadmap to accelerate our growth in the telco market</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>A thorough technical understanding of the telco NFVi (VIM), NFVO, VNFM and MEC space and key telco cloud infrastructure technologies like CPU Pinning, NUMA, SR-IOV, DPDK, etc</li> <li>Familiarity with telco architecture and industry standards</li> <li>Working knowledge of at least <strong>one of the following domains</strong>: Mobile Packet Core (4G/5G), Private Network, Radio Access Network (RAN), Voice, IP Backbone, VAS or OSS/BSS</li> <li>Working knowledge of Linux, Networking, OpenStack and Kubernetes</li> <li>Python software development experience for automation</li> <li>Ability to lead complex projects from start to finish</li> <li>A collaborative, customer-centric mindset with a strong focus on customer success</li> <li>Able to travel up to 25% of the time based on business requirements for events, customer meetings, project delivery</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Additional skills that you might also bring</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Second language such as Spanish, Portuguese or French</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Track record of open source contributions</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Understanding of AI and machine learning concepts, including sovereign AI, and their potential applications in telco environments, such as network optimization, predictive maintenance, unified communication, and customer experience improvement</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Exposure to frameworks such as 3GPP, TM Forum ODA, eTOM, ETSI NFV, ONAP, O-RAN, or similar is a plus</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.</p> <p>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.</p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Annual compensation review</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Recognition rewards</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Parental Leave</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. </span><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</span></a></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-remote </span></p>

title: Senior Treasury Capital Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Dublin, Ireland | 💰€100,000 - €130,000,  Incentive Awards tied to your performance➕ benefits </p> <p><strong>⭐Our Finance team</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a dynamic Treasury Capital Manager in Dublin to become a key part of the team building the new Monzo European entity. Reporting into the Director of Treasury and Capital, you will shape, develop and implement the Capital management process and infrastructure in tandem with supporting the growth and strategic development of the business. As well as skills and experience in Treasury and Capital Management, the ability to adapt, be creative and work in a fast paced environment with wider Group colleagues will be essential talents as the business grows.</p> <p>As part of a new and growing team, the Treasury Capital Manager will be responsible for ensuring that Monzo effectively manages its capital and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements in Europe. This is an opportunity to be part of something from the start and make a real difference.</p> <p><strong>🔑</strong><strong>You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the planning and production of Monzo Europe’s ICAAP in line with regulatory capital requirements.</li> <li>Develop capital plans and forecasts, including stress testing and scenario analysis.</li> <li>Lead the planning and implementation work in line with Monzo’s recovery and resolution requirements including the Recovery Plan and Solvent Wind Down Plan.</li> <li>Identify the impact of prudential regulatory change and supporting relevant teams to assess and adapt to the challenges.</li> <li>Optimise the capital structure and allocation to support growth and strategic objectives.</li> <li>Prepare and present regular financial reports and forecasts to senior management.</li> <li>Building strong relationships with internal teams such as the business/product collectives to optimize the bank's capital structure and funding strategies.</li> <li>Provide operational coverage for the Director of Treasury and Capital during holidays.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩We’d love to hear from you if you have…</strong></p> <ul> <li>A bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field. A Master’s degree or professional qualification (e.g., CFA, ACA, ACCA) is preferred.</li> <li>A minimum of 5 years of experience in Treasury Capital management, within the banking sector, a consultancy, or regulatory body.</li> <li>Have detailed knowledge/experience of the European regulatory requirements, and the ability to interpret what that means for the relatively unique circumstances of our bank.  </li> <li>Have the ability to coordinate, participate and lead projects to produce regulatory deliverables and maintain the Bank’s set of prudential documentation and supporting materials.</li> <li>Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.</li> <li>Strong leadership abilities and experience in working across dispersed teams.</li> <li>Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰A salary range of €100,000 - €130,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week.</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An introductory call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, behavioural & leadership principles interviews</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-ÉS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

title: Data Center Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Location: Austin, San Francisco or New York</strong></h3> <h3>About the role</h3> <p>Cloudflare is hiring a Data Center Architect to define and deliver the physical infrastructure behind high-density compute and GPU deployments across our global network. You'll own 3 connected domains: the liquid cooling chain, the low-voltage connectivity layer, and the MV/LV electrical architecture that powers both.</p> <p>This is a senior individual-contributor role spanning architecture, detailed design, technical qualification, design governance, commissioning, and operational readiness. You're Cloudflare's owner-side technical lead in these domains: the person who connects what our hardware needs with what colocation providers, equipment manufacturers, and delivery partners can actually build.</p> <p>Scope runs from a single rack in commercial colocation to multi-megawatt compute deployments. You'll design power, cooling, and cabling as one system so they don't fight each other at the rack, in the white space, or during maintenance.</p> <p>If your background is only HVAC design, only cold-plate research, or only utility-scale generation, this role will be wider than you expect. We need someone who can hold the electrical, cooling, and cabling layers together.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>We work with engineering, capacity planning, network strategy, supply chain, and operations to grow Cloudflare's data center and PoP footprint. With colocation providers, hardware suppliers, and delivery partners worldwide, we turn infrastructure requirements into deployments that come online faster, cost less, and work the first time.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <h4>Architecture and reference designs</h4> <ul> <li><strong>Own the physical-infrastructure architecture.</strong> Build reference designs for power, liquid cooling, and connectivity for AI and high-density compute, including how they interface at rack, row, and site level. Maintain the standards, templates, and libraries that deployment, operations, and partner teams build from.</li> <li><strong>Translate hardware and capacity needs into engineering requirements.</strong> Turn heat loads, electrical loads, port counts, network topologies, and growth plans into power, cooling, and connectivity requirements and into site and rack qualification criteria.</li> <li><strong>Qualify sites and facility interfaces.</strong> Assess provider power and cooling availability, utility and backup capacity, water supply and return conditions, hydraulic capacity, upstream heat rejection, expansion headroom, maintenance constraints, and contractual boundaries. Give go/no-go recommendations with the risks written down.</li> </ul> <h3>Electrical power architecture (MV/LV)</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Lead MV and LV electrical architecture:</strong> single-line diagrams, power distribution, switchgear and UPS topology, busway and PDU design, grounding and bonding.</li> <li><strong>Design physical power infrastructure,</strong> AC and DC, including power conversion, backup generation, energy storage, and distribution, with attention to fault levels, selectivity, and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Validate designs with modeling:</strong> load-flow, short-circuit, arc-flash, and selectivity studies, checked against measured performance where possible.</li> <li><strong>Define digital power requirements</strong> for monitoring, metering, protection coordination, and control. Work with controls and operations teams on alarm thresholds, trend retention, remote monitoring, and BMS/SCADA integration.</li> <li><strong>Fold emerging standards</strong> (NEC, NFPA, UL, OCP power and rack specs) into forward-looking electrical designs.</li> </ul> <h3>Liquid cooling</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own the liquid-cooling architecture and roadmap.</strong> Develop repeatable direct-to-chip designs and evaluate liquid-to-liquid, liquid-to-air, rear-door, and other approaches against deployment needs.</li> <li><strong>Design and validate the hydraulic system.</strong> Flow and pressure-drop calculations, pipe sizing, pump selection, balancing, and control requirements. Validate at partial load, during expansion and maintenance, and in failure scenarios, not just at nameplate.</li> <li><strong>Specify equipment and rack integration.</strong> Qualify CDUs, heat exchangers, pumps, manifolds, hoses, quick-disconnects, valves, and instrumentation. Coordinate rack access, piping routes, service clearances, and installation sequencing with the electrical, cabling, hardware, and structural disciplines.</li> <li><strong>Own coolant integrity and serviceability.</strong> Set manufacturer-aligned requirements for fluid quality, material compatibility, cleanliness, filtration, corrosion control, condensation prevention, and leak detection. Make isolation, fluid handling, component replacement, and servicing safe and maintainable.</li> </ul> <h3>Low-voltage connectivity and structured cabling</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own the physical-layer architecture.</strong> Reference designs for rack, row, cage, and site connectivity: copper and fiber distribution, patch-panel placement, cross-connect demarcations, diverse routes, and reserved expansion capacity.</li> <li><strong>Engineer fiber and copper connectivity.</strong> Specify media, connectors, trunks, cassettes, and patching for equipment reach and performance. Validate optical loss budgets, connector counts, polarity, breakouts, bend radius, and compatibility across hardware generations.</li> <li><strong>Produce buildable designs.</strong> Pathway layouts, fiber schedules, port-to-port patching plans, cable-length schedules, bills of materials, and installation specs.</li> <li><strong>Connect to colocation and carrier infrastructure.</strong> Qualify meet-me-room access, provider pathways, cross-connect options, demarcation points, and route diversity. Define handoffs with data center providers, carriers, ISPs, and Cloudflare's network strategy team.</li> </ul> <h3>Integration, controls, and resilience</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Coordinate white-space interfaces.</strong> Layouts that account for rack access, airflow, liquid-cooling pipes and manifolds, power segregation, pathway capacity, and expansion. Coordinate supports, bonding, grounding, and firestopping with the responsible disciplines and providers.</li> <li><strong>Design for resilience and controlled failure.</strong> Evaluate redundancy, shared failure dependencies, cooling and power interruptions, and thermal ride-through. Agree protective responses with hardware and operations teams for pump or CDU failure, loss of facility cooling, leaks, sensor faults, control failures, and power events.</li> <li><strong>Define controls and operational visibility:</strong> temperatures, pressures, flows, power metering, leak alarms, equipment status, and capacity telemetry.</li> </ul> <h3>Governance, delivery, and acceptance</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Be Cloudflare's owner-side design authority.</strong> Own basis-of-design documents, single-line diagrams, P&IDs, cabling and equipment schedules, interface requirements, scopes, responsibility matrices, review gates, and acceptance criteria. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal or London, United Kingdom or Austin, Texas or New York City</strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The Egress team was formed to own a very important aspect of Cloudflare's <a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/connectivity-cloud/">Connectivity Cloud</a>: egress connectivity for our vast portfolio of products. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. In an acceleratingly dangerous world, the scope of that mission has changed. We are becoming something more: critical infrastructure. Banks run their payment rails on us. Governments run public services on us. Media companies depend on us during live events. Health systems depend on us to provide care. Reliability for these customers is no longer a feature of our product. It is a mission.</p> <p>Serving that customer base demands a different operating model. Traditional support organizations route tickets. Traditional engineering organizations ship features. Neither alone is enough when the stakes are this high. We are pivoting to something different: a customer-facing engineering organization, directly engaged with our customers at scale. This is work a central dev team cannot do from the inside of the network.</p> <p>The Customer Reliability Engineering function is the spine of that pivot. CRE is SRE applied outward, the same engineering discipline, applied to the reliability of the systems our customers run on Cloudflare. You are the engineer who owns the problems that matter most to the customers who matter most, and you contribute directly to our products and tooling, in partnership with Product Engineering, to hold that standard across the entire customer base.</p> <p>CRE is a rapid response team and a proactive engineering team. You fix things at the edge as they come up, and you help build the product capabilities that identify customer issues before they become a crisis. Both modes are equally core.</p> <p><strong>Rapid response.</strong> When a customer issue surfaces that is high-severity, cross-layer and complex, you are the engineer who answers. You reproduce the defect, isolate the root cause across Cloudflare's infrastructure and the customer's stack, drive the fix with Product Engineering, and confirm resolution. You hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global shift rotation.</p> <p><strong>Proactive engineering.</strong> When no fire is burning, you work with Product Engineering and our platform teams to build the capabilities that make the next fire cheaper or unnecessary: telemetry pipelines that correlate signals across the customer base, detectors that fire before a human notices, diagnostic tooling that scales across hundreds of customers, automation that reduces toil for Customer Support. Every incident you carry generates engineering output that reduces the cost of recurrence. The work compounds.</p> <p>Cloudflare is building CRE as an AI-native function. You will work with and help build agents and tooling that pre-diagnose incidents, surface relevant logs and configuration, and propose fixes with cited evidence. Engineers who ship AI-assisted diagnostics are the ones defining this discipline.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <h3>Rapid response:</h3> <ul> <li>Own a Sev-1 incident where a large financial services customer sees asymmetric latency from a single POP. Trace it through BGP routing and origin configuration. Produce the fix upstream.</li> <li>Diagnose a recurring WebSocket disconnect that a media customer has been fighting for weeks. Isolate it to a specific interaction between WAF and their origin load balancer. Drive the fix with Product Engineering.</li> <li>Partner with a government customer's SRE team during an active DDoS event. Help them shape their Magic Transit and WAF configuration in real time.</li> </ul> <h3>Proactive engineering:</h3> <ul> <li>Build, with Product Engineering, a distributed tracing capability that correlates Cloudflare edge signals with customer origin metrics so a single query tells the story of a failing request end-to-end.</li> <li>Ship a detector for a class of WAF false positives silently degrading several customers. Get it into production before the next renewal cycle.</li> <li>Prototype an AI agent that takes a new customer case, pulls relevant logs and config, and proposes a root cause with linked evidence. Deploy it internally. Measure whether it makes engineers faster. Iterate.</li> <li><strong>Rapid incident response and root cause analysis.</strong> Own the most complex, high-severity customer issues end-to-end, from first signal through confirmed resolution. Lead deep-dive debugging across the full stack: edge, network, DNS, transport, APIs, application, customer-side configuration. Reproduce defects, validate fixes with Engineering, and confirm customer-side resolution. Produce postmortems other engineers rely on. Hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global rotation that includes weekends.</li> <li><strong>Proactive reliability engineering.</strong> Analyze support and telemetry signals across the customer base to find systemic risks before they become incidents. Contribute monitoring, detection, and diagnostic capability to the core product and the engineering systems that give Customer Support early visibility into customer-affecting issues. Define customer-facing reliability metrics (error rates, resolution times, repeat-contact rates) and drive measurable improvement. Write automation that reduces mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-resolve.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional partnership.</strong> Manage the technical escalation lifecycle with clear ownership and timely communication. Partner with Product Engineering to drive fixes, workarounds, and configuration changes that address underlying gaps. Represent the customer reliability perspective in engineering syncs, incident reviews, and post-mortem processes.</li> <li><strong>Technical leadership and enablement.</strong> Raise the technical floor of Customer Support through pair-debugging, structured knowledge transfer, and shared tooling. Document diagnostic procedures and resolution patterns in runbooks, internal knowledge bases, and AI skills. Share insights from customer-facing incidents to improve product documentation and operational readiness.</li> <li><strong>Product and platform depth.</strong> Maintain deep, current expertise across Cloudflare's product portfolio: edge networking, DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation, Zero Trust, Workers, and our developer platform. Anticipate customer impact from new releases and architecture changes. Serve as a go-to subject-matter expert in one or more domains.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in site reliability engineering, escalation engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable deeply technical support / operations role, with at least 2 years in customer-facing environments.</li> <li>Strong foundation in networking and security: <ul> <li>TCP/IP fundamentals: OSI model, IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, routing, switching.</li> <li>Core protocols: DNS, HTTP/S, TLS/SSL, SMTP, SNMP, NTP.</li> <li>Routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, including path selection and route propagation.</li> <li>Firewall concepts: stateful/stateless inspection, rule sets, NAT, ACLs.</li> <li>VPN and encryption: IPSec, SSL/TLS tunnels, GRE.</li> <li>Zero Trust architecture, network segmentation, modern security models.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Proficiency with observability and diagnostic tooling: packet capture and analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump), log aggregation (Kibana, Elasticsearch), metrics dashboards (Grafana), distributed tracing.</li> <li>Strong scripting and automation skills (Bash, Python) with a track record of shipping tooling that improves reliability and reduces toil.</li> <li>Experience with incident management, postmortem culture, and SLO/SLI-based reliability practices.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Kansas City, MO</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executive to join our Territory/Field Sales team. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).</p> <p>As an Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Revenue Generation:</strong> Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.</li> <li><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.</li> <li><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Engagement Leadership:</strong> Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</li> <li><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.</li> <li><strong>Compelling Value Creation:</strong> Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution.
